sql_infos.sql: SELECT COALESCE(p.playerid::text, d.playerid::text) AS playerid_combined, p.lastname, p.firstname, d.draftyear, ap.season_id, ap.points, pt.year, pt.points AS regular_season_points, SUM(ap.points) OVER(PARTITION BY COALESCE(p.playerid::text, d.playerid::text), ap.season_id) AS total_allstar_points_per_season, AVG(pt.points) OVER(PARTITION BY COALESCE(p.playerid::text, d.playerid::text), pt.year) AS avg_regular_season_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) FILTER (WHERE awp.award IS NOT NULL) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(c.won) AS max_coach_wins, SUM(t.won) AS total_team_wins_linked, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sp.round, ', ') AS playoff_rounds_participated FROM players p FULL OUTER JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::text = d.playerid::text LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::text = ap.playerid::text LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::text = pt.playerid::text AND ap.season_id = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::text = awp.playerid::text AND ap.season_id = awp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::text = sp.tmidwinner::text OR t.tmid::text = sp.tmidloser::text WHERE ap.points > 10.38 AND pt.points > 2403.56 AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1983.84 AND 1970.09 AND t.year BETWEEN 1986.87 AND 1956.72 GROUP BY COALESCE(p.playerid::text, d.playerid::text), p.lastname, p.firstname, d.draftyear, ap.season_id, ap.points, pt.year, pt.points, awp.award, c.won, t.won, sp.round HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1379.84 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 1.32 ORDER BY total_allstar_points_per_season DESC, avg_regular_season_points_per_year DESC;

SELECT a.coachid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.year) AS distinct_years, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) AS distinct_awards, SUM(c.won) AS total_wins FROM awards_coaches a JOIN coaches c ON a.coachid::text = c.coachid AND a.year = c.year WHERE a.year >= 2017 AND a.year <= 2023 AND c.won > 61 GROUP BY a.coachid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.year) > 6 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT a.year, a.award, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS player_count, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points FROM awards_players a JOIN awards_players a2 ON a.year = a2.year AND a.playerid = a2.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON a.playerid = pa.playerid AND a.year = pa.season_id WHERE a.year >= 1992.12 AND a.year <= 2004.31 GROUP BY a.year, a.award HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) > 53.37 ORDER BY player_count DESC;

SELECT a.year, a.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS award_players, AVG(p.points) AS avg_points, SUM(p.assists) AS total_assists FROM awards_players a JOIN players_teams p ON a.playerid = p.playerid AND a.year = p.year WHERE a.year >= 1979 AND p.points > 1749 GROUP BY a.year, a.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) > 48 ORDER BY a.year DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT a.year, a.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS award_players, AVG(p.points) AS avg_points, SUM(p.assists) AS total_assists FROM awards_players a JOIN players_teams p ON a.playerid = p.playerid AND a.year = p.year WHERE a.year >= 2012 AND p.points > 1112 GROUP BY a.year, a.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) > 38 ORDER BY a.year DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT ap.playerid, ap.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award)) OVER (PARTITION BY ap.playerid ORDER BY ap.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_awards FROM awards_players ap JOIN players p ON ap.playerid = p.id JOIN player_allstar pa ON ap.playerid = pa.playerid AND ap.year = pa.season_id JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE ap.year >= 1975 AND ap.year <= 2015 AND p.weight >= 223 GROUP BY ap.playerid, ap.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 7 ORDER BY ap.playerid, ap.year;

SELECT ap.playerid, ap.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, SUM(ap2.year) AS total_award_years FROM awards_players ap JOIN awards_players ap2 ON ap.playerid = ap2.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 1993 AND ap2.year <= 1972 GROUP BY ap.playerid, ap.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 1 ORDER BY award_count DESC;

SELECT ap.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.award, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, MAX(pt.year) AS last_team_year, MIN(pt.year) AS first_team_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = CAST(pt.tmid AS integer) THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_series_won, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidloser = CAST(pt.tmid AS integer) THEN sp.l ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_series_lost, ROUND(SUM(pa.points)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(pa.minutes), 0), 2) AS points_per_minute_allstar, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pa.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.award ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) DESC) AS award_frequency_rank FROM awards_players ap JOIN players p ON ap.playerid = CAST(p.playerid AS integer) JOIN player_allstar pa ON ap.playerid = pa.playerid AND ap.year = pa.season_id JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = CAST(t.tmid AS integer) AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser WHERE ap.year >= 2005 AND ap.year <= 1982 AND pa.points > 3 AND pt.points > 2717 AND t.won > 26 GROUP BY ap.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.award HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) > 4 AND SUM(pa.points) > 228 AND AVG(pt.points) > 220 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 13 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, award_years DESC;

SELECT p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.year >= 2001 AND pt.year <= 1990 GROUP BY p.id, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(ap.points) > 35.35 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 12 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.firstname, p.lastname, p.playerid, p.firstseason, p.lastseason, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS career_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS career_assists, AVG(pt.points*1.0/NULLIF(pt.minutes,0)) AS points_per_minute, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid::character varying = p.playerid AND ap.award = 'MVP') AS mvp_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON pt.playerid::character varying = p.playerid JOIN teams t ON t.tmid::character varying = pt.tmid::character varying AND t.year = pt.year JOIN draft d ON d.playerid::character varying = p.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON pa.playerid::character varying = p.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 1989 AND p.lastseason <= 2012 AND pt.year BETWEEN p.firstseason AND p.lastseason AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid::character varying = p.playerid AND ap2.award LIKE '%All-Star%') AND pt.points > 63 AND pt.rebounds > 33 GROUP BY p.firstname, p.lastname, p.playerid, p.firstseason, p.lastseason HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 35559 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 4 ORDER BY career_points DESC, career_rebounds DESC, career_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname AS first_name, p.lastname AS last_name, COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) AS total_regular_points, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) AS total_post_points, COALESCE(SUM(pa.points), 0) AS total_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game_regular, AVG(pa.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pa.games_played, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game_allstar, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) DESC) AS career_points_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.lgid ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) DESC) AS league_points_rank FROM players p LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer WHERE pt.year >= 1999 AND pt.year <= 1980 AND pa.season_id >= 1971 AND pa.season_id <= 1987 AND t.year >= 1966 AND t.year <= 1978 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.lgid HAVING COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) > 30301 AND COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) > 2104 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 13 UNION SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname AS first_name, p.lastname AS last_name, COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) AS total_regular_points, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) AS total_post_points, COALESCE(SUM(pa.points), 0) AS total_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game_regular, AVG(pa.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pa.games_played, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game_allstar, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) DESC) AS career_points_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.lgid ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) DESC) AS league_points_rank FROM players p LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer WHERE pt.year >= 2013 AND pt.year <= 1972 AND pa.season_id >= 2002 AND pa.season_id <= 1968 AND t.year >= 1981 AND t.year <= 1997 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.lgid HAVING COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) > 46282 AND COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) > 424 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 1 ORDER BY career_points_rank, league_points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname AS first_name, p.lastname AS last_name, SUM(pt.points) AS regular_season_points, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS playoff_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS regular_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) DESC) AS awards_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1993 AND pt.points >= 1534 AND pa.points >= 37 AND t.won >= 21 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 12438 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 9 ORDER BY regular_season_points DESC, awards_rank ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname AS first_name, p.lastname AS last_name, pt.year AS season_year, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for_count, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, COUNT(apl.award) AS mvp_award_count, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_wins_with_team, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league_season FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players apl ON p.playerid::integer = apl.playerid AND pt.year = apl.year AND apl.award = 'Most Valuable Player' LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON pt.tmid = sp.tmidwinner AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE pt.year >= 1997 AND pt.year <= 2007 AND pt.points > 2007 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, t.name, t.lgid), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.lgid), (pt.year, t.lgid), (t.lgid), () ) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4844 ORDER BY total_points DESC, season_year ASC, league ASC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.birthcountry, p.college, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, SUM(pa.assists) AS total_allstar_assists, SUM(pa.rebounds) AS total_allstar_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, AVG(pa.assists) AS avg_allstar_assists, AVG(pa.rebounds) AS avg_allstar_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS allstar_seasons_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_regular_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_regular_rebounds, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_regular_assists, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_regular_rebounds, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_post_points, SUM(pt.postassists) AS total_post_assists, SUM(pt.postrebounds) AS total_post_rebounds, AVG(pt.postpoints) AS avg_post_points, AVG(pt.postassists) AS avg_post_assists, AVG(pt.postrebounds) AS avg_post_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS regular_seasons_count, MAX(ap.year) AS latest_award_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.confid AS conference, t.divid AS division, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS team_losses, SUM(t.o_pts) AS team_offensive_points, SUM(t.d_pts) AS team_defensive_points_allowed, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank, (SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.assists) + SUM(pt.rebounds)) AS total_regular_stats, (SUM(pa.points) + SUM(pa.assists) + SUM(pa.rebounds)) AS total_allstar_stats, (SUM(pt.postpoints) + SUM(pt.postassists) + SUM(pt.postrebounds)) AS total_post_stats FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying AND pa.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.lgid = t.lgid AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND t.year = sp.year WHERE p.birthdate >= '1900-01-01' AND p.firstseason >= 1981.5 AND pt.year >= 1979.45 AND pa.season_id >= 1976.3 AND t.year >= 1951.48 AND pt.points > 1187.07 AND pa.points > 56.93 AND t.won > 30.08 AND t.o_pts > 11788.76 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.birthcountry, p.college, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, t.name, t.lgid, t.confid, t.divid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) > 8.94 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 12.6 AND SUM(pt.points) > 11412.2 AND SUM(pa.points) > 1385.72 AND SUM(t.won) > 772.29 ORDER BY total_regular_points DESC, total_allstar_points DESC, total_post_points DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT p.playerid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS distinct_team_years, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.league_id) AS distinct_allstar_leagues, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE ap.points > 49.67 AND pt.year >= 2016.33 GROUP BY p.playerid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 6.51 AND SUM(pt.points) < 45136.74 ORDER BY total_regular_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, ap.season_id, SUM(ap.points) AS total_points, SUM(ap.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(ap.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players aw ON p.id = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year WHERE ap.points > 0 AND ap.assists > 5 AND aw.award = 'Most Valuable Player' GROUP BY p.playerid, ap.season_id HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 925 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, d.draftyear, COUNT(DISTINCT apt.year) AS award_years, SUM(aps.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_team_points, MAX(t.won) AS max_team_wins, (SUM(pt.points) / NULLIF(SUM(pt.minutes),0)) * 100.0 AS points_per_100_min, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY d.draftyear DESC) AS draft_rank FROM players p JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN awards_players apt ON p.playerid::integer = apt.playerid AND d.draftyear = apt.year JOIN player_allstar aps ON p.playerid::integer = aps.playerid AND apt.year = aps.season_id JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND apt.year = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND apt.year = t.year WHERE apt.year > 1966 AND apt.year < 1953 AND d.draftoverall > 106 AND aps.points > 38 AND t.won > 72 GROUP BY p.playerid, d.draftyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT apt.year) > 20 AND SUM(aps.points) > 641 AND AVG(pt.points) > 3819 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, avg_team_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year >= 1952) AS award_count FROM players p WHERE p.id IN ( SELECT pt.playerid FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.year = 2023 AND pt.points > 2093 ) ORDER BY award_count DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year >= 1957) AS award_count FROM players p WHERE p.id IN ( SELECT pt.playerid FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.year = 1988 AND pt.points > 1504 ) ORDER BY award_count DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.award = 'All-NBA') AS award_count FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid WHERE pa.season_id BETWEEN 2011 AND 1996 AND pa.league_id = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.id, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 11.67 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.season_id) AS allstar_seasons FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.playerid::integer = ps.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND ps.season_id = ap.year WHERE ap.award = 'All-Star' AND ps.season_id IN (SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'All-Star' AND lgid = 'NBA' AND year > 1999) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(ps.points) > 27.13 ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year), 0) AS award_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND p.firstseason = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE pt.points > 1576.21 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2009.79 AND 2015.84 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 4.23 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COALESCE(SUM(pa.points), 0) AS total_allstar_points, COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) AS total_regular_points, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) AS total_postseason_points, COALESCE(AVG(pa.points / NULLIF(pa.games_played, 0)), 0) AS avg_points_per_allstar_game, COALESCE(AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)), 0) AS avg_points_per_regular_game, COALESCE(AVG(pt.postpoints / NULLIF(pt.postgp, 0)), 0) AS avg_points_per_postseason_game, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS years_drafted, MAX(CASE WHEN ac.award = 'Coach of the Year' THEN ac.year END) AS last_coach_of_year_award, MAX(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t.id OR sp.tmidloser = t.id THEN sp.year END) AS last_playoff_year, SUM(t.o_pts) AS team_offensive_points, SUM(t.d_pts) AS team_defensive_points_allowed, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) DESC) AS regular_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) DESC) AS postseason_points_rank FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::INTEGER = pa.playerid AND pa.points > 40.11 LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::INTEGER = pt.playerid AND pt.points > 2379.84 AND pt.postpoints > 592.99 LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::INTEGER = ap.playerid AND ap.year >= 1952.4 AND ap.year <= 1961.97 LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::INTEGER = d.playerid AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 2013.65 AND 1973.52 LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::INTEGER = t.id AND t.year = pt.year AND t.o_pts > 9308.23 LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::INTEGER = c.tmid AND c.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::INTEGER = ac.coachid AND ac.year = c.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 1967.05 AND p.lastseason <= 2009.76 AND (p.height > 0.38 OR p.weight > 79.51) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 13.01 AND COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) <= 9.92 AND MAX(CASE WHEN ac.award = 'Coach of the Year' THEN ac.year END) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY regular_points_rank, postseason_points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) AS total_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 1977 AND pt.year <= 2023 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname UNION ALL SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COALESCE(SUM(pas.points), 0) AS total_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar pas ON p.playerid = pas.playerid::character varying WHERE pas.season_id >= 2011 AND pas.season_id <= 1980 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year WHERE ap.points > 14 AND aw.year >= 2008 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 4 ORDER BY allstar_appearances DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, (SELECT AVG(pts_avg) FROM (SELECT playerid, AVG(points) AS pts_avg FROM player_allstar GROUP BY playerid HAVING AVG(points) > 22.52) AS inner_sub) AS league_avg_pts_over_threshold FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE ap.season_id BETWEEN 1989 AND 2004 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 11 ORDER BY allstar_seasons DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE ap.points > 36 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2000 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 6 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE ap.points > 43 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2013 AND 1998 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 2 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid WHERE ap.season_id BETWEEN 2000 AND 1955 AND pt.minutes > 2498 AND aw.year >= 1957 AND aw.award = 'All-NBA' AND (ap.points > 42 OR ap.assists > 16) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 15 AND SUM(pt.points) > 28615 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT apw.year) AS award_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players apw ON p.playerid::integer = apw.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id WHERE pt.year >= 2014 AND ap.season_id >= 2020 AND pt.points > 656 AND ap.points > 36 AND t.won > 79 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 1 AND SUM(pt.points) > 12970 AND AVG(pt.rebounds) > 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid = awp.playerid::character varying WHERE awp.award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND awp.year BETWEEN 1969 AND 1992 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND d.draftyear > 1984) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 27 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 48.0) AS avg_points_per_48, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 536.33 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1989.49 AND 2008.15 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 18.45 ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 73.64;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS distinct_team_years, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.league_id) AS distinct_allstar_leagues, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.assists) AS avg_allstar_assists, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_regular_assists, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.season_id = pt.year THEN ap.points + pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS combined_points_matching_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) DESC) AS allstar_seasons_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE ap.points > 36 AND pt.points > 1108 AND t.won > 25 AND c.won > 43 AND sp.w > 4 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 11 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 10 AND SUM(ap.points) > 472 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, distinct_allstar_seasons DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS distinct_team_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE ap.points > 46.63 AND pt.year >= 1972.34 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 8999.39 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS team_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS coached_teams FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.id = ps.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 2007 AND ap.year >= 1995 AND ps.season_id >= 2010 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 23827 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) >= 8 AND AVG(ps.points) >= 11 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, MAX(ap.season_id) AS last_allstar_season, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS total_seasons_played, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, SUM(ap.points) AS allstar_points_total, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_points_rank, SUM(CASE WHEN dp.draftyear IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS draft_year_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players awp WHERE awp.playerid = p.id AND awp.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_awards_count FROM players p INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid INNER JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft dp ON p.id = dp.playerid AND dp.draftyear = pt.year INNER JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND t.year = pt.year INNER JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND c.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND sp.year = pt.year WHERE pt.year >= 2010 AND pt.year <= 1967 AND pt.points > 1923 AND ap.points > 1 AND t.won > 9 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 17 AND SUM(pt.points) > 47232 ORDER BY career_points DESC, avg_points_per_game DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE ap.year >= 1972 AND pt.points > 1459 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) > 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS awards_list, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years_count FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id WHERE pa.points > 4.0 AND pt.year >= 1951.39 AND t.won >= 1.36 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 79.38 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 9.98 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS career_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points_per_allstar, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS allstar_seasons FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE pa.points > 40.17 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) >= 11.34 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2001 AND pt.year <= 1977 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 18329 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid INNER JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1874 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1972 AND 2001 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 11 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1958 AND pt.year <= 1955 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 22677 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 4 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 1952 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 17489 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2016 AND pt.year <= 1998 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 24842 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.points > 47 AND pt.year >= 2012 AND pt.year <= 2014 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 13462 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 23 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1991 AND 1983 AND t.won > 44 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 15.6 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_active FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.lgid = 'NBA' AND pt.year >= 1955 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND ap.year BETWEEN 2013 AND 1950 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 8011 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_active FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.lgid = 'NBA' AND pt.year >= 1996 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND ap.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1956 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 5110 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.year >= 2007 THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS recent_points, COUNT(CASE WHEN pt.lgid = 'NBA' THEN 1 END) AS seasons_in_league, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1984 AND 2004 AND pt.points > 152 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 24299 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight, p.pos, p.college, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS allstar_total_points, AVG(ap.points) AS allstar_avg_points, SUM(pt.points) AS regular_total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS regular_avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(pt.year) AS last_season, MIN(pt.year) AS first_season, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.points > 37 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_scoring_allstar_games, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pos ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS regular_points_rank_by_pos FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.lgid = t.lgid AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND aw.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND c.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser WHERE p.height > '150.0' AND p.weight BETWEEN 189 AND 360 AND pt.year >= 2018 AND (ap.points > 27 OR ap.rebounds > 0 OR ap.assists > 9) AND (t.won > 1 OR t.attendance > 1066515) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players aw2 WHERE aw2.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND aw2.award = 'Most Valuable Player') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_coaches ac WHERE ac.coachid::integer = c.id AND ac.award = 'Coach of the Year')) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight, p.pos, p.college HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 10 AND SUM(pt.points) > 8003 AND AVG(ap.points) > 11 ORDER BY allstar_total_points DESC, regular_total_points DESC LIMIT 129;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.year = ap.year AND pt.points > 2661 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 2 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pa.season_id = d.draftyear AND pa.points > 1 AND d.draftround = 2 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos HAVING AVG(pa.minutes) >= 17 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, p.height, p.weight, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(ap.assists) AS total_allstar_assists, AVG(ap.assists) AS avg_allstar_assists, SUM(ap.rebounds) AS total_allstar_rebounds, AVG(ap.rebounds) AS avg_allstar_rebounds, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.league_id, ', ' ORDER BY ap.league_id) AS allstar_leagues, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS team_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_team_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_team_assists, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_team_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_team_rebounds, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_team_rebounds, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pt.lgid, ', ' ORDER BY pt.lgid) AS team_leagues, COUNT(DISTINCT ap2.award) AS award_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap2.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap2.award) AS awards, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_pick, t.name AS last_team_name, t.won AS last_team_wins, t.lost AS last_team_losses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) DESC) AS allstar_seasons_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN awards_players ap2 ON p.playerid = ap2.playerid::character varying JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE p.height > 190.6 AND p.weight > 73.86 AND ap.points > 31.94 AND pt.points > 985.65 AND t.won > 73.39 AND d.draftyear >= 2014.0 AND d.draftyear <= 1963.57 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, p.height, p.weight, t.name, t.won, t.lost HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 10.14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 8.12 AND SUM(ap.points) > 174.42 AND SUM(pt.points) > 1167.4 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, total_team_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, p.height, p.weight, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_blocks, SUM(pt.turnovers) AS total_turnovers, SUM(pt.pf) AS total_fouls, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute, AVG(pt.fgmade * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.fgattempted, 0)) AS fg_pct, AVG(pt.ftmade * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.ftattempted, 0)) AS ft_pct, AVG(pt.threemade * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.threeattempted, 0)) AS three_pct, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(ap.season_id) AS last_allstar_season, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, MAX(a.year) AS last_award_year, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) AS distinct_awards, MAX(d.draftyear) AS draft_year, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, MAX(t.won) AS max_team_wins, MIN(t.lost) AS min_team_losses, SUM(t.o_pts) AS total_team_points_for, SUM(t.d_pts) AS total_team_points_against, SUM(s.w) AS total_playoff_wins, SUM(s.l) AS total_playoff_losses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.steals) DESC) AS steals_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.blocks) DESC) AS blocks_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.turnovers) DESC) AS turnovers_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) DESC) AS ppm_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN awards_players a ON p.playerid = a.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN series_post s ON t.tmid::character varying = s.tmidwinner::character varying OR t.tmid::character varying = s.tmidloser::character varying WHERE p.height > 238.49 AND p.weight > 98.5 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1988 AND 1960 AND t.won > 24 AND (a.award IS NULL OR a.award != '') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, p.height, p.weight HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 36713 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 8085 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 16260 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 14 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_rebounds DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year) AS total_points_year, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year) AS avg_points_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 130.66 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1965.75 AND 2008.83 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points HAVING COUNT(ap.award) >= 4.12 ORDER BY pt.year, points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, SUM(pa.points) AS allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 2017 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1962 AND 2014 AND pa.points > 9 AND t.won > 22 AND c.won > 42 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3128 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 8 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 26 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_points_by_team FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2002 AND pt.points > 2427 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1038 ORDER BY pt.year, pt.tmid, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid) AS avg_team_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id WHERE pt.year >= 2013 AND pt.year <= 2006 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3493 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid) AS avg_team_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1990 AND pt.points > 1637 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 344 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) AS stint_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1973 AND 2021 AND pt.points > 2132 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award IS NOT NULL ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = pt.tmid AND c.year = pt.year AND c.won > 24 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4180 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE p.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT pas.playerid FROM player_allstar pas WHERE pas.points > 47 AND pas.season_id >= 1997 ) AND pt.points > 31 AND t.won >= 69 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1737 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_by_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 1650 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1988 AND 2017 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 9680 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, points_rank_by_year;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, SUM(ap.points) AS allstar_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(apl.award) AS player_award_count, COUNT(acl.award) AS coach_award_count, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS team_losses, SUM(t.o_pts) AS team_offensive_points, SUM(t.d_pts) AS team_defensive_points_allowed, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_per_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_total_points, (SUM(pt.points) - LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year)) AS points_change_from_previous_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players apl ON p.playerid::integer = apl.playerid AND pt.year = apl.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches acl ON p.playerid::integer = acl.coachid AND pt.year = acl.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN series_post sp1 ON t.tmid::integer = sp1.tmidwinner JOIN series_post sp2 ON t.tmid::integer = sp2.tmidloser WHERE pt.points > 6 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2009 AND 1995 AND t.won > 11 AND t.lost < 72 AND ap.points > 10 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 606 AND AVG(pt.points) > 23.37 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 20 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, points_rank_per_year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 2689 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 1160 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS scoring_category, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 1999 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4644 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 18 AND pt.year >= 2018 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 659 ORDER BY pt.year, points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) > 42859.51 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.assists) > 1121.29 THEN 'High Assister' ELSE 'Balanced' END AS player_category FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND p.id::text = pt.playerid::text JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::text = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1993 AND pt.year <= 2016 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 21543.48 OR SUM(pt.assists) > 1152.31 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, pt.tmid;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_position, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins_for_team, SUM(t.won) AS total_team_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league, SUM(pt.points) / NULLIF(SUM(pt.minutes), 0) AS points_per_minute FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year AND t.lgid = c.lgid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 58.83 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1994.94 AND 1950.21 AND t.won > 13.55 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.assists) > 68.24 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 11.74 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank_in_league;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid, pt.year) AS team_avg_points, COUNT(ap.award) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid) AS total_awards, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS career_points_running_total FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.points > 19 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2005 AND 1999 AND pt.rebounds >= 7 AND t.won > 41 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, ap.award, pa.points HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 23 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid, pt.year) AS team_avg_points, COUNT(ap.award) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid) AS total_awards, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS career_points_running_total FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.points > 36 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2004 AND 2000 AND pt.rebounds >= 20 AND t.won > 50 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, ap.award, pa.points HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 16 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, ap.points AS allstar_points, ap.rebounds AS allstar_rebounds, ap.assists AS allstar_assists, pt.points AS regular_points, pt.rebounds AS regular_rebounds, pt.assists AS regular_assists, pt.steals AS regular_steals, pt.blocks AS regular_blocks, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftselection, c.coachid, ac.award AS coach_award, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, sp.w AS series_wins, sp.l AS series_losses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.tmid ORDER BY pt.points DESC, pt.rebounds DESC, pt.assists DESC) SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.award LIKE '%All-Star%' AND ap.year BETWEEN 2013 AND 1966) AS allstar_awards_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY AVG(pt.points) DESC) AS league_avg_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.id WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1977 AND 1958 AND pt.points > 1385 AND pa.points > 99 AND t.won > 74 AND (d.draftyear IS NULL OR d.draftyear < 1980) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.year, t.lgid, p.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 20904 AND AVG(pt.points) > 21 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 6 ORDER BY total_points DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_by_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM coaches c WHERE c.won > 22 AND c.lost < 54 UNION SELECT DISTINCT year FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.w > 5 AND sp.l < 7 ) AND pt.points > 349 AND t.attendance > 62959 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 264 AND AVG(pt.points) > 46 ORDER BY total_points DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_pick, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t.id THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_wins_by_team, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.year >= 1983 AND pt.year <= 2008 AND pt.points > 1794 AND t.won > 23 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 14243 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 20 AND AVG(pa.points) >= 13.15 ORDER BY total_points DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.points > 21.85 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_scoring_games, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.steals > 4.25 THEN pt.steals ELSE 0 END) AS impactful_steals, COUNT(CASE WHEN pt.turnovers < 2.65 THEN 1 END) AS low_turnover_games, (SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.assists) + SUM(pt.rebounds)) AS total_contributions, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner WHERE pt.points >= 0.94 AND t.year BETWEEN 1987 AND 1989 AND pt.minutes > 43.93 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1248.02 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 5 ORDER BY total_contributions DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.tmid, t.name, pt.year, pt.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_lg, SUM(pt.points) / NULLIF(SUM(pt.minutes), 0) AS points_per_minute, (SELECT MAX(d.draftoverall) FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid::character varying = p.playerid AND d.draftyear <= pt.year) AS highest_draft_pick_before_year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND c.year = pt.year AND c.won > c.lost) AS winning_coaches_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::character varying = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.lgid = t.lgid AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON pa.playerid = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE pt.points > 2096.68 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1980.37 AND 1974.96 AND t.won > 72.75 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.tmid, t.name, pt.year, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.assists) > 22.02 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 15.58 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank_lg;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstseason, p.lastseason, ap.season_id, AVG(ap.points) OVER(PARTITION BY p.playerid) AS avg_points, SUM(ap.o_rebounds) OVER(PARTITION BY ap.season_id ORDER BY ap.minutes DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_oreb FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players awp ON ap.playerid = awp.playerid AND ap.season_id = awp.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 1998 AND p.lastseason <= 1959 AND awp.award = 'All-NBA First Team' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstseason, p.lastseason, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.o_rebounds, ap.minutes ORDER BY avg_points DESC, running_total_oreb DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.fullgivenname, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_points, COUNT(ap.award) FILTER (WHERE ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player') AS mvp_count, MAX(c.won) AS max_coach_wins, AVG(t.o_pts) AS avg_team_points, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, SUM(s.w) AS total_series_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::text = pt.playerid::text JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::text = ap.playerid::text AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::text = t.tmid::text AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::text = d.playerid::text JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::text = c.tmid::text AND t.year = c.year JOIN series_post s ON t.tmid::text = s.tmidwinner::text AND t.year = s.year WHERE pt.points > 3771.4 AND pt.year >= 2011.9 AND t.o_pts > 79.05 AND d.draftyear >= 2020.33 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.fullgivenname, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 75571.72 AND COUNT(ap.award) > 94.36 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_season_points, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, SUM(CASE WHEN c.post_wins > c.post_losses THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS winning_postseasons, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS total_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1954 AND 1990 AND t.attendance > 471757 AND pa.minutes > 31 AND pt.points > 3927 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) < 1988 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 48.14 AND SUM(pa.points) > 92 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 13 ORDER BY total_points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying WHERE pa.season_id >= 1985.28 AND pa.season_id <= 2018.67 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 187.33 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 1998.56 AND pt.year <= 1979.7 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3229.56 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, pt.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute FROM players_teams pt JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id JOIN player_allstar ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id WHERE pt.year >= 2019.4 AND pt.year <= 2015.85 GROUP BY p.playerid, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 829.81 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, AVG(p1.points) AS avg_points, AVG(p2.points) AS avg_teammate_points, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.playerid) AS num_teammates, SUM(p1.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p1.year, p1.tmid ORDER BY p1.points DESC) AS team_points_running_total FROM players_teams p1 JOIN players_teams p2 ON p1.year = p2.year AND p1.tmid = p2.tmid AND p1.playerid != p2.playerid JOIN players pl ON p1.playerid = pl.id JOIN awards_players ap ON p1.playerid = ap.playerid AND p1.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON p1.tmid = t.id AND p1.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON p1.tmid = c.tmid AND p1.year = c.year WHERE p1.points > 201 AND p1.year BETWEEN 2015 AND 1964 AND t.won > 51 AND c.won > 36 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points HAVING AVG(p2.points) > 1010 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p2.playerid) >= 7 ORDER BY avg_points DESC, team_points_running_total DESC;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, AVG(p1.points) AS avg_points, AVG(p2.points) AS avg_teammate_points, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.playerid) AS num_teammates, SUM(p1.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p1.year, p1.tmid ORDER BY p1.points DESC) AS team_points_running_total FROM players_teams p1 JOIN players_teams p2 ON p1.year = p2.year AND p1.tmid = p2.tmid AND p1.playerid != p2.playerid JOIN players pl ON p1.playerid = pl.id JOIN awards_players ap ON p1.playerid = ap.playerid AND p1.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON p1.tmid = t.id AND p1.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON p1.tmid = c.tmid AND p1.year = c.year WHERE p1.points > 2506 AND p1.year BETWEEN 1978 AND 1975 AND t.won > 25 AND c.won > 70 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points HAVING AVG(p2.points) > 1741 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p2.playerid) >= 5 ORDER BY avg_points DESC, team_points_running_total DESC;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points AS regular_points, p2.points AS allstar_points, (p1.points - p2.points) AS point_diff FROM players_teams p1 JOIN player_allstar p2 ON p1.playerid = p2.playerid AND p1.year = p2.season_id WHERE p1.points > 2598 AND p2.points > 28 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points, p2.points HAVING (p1.points - p2.points) > 803 ORDER BY point_diff DESC;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points AS regular_points, p2.points AS allstar_points, (p1.points - p2.points) AS point_diff FROM players_teams p1 JOIN player_allstar p2 ON p1.playerid = p2.playerid AND p1.year = p2.season_id WHERE p1.points > 287 AND p2.points > 71 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points, p2.points HAVING (p1.points - p2.points) > 941 ORDER BY point_diff DESC;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points AS regular_points, p2.points AS allstar_points, (p1.points - p2.points) AS point_difference FROM players_teams p1 JOIN player_allstar p2 ON p1.playerid = p2.playerid AND p1.year = p2.season_id WHERE p1.points > 2429 AND p2.points > 79 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points, p2.points ORDER BY point_difference DESC;

SELECT pl.playerid AS p_id, pl.firstname || ' ' || pl.lastname AS player_name, pl.pos AS position, pl.firstseason AS debut_year, pl.lastseason AS last_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) FILTER (WHERE awp.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) FILTER (WHERE awp.award LIKE '%All-Star%') AS allstar_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, SUM(pt.points) AS total_career_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_career_rebounds, AVG(pt.rebounds / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_rebounds_per_game, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_career_assists, AVG(pt.assists / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_assists_per_game, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_career_steals, AVG(pt.steals / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_steals_per_game, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_career_blocks, AVG(pt.blocks / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_blocks_per_game, SUM(pt.turnovers) AS total_career_turnovers, AVG(pt.turnovers / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_turnovers_per_game, SUM(pt.fgmade) AS total_fg_made, SUM(pt.fgattempted) AS total_fg_attempted, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.fgattempted) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(pt.fgmade) * 100.0 / SUM(pt.fgattempted), 2) ELSE 0 END AS career_fg_percentage, SUM(pt.ftmade) AS total_ft_made, SUM(pt.ftattempted) AS total_ft_attempted, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.ftattempted) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(pt.ftmade) * 100.0 / SUM(pt.ftattempted), 2) ELSE 0 END AS career_ft_percentage, SUM(pt.threemade) AS total_three_made, SUM(pt.threeattempted) AS total_three_attempted, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.threeattempted) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(pt.threemade) * 100.0 / SUM(pt.threeattempted), 2) ELSE 0 END AS career_three_percentage, MIN(d.draftyear) AS draft_year, MIN(d.draftround) AS draft_round, MIN(d.draftselection) AS draft_selection, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS draft_overall, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT t.name, ', ') AS team_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT t.arena, ', ') AS arenas_played_in, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coaches_played_under, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.tmidwinner) AS playoff_series_won_with_teams, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.tmidloser) AS playoff_series_lost_with_teams, SUM(sp.w) AS total_playoff_series_wins, SUM(sp.l) AS total_playoff_series_losses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.steals) DESC) AS steals_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.blocks) DESC) AS blocks_rank FROM players pl LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON pl.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON pl.playerid::integer = awp.playerid LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON pl.playerid::integer = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON pl.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (pt.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR pt.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser) AND pt.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year WHERE pl.firstseason >= 1995 AND pl.lastseason <= 1992 AND pl.height >= '150' AND pl.weight >= 85 AND pt.points >= 4838 AND ap.points >= 72 AND t.won >= 41 AND sp.year >= 2010 AND d.draftyear >= 1955 GROUP BY pl.playerid, pl.firstname, pl.lastname, pl.pos, pl.firstseason, pl.lastseason HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 10 AND COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) >= 5 AND SUM(pt.points) >= 17054 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) >= 4562 AND SUM(pt.assists) >= 14314 AND AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) >= '5' ORDER BY total_career_points DESC, total_career_rebounds DESC, total_career_assists DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT pl.playerid, pl.firstname, pl.lastname, pl.college, pl.pos, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, ap.conference, AVG(ap.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pl.playerid, ap.league_id, ap.conference ORDER BY ap.season_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_career_points, SUM(ap.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pl.playerid, ap.league_id, ap.conference ORDER BY ap.season_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.league_id, ap.conference, ap.season_id ORDER BY ap.points DESC) AS season_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.league_id, ap.conference, ap.season_id ORDER BY ap.points DESC) AS season_dense_rank, LAG(ap.points, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY pl.playerid, ap.league_id, ap.conference ORDER BY ap.season_id) AS prev_season_points, LEAD(ap.points, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY pl.playerid, ap.league_id, ap.conference ORDER BY ap.season_id) AS next_season_points, pt.year AS team_year, pt.tmid, pt.lgid AS team_lgid, pt.points AS team_points, pt.rebounds AS team_rebounds, pt.assists AS team_assists, t.name AS team_name, t.arena, t.playoff, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid, pt.lgid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS team_cumulative_points, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid, pt.lgid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS team_avg_points, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, d.draftfrom, apw.year AS award_year, apw.award, apw.lgid AS award_lgid, c.year AS coach_year, c.coachid, c.won AS coach_wins, c.lost AS coach_losses, c.lgid AS coach_lgid, sp.year AS series_year, sp.round, sp.series, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, sp.w AS series_wins, sp.l AS series_losses, sp.lgidwinner, sp.lgidloser, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY pl.playerid, ap.league_id, ap.conference) AS total_allstar_appearances, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, MIN(ap.points) AS min_allstar_points, SUM(ap.rebounds) AS total_allstar_rebounds, AVG(ap.rebounds) AS avg_allstar_rebounds, SUM(ap.assists) AS total_allstar_assists, AVG(ap.assists) AS avg_allstar_assists, SUM(ap.steals) AS total_allstar_steals, AVG(ap.steals) AS avg_allstar_steals, SUM(ap.blocks) AS total_allstar_blocks, AVG(ap.blocks) AS avg_allstar_blocks, SUM(ap.turnovers) AS total_allstar_turnovers, AVG(ap.turnovers) AS avg_allstar_turnovers, SUM(ap.personal_fouls) AS total_allstar_fouls, AVG(ap.personal_fouls) AS avg_allstar_fouls, SUM(ap.fg_made) AS total_allstar_fg_made, AVG(ap.fg_made) AS avg_allstar_fg_made, SUM(ap.fg_attempted) AS total_allstar_fg_attempted, AVG(ap.fg_attempted) AS avg_allstar_fg_attempted, SUM(ap.ft_made) AS total_allstar_ft_made, AVG(ap.ft_made) AS avg_allstar_ft_made, SUM(ap.ft_attempted) AS total_allstar_ft_attempted, AVG(ap.ft_attempted) AS avg_allstar_ft_attempted, SUM(ap.three_made) AS total_allstar_three_made, AVG(ap.three_made) AS avg_allstar_three_made, SUM(ap.three_attempted) AS total_allstar_three_attempted, AVG(ap.three_attempted) AS avg_allstar_three_attempted FROM players pl JOIN player_allstar ap ON pl.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON pl.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND pt.lgid = t.lgid AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON pl.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN awards_players apw ON pl.playerid::integer = apw.playerid AND ap.season_id = apw.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::character varying = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year AND t.lgid = c.lgid JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::character varying = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND t.year = sp.year AND t.lgid = sp.lgidwinner WHERE ap.points > 21.64 AND pt.points > 2284.77 AND t.year >= 2003 AND d.draftyear >= 1973 AND apw.year >= 2022 AND c.year >= 1958 AND sp.year >= 2021 GROUP BY pl.playerid, pl.firstname, pl.lastname, pl.college, pl.pos, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, ap.conference, ap.points, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.lgid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, t.name, t.arena, t.playoff, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, d.draftfrom, apw.year, apw.award, apw.lgid, c.year, c.coachid, c.won, c.lost, c.lgid, sp.year, sp.round, sp.series, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, sp.w, sp.l, sp.lgidwinner, sp.lgidloser ORDER BY pl.playerid, ap.season_id, pt.year, d.draftyear, apw.year, c.year, sp.year;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::text = pt.lgid WHERE t.year > 1958 AND pt.year > 1952 AND t.won > 37 GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 43.85 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1955 AND 1992 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 37161 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS unique_coaches FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 2005 AND t.won > 15 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year), (t.lgid, t.year), (t.year), () ) ORDER BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts FROM teams t WHERE t.year = 1998 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.points > 2052 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND c.year = t.year AND c.won > 37 ) ORDER BY t.won DESC, t.o_pts DESC;
