SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS total_players, SUM(p.points) AS total_points, AVG(p.points) AS avg_points_per_player, SUM(p.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(p.assists) AS total_assists, MAX(ap.awards_count) AS max_awards_per_player, (SELECT MAX(sub_awards) FROM (SELECT COUNT(award) AS sub_awards FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid IN (SELECT playerid FROM players_teams pt2 WHERE pt2.tmid = t.id AND pt2.year = t.year) GROUP BY ap2.playerid) subq) AS max_awards_in_team_year, (SELECT AVG(draft_rank) FROM (SELECT draftoverall AS draft_rank FROM draft d WHERE d.tmid = t.id AND d.draftyear = t.year) draft_sub) AS avg_draft_rank FROM teams t JOIN players_teams p ON t.id = p.tmid AND t.year = p.year LEFT JOIN (SELECT playerid, COUNT(*) AS awards_count FROM awards_players GROUP BY playerid) ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid WHERE t.year >= 1973 AND t.year <= 1978 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.lgid, t.id HAVING SUM(p.points) > 18180 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) >= 15 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS unique_players, COUNT(DISTINCT d.playerid) AS unique_drafted_players, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS unique_allstar_players, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS unique_coaches, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_player_points, AVG(p.height) AS avg_player_height, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t.id THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS total_playoff_series_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidloser = t.id THEN sp.l ELSE 0 END) AS total_playoff_series_losses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS player_count_rank FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.id = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 2012.14 AND 1996.34 LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND ap.season_id = t.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser) AND t.year = sp.year WHERE t.year >= 1962.59 AND t.year <= 2009.89 AND t.won >= 73.55 AND pt.points > 2919.06 AND p.height IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, t.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 6.66 AND SUM(pt.points) > 8506.77 AND AVG(p.height) BETWEEN 206.33 AND 197.03 ORDER BY total_team_player_points DESC, avg_player_height ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS lg_3yr_avg_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1989 AND t.year <= 1985 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA First Team' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 9934 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.won) AS total_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS total_losses, AVG(t.o_pts) AS avg_offensive_points, AVG(t.d_pts) AS avg_defensive_points, AVG(SUM(t.won)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins_3yr FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year AND t.lgid = pt.lgid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id WHERE t.year >= 1985 AND t.year <= 1957 AND t.o_pts > 6360 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.won) > 80 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t1.lgid, t1.year, t1.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.coachid) AS award_coaches, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.lgid ORDER BY t1.year) AS prev_year_points FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year AND t1.tmid <> t2.tmid JOIN players_teams pt ON t1.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t1.year = pt.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN coaches c ON t1.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t1.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN draft d ON pt.playerid = d.playerid AND pt.year = d.draftyear JOIN series_post sp ON t1.tmid = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND t1.year = sp.year WHERE t1.won > 36.06 AND t1.games > 83.93 AND pt.points > 1703.7 AND pa.points > 41.96 AND ap.award = 'MVP' AND ac.award = 'Coach of the Year' AND d.draftround > 4.29 AND sp.w > 6.62 GROUP BY t1.lgid, t1.year, t1.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 78592.27 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) > 6.49 ORDER BY t1.lgid, t1.year, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.name, t1.won, t1.lost, t1.o_pts, t1.d_pts, t2.won AS t2_won, t2.lost AS t2_lost, t2.o_pts AS t2_o_pts, t2.d_pts AS t2_d_pts, (t1.o_pts - t1.d_pts) AS t1_net_rating, (t2.o_pts - t2.d_pts) AS t2_net_rating, AVG(t1.o_pts + t1.d_pts) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.year) AS avg_combined_pts_per_year FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.year = t2.year AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.tmid < t2.tmid JOIN players_teams pt ON pt.tmid = t1.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t1.year WHERE t1.year >= 1959 AND t1.o_pts >= 11271 GROUP BY t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.name, t1.won, t1.lost, t1.o_pts, t1.d_pts, t2.won, t2.lost, t2.o_pts, t2.d_pts HAVING COUNT(pt.playerid) > 15 ORDER BY t1.year DESC, t1_net_rating DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.name, t1.won, t1.lost, t1.o_pts, t1.d_pts, t2.won AS t2_won, t2.lost AS t2_lost, t2.o_pts AS t2_o_pts, t2.d_pts AS t2_d_pts, (t1.o_pts - t1.d_pts) AS t1_net_rating, (t2.o_pts - t2.d_pts) AS t2_net_rating, AVG(t1.o_pts + t1.d_pts) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.year) AS avg_combined_pts_per_year FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.year = t2.year AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.tmid < t2.tmid JOIN players_teams pt ON pt.tmid = t1.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t1.year WHERE t1.year >= 1969 AND t1.o_pts >= 14130 GROUP BY t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.name, t1.won, t1.lost, t1.o_pts, t1.d_pts, t2.won, t2.lost, t2.o_pts, t2.d_pts HAVING COUNT(pt.playerid) > 3 ORDER BY t1.year DESC, t1_net_rating DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.won AS current_year_wins, t2.won AS previous_year_wins, (t1.won - t2.won) AS win_difference FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.won > 67 AND t2.won > 54 ORDER BY win_difference DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, AVG(t1.won) AS avg_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.tmid) AS teams_with_higher_attendance FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.year = t2.year AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t2.attendance > t1.attendance WHERE t1.year >= 1986 AND t1.attendance >= 3055894 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid HAVING AVG(t1.won) > 61.26 ORDER BY t1.year DESC, t1.lgid;

SELECT t1.year, t1.tmid, t1.name, t1.won AS wins, t2.won AS previous_wins, (t1.won - t2.won) AS win_improvement FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.won > 32 AND t2.won > 21 ORDER BY win_improvement DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT a.award, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS unique_players, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS unique_draft_years, SUM(ps.points) AS total_points, AVG(ps.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, MAX(ps.assists) AS max_assists, MIN(ps.steals) AS min_steals, SUM(t.won) AS total_team_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS unique_teams, COUNT(DISTINCT s.tmidwinner) AS unique_series_winners, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS unique_coaches FROM awards_players a JOIN players p ON a.playerid = p.id JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.id = ps.playerid AND a.year = ps.season_id JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND a.year = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND a.lgid = t.lgid JOIN series_post s ON t.id = s.tmidwinner AND a.year = s.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND a.year = c.year AND t.lgid = c.lgid JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND a.year = d.draftyear WHERE a.year >= 1973 AND a.year <= 1960 AND ps.points > 23 AND t.won > 53 AND c.won > 12 AND d.draftyear >= 1986 AND d.draftyear <= 1948 GROUP BY a.award HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) > 193 AND COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) > 13 AND SUM(ps.points) > 94154 AND AVG(ps.rebounds) > '0.0' AND MAX(ps.assists) > 14 AND MIN(ps.steals) < 0 AND SUM(t.won) > 420 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) > 7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.tmidwinner) > 3 AND SUM(c.won) > 15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) > 14 ORDER BY unique_players DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT a.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) AS distinct_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS distinct_teams, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pa.rebounds) AS avg_allstar_rebounds, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_regular_rebounds FROM awards_players a JOIN players p ON a.playerid = p.id JOIN player_allstar pa ON a.playerid = pa.playerid AND a.year = pa.season_id JOIN players_teams pt ON a.playerid = pt.playerid AND a.year = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::text = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year WHERE a.year >= 2005 AND a.year <= 1993 AND pt.points > 2967 GROUP BY a.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) > 19 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 24 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, distinct_awards DESC;

SELECT a.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS career_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS career_rebounds, AVG(pt.points::float / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, SUM(CASE WHEN c.won > c.lost THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS winning_seasons_coached, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t.id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_series_wins, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM awards_players a JOIN players p ON a.playerid::text = p.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON a.playerid = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner JOIN draft d ON a.playerid = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON a.playerid = ap.playerid AND a.year = ap.season_id WHERE a.year >= 1986.44 AND a.year <= 1951.7 AND pt.year >= 1987.76 AND pt.year <= 2010.38 AND t.year >= 1953.52 AND t.year <= 2013.79 AND c.year >= 1957.04 AND c.year <= 1982.57 AND sp.year >= 1965.26 AND sp.year <= 2013.89 AND d.draftyear >= 1970.17 AND d.draftyear <= 1969.5 AND ap.season_id >= 1999.16 AND ap.season_id <= 2004.96 AND pt.points > 2250.12 AND pt.assists > 320.69 AND pt.rebounds > 2182.75 GROUP BY a.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 27537.08 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 6317.96 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 15808.68 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 1.25 AND COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) > 1.61 ORDER BY career_points DESC, career_assists DESC, career_rebounds DESC;

SELECT d.draftyear, AVG(p.height) AS avg_height, COUNT(*) AS total_players FROM draft d JOIN players p ON d.playerid = p.id WHERE d.draftyear >= 2015.01 AND p.height > 68.92 GROUP BY d.draftyear ORDER BY d.draftyear;

SELECT p.firstname, p.lastname, p.playerid, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY SUBSTRING(p.playerid FROM 1 FOR 1) ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS rank_by_id_prefix, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (ORDER BY p.playerid) AS prev_player_points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid = p.id AND ap2.award LIKE 'Most Valuable Player') AS mvp_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON p.playerid = c.coachid WHERE p.firstseason >= 1958 AND p.lastseason <= 2006 AND pt.points > 2889 AND pa.points > 14 GROUP BY p.id, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.playerid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 14595 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 14 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.firstname, p.lastname, p.playerid, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY SUBSTRING(p.playerid FROM 1 FOR 1) ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS rank_by_id_prefix, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (ORDER BY p.playerid) AS prev_player_points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid = p.id AND ap2.award LIKE 'Most Valuable Player') AS mvp_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON p.playerid = c.coachid WHERE p.firstseason >= 2004 AND p.lastseason <= 1992 AND pt.points > 2446 AND pa.points > 10 GROUP BY p.id, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.playerid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4396 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 3 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname AS first_name, p.lastname AS last_name, p.pos AS position, p.college AS college, t.lgid AS league, t.divid AS division, ap.season_id AS allstar_season, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS birth_year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.points > 21.64 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_scoring_allstar_games, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_postseason_points, SUM(pt.postassists) AS total_postseason_assists, SUM(pt.postrebounds) AS total_postseason_rebounds, (SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.assists) + SUM(pt.rebounds)) AS total_career_stats, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS league_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS overall_assists_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_percentile, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY MAX(pt.year)) AS prev_year_points, LEAD(SUM(pt.assists), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY MAX(pt.year)) AS next_year_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1986 AND 1994 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND p.height > '1.7' AND pt.points > 4272 AND (ap.points IS NOT NULL OR aw.award IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, t.lgid, t.divid, ap.season_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, t.lgid, t.divid), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college), (t.lgid, t.divid, ap.season_id), (t.lgid, t.divid), (p.pos, p.college), () ) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 35507 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 10 AND AVG(ap.points) >= 7.34 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_assists DESC, total_rebounds DESC LIMIT 510;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.stint = 1 THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS total_points_stint1, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.stint = 2 THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS total_points_stint2, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(CASE WHEN ap.season_id IS NOT NULL THEN ap.points ELSE NULL END) AS max_allstar_points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid = p.id AND ap2.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_awards_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2017 AND 1989 AND pt.points > 3400 AND (t.won > 81 OR t.won IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 45953 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 19 AND AVG(pt.assists) > 6 ORDER BY total_points_stint1 DESC, avg_assists DESC LIMIT 110;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, SUM(pt.points) AS total_career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid::character varying = p.playerid AND ap.award LIKE '%All-Star%' AND ap.year >= 2000) AS all_star_appearances_since_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pos ORDER BY AVG(pt.points) DESC) AS pos_avg_points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (ORDER BY p.playerid) AS prev_player_career_points, (SELECT MIN(draft.draftoverall) FROM draft WHERE draft.playerid::character varying = p.playerid AND draft.draftyear <= 2017) AS earliest_draft_pick, (SELECT AVG(pa.points) FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid::character varying = p.playerid AND pa.season_id BETWEEN 1966 AND 2004) AS avg_allstar_points_in_range, MAX(teams.won) AS max_team_wins_in_season, MIN(teams.lost) AS min_team_losses_in_season, SUM(teams.o_pts) AS total_team_offensive_points, COUNT(DISTINCT teams.tmid) AS distinct_teams_played_for FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams ON pt.tmid = teams.tmid::integer AND pt.year = teams.year LEFT JOIN draft ON p.playerid = draft.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.points > 1027 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1958 AND 1994 AND (p.college IS NOT NULL OR p.highschool IS NOT NULL) AND teams.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 24138 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 14 ORDER BY total_career_points DESC, avg_points_per_season DESC LIMIT 531;

SELECT p.playerid, d.draftyear, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND d.draftyear = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND d.draftyear = pa.season_id WHERE d.draftyear BETWEEN 1971 AND 1976 AND pa.points > 64 AND ap.award = 'All-Star' GROUP BY p.playerid, d.draftyear HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 117 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS full_name, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer WHERE pt.points > 14.91 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1993 AND 2017 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 10 ORDER BY avg_points_per_game DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) AS total_points, COALESCE(AVG(pt.points), 0) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1996 AND 2016 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) > 23513 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying WHERE ap.award LIKE '%All-Star%' AND pa.season_id >= 2000.82 AND pa.season_id <= 1996.44 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 112.24 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_award_types, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, SUM(CASE WHEN c.coachid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coached_seasons FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON p.playerid::integer = c.coachid::integer WHERE pt.year >= 2006 AND pt.year <= 2012 AND pa.season_id >= 1975 AND pa.season_id <= 2000 AND pt.points > 1497 AND pa.points > 71 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 47748 AND AVG(pa.points) > 42 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 4 ORDER BY career_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.points > 2012 AND ap.points BETWEEN 43 AND 38 AND (pt.gp >= 66 OR pt.minutes > 1450) AND NOT (ap.three_attempted = 0 AND ap.three_made > 0) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(ap.points) > 8 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 8 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid = awp.playerid::character varying WHERE awp.award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND awp.year BETWEEN 1997 AND 1993 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND d.draftyear > 1995) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 81 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, (SELECT AVG(pts.o_pts) FROM teams pts WHERE pts.year = ap.season_id AND pts.lgid = ap.league_id) AS avg_league_points_per_team_that_year FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year JOIN coaches c ON ap.season_id = c.year AND ap.league_id = c.lgid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE ap.points > 42 AND ap.season_id BETWEEN 1956 AND 1963 AND aw.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, ap.league_id HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 387 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.year >= 1993 AND pt.year <= 1955 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 5801 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS distinct_teams_played_for, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE ap.points > 34.15 AND pt.year >= 2002.1 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 18.51 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS distinct_team_years, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.league_id) AS distinct_allstar_leagues, COUNT(DISTINCT dp.draftyear) AS distinct_draft_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, MAX(pt.rebounds) AS max_rebounds, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) DESC) AS allstar_season_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN draft dp ON p.playerid::integer = dp.playerid JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::integer = awp.playerid AND ap.season_id = awp.year JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 1227.36 AND pt.year >= 1984 AND pt.year <= 2016 AND t.won > 15.19 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 16.23 AND SUM(pt.points) > 27747.58 ORDER BY total_points DESC, distinct_allstar_seasons DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS team_years, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position FROM players p LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid::integer AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 1983 AND p.lastseason <= 1975 AND (pa.points >= 8 OR pa.points IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) >= 2 AND AVG(pa.points) > 5.85 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 1986 AND pa.season_id >= 2007 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) > 1 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, MAX(pt.points) AS max_regular_points, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_post_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) FILTER (WHERE d.draftyear IS NOT NULL) AS draft_years, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_pick, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pa.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS regular_points_rank, (SUM(pa.points) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pa.games_played), 0)) AS allstar_ppg, (SUM(pt.points) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pt.gp), 0)) AS regular_ppg FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE pa.points > 49 AND pt.points > 1558 AND ap.year >= 1978 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 1976 AND (t.won > 12 OR t.won IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 18 AND SUM(pa.points) > 287 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, total_regular_points DESC LIMIT 443;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points_last_seasons, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points_last_seasons FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pa.playerid = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE pa.season_id >= 1998 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 120 ORDER BY total_points_last_seasons DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year IN (SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'All-NBA First Team') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 29456 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1967 AND pt.year <= 2010 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND d.draftyear > 1955 LIMIT 1) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 20117 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2019 AND pt.year <= 1991 AND pt.points > 1074 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 42542 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1950 AND pt.year <= 1981 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 22810 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year IN (SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'Most Valuable Player') AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4061.17 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE (pt.points > 1608 OR pt.assists > 24) AND NOT (pt.lgid = 'NBA' AND t.playoff = 'Y') AND pt.year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2014 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 33100 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 20 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer WHERE pt.points > 537 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2001 AND 2006 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > (SELECT AVG(points) FROM players_teams WHERE year = 1985) ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid::integer JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner WHERE pt.year >= 1995 AND pt.year <= 1970 AND pt.points > 2281 AND ap.year >= 1956 AND d.draftyear >= 1997 AND pa.season_id >= 2010 AND c.year >= 1989 AND t.year >= 1948 AND sp.year >= 1958 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 16764 AND AVG(pt.assists) > 1.08 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 20 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid::integer JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.year >= 2014 AND pt.year <= 1951 AND pt.points > 2303 AND ap.year >= 1962 AND d.draftyear >= 1994 AND pa.season_id >= 1981 AND c.year >= 2005 AND t.year >= 1998 AND sp.year >= 1960 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 24351 AND AVG(pt.assists) > 14.38 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1995 AND pt.year <= 2009 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND d.draftyear > 1972 LIMIT 1) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 18735 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE p.college LIKE '%''%' AND pt.year BETWEEN 1963 AND 1966 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 28124 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1988 AND pt.year <= 2017 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 24578 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2019 AND pt.year <= 1958 AND pt.gp > 38 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2573 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1984 AND pt.year <= 2008 AND pt.points > 42 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 32476 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) DESC) AS seasons_played_rank, (SUM(pt.points) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pt.minutes), 0)) AS points_per_minute, (SUM(pt.assists) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pt.turnovers), 0)) AS assist_to_turnover_ratio FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::integer = awp.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer WHERE pt.year >= 1986 AND pt.year <= 1981 AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM coaches c WHERE c.coachid::integer = pt.tmid AND c.year = pt.year AND c.won > 36) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 47076 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 30 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_points_per_game DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.points > 34 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_scoring_games, COUNT(pt.stint) AS total_stints FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1990 AND 2014 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 5970 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.year >= 1998 THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS recent_points, COUNT(CASE WHEN pt.lgid = 'NBA' THEN 1 END) AS league_games FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1978 AND 2013 AND pt.points > 4945 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 27824 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.year >= 2020 THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS recent_points, COUNT(CASE WHEN pt.lgid = 'NBA' THEN 1 END) AS league_seasons FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1993 AND 1991 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 31071 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(CAST(pt.points AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year) AS awards_count_per_year, (SELECT AVG(ps.points) FROM player_allstar ps WHERE ps.playerid = p.id AND ps.season_id = pt.year) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1958 AND 2012 AND pt.gp > 42 AND t.won > 61 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.id, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 590 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 425 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_assists DESC LIMIT 89;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pos ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS scoring_rank_by_position, SUM(t.o_pts) AS total_team_offensive_points, SUM(t.d_pts) AS total_team_defensive_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid = ac.coachid::character varying AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 343.77 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2016.11 AND 1949.51 AND t.won > 5.48 AND pa.points >= 75.62 AND ac.award IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 6246.69 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 37.18 ORDER BY total_points DESC, scoring_rank_by_position;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE ap.points > 27.1 AND pt.points > 1024.09 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id HAVING AVG(ap.points) > 14.97 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, pt.year, pt.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 100) AS pts_per_100min, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) FILTER (WHERE d.draftyear IS NOT NULL) AS draft_years_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.conference = 'East' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS east_allstar_appearances, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.conference = 'West' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS west_allstar_appearances, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.lgid ORDER BY AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 100) DESC) AS efficiency_rank_in_league FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid AND d.draftyear = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND aw.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND t.year = pt.year AND t.lgid = pt.lgid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1972 AND 1979 AND pt.minutes > 1275 AND (p.college IS NOT NULL OR p.highschool IS NOT NULL) AND pt.lgid IN ('NBA', 'NBA') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, pt.year, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 28253 AND AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 100) >= 84.3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 14 ORDER BY total_points DESC, efficiency_rank_in_league ASC LIMIT 147;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, SUM(pa.points) AS allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 172 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2020 AND 2003 AND pa.points > 39 AND t.won > 79 AND c.won > 63 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4042 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 10 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 18 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, SUM(pa.points) AS allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 1772 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2022 AND 2015 AND pa.points > 33 AND t.won > 74 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2520 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 35 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 9 AND SUM(pa.points) > 47 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid) AS avg_team_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1972 AND pt.year <= 1991 AND pt.points > 1095 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 977 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) AS stint_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND pt.year >= d.draftyear LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1987 AND 2007 AND pt.gp >= 58 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award IS NOT NULL ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE (sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) AND sp.year = pt.year AND sp.round = 'Finals' ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2535 AND AVG(pt.minutes) >= 15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) <= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) AS stint_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1960 AND 1986 AND pt.minutes > 2114 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = pt.tmid AND c.year = pt.year AND c.won > 76 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE (sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) AND sp.year = pt.year AND sp.w > 7 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1767 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 2 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 7154.68 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 1805.15 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS scoring_category, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1993 AND pt.year <= 2019 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1966.63 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_team_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 2001 AND pt.year <= 2001 AND pt.points > 1615 AND pa.points > 1 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1957 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 0 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = 'MVP') AS mvp_count, (SELECT AVG(pa.points) FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid = p.id AND pa.season_id = pt.year) AS allstar_avg_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1995 AND 1950 AND pt.points > 1929 AND pt.rebounds > 245 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t.id AND sp.year = pt.year ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, p.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1762 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 1957 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_rebounds DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1518 AND pt.year >= 2014 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points HAVING COUNT(pt.stint) >= 3 ORDER BY pt.year, points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award) AS coach_awards, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, ROUND(SUM(pt.fgmade)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(pt.fgattempted), 0) * 100, 2) AS fg_percentage, ROUND(SUM(pt.ftmade)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(pt.ftattempted), 0) * 100, 2) AS ft_percentage, ROUND(SUM(pt.threemade)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(pt.threeattempted), 0) * 100, 2) AS three_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid THEN sp.id END) AS playoff_series_count, MAX(c.won) AS coach_wins, MAX(c.lost) AS coach_losses, d.draftround, d.draftselection FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (pt.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR pt.tmid = sp.tmidloser) AND pt.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1062 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1981 AND 2018 AND pa.minutes > 26 AND t.won > 27 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, d.draftround, d.draftselection HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4175 AND AVG(pa.points) > 26 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 6 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS career_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS career_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS avg_points_per_minute, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pt.points) AS median_points_per_season, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pt.assists) AS percentile_75_assists, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS overall_assists_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.rebounds), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_rebounds FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 2385 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1987 AND 1974 AND t.won > 73 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' AND d.draftyear >= 2016 AND pa.points >= 35 AND c.won > 64 AND ac.year = c.year AND sp.round = 'Conf Finals' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 25636 AND AVG(pt.assists) >= 0.31 ORDER BY career_points DESC, pt.year, team_points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1987 AND 1958 AND pt.points > 698 AND t.won > 54 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2272 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.lgid) >= 4 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, points_rank_in_year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, ap.points AS allstar_points, ac.year AS coach_award_year, ac.award AS coach_award, d.draftyear, d.draftround, sp.year AS playoff_year, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, c.coachid, c.won AS coach_wins, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, SUM(t.won) AS team_total_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award) AS distinct_coach_awards FROM players p INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid INNER JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id IN (sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser) AND t.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year WHERE pt.points > 885 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1988 AND 1979 AND t.won > 20 AND (ap.points > 37 OR ap.points IS NULL) AND (d.draftround <= 3 OR d.draftround IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, ap.season_id, ap.points, ac.year, ac.award, d.draftyear, d.draftround, sp.year, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, c.coachid, c.won HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1833 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 19 AND AVG(pt.minutes) >= 46 ORDER BY total_points DESC, team_points_rank ASC LIMIT 66;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, pt.year, pt.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.season_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS allstar_appearances, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_pick, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_by_year_league, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points, SUM(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3yr_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.year >= 2006 AND pt.points > 2003 AND t.won > 3 AND (ap.points IS NULL OR ap.points > 22) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, pt.year, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 15322 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 23 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, points_rank_by_year_league ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.points > 31 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_scoring_games, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.assists > 7 AND pt.rebounds > 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS double_threat_games, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ap.league_id = 'NBA' THEN ap.season_id END) AS specific_league_allstars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points_with_team FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2008 AND 1999 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND pt.gp > 27 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.year, t.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1403 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 2 ORDER BY total_points DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.fullgivenname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league_id, pt.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_blocks, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute, AVG(pt.rebounds * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS rebounds_per_minute, AVG(pt.assists * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS assists_per_minute, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.season_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS allstar_game_appearances, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT ap2.award) AS distinct_awards_won, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.year >= 1998 THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS recent_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league_year, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS overall_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap2 ON p.playerid::integer = ap2.playerid AND pt.year = ap2.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid::integer AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE p.pos LIKE 'G' AND t.lgid LIKE 'NBA' AND p.college LIKE 'University' AND pt.year BETWEEN 1964 AND 1963 AND pt.points > 1409 AND pt.rebounds > 100 AND pt.assists > 1509 AND (t.playoff = 'Y' OR t.playoff IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.fullgivenname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, t.name, t.lgid, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 22334 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 16901 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 9493 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_rebounds DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, AVG(pt.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_points, SUM(pt.assists) OVER ( PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS running_total_assists FROM players_teams pt JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id::integer WHERE pt.year >= 2014 AND pt.points > 733 AND p.firstseason <= 1989 ORDER BY pt.playerid, pt.year;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.attendance, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS player_count, SUM(p.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(p.points) AS avg_player_points, MAX(p.points) AS max_player_points, MIN(p.points) AS min_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins, AVG(c.won) AS avg_coach_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.won DESC) AS league_rank_by_wins, SUM(t.won) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_wins_in_league, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t.id OR sp.tmidloser = t.id) AS playoff_series_appearances, (SELECT AVG(d.draftoverall) FROM draft d WHERE d.tmid = t.id AND d.draftyear BETWEEN t.year - 5 AND t.year) AS avg_draft_pick_last_5_years FROM teams t JOIN players_teams p ON t.id = p.tmid AND t.year = p.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid AND p.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::text = ac.coachid::text AND c.year = ac.year WHERE t.year >= 1993 AND t.year <= 1972 AND t.won >= 35 AND t.attendance >= 2628268 GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.attendance, t.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 494 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) > 68 UNION ALL SELECT t.lgid, t.year, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.attendance, COUNT(DISTINCT pas.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(pas.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(pas.points) AS avg_player_points, MAX(pas.points) AS max_player_points, MIN(pas.points) AS min_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins, AVG(c.won) AS avg_coach_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.won DESC) AS league_rank_by_wins, SUM(t.won) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_wins_in_league, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t.id OR sp.tmidloser = t.id) AS playoff_series_appearances, (SELECT AVG(d.draftoverall) FROM draft d WHERE d.tmid = t.id AND d.draftyear BETWEEN t.year - 5 AND t.year) AS avg_draft_pick_last_5_years FROM teams t JOIN player_allstar pas ON t.lgid = pas.league_id AND t.year = pas.season_id JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON pas.playerid = ap.playerid AND pas.season_id = ap.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::text = ac.coachid::text AND c.year = ac.year WHERE t.year >= 1955 AND t.year <= 1948 AND t.won >= 8 AND t.attendance >= 2838785 GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.attendance, t.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pas.playerid) > 28 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) > 1 ORDER BY league_rank_by_wins, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.name, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.award = 'MVP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mvp_count FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t.year = pt.year AND t.lgid = pt.lgid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ps ON pt.playerid = ps.playerid AND pt.year = ps.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year AND t.lgid = c.lgid JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND t.year = sp.year WHERE t.year >= 1954 AND t.year <= 1961 AND t.won >= 72 AND t.attendance > 466522 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 45744 UNION ALL SELECT t.name, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, SUM(CASE WHEN ac.award = 'Coach of the Year' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coach_of_year_count FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t.year = pt.year AND t.lgid = pt.lgid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ps ON pt.playerid = ps.playerid AND pt.year = ps.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON t.tmid = ac.coachid::character varying AND t.year = ac.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year AND t.lgid = c.lgid JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidloser::character varying AND t.year = sp.year WHERE t.year >= 2003 AND t.year <= 1951 AND t.lost >= 80 AND t.attendance > 1914358 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3231 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.name ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2017 AND t.year <= 1992 GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 41931 ORDER BY t.name, t.year;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 2020 AND pt.year <= 1987 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 26741.28 INTERSECT SELECT t.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 1962 AND pt.year <= 1997 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) < 12381.57 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1956 AND 1991 AND pt.playerid IN ( SELECT ap.playerid FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = 'All-NBA First Team' ) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 11692 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.lgid, SUM(pt.minutes) AS total_minutes_played, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_player, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2020.12 AND 1963.65 AND (t.lgid = 'NBA' OR t.lgid = 'NBA') AND t.playoff = 'Y' AND pt.minutes > 1930.44 AND NOT (p.birthcountry = 'USA') GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 149647.0 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_minutes_played DESC;

pt.rebounds > 1836 AND ap.rebounds > 21 AND pt.assists > 1084 AND ap.assists > 41 AND pt.steals > 436 AND ap.steals > 2 AND pt.blocks > 423 AND ap.blocks > 0 AND pt.turnovers > 647 AND ap.turnovers > SELECT a.playerid, a.year, 'awards_players' AS source, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM awards_players a JOIN players p ON a.playerid::character varying = p.playerid WHERE a.year > 2011 GROUP BY a.playerid, a.year UNION ALL SELECT d.playerid, d.draftyear AS year, 'draft' AS source, 1 AS award_count FROM draft d JOIN players p2 ON d.playerid::character varying = p2.playerid WHERE d.draftyear BETWEEN 1947 AND 2014 ORDER BY year DESC, award_count DESC;

SELECT a.year, a.award, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS player_count, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points FROM awards_players a JOIN awards_players a2 ON a.year = a2.year AND a.playerid = a2.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON a.playerid = pa.playerid AND a.year = pa.season_id WHERE a.year >= 2017.26 AND a.year <= 1971.25 GROUP BY a.year, a.award HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) > 64.59 ORDER BY player_count DESC;

SELECT a.year, a.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS award_players, AVG(pas.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM awards_players a JOIN player_allstar pas ON a.playerid = pas.playerid AND a.year = pas.season_id JOIN players_teams pt ON a.playerid = pt.playerid AND a.year = pt.year WHERE a.year >= 1997 AND a.year <= 1977 GROUP BY a.year, a.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) > 76 ORDER BY a.year DESC, award_players DESC;

SELECT ap.playerid, ap.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, SUM(ap2.year) AS total_award_years FROM awards_players ap JOIN awards_players ap2 ON ap.playerid = ap2.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 1973 AND ap2.year <= 1956 GROUP BY ap.playerid, ap.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 7 ORDER BY award_count DESC;

SELECT c.coachid, t.tmid, t.name, ap.playerid, ap.award, ap.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_count, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.assists) AS avg_assists, SUM(pt.points) AS team_points, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS team_losses, SUM(t.o_pts) AS team_offensive_points, SUM(t.d_pts) AS team_defensive_points, GROUPING(c.coachid, t.tmid, ap.playerid, ap.award, ap.year) AS grouping_id FROM coaches c JOIN teams t ON c.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND c.year = t.year AND c.lgid = t.lgid JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid = ac.coachid::character varying AND c.year = ac.year JOIN awards_players ap ON ac.year = ap.year AND ac.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN player_allstar pa ON ap.playerid = pa.playerid AND ap.year = pa.season_id JOIN players_teams pt ON pa.playerid = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::character varying = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND t.year = sp.year WHERE ac.award = 'Coach of the Year' AND ap.award IN ('MVP', 'All-NBA') AND pa.points > 70.31 AND t.won > 8.02 AND t.year BETWEEN 2013.61 AND 2011.39 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((c.coachid, t.tmid, t.name, ap.playerid, ap.award, ap.year), (c.coachid, t.tmid, t.name, ap.year), (c.coachid, t.tmid, t.name), (c.coachid, t.tmid), (c.coachid), ()) HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 604.54 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) >= 4.86 ORDER BY total_points DESC, team_wins DESC, grouping_id;

SELECT p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, p.college, p.birthdate, pt.year, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_by_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1967 AND pt.year <= 1958 AND p.birthdate IS NOT NULL AND (p.birthdate::date) >= (DATE '1900-01-01' + INTERVAL '45 years') AND (p.birthdate::date) <= (DATE '2005-12-31' - INTERVAL '39 years') AND pt.points > 4787 GROUP BY p.firstname, p.lastname, p.college, p.birthdate, pt.year, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 5087 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname AS first_name, p.lastname AS last_name, 'Regular Season' AS season_type, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.minutes) AS total_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1351 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2011 AND 1957 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname UNION ALL SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname AS first_name, p.lastname AS last_name, 'All-Star' AS season_type, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, SUM(pa.minutes) AS total_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE pa.points > 56 AND pa.season_id BETWEEN 1956 AND 1967 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname AS first_name, p.lastname AS last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, SUM(ap.year) AS total_award_years, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(pa.season_id) AS latest_allstar_season FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying WHERE p.college LIKE '%State%' AND pa.season_id >= 1985.53 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 8.34 ORDER BY distinct_awards_count DESC, total_award_years DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, (SELECT MAX(d.draftoverall) FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid::character varying = p.playerid) AS best_draft_position FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND ap.year = pa.season_id WHERE pa.season_id >= 1956 AND pa.season_id <= 1996 AND pt.points > 3751 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 17.04 ORDER BY total_regular_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, (SELECT MAX(d.draftoverall) FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid::character varying = p.playerid) AS best_draft_position FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND ap.year = pa.season_id WHERE pa.season_id >= 2005 AND pa.season_id <= 2014 AND pt.points > 2812 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 5.92 ORDER BY total_regular_points DESC;

END), 0) AS nba_allstar_assists, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pt.lgid = 'NBA' THEN pt.assists ELSE 0 END), 0) AS nba_regular_assists, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pt.lgid = 'NBA' THEN pt.postassists ELSE 0 END), 0) AS nba_playoff_assists, AVG(CASE WHEN ap.league_id = 'NBA' THEN ap.points ELSE NULL END) AS avg_nba_allstar_points, AVG(CASE WHEN pt.lgid = 'NBA' THEN pt.points ELSE NULL END) AS avg_nba_regular_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS nba_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS nba_regular_seasons, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid = p.id AND ap2.award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND ap2.lgid = 'NBA') AS mvp_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap3 WHERE ap3.playerid = p.id AND ap3.award = 'Finals MVP' AND ap3.lgid = 'NBA') AS finals_mvp_count, (SELECT MAX(draft.draftoverall) FROM draft WHERE draft.playerid = p.id AND draft.lgid = 'NBA') AS highest_draft_pick, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner IN (SELECT tmid FROM players_teams pt2 WHERE pt2.playerid = p.id) OR sp.tmidloser IN (SELECT tmid FROM players_teams pt3 WHERE pt3.playerid = p.id)) AS playoff_series_appearances, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY
