SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 1457.93 AND pt.gp >= 21.27 AND t.won > 40.34 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' AND pt.year BETWEEN 1981.34 AND 1957.82 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2405.28 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 330.06 AND pt.gp >= 49.48 AND t.won > 50.27 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' AND pt.year BETWEEN 1971.66 AND 1987.51 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 21916.11 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS total_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) DESC) AS seasons_played_rank, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.year >= 2001 THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS recent_points, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(pt.year::text, 'YYYY')) IN (4, 3) THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS q_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1656 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1989 AND 1955 AND ap.points > 20 AND t.won > 22 AND sp.w > 6 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 23619 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, seasons_played DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1978 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = pt.playerid AND d.draftyear <= 1956) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 10390 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2010 AND pt.year <= 1958 AND (pt.points > 45 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = 'All-NBA')) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 29252 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 246.75 AND pt.year >= 1971.74 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 1.6 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 2576 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1980 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 32808 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1983 AND pt.year <= 1975 AND pt.points > 0 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 15917 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 2238 AND t.won > 47 AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 39219 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) DESC) AS awards_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid::integer JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::character varying = ac.coachid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::character varying = sp.tmidwinner::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 2017 AND pt.year <= 1959 AND pt.points > 62 AND pa.points > 37 AND t.won > 46 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 10525 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 47 ORDER BY total_points DESC, awards_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 2452 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND d.draftyear >= 1968) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 33094 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1094.8 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1993 AND 1951 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 16.26 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, SUM(ap.points) AS total_points, AVG(ap.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid) AS avg_points_per_allstar FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players aw ON p.id = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year WHERE ap.points > 20.48 AND aw.year >= 1991.03 AND aw.year <= 1987.27 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, ap.points HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 456.0 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.assists, ap.rebounds, ap.steals, ap.blocks, (ap.points + ap.assists + ap.rebounds + ap.steals + ap.blocks) AS total_stats, AVG(ap.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid) AS avg_points_per_season, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid) AS allstar_appearances FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = CAST(ap.playerid AS character varying) JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid = CAST(aw.playerid AS character varying) AND ap.season_id = aw.year WHERE ap.points > 20.8 AND ap.season_id BETWEEN 1983.6 AND 2000.88 AND aw.award = 'All-Star' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.assists, ap.rebounds, ap.steals, ap.blocks, aw.award HAVING (ap.points + ap.assists + ap.rebounds + ap.steals + ap.blocks) > 34.56 ORDER BY total_stats DESC, ap.season_id ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, d.draftyear, d.draftround FROM players p LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE d.playerid IS NULL AND p.firstseason >= 1942 AND p.lastseason <= 1979 ORDER BY p.lastname, p.firstname;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, d.draftyear, d.draftround FROM players p LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE d.playerid IS NULL AND p.firstseason >= 1957 AND p.lastseason <= 2001 ORDER BY p.lastname, p.firstname;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.birthdate, d.draftyear, d.draftoverall, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.assists, ap.rebounds, pt.year AS team_year, pt.points AS team_points, pt.assists AS team_assists, pt.rebounds AS team_rebounds, c.year AS coach_year, c.won AS coach_wins, c.lost AS coach_losses, ac.award, ac.year AS award_year, t.name AS team_name, t.year AS team_stats_year, t.won AS team_wins, t.lost AS team_losses, AVG(ap.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY ap.season_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_points_career, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid, pt.year ORDER BY pt.stint) AS total_points_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.draftyear ORDER BY d.draftoverall) AS draft_rank, COUNT(ac.award) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid) AS total_awards, (ap.points + ap.assists + ap.rebounds) AS allstar_game_score, (pt.points + pt.assists + pt.rebounds) AS season_game_score, (t.o_pts - t.d_pts) AS team_point_diff, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS birth_year, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) + 29 AS projected_retirement_year, TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + INTERVAL '35 years' AS projected_peak_date FROM players p JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = CAST(d.playerid AS character varying) JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = CAST(ap.playerid AS character varying) JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = CAST(pt.playerid AS character varying) AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = CAST(c.tmid AS integer) AND pt.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid = CAST(ac.coachid AS character varying) AND c.year = ac.year JOIN awards_players aap ON p.playerid = CAST(aap.playerid AS character varying) AND ap.season_id = aap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = CAST(t.tmid AS integer) AND pt.year = t.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = CAST(sp.tmidwinner AS character varying) AND t.year = sp.year WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 1983 AND 1971 AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1960 AND 1982 AND ap.season_id BETWEEN 2015 AND 1972 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1962 AND 1966 AND c.year BETWEEN 1963 AND 1979 AND ac.year BETWEEN 1990 AND 2013 AND t.year BETWEEN 1954 AND 1963 AND sp.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 1984 AND (ap.points > 39 OR ap.assists > 7 OR ap.rebounds > 8) AND (pt.points > 1594 OR pt.assists > 291 OR pt.rebounds > 419) AND (t.o_pts > 8032 AND t.d_pts < 13723) AND TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + INTERVAL '34 years' >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '22 years' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.birthdate, d.draftyear, d.draftoverall, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.assists, ap.rebounds, pt.year, pt.points, pt.assists, pt.rebounds, c.year, c.won, c.lost, ac.award, ac.year, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, d.draftyear, d.draftoverall, ap.season_id, pt.stint, ac.award, p.playerid, ap.points, ap.assists, ap.rebounds, pt.points, pt.assists, pt.rebounds HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4885 AND AVG(ap.points) > '5.0' AND COUNT(ac.award) > 5 ORDER BY total_points_season DESC, avg_points_career DESC, draft_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight, p.pos, p.college, p.birthdate, p.birthcountry, p.highschool, p.hscity, p.hsstate, p.hscountry, p.usefirst, p.firstseason, p.lastseason, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_blocks, SUM(pt.turnovers) AS total_turnovers, SUM(pt.pf) AS total_pf, SUM(pt.minutes) AS total_minutes, SUM(pt.gp) AS total_gp, SUM(pt.gs) AS total_gs, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute, AVG(pt.assists * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.turnovers, 0)) AS ast_to_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(ps.points) AS max_allstar_points, MAX(ps.assists) AS max_allstar_assists, MAX(ps.rebounds) AS max_allstar_rebounds, MAX(ps.steals) AS max_allstar_steals, MAX(ps.blocks) AS max_allstar_blocks, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_won, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, MAX(d.draftyear) AS draft_year, MAX(t.won) AS max_team_wins, MAX(t.lost) AS max_team_losses, MAX(t.attendance) AS max_team_attendance, MAX(t.o_pts) AS max_team_off_pts, MAX(t.d_pts) AS max_team_def_pts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.steals) DESC) AS steals_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.blocks) DESC) AS blocks_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) DESC) AS ppm_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(pt.assists * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.turnovers, 0)) DESC) AS ast_to_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.playerid = ps.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = ps.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying WHERE (pt.points > 28 OR pt.assists > 5 OR pt.rebounds > 11 OR pt.steals > 10 OR pt.blocks > 5) AND pt.year BETWEEN 2004 AND 1991 AND (p.height > '150.0' OR p.weight > 134) AND (p.birthcountry = 'USA' OR p.hscountry = 'USA') AND (p.college IS NOT NULL OR p.highschool IS NOT NULL) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND ap2.award = 'Most Valuable Player')) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t.id OR sp.tmidloser = t.id)) AND (pt.tmid IN (SELECT pt2.tmid FROM players_teams pt2 WHERE pt2.playerid = pt.playerid AND pt2.year > pt.year - 3 GROUP BY pt2.tmid HAVING SUM(pt2.points) > 4499)) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight, p.pos, p.college, p.birthdate, p.birthcountry, p.highschool, p.hscity, p.hsstate, p.hscountry, p.usefirst, p.firstseason, p.lastseason HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 10411 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 1423 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 16910 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 6 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_assists DESC, total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pa.rebounds) AS total_allstar_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS allstar_seasons_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pt.points) AS median_regular_season_points, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pt.assists) AS p75_regular_season_assists, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_postseason_points, AVG(t.won) AS avg_team_wins, MAX(t.attendance) AS max_team_attendance, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE p.height > 201.96 AND p.weight BETWEEN 195 AND 134 AND pt.year >= 1993 AND t.attendance > 193636 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 14.47 AND SUM(pt.postpoints) > 2650 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) >= 20 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC, total_postseason_points DESC LIMIT 90;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS career_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS career_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, AVG(pt.assists * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_assists_per_game, AVG(pt.rebounds * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_rebounds_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(ap.season_id) AS last_allstar_season, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::integer = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 1551 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1968 AND 2017 AND (p.college IS NOT NULL OR 0 = 1) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 25144 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 26 ORDER BY career_points DESC, career_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = 'All-NBA') as award_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1006 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 1999 ORDER BY pt.points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = 'All-NBA') as award_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 2312 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1991 AND 2010 ORDER BY pt.points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points, AVG(pt.points) OVER(PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1962 AND 1987 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points ORDER BY p.playerid, pt.year;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1848 AND pt.year >= 2006 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points HAVING COUNT(pt.stint) >= 5 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award) AS coach_awards, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON pt.tmid::integer = ac.coachid::integer AND pt.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.id = ps.playerid AND pt.year = ps.season_id JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1988 AND 1960 AND pt.points > 1066 AND pt.rebounds > 577 AND pt.assists > 964 AND t.won > 68 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2208 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 1695 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 116 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_rebounds DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, SUM(pa.points) AS allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, SUM(sp.w) AS playoff_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 2493 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2011 AND 1998 AND pa.points > 20 AND t.won > 68 AND c.won > 50 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4939 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 10 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 24 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) AS stint_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid::integer AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT sp.year FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.w > 3 AND sp.l < 1 ) AND pt.minutes > 144 AND pa.points > 31 AND c.won > 59 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 918 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 24 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_minutes DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) AS stint_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1954 AND 2009 AND pt.points > 1496 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award IS NOT NULL ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = pt.tmid AND c.year = pt.year AND c.won > 77 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1014 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_by_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.coachid::integer AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.points > 25 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1965 AND 1966 AND t.won > 59 AND pa.points > 32 AND c.won > 20 AND sp.year = pt.year GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 253 AND AVG(pt.points) > 18.4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_points_per_game DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 5117.46 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 833.95 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS scoring_category, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1990 AND 2012 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1323.77 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 42 AND pt.year >= 1968 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 127 ORDER BY pt.year, points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) > 6983.43 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.assists) > 8105.31 THEN 'High Assister' ELSE 'Balanced' END AS player_category FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND p.id::text = pt.playerid::text JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::text = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1999 AND pt.year <= 2015 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2931.21 OR SUM(pt.assists) > 3495.77 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, pt.tmid;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_position, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins_for_team, SUM(t.won) AS total_team_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league, SUM(pt.points) / NULLIF(SUM(pt.minutes), 0) AS points_per_minute FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year AND t.lgid = c.lgid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 243.56 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2016.73 AND 1974.9 AND t.won > 81.36 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.assists) > 622.53 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 21.52 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank_in_league;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, AVG(pt.points + pt.rebounds + pt.assists) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid, pt.year) AS team_avg_performance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid, pt.year ORDER BY (pt.points + pt.rebounds + pt.assists) DESC) AS performance_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1954.98 AND pt.points >= 2422.72 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists HAVING (pt.points + pt.rebounds + pt.assists) > 3269.49 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, pt.tmid, performance_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1985 AND 2013 AND pt.points > 2109 AND t.won > 18 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4164 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.lgid) >= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, points_rank_in_year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_season_league, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS previous_season_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2000 AND pt.year <= 1988 AND pt.points > 2169 AND t.won > 17 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4340 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 7 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, points_rank_in_season_league ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pt.points) AS median_points_per_game, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pt.assists) AS percentile_75_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_by_year, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS overall_assists_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 41 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2020 AND 1957 AND t.won > 26 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' AND d.draftyear >= 1967 AND pa.points >= 22 AND c.won > 73 AND ac.year = c.year AND sp.round = 'Conf Finals' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1918 AND AVG(pt.assists) > 3.21 ORDER BY total_points DESC, overall_assists_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_per_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT year FROM coaches WHERE coachid = 'A' AND lgid = 'AA' UNION SELECT year FROM series_post WHERE tmidwinner = 126 OR tmidloser = 108 INTERSECT SELECT season_id FROM player_allstar WHERE league_id = 'AA' AND conference = 'East' ) AND pt.points > 1000 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2015 AND 1986 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 48037 AND AVG(pt.assists) >= 6269 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_points_per_season DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year WHERE pt.year >= 2010 AND pt.year <= 1967 AND pt.points > 2952 AND pt.minutes > 90 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 20854 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.lgid) >= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1995 AND pt.year <= 1963 AND pt.points > 2658 AND pt.gp >= 74 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 135 AND AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) > 14.72 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, t.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_ppg, AVG(pt.assists * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_apg, AVG(pt.rebounds * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_rpg, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank_in_league_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank_in_league_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) FILTER (WHERE ap.award IS NOT NULL) AS distinct_awards_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid AND sp.year = pt.year) AS team_playoff_series_wins, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = pt.tmid AND c.year = pt.year AND c.won > c.lost) AS winning_coach_stints FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying AND d.draftyear = p.firstseason LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2005 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND pt.gp >= 79 AND pt.points >= 2449 AND (p.college = 'University of California, Los Angeles' OR p.college IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 25339 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 9607 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 21716 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC, total_assists DESC, total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 44 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2001 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' AND d.draftyear >= 1997 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 18927 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 19 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, ap.conference, SUM(ap.points) AS total_points, SUM(ap.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(ap.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(ap.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS seasons_played, MAX(ap.games_played) AS max_games_in_season, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_regular_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_regular_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_regular_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS regular_seasons_played, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_post_points, SUM(pt.postassists) AS total_post_assists, SUM(pt.postrebounds) AS total_post_rebounds, AVG(pt.postminutes) AS avg_post_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pt.postgp > 0 THEN pt.year END) AS post_seasons_played, SUM(d.draftoverall) AS draft_sum, COUNT(d.draftyear) AS draft_count, AVG(c.won::numeric / NULLIF(c.won + c.lost, 0)) AS coach_win_percentage, SUM(c.post_wins) AS total_coach_post_wins, SUM(s.w) AS total_series_wins_by_team, COUNT(s.id) AS series_appearances, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.league_id ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS league_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS overall_regular_points_rank, LAG(SUM(ap.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY ap.season_id) AS prev_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.lgid = t.lgid AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year AND t.lgid = c.lgid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN series_post s ON t.id = s.tmidwinner AND t.year = s.year JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year WHERE ap.points > 24 AND pt.points > 2860 AND t.won > 33 AND d.draftyear >= 1949 AND aw.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, ap.conference, t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 490 AND SUM(pt.points) > 28359 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 19 AND AVG(pt.minutes) >= 11 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_regular_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.playerid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS allstar_appearances, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_per_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points, (SUM(pt.points) - LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year)) AS points_change_from_prev FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 2747 AND pt.year >= 1990 AND pt.year <= 2006 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 22136 AND AVG(pt.assists) > 166 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_pick, SUM(CASE WHEN c.post_wins > c.post_losses THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS winning_postseasons, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_team FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE pt.year >= 1996 AND pt.year <= 2000 AND pt.points > 1608 AND t.won > 72 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.year, t.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 26768 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 7 AND AVG(pa.points) >= 34 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank_in_team;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_playoff_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(c.won) AS max_coach_wins, SUM(s.w) AS total_series_wins_by_teams, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) DESC) AS awards_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.postpoints) DESC) AS playoff_percentile FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::character varying = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year JOIN series_post s ON t.id = s.tmidwinner OR t.id = s.tmidloser WHERE pt.points > 1234.63 AND pt.year >= 1969.32 AND t.won >= 28.21 AND pa.points >= 48.22 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 21418.63 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 3.86 ORDER BY total_regular_points DESC, awards_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.tmid, t.name, pt.year, pt.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_lg, SUM(pt.points) / NULLIF(SUM(pt.minutes), 0) AS points_per_minute, (SELECT MAX(d.draftoverall) FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid::character varying = p.playerid AND d.draftyear <= pt.year) AS highest_draft_pick_before_year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND c.year = pt.year AND c.won > c.lost) AS winning_coaches_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::character varying = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.lgid = t.lgid AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON pa.playerid = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE pt.points > 2962.06 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1943.58 AND 1990.99 AND t.won > 15.35 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.tmid, t.name, pt.year, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.assists) > 888.83 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 47.51 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank_lg;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.year, t.lgid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.season_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS allstar_appearances, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_season_league, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_season_points, SUM(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3_season_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2008 AND pt.year <= 1955 AND pt.points > 761 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.year, t.lgid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2366 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 4 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstseason, p.lastseason, ap.season_id, AVG(ap.points) OVER(PARTITION BY p.playerid) AS avg_points, SUM(ap.o_rebounds) OVER(PARTITION BY ap.season_id ORDER BY ap.minutes DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_oreb FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players awp ON ap.playerid = awp.playerid AND ap.season_id = awp.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 1975 AND p.lastseason <= 1959 AND awp.award = 'All-NBA First Team' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstseason, p.lastseason, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.o_rebounds, ap.minutes ORDER BY avg_points DESC, running_total_oreb DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner WHERE pt.points > 24 AND pa.points > 36 AND t.won > 59 AND c.won > 37 AND sp.w > 4 AND ap.year >= 1952 AND d.draftyear <= 1957 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1780 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 24 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.points > 16 AND pa.points > 35 AND t.lost > 55 AND c.lost > 67 AND sp.l > 4 AND ap.year >= 1987 AND d.draftyear <= 2015 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 39869 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 17 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, t.tmid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS birth_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) AS distinct_awards, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_pick, SUM(CASE WHEN c.won > c.lost THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS winning_seasons_coached, SUM(sp.w) AS total_playoff_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::integer = awp.playerid LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner WHERE pt.points > 841 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1983 AND 2008 AND ap.minutes > 14 AND awp.year >= 1962 GROUP BY CUBE(p.playerid, t.tmid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 11460 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 13 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_assists DESC;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points AS regular_points, p2.points AS allstar_points, (p1.points - p2.points) AS point_difference FROM players_teams p1 JOIN player_allstar p2 ON p1.playerid = p2.playerid AND p1.year = p2.season_id WHERE p1.points > 1381 AND p2.points > 46 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points, p2.points ORDER BY point_difference DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_player, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player') AS mvp_count_in_year, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_blocks, SUM(pt.turnovers) AS total_turnovers, MAX(pt.points) AS max_player_points, MIN(pt.points) AS min_player_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS league_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS overall_assists_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points, LEAD(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS next_year_points, (SELECT AVG(pas.points) FROM player_allstar pas WHERE pas.season_id = t.year AND pas.league_id = t.lgid) AS avg_allstar_points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coaches c WHERE c.year = t.year AND c.lgid = t.lgid AND c.won > c.lost) AS winning_coaches_count, SUM(t.o_pts) AS team_offensive_points, SUM(t.d_pts) AS team_defensive_points, (SUM(t.o_pts) - SUM(t.d_pts)) AS point_differential, (SELECT SUM(sp.w) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = t.id OR sp.tmidloser = t.id)) AS total_playoff_wins FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.id = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year AND t.lgid = pt.lgid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::text = p.playerid LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND d.draftyear = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap2 ON p.id = ap2.playerid AND ap2.year = t.year AND ap2.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN coaches c2 ON t.id = c2.tmid AND t.year = c2.year AND t.lgid = c2.lgid LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c2.id = ac.coachid::integer AND ac.year = t.year AND ac.lgid = t.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2007 AND t.year <= 2014 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND t.playoff = 'Y' GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year, t.name, t.tmid, t.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 21127 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) >= 31 ORDER BY total_team_points DESC, t.year ASC, t.name ASC;

SELECT t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t.year = pt.year WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT year FROM players_teams WHERE playerid IN ( SELECT playerid FROM awards_players WHERE year BETWEEN 2006 AND 1962 ) ) GROUP BY t.name HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 8.03 ORDER BY player_count DESC;

SELECT t.name, t.won AS team_wins, t.lost AS team_losses, c.coachid AS coach_id, c.won AS coach_wins, c.lost AS coach_losses, AVG(c.won::numeric / (c.won + c.lost)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid) AS avg_coach_win_pct_by_team, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(c.won::numeric / (c.won + c.lost)) DESC) AS overall_coach_win_pct_rank FROM teams t JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.won > 58.15 AND c.won > 47.21 GROUP BY t.name, t.tmid, t.won, t.lost, c.coachid, c.won, c.lost ORDER BY overall_coach_win_pct_rank;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, p.pos, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS birth_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS allstar_players, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.playerid) AS award_players, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.tmidwinner) AS playoff_series_won FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 27.91 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1983 AND 2012 AND t.won > 22.91 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (t.tmid, t.lgid), (t.tmid, p.pos), (t.lgid, birth_year), (t.tmid), (t.lgid), (p.pos), (birth_year), () ) HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 11.28 ORDER BY total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, pt.year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::text = p.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2005 AND pt.points > 159 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (t.tmid, t.lgid, pt.year), (t.tmid, t.lgid), (t.lgid, pt.year), (t.tmid), (t.lgid), (pt.year), () ) ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2009 AND pt.points > 26 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 23.7 ORDER BY player_count DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.points > 35.09) AS high_scorers_count FROM teams t JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::character varying = sp.tmidwinner::character varying WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 1994 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.year HAVING t.won > 37.1 ORDER BY high_scorers_count DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t.id AND sp.year = t.year) AS playoff_series_won, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.id = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2023 AND t.won >= 35 AND t.o_pts >= 4034 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 21002 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::text = pt.tmid::text AND t.year = pt.year WHERE t.year >= 1994.36 AND t.won > 4.6 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.id) AS coach_award_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS player_award_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, SUM(d.draftoverall) AS total_draft_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points FROM teams t JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN draft d ON pt.playerid = d.playerid AND d.draftyear = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1966 AND 1958 AND t.attendance > 3276450 AND pt.points > 612 AND pa.points > 56 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 45901 AND AVG(pt.points) > 12.22 ORDER BY total_team_points DESC, t.year;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.name, t.lgid, SUM(ap.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(ap.three_made) AS avg_threes_made, COUNT(DISTINCT d.playerid) AS drafted_players, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_season_points, MAX(c.won) AS max_coach_wins, SUM(sp.w) AS total_playoff_wins, SUM(sp.l) AS total_playoff_losses, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.playerid) AS award_winning_players, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND t.year = ap.season_id JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1971.83 AND 1979.26 JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser) AND t.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND awp.year = t.year WHERE t.attendance > 835163.83 AND t.year >= 2000.89 AND t.year <= 1989.47 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 10899.64 AND COUNT(DISTINCT d.playerid) >= 23.58 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC, total_team_season_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.name, t.lgid, SUM(ap.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(ap.three_made) AS avg_threes_made, COUNT(DISTINCT d.playerid) AS drafted_players, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_season_points, MAX(c.won) AS max_coach_wins, SUM(sp.w) AS total_playoff_wins, SUM(sp.l) AS total_playoff_losses, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.playerid) AS award_winning_players, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND t.year = ap.season_id JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 2009.7 AND 2018.42 JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser) AND t.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND awp.year = t.year WHERE t.attendance > 865472.21 AND t.year >= 1982.54 AND t.year <= 1955.09 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 43206.86 AND COUNT(DISTINCT d.playerid) >= 1.3 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC, total_team_season_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS num_players, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::text JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::text WHERE pt.year >= 2002 AND pt.year <= 1991 AND ap.award = 'NBA All-Defensive First Team' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, AVG(t1.won) AS avg_wins, AVG(t2.won) AS avg_wins_prev_year, AVG(t1.won) - AVG(t2.won) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.year >= 1984 AND t2.year >= 1975 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid HAVING AVG(t1.won) > 11 ORDER BY win_change DESC;

WITH player_performance AS ( SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.lgid, pt.gp, pt.minutes, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, pt.steals, pt.blocks, pt.turnovers, pt.pf, ROUND(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS pts_per_36, ROUND(pt.rebounds::numeric / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS reb_per_36, ROUND(pt.assists::numeric / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS ast_per_36, ROUND((pt.steals + pt.blocks)::numeric / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS stl_blk_per_36, ROUND(pt.turnovers::numeric / NULLIF(pt.assists, 0), 2) AS ast_to_ratio, CASE WHEN pt.fgattempted > 0 THEN ROUND(pt.fgmade::numeric / pt.fgattempted * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END AS fg_pct, CASE WHEN pt.ftattempted > 0 THEN ROUND(pt.ftmade::numeric / pt.ftattempted * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END AS ft_pct, CASE WHEN pt.threeattempted > 0 THEN ROUND(pt.threemade::numeric / pt.threeattempted * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END AS three_pct FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.minutes > 381 AND pt.gp > 39 ), team_performance AS ( SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.o_reb, t.d_reb, t.o_asts, t.d_stl, t.o_blk, t.d_to, ROUND(t.o_pts::numeric / NULLIF(t.d_pts, 0), 2) AS off_def_ratio, ROUND((t.o_reb + t.o_pts > 7788 ), coach_performance AS ( SELECT c.coachid, c.year, c.tmid, c.lgid, c.won, c.lost, c.post_wins, c.post_losses, c.won::numeric / NULLIF(c.won + c.lost, 0) AS reg_season_win_pct, CASE d.playerid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftselection, d.draftoverall, d.tmid, d.lgid, CASE WHEN d.draftround = 1 AND d.draftselection <= 10 THEN 'Lottery' WHEN d.draftround = 1 THEN 'First Round' WHEN d.draftround = 2 THEN 'Second Round' ELSE 'Late Round' END AS draft_tier FROM draft d WHERE d.draftyear BETWEEN 2014 AND 2009 ), all_star_performance AS ( SELECT asp.playerid, asp.season_id, asp.games_played, asp.minutes, asp.points, asp.rebounds, asp.assists, asp.steals, asp.blocks, ROUND(asp.points::numeric / NULLIF(asp.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS asg_pts_per_36, ROUND(asp.rebounds::numeric / NULLIF(asp.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS asg_reb_per_36, ROUND(asp.assists::numeric / NULLIF(asp.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS asg_ast_per_36 FROM player_allstar asp WHERE asp.minutes > 35 AND asp.points > 12 coach_win_pct, cp.playoff_win_pct, aw.award, aw.awards_count, da.draft_tier, da.draftoverall, asp.asg_pts_per_36, asp.asg_reb_per_36, asp.asg_ast_per_36, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY pp.year, pp.lgid ORDER BY pp.pts_per_36 DESC ) AS pts_per_36_rank, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY pp.year, pp.lgid, p.pos ORDER BY (pp.pts_per_36 + pp.reb_per_36 + pp.ast_per_36) DESC ) AS overall_perf_rank_by_pos, JOIN players p ON pp.playerid = p.id::integer JOIN team_performance tp ON pp.tmid = tp.tmid::integer AND pp.year = tp.year AND pp.lgid = tp.lgid JOIN coach_performance cp ON pp.tmid = cp.tmid::integer all_star_performance asp ON pp.playerid = asp.playerid AND pp.year = asp.season_id LEFT JOIN teams t ON pp.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pp.year = t.year WHERE pp.pts_per_36 > 37.98 AND pp.ast_to_ratio < SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_season_league FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1968 AND pt.year <= 2018 AND pt.points > 1103 AND t.won > 70 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1440 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 10 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, MIN(d.draftyear) AS draft_year, MAX(c.won) AS max_coach_wins, (SUM(pt.points) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pt.fgattempted), 0)) AS points_per_attempt FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid::integer = c.tmid::integer AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year >= 1984 AND pt.year <= 1955 AND pt.points > 4812 AND t.won > 67 AND (c.won > 13 OR c.won IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, pt.tmid, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 18583 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 4458 ORDER BY total_points DESC, team_points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, MIN(d.draftyear) AS draft_year, MAX(c.won) AS max_coach_wins, (SUM(pt.points) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pt.fgattempted), 0)) AS points_per_attempt FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid::integer = c.tmid::integer AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year >= 2020 AND pt.year <= 1983 AND pt.points > 7190 AND t.won > 1 AND (c.won > 53 OR c.won IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, pt.tmid, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 42135 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 1463 ORDER BY total_points DESC, team_points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.points) AS distinct_points_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.assists) AS distinct_assists_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.rebounds) AS distinct_rebounds_count, SUM(ap.points) AS total_points, SUM(ap.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(ap.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_points, AVG(ap.assists) AS avg_assists, AVG(ap.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_team_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_team_rebounds, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_team_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_team_assists, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_team_rebounds, SUM(t.o_pts) AS total_team_offensive_points, SUM(t.d_pts) AS total_team_defensive_points, AVG(t.o_pts) AS avg_team_offensive_points, AVG(t.d_pts) AS avg_team_defensive_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::integer = awp.playerid AND ap.season_id = awp.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner WHERE ap.points > 63 AND ap.assists > 14 AND ap.rebounds > 25 AND pt.points > 572 AND pt.assists > 684 AND pt.rebounds > 592 AND t.o_pts > 8070 AND t.d_pts > 7966 AND ap.season_id >= 1977 AND ap.season_id <= 1987 AND t.year >= 2003 AND t.year <= 1993 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, ap.season_id, ap.league_id HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 3941 AND SUM(ap.assists) > 462 AND SUM(ap.rebounds) > 842 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.points) > 17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.assists) > 27 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.rebounds) > 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_assists DESC, total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS overall_points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner WHERE pt.points > 1715 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1994 AND 2023 AND t.won > 58 AND ap.points > 46 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, pt.tmid, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 7873 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 38 ORDER BY total_points DESC, overall_points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.assists) AS avg_allstar_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, pt.year, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_regular_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_regular_rebounds, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_regular_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_regular_blocks, SUM(pt.turnovers) AS total_regular_turnovers, SUM(pt.fgmade) AS total_fgmade, SUM(pt.fgattempted) AS total_fgattempted, (CASE WHEN SUM(pt.fgattempted) > 0 THEN (SUM(pt.fgmade)::float / SUM(pt.fgattempted)::float) * 100 ELSE 0 END) AS fg_percentage, SUM(pt.ftmade) AS total_ftmade, SUM(pt.ftattempted) AS total_ftattempted, (CASE WHEN SUM(pt.ftattempted) > 0 THEN (SUM(pt.ftmade)::float / SUM(pt.ftattempted)::float) * 100 ELSE 0 END) AS ft_percentage, SUM(pt.threemade) AS total_threemade, SUM(pt.threeattempted) AS total_threeattempted, (CASE WHEN SUM(pt.threeattempted) > 0 THEN (SUM(pt.threemade)::float / SUM(pt.threeattempted)::float) * 100 ELSE 0 END) AS three_percentage, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, c.year AS coach_year, c.won AS coach_wins, c.lost AS coach_losses, (CASE WHEN (c.won + c.lost) > 0 THEN (c.won::float / (c.won + c.lost)::float) * 100 ELSE 0 END) AS coach_win_percentage, sp.year AS playoff_year, sp.round, sp.w AS playoff_wins, sp.l AS playoff_losses, ac.award, ac.note AS award_note, ap2.award AS player_award, ap2.note AS player_award_note, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league_year, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS overall_points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points, LEAD(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS next_year_points, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_percentile, CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_cume_dist, SUM(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid) AS league_year_total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid) AS avg_points_per_player_in_league_year FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid::integer AND t.year = c.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid = ac.coachid::character varying AND c.year = ac.year JOIN awards_players ap2 ON p.playerid::integer = ap2.playerid AND pt.year = ap2.year WHERE ap.points > 10.95 AND pt.points > 42.53 AND t.year BETWEEN 1952.16 AND 1965.1 AND d.draftyear >= 2013.55 AND c.won >= 46.41 AND sp.w >= 6.95 AND ac.year = c.year AND ap2.year = pt.year GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, pt.year, t.name, t.lgid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, c.year, c.won, c.lost, sp.year, sp.round, sp.w, sp.l, ac.award, ac.note, ap2.award, ap2.note HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 336.01 AND AVG(pt.assists) > 6.92 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 17.68 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 1342.85 AND SUM(pt.steals) > 236.33 AND SUM(pt.blocks) > 462.58 AND (CASE WHEN SUM(pt.fgattempted) > 0 THEN (SUM(pt.fgmade)::float / SUM(pt.fgattempted)::float) * 100 ELSE 0 END) > 79.65 AND (CASE WHEN SUM(pt.ftattempted) > 0 THEN (SUM(pt.ftmade)::float / SUM(pt.ftattempted)::float) * 100 ELSE 0 END) > 57.7 AND (CASE WHEN SUM(pt.threeattempted) > 0 THEN (SUM(pt.threemade)::float / SUM(pt.threeattempted)::float) * 100 ELSE 0 END) > 42.03 ORDER BY total_regular_points DESC, avg_regular_assists DESC, total_regular_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, t.lgid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS birth_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.league_id = 'NBA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nba_allstar_games, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1999 AND pt.year <= 1989 AND pt.points > 1920 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY CUBE(p.playerid, t.lgid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 16197 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, t.lgid, p.playerid;

SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, AVG(pt.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_points, SUM(pt.assists) OVER ( PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS running_total_assists FROM players_teams pt JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id::integer WHERE pt.year >= 1991 AND pt.points > 886 AND p.firstseason <= 1997 ORDER BY pt.playerid, pt.year;

SELECT s1.playerid, s1.season_id, s1.league_id, SUM(s1.points) AS total_points, AVG(s1.minutes) AS avg_minutes, MAX(s1.rebounds) AS max_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT s1.conference) AS conferences_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s1.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM player_allstar s1 JOIN players p ON s1.playerid = p.id::integer WHERE s1.minutes > 17 AND s1.season_id BETWEEN 2017 AND 1991 GROUP BY s1.playerid, s1.season_id, s1.league_id HAVING SUM(s1.points) > 72 INTERSECT SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, MAX(pt.rebounds) AS max_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.lgid) AS leagues_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players_teams pt JOIN draft d ON pt.playerid = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id::integer WHERE pt.minutes > 1 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1972 AND 1966 AND d.draftyear < 2007 GROUP BY pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 39 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 44 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year, p.playerid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 48.0) AS points_per_48, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS rank_points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid::text = p.playerid AND ap.year = t.year AND ap.award LIKE '%All-Star%') AS all_star_count, (SELECT MAX(d.draftoverall) FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid::integer = p.playerid::integer AND d.draftyear <= t.year) AS highest_draft_pick, (SELECT SUM(c.won) FROM coaches c WHERE c.coachid::text = t.tmid AND c.year = t.year) AS coach_wins FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::text = p.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::text = ap.playerid::text AND t.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::text = d.playerid::text AND t.year >= d.draftyear JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::text = c.coachid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 1983 AND t.year <= 1993 AND pt.points > 1189 AND t.playoff = 'Y' GROUP BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year, p.playerid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1158 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 1 ORDER BY t.year DESC, rank_points;
