SELECT t.lgid, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS unique_players, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS unique_coaches, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.lgid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::character varying = p.playerid JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.lgid AND t.year = c.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND t.year = pa.season_id WHERE t.year >= 1964 AND t.won >= 14 GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 7957 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.attendance, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS player_count, SUM(p.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(p.points) AS avg_player_points, MAX(p.points) AS max_player_points, MIN(p.points) AS min_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins, AVG(c.won) AS avg_coach_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.won DESC) AS league_rank_by_wins, SUM(t.won) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_wins_in_league, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t.id OR sp.tmidloser = t.id) AS playoff_series_appearances, (SELECT AVG(d.draftoverall) FROM draft d WHERE d.tmid = t.id AND d.draftyear BETWEEN t.year - 5 AND t.year) AS avg_draft_pick_last_5_years FROM teams t JOIN players_teams p ON t.id = p.tmid AND t.year = p.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid AND p.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::text = ac.coachid::text AND c.year = ac.year WHERE t.year >= 1969 AND t.year <= 1986 AND t.won >= 46 AND t.attendance >= 942138 GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.attendance, t.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 368 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) > 40 UNION ALL SELECT t.lgid, t.year, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.attendance, COUNT(DISTINCT pas.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(pas.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(pas.points) AS avg_player_points, MAX(pas.points) AS max_player_points, MIN(pas.points) AS min_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins, AVG(c.won) AS avg_coach_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.won DESC) AS league_rank_by_wins, SUM(t.won) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_wins_in_league, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t.id OR sp.tmidloser = t.id) AS playoff_series_appearances, (SELECT AVG(d.draftoverall) FROM draft d WHERE d.tmid = t.id AND d.draftyear BETWEEN t.year - 5 AND t.year) AS avg_draft_pick_last_5_years FROM teams t JOIN player_allstar pas ON t.lgid = pas.league_id AND t.year = pas.season_id JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON pas.playerid = ap.playerid AND pas.season_id = ap.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::text = ac.coachid::text AND c.year = ac.year WHERE t.year >= 1977 AND t.year <= 1981 AND t.won >= 30 AND t.attendance >= 4952700 GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.attendance, t.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pas.playerid) > 40 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) > 29 ORDER BY league_rank_by_wins, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS unique_coaches FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 1963 AND t.won > 50 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year), (t.lgid, t.year), (t.year), () ) ORDER BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2018 AND pt.points > 21 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 10.46 ORDER BY player_count DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.won, t.lost, ROUND(t.won::DECIMAL / NULLIF(t.games, 0), 3) AS win_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count FROM teams t LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::INTEGER = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::INTEGER = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year = 1953 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE (sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid::INTEGER OR sp.tmidloser = t.tmid::INTEGER) AND sp.year = 2014 ) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.games HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) > 13 ORDER BY win_percentage DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.attendance, COALESCE(SUM(c.post_wins), 0) AS total_post_wins, COALESCE(SUM(c.post_losses), 0) AS total_post_losses, COUNT(DISTINCT s.tmidwinner) AS seasons_with_series_win, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t.won DESC, t.lost ASC) AS win_rank FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post s ON t.id = s.tmidwinner AND t.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1962.98 AND t.year <= 1971.29 AND t.won >= 54.44 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.attendance HAVING COALESCE(SUM(c.post_wins), 0) > 4.02 OR COUNT(DISTINCT s.tmidwinner) > 1.93 ORDER BY t.year DESC, win_rank ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::text = pt.tmid::text AND t.year = pt.year WHERE t.year >= 1972.92 AND t.won > 52.5 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS distinct_players, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS league_points_rank, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_team_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_team_assists, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.award IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS player_awards_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = t.id AND c.year = t.year AND c.won > c.lost) AS winning_coaches_count, (SELECT AVG(d.draftoverall) FROM draft d WHERE d.tmid = t.id AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1970 AND 2006) AS avg_draft_pick FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.id = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2022 AND t.won > 10 AND pt.minutes > 1845 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, t.name, t.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 14975 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) >= 8 ORDER BY total_team_points DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.tmid, t.name, AVG(t.won::numeric / t.games) AS win_rate, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_points_3yr, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS league_points_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players_count, MAX(CASE WHEN ac.award = 'Coach of the Year' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_coach_of_year FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND t.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND t.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND t.year = ac.year WHERE t.year >= 2008 AND t.year <= 1996 AND t.attendance >= 269455 AND pt.points >= 723 GROUP BY t.year, t.tmid, t.name, t.lgid HAVING AVG(t.won::numeric / t.games) > 0.86 AND SUM(pt.points) > 206432 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.name, t1.year, t1.won, t1.lost, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t1.id AND sp.year = t1.year) AS playoff_wins, (SELECT AVG(c.won) FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = t1.id AND c.year = t1.year) AS avg_coach_wins, (SELECT SUM(pa.points) FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.league_id = t1.lgid AND pa.season_id = t1.year) AS allstar_points_in_league, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.tmid = t1.id AND pt.year = t1.year AND pt.points > 1403.81) AS high_scoring_players, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM draft d WHERE d.tmid = t1.id AND d.draftyear = t1.year AND d.draftoverall <= 2.21) AS top_draft_picks, (SELECT MAX(ap.year) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid IN (SELECT pt.playerid FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.tmid = t1.id AND pt.year = t1.year) AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player') AS latest_award_year, SUM(t2.o_pts) AS total_opp_points, AVG(t2.d_pts) AS avg_def_points_allowed FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year AND t1.id != t2.id LEFT JOIN players_teams pt1 ON pt1.tmid = t1.id AND pt1.year = t1.year LEFT JOIN players p ON p.id = pt1.playerid WHERE t1.year BETWEEN 1978.8 AND 1977.85 AND t1.won > 6.35 AND t1.playoff = 'Y' GROUP BY t1.tmid, t1.name, t1.year, t1.won, t1.lost, t1.id, t1.lgid HAVING AVG(pt1.points) > 6.91 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.college) >= 47.02 ORDER BY t1.year DESC, total_opp_points ASC;

SELECT t1.year AS year1, t2.year AS year2, t1.lgid, AVG(t1.won - t2.won) AS avg_win_diff, SUM(t1.o_pts) AS total_pts_year1, SUM(t2.o_pts) AS total_pts_year2 FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.tmid = t2.tmid WHERE t1.year > t2.year AND t1.year - t2.year <= 3 AND t1.won >= 56 AND t2.won >= 1 GROUP BY t1.year, t2.year, t1.lgid HAVING AVG(t1.won - t2.won) > -7.91 ORDER BY avg_win_diff DESC;

WITH player_performance AS ( SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, pt.steals, pt.blocks, pt.minutes, pt.gp, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) as points_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.rebounds DESC) as rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.assists DESC) as assists_rank, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year) as avg_points_per_year, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as career_points_running_total FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.minutes > 689 AND pt.gp >= 41 ), team_performance AS ( SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.o_reb, t.d_reb, t.attendance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY t.won DESC) as wins_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY t.o_pts DESC) as offense_rank, (t.o_pts - t.d_pts) as point_differential, AVG(t.o_pts) OVER (PARTITION BY t.year) as avg_offense_per_year FROM teams t WHERE t.attendance > 294047 AND t.won >= 28 ), coach_performance AS ( SELECT c.coachid, c.year, c.tmid, c.won, c.lost, c.post_wins, c.post_losses, (c.won::decimal / (c.won + c.lost)) as win_percentage, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.year ORDER BY c.won DESC) as wins_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.year ORDER BY (c.won::decimal / (c.won + c.lost)) DESC) as win_pct_rank FROM coaches c WHERE c.won > 62 AND c.post_wins >= 18 ), all_star_performance AS ( SELECT ap.playerid, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.rebounds, ap.assists, ap.steals, ap.blocks, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.season_id ORDER BY ap.points DESC) as all_star_points_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.season_id ORDER BY ap.points) as points_percentile FROM player_allstar ap WHERE ap.points > 46 AND ap.rebounds >= 11 ), award_winners AS ( SELECT aw.playerid, aw.year, aw.award, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY aw.playerid) as total_awards, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY aw.year ORDER BY aw.award) as award_rank FROM awards_players aw WHERE aw.year BETWEEN 1955 AND 2003 ), draft_analysis AS ( SELECT d.playerid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.draftyear ORDER BY d.draftoverall) as draft_position_rank, CASE WHEN d.draftround = 1 THEN 'First Round' WHEN d.draftround = 2 THEN 'Second Round' ELSE 'Late Round' END as draft_category FROM draft d WHERE d.draftoverall <= 24 AND d.draftyear >= 1954 ) SELECT pp.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pp.year, pp.tmid, t.name as team_name, pp.points, pp.rebounds, pp.assists, pp.points_rank, pp.rebounds_rank, pp.assists_rank, pp.avg_points_per_year, pp.career_points_running_total, tp.won as team_wins, tp.lost as team_losses, tp.wins_rank as team_wins_rank, tp.point_differential, tp.avg_offense_per_year, cp.coachid, cp.win_percentage as coach_win_pct, cp.wins_rank as coach_wins_rank, ap.points as all_star_points, ap.all_star_points_rank, ap.points_percentile, aw.total_awards, aw.award_rank, da.draftoverall, da.draft_position_rank, da.draft_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pp.year ORDER BY pp.points DESC) as yearly_points_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pp.year ORDER BY pp.points) as yearly_points_percentile, SUM(pp.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pp.playerid ORDER BY pp.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as career_total_points, AVG(pp.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pp.tmid, pp.year) as team_avg_points FROM player_performance pp JOIN players p ON pp.playerid = p.id::integer JOIN team_performance tp ON pp.tmid = tp.tmid::integer AND pp.year = tp.year JOIN coach_performance cp ON pp.tmid = cp.tmid::integer AND pp.year = cp.year LEFT JOIN all_star_performance ap ON pp.playerid = ap.playerid AND pp.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN award_winners aw ON pp.playerid = aw.playerid AND pp.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN draft_analysis da ON pp.playerid = da.playerid JOIN teams t ON pp.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pp.year = t.year WHERE pp.points > 538 AND tp.won >= 20 AND cp.win_percentage > 0.75 GROUP BY pp.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pp.year, pp.tmid, t.name, pp.points, pp.rebounds, pp.assists, pp.points_rank, pp.rebounds_rank, pp.assists_rank, pp.avg_points_per_year, pp.career_points_running_total, tp.won, tp.lost, tp.wins_rank, tp.point_differential, tp.avg_offense_per_year, cp.coachid, cp.win_percentage, cp.wins_rank, ap.points, ap.all_star_points_rank, ap.points_percentile, aw.total_awards, aw.award_rank, da.draftoverall, da.draft_position_rank, da.draft_category HAVING AVG(pp.points) > 1677 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pp.year) >= 6 ORDER BY pp.points DESC, pp.year DESC, pp.playerid;

SELECT a.coachid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.year) AS distinct_years, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) AS distinct_awards, SUM(c.won) AS total_wins FROM awards_coaches a JOIN coaches c ON a.coachid::text = c.coachid AND a.year = c.year WHERE a.year >= 1955 AND a.year <= 1956 AND c.won > 60 GROUP BY a.coachid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.year) > 12 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, p.college, p.pos, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, SUM(pt.minutes) AS total_minutes, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_blocks, SUM(pt.turnovers) AS total_turnovers, SUM(pt.pf) AS total_fouls, SUM(pt.fgmade) AS total_fg_made, SUM(pt.fgattempted) AS total_fg_attempted, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.fgattempted) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(pt.fgmade)::DECIMAL / SUM(pt.fgattempted)) * 100, 2) ELSE 0.00 END AS fg_percentage, SUM(pt.threemade) AS total_three_made, SUM(pt.threeattempted) AS total_three_attempted, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.threeattempted) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(pt.threemade)::DECIMAL / SUM(pt.threeattempted)) * 100, 2) ELSE 0.00 END AS three_point_percentage, SUM(pt.ftmade) AS total_ft_made, SUM(pt.ftattempted) AS total_ft_attempted, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.ftattempted) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(pt.ftmade)::DECIMAL / SUM(pt.ftattempted)) * 100, 2) ELSE 0.00 END AS ft_percentage, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(ps.points) AS max_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years_count, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league_year, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS overall_points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS previous_year_points, LEAD(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS next_year_points, SUM(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid = p.id AND ap2.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_award_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t.id OR sp.tmidloser = t.id) AS team_playoff_series_count, (SELECT AVG(c.won::DECIMAL / (c.won + c.lost)) FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = t.id AND c.year = pt.year) AS coach_win_percentage FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.id = ps.playerid AND pt.year = ps.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON t.id = ac.coachid::INTEGER AND pt.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1965 AND 1958 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND p.pos IN ('G', 'F', 'C') AND pt.minutes >= 4697 AND pt.points >= 545 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.college, p.pos, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, t.lgid, t.id, p.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 35271 AND SUM(pt.minutes) > 45243 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) <= 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC, player_name, pt.year;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, p.college, p.pos, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, SUM(pt.minutes) AS total_minutes, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_blocks, SUM(pt.turnovers) AS total_turnovers, SUM(pt.pf) AS total_fouls, SUM(pt.fgmade) AS total_fg_made, SUM(pt.fgattempted) AS total_fg_attempted, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.fgattempted) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(pt.fgmade)::DECIMAL / SUM(pt.fgattempted)) * 100, 2) ELSE 0.00 END AS fg_percentage, SUM(pt.threemade) AS total_three_made, SUM(pt.threeattempted) AS total_three_attempted, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.threeattempted) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(pt.threemade)::DECIMAL / SUM(pt.threeattempted)) * 100, 2) ELSE 0.00 END AS three_point_percentage, SUM(pt.ftmade) AS total_ft_made, SUM(pt.ftattempted) AS total_ft_attempted, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.ftattempted) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(pt.ftmade)::DECIMAL / SUM(pt.ftattempted)) * 100, 2) ELSE 0.00 END AS ft_percentage, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(ps.points) AS max_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years_count, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league_year, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS overall_points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS previous_year_points, LEAD(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS next_year_points, SUM(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid = p.id AND ap2.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_award_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t.id OR sp.tmidloser = t.id) AS team_playoff_series_count, (SELECT AVG(c.won::DECIMAL / (c.won + c.lost)) FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = t.id AND c.year = pt.year) AS coach_win_percentage FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.id = ps.playerid AND pt.year = ps.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON t.id = ac.coachid::INTEGER AND pt.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1993 AND 1984 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND p.pos IN ('G', 'F', 'C') AND pt.minutes >= 3737 AND pt.points >= 3685 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.college, p.pos, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, t.lgid, t.id, p.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4810 AND SUM(pt.minutes) > 7016 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) <= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, player_name, pt.year;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id::integer WHERE p.id IN ( SELECT playerid FROM draft WHERE draftyear IN ( SELECT year FROM awards_coaches WHERE coachid IN ( SELECT coachid::integer FROM coaches WHERE won > 33 AND year >= 1994 ) ) ) AND pa.points > 39 AND t.won > 35 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 29 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) >= 10 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_regular_assists, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_regular_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_regular_rebounds, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_regular_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS regular_seasons, MAX(ap.year) AS latest_award_year, COUNT(ap.award) AS total_awards, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, t.name AS team_name, t.won AS team_wins, t.lost AS team_losses, t.attendance AS team_attendance, SUM(sp.w) AS total_playoff_wins, SUM(sp.l) AS total_playoff_losses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner WHERE pa.points > 45.74 AND pt.points > 2457.99 AND ap.year >= 1972.63 AND d.draftyear >= 1990.02 AND t.year >= 2002.39 AND sp.year >= 2012.22 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.attendance HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 6545.35 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) >= 13.23 AND COUNT(ap.award) >= 42.15 ORDER BY total_regular_points DESC, total_allstar_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1985 AND pt.points > 235 AND d.draftyear <= 1953 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) > 14.2 ORDER BY avg_points_per_game DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE p.firstseason >= 1975 AND p.lastseason <= 1950 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) < 20 ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 2008 AND pa.year >= 1966 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 22503 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_award_types, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.assists) AS avg_assists, MAX(ps.w) AS max_playoff_wins FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN series_post ps ON pa.tmid = ps.tmidwinner JOIN teams t ON pa.tmid = t.id WHERE pa.year >= 2018 AND pa.points > 4850 AND t.won > 32 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 39647 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS distinct_teams, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS distinct_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 2361 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1974 AND 1960 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 34291 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, MAX(pt.points) AS max_regular_points, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_post_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) FILTER (WHERE d.draftyear IS NOT NULL) AS draft_years, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_pick, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pa.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS regular_points_rank, (SUM(pa.points) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pa.games_played), 0)) AS allstar_ppg, (SUM(pt.points) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pt.gp), 0)) AS regular_ppg FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE pa.points > 6 AND pt.points > 292 AND ap.year >= 1975 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1955 AND 1969 AND (t.won > 61 OR t.won IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 2 AND SUM(pa.points) > 100 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, total_regular_points DESC LIMIT 909;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS player_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years_count, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(pa.rebounds) AS max_allstar_rebounds, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, MAX(pt.rebounds) AS max_regular_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, SUM(CASE WHEN d.draftround IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS draft_appearances, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_pick, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pa.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) DESC) AS awards_rank FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid WHERE pa.points > 42.3 AND pt.points > 1880.07 AND ap.year >= 1950.95 AND pt.year >= 1975.44 AND (t.year >= 1998.38 OR t.year IS NULL) AND (sp.year >= 1955.99 OR sp.year IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 15.76 AND SUM(pa.points) > 388.09 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, awards_rank ASC LIMIT 80.32;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 298 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2014 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 16 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 15 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2023 AND 2011 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 7993 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'None' AND year >= 1954 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 22377 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year IN (SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'All-Star') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 12735 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2006 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = pt.playerid AND d.draftyear > 2019 LIMIT 1) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 24008 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, MAX(ps.season_id) AS last_allstar_season, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) DESC) AS team_variety_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar ps ON pt.playerid = ps.playerid AND pt.year = ps.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner WHERE pt.year >= 1963 AND pt.year <= 2000 AND pt.points > 2185 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND ap2.award = 'Most Valuable Player') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 16826 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying WHERE pt.year IN (SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'All-NBA First Team') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 46887 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE p.college LIKE '%''%' AND pt.year BETWEEN 1971 AND 1985 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 24956 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.points > 43 AND pt.year >= 1999 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 18 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 666 AND t.won > 36 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 22519 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2002 AND pt.year <= 2020 AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM coaches c WHERE c.year = pt.year AND c.lgid = pt.lgid AND c.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND c.won > 55 LIMIT 1) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 34469 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 11 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) DESC) AS seasons_played_rank, (SUM(pt.points) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pt.minutes), 0)) AS points_per_minute, (SUM(pt.assists) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pt.turnovers), 0)) AS assist_to_turnover_ratio FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::integer = awp.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer WHERE pt.year >= 2004 AND pt.year <= 1951 AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM coaches c WHERE c.coachid::integer = pt.tmid AND c.year = pt.year AND c.won > 49) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 9552 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 11 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_points_per_game DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2016 AND pt.year <= 2007 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 6855 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.year >= 2020 THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS recent_points, COUNT(CASE WHEN pt.lgid = 'NBA' THEN 1 END) AS league_games FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2015 AND 1990 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 31311 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid = aw.playerid::character varying WHERE ap.points > 13.03 AND aw.award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND aw.year IN (SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND year >= 2009.39) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 5.72 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.tmidwinner) AS championship_wins, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN series_post sp ON pt.tmid = sp.tmidwinner AND pt.year = sp.year JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year WHERE pt.points > 625 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2014 AND 1993 AND pa.points > 21 AND d.draftoverall < 91 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2974 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 10 AND AVG(pa.points) > 29 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_awards DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE p.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT d.playerid FROM draft d WHERE d.draftyear BETWEEN 1988 AND 2006 AND d.draftround <= 1 ) AND pt.points > 1562 AND t.won > 47 AND c.won > 70 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2941 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_position, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins_for_team, SUM(t.won) AS total_team_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league, SUM(pt.points) / NULLIF(SUM(pt.minutes), 0) AS points_per_minute FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year AND t.lgid = c.lgid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1394.86 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2013.57 AND 1995.84 AND t.won > 23.63 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.assists) > 943.94 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 12.86 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank_in_league;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1056 AND pt.year >= 1993 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points HAVING COUNT(pt.stint) >= 2 ORDER BY pt.year, points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_per_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT year FROM coaches WHERE coachid = 'A' AND lgid = 'AA' UNION SELECT year FROM series_post WHERE tmidwinner = 376 OR tmidloser = 797 INTERSECT SELECT season_id FROM player_allstar WHERE league_id = 'AA' AND conference = 'East' ) AND pt.points > 646 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1981 AND 2009 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 39387 AND AVG(pt.assists) >= 9498 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_points_per_season DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_season_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS total_points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_team_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1995 AND pt.year <= 2016 AND pt.points > 332 AND pa.points > 34 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = pt.tmid AND c.year = pt.year AND c.won > 6 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE (sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) AND sp.year = pt.year AND sp.w > 0 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, pt.tmid, pt.year HAVING AVG(pa.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 8 ORDER BY total_points_rank, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, pt.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_player_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award) AS distinct_coach_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS distinct_draft_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, MAX(ap.year) AS latest_award_year, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_by_year, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS team_losses, (SUM(t.won) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(t.won) + SUM(t.lost), 0)) * 100 AS team_win_percentage FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON ac.coachid::integer = pt.tmid AND ac.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND c.year = pt.year WHERE pt.points > 2808.14 AND pt.year >= 1991.1 AND pt.year <= 1959.22 AND t.won >= 55.19 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, pt.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 14.1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award) <= 23.93 AND COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) > 18.69 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank_by_year ASC, team_win_percentage DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.year >= 2005 THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS points_since_year, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pt.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2013 THEN pt.year END) AS seasons_in_range FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 57 AND pt.assists > 372 AND pt.rebounds > 1791 AND t.year >= 1971 AND t.year <= 1966 AND (t.lgid = 'NBA' OR t.lgid = 'NBA') AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1965 AND 1962 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3259 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 13 AND AVG(pa.points) > 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_assists DESC, total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1976 AND 1951 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 24768 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pa.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying WHERE pa.season_id >= 1984 AND pa.season_id <= 1979 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 3815 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.award = 'MVP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mvp_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.year, p.pos ORDER BY AVG(pt.points) DESC) AS pos_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid::integer AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.points > 40.76 AND t.year BETWEEN 2004.15 AND 1985.55 AND p.height > 1.91 GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year, p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 7421.39 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 20.12 ORDER BY t.lgid, t.year, points_rank;

SELECT t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t.year = pt.year WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT year FROM players_teams WHERE playerid IN ( SELECT playerid FROM awards_players WHERE year BETWEEN 1963 AND 1967 ) ) GROUP BY t.name HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 13.17 ORDER BY player_count DESC;

SELECT t.name, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.award = 'MVP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mvp_count FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t.year = pt.year AND t.lgid = pt.lgid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ps ON pt.playerid = ps.playerid AND pt.year = ps.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year AND t.lgid = c.lgid JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND t.year = sp.year WHERE t.year >= 1971 AND t.year <= 1989 AND t.won >= 48 AND t.attendance > 1416554 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 179 UNION ALL SELECT t.name, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, SUM(CASE WHEN ac.award = 'Coach of the Year' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coach_of_year_count FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t.year = pt.year AND t.lgid = pt.lgid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ps ON pt.playerid = ps.playerid AND pt.year = ps.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON t.tmid = ac.coachid::character varying AND t.year = ac.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year AND t.lgid = c.lgid JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidloser::character varying AND t.year = sp.year WHERE t.year >= 2014 AND t.year <= 1968 AND t.lost >= 27 AND t.attendance > 716956 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 13617 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, pt.year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::varchar = p.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1972 AND 2015 AND pt.points > 958 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (t.tmid, t.lgid, pt.year), (t.tmid, t.lgid), (t.lgid, pt.year), (t.tmid), (t.lgid), (pt.year), () ) ORDER BY t.lgid, pt.year, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id WHERE t.name LIKE '%Lakers%' AND t.year >= 2020 AND t.year <= 2005 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.lgid, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(pa.points) AS allstar_points, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_pick FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id AND p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND c.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND d.draftyear = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND ap.year = t.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND ac.year = t.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 1983 AND pt.points > 1399 AND pa.points > 64 AND c.won > 27 AND d.draftoverall < 79 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.lgid HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 3292 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 2088 INTERSECT SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.lgid, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(pa.points) AS allstar_points, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_pick FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id AND p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND c.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND d.draftyear = t.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND sp.year = t.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1958 AND 2017 AND pt.points > 2853 AND pa.points > 124 AND c.won > 28 AND sp.w > 5 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.lgid HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 4142 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 2909;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE t.won > 42 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA First Team' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 26 ORDER BY avg_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS num_players, AVG(p.points) AS avg_points FROM players_teams p JOIN teams t ON p.tmid::text = t.tmid AND p.year = t.year WHERE p.points > 1899.9 AND t.year >= 1996.52 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, num_players DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS player_count, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points FROM players_teams p JOIN teams t ON p.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND p.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid AND p.year = pa.season_id WHERE p.year >= 1992 AND p.year <= 1961 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, player_count DESC;

SELECT a.playerid, a.year, a.award, p.firstname, p.lastname, CASE WHEN a.year >= 2015 THEN 'Recent Era' ELSE 'Earlier Era' END AS era_category, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.year) AS awards_in_year, SUM(p_a.points) AS total_points FROM awards_players a JOIN players p ON p.playerid::integer = a.playerid JOIN player_allstar p_a ON p_a.playerid = a.playerid AND p_a.season_id = a.year WHERE a.year BETWEEN 2009 AND 2005 AND p_a.points > 36 GROUP BY a.playerid, a.year, a.award, p.firstname, p.lastname, p_a.points HAVING SUM(p_a.points) > 13 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT ap.playerid, ap.year, ap.award, COUNT(*) AS award_count, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_season_points, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.points > (SELECT AVG(points) FROM players_teams WHERE year = ap.year) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS games_above_avg_points FROM awards_players ap JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE ap.year >= 1979.27 AND pt.points >= 47.52 GROUP BY ap.playerid, ap.year, ap.award HAVING COUNT(*) > 8.86 ORDER BY award_count DESC, avg_regular_season_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 1292 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1991 AND 1990 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 18003 UNION ALL SELECT c.coachid AS coach_id, c.coachid AS coach_name, SUM(c.won) AS total_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT c.year) AS seasons_coached, AVG(c.won * 1.0 / NULLIF(c.won + c.lost, 0)) AS win_percentage FROM coaches c JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid = ac.coachid::character varying AND c.year = ac.year JOIN teams t ON c.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND c.year = t.year WHERE c.won > 80 AND c.year BETWEEN 1988 AND 1970 GROUP BY c.coachid HAVING SUM(c.won) > 1995 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, p.pos AS position, p.height, p.weight, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS allstar_total_points, AVG(ap.points) AS allstar_avg_points, SUM(ap.assists) AS allstar_total_assists, AVG(ap.assists) AS allstar_avg_assists, SUM(ap.rebounds) AS allstar_total_rebounds, AVG(ap.rebounds) AS allstar_avg_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS team_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS regular_season_total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS regular_season_avg_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS regular_season_total_assists, AVG(pt.assists) AS regular_season_avg_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS regular_season_total_rebounds, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS regular_season_avg_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) FILTER (WHERE awp.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_awards_count, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) FILTER (WHERE awp.award LIKE '%All-Star%') AS allstar_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, d.draftfrom AS drafted_from, t.name AS most_recent_team, t.lgid AS most_recent_league, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS total_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(pt.points) DESC) AS avg_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(ap.points) DESC) AS allstar_avg_points_rank, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) AS playoff_series_appearances, (SELECT SUM(sp.w) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid) AS playoff_series_wins, (SELECT SUM(sp.l) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) AS playoff_series_losses FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid = awp.playerid::character varying AND ap.season_id = awp.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year WHERE p.height > 211.51 AND p.weight BETWEEN 121.86 AND 245.61 AND ap.points > 2.95 AND pt.points > 1082.74 AND awp.award IS NOT NULL AND d.draftyear >= 1999.5 AND t.won > 48.6 AND c.won > 68.85 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players awp2 WHERE awp2.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND awp2.award LIKE '%All-Star%') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.height, p.weight, d.draftoverall, d.draftfrom, t.name, t.lgid, pt.tmid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 10.82 AND SUM(pt.points) > 5088.32 AND AVG(ap.points) > 17.03 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) > 40.03 ORDER BY total_points_rank, avg_points_rank, allstar_points_rank, allstar_avg_points_rank LIMIT 161.84;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_regular_assists, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_regular_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_regular_rebounds, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_regular_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS regular_seasons, MAX(ap.year) AS latest_award_year, COUNT(ap.award) AS total_awards, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, t.name AS team_name, t.won AS team_wins, t.lost AS team_losses, t.attendance AS team_attendance, SUM(sp.w) AS total_playoff_wins, SUM(sp.l) AS total_playoff_losses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner WHERE pa.points > 14.22 AND pt.points > 246.03 AND ap.year >= 2006.57 AND d.draftyear >= 2009.8 AND t.year >= 1996.77 AND sp.year >= 2013.79 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.attendance HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 35284.52 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) >= 7.76 AND COUNT(ap.award) >= 28.4 ORDER BY total_regular_points DESC, total_allstar_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pa.points) AS median_points, SUM(pa.assists) AS total_assists FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pa.playerid = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year JOIN players_teams pt ON pa.playerid = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year WHERE pa.points > 34 AND pa.season_id >= 1977 AND pa.season_id <= 2000 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 26.98 ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pa.points) AS median_points, SUM(pa.assists) AS total_assists FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pa.playerid = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year JOIN players_teams pt ON pa.playerid = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year WHERE pa.points > 5 AND pa.season_id >= 1969 AND pa.season_id <= 1992 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 9.27 ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COALESCE(SUM(pa.points), 0) AS total_allstar_points, COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) AS total_regular_points, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) AS total_postseason_points, COALESCE(AVG(pa.points / NULLIF(pa.games_played, 0)), 0) AS avg_points_per_allstar_game, COALESCE(AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)), 0) AS avg_points_per_regular_game, COALESCE(AVG(pt.postpoints / NULLIF(pt.postgp, 0)), 0) AS avg_points_per_postseason_game, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS years_drafted, MAX(CASE WHEN ac.award = 'Coach of the Year' THEN ac.year END) AS last_coach_of_year_award, MAX(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t.id OR sp.tmidloser = t.id THEN sp.year END) AS last_playoff_year, SUM(t.o_pts) AS team_offensive_points, SUM(t.d_pts) AS team_defensive_points_allowed, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) DESC) AS regular_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) DESC) AS postseason_points_rank FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::INTEGER = pa.playerid AND pa.points > 39.98 LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::INTEGER = pt.playerid AND pt.points > 2911.31 AND pt.postpoints > 578.39 LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::INTEGER = ap.playerid AND ap.year >= 1951.72 AND ap.year <= 1984.66 LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::INTEGER = d.playerid AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1957.99 AND 1980.62 LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::INTEGER = t.id AND t.year = pt.year AND t.o_pts > 7399.51 LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::INTEGER = c.tmid AND c.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::INTEGER = ac.coachid AND ac.year = c.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 1995.86 AND p.lastseason <= 2021.93 AND (p.height > 0.05 OR p.weight > 48.72) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 0.21 AND COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) <= 11.86 AND MAX(CASE WHEN ac.award = 'Coach of the Year' THEN ac.year END) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY regular_points_rank, postseason_points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) AS total_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying WHERE p.firstseason >= 1963 AND p.lastseason <= 1963 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) > 4225 ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) AS total_points, COALESCE(AVG(pt.points), 0) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1997 AND 1984 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) > 27663 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pa.rebounds) AS total_rebounds FROM players p INNER JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 1973 AND ap.year <= 1996 AND pa.points >= 21 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 6 ORDER BY award_count DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, SUM(aps.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_team_points, MAX(t.won) AS max_team_wins, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(aps.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar aps ON p.id = aps.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND t.year = pt.year WHERE ap.year >= 1967 AND ap.year <= 2013 AND t.won > 77 AND aps.points > 66 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 10 AND SUM(aps.points) > 513 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, distinct_awards DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 1960 AND pa.season_id >= 1963 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 3136 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE ap.year >= 2008 AND pt.points >= 1273 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 6 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid WHERE ap.season_id BETWEEN 1951 AND 1965 AND pt.minutes > 3411 AND aw.year >= 1961 AND aw.award = 'All-NBA' AND (ap.points > 16 OR ap.assists > 7) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 18 AND SUM(pt.points) > 41207 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.year >= 2021 AND pt.year <= 1977 AND pt.points > 815 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 19 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.year >= 1953 AND pt.year <= 1970 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 14394 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.year >= 1958 AND pt.year <= 1978 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 36830 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 2008 AND p.lastseason <= 1973 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 13631 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE p.firstseason >= 2023 AND p.lastseason <= 1965 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 12430 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) AS distinct_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS distinct_teams_played_for, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS distinct_draft_years, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.minutes) AS avg_allstar_minutes, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_regular_minutes, MAX(pt.points) AS max_regular_points, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins, SUM(c.lost) AS total_coach_losses, SUM(t.won) AS total_team_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS total_team_losses, SUM(sp.w) AS total_series_wins, SUM(sp.l) AS total_series_losses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS regular_points_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::integer = awp.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid WHERE ap.points > 24.96 AND pt.points > 2130.38 AND t.won > 45.01 AND c.won > 73.49 AND sp.year >= 2017.14 AND sp.year <= 1980.29 AND awp.year >= 2003.8 AND awp.year <= 1995.43 AND d.draftyear >= 2015.22 AND d.draftyear <= 1965.96 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 5.63 AND COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) > 5.98 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) > 12.54 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, total_regular_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS distinct_team_years, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE ap.points > 20 AND pt.points > 925 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 19 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid = p.id AND pa.season_id = pt.year AND pa.points > 44 ) AND pt.year BETWEEN 1995 AND 2013 AND t.won > 35 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 17.56 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 1 ORDER BY total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(ap.award) AS award_count, SUM(pts.points) AS total_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pts ON p.playerid::integer = pts.playerid AND ap.year = pts.season_id WHERE p.firstseason >= 1981 AND p.lastseason <= 1978 AND pts.points > 41 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(ap.award) > 37 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS player_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, MAX(pt.points) AS max_regular_points, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_post_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT t.name, ', ' ORDER BY t.name) AS team_names, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_series_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid THEN sp.l ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_series_losses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) DESC) AS awards_rank FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) AND sp.year = pt.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 1984 AND p.lastseason <= 2013 AND pa.points > 9 AND pt.points > 2622 AND t.won > 64 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 40219 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 44 ORDER BY total_regular_points DESC, awards_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS player_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years_count, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(pa.rebounds) AS max_allstar_rebounds, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, MAX(pt.rebounds) AS max_regular_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, SUM(CASE WHEN d.draftround IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS draft_appearances, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_pick, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pa.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) DESC) AS awards_rank FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid WHERE pa.points > 38.71 AND pt.points > 2037.11 AND ap.year >= 2015.93 AND pt.year >= 2012.87 AND (t.year >= 1958.19 OR t.year IS NULL) AND (sp.year >= 1953.42 OR sp.year IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 18.31 AND SUM(pa.points) > 119.96 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, awards_rank ASC LIMIT 45.27;
