DESC) AS distinct_coach_award_types_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear), 0) DESC) AS distinct_draft_years_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid), 0) DESC) AS distinct_coaches_rank FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying AND pa.points > 33.49 AND pa.season_id >= 1990.98 LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying AND pt.points > 2655.61 AND pt.year >= 1989.85 LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying AND ap.year >= 2002.32 LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON p.playerid = ac.coachid::character varying AND ac.year >= 1959.38 LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying AND d.draftyear >= 2019.36 LEFT JOIN coaches c ON p.playerid = c.coachid AND c.year >= 1979.0 LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND t.year >= 1990.73 LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND sp.year >= 2016.65 WHERE p.height > 248.82 AND p.weight > 138.71 AND p.firstseason >= 1971.92 AND p.lastseason <= 2019.07 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.height, p.weight HAVING COALESCE(SUM(pa.points), 0) > 145.71 OR COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) > 7172.49 OR COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) > 2354.86 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, total_regular_points DESC, total_post_points DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.tmidwinner) AS championship_wins, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN series_post sp ON pt.tmid = sp.tmidwinner AND pt.year = sp.year JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year WHERE pt.points > 1082 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1994 AND pa.points > 6 AND d.draftoverall < 253 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4376 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 2 AND AVG(pa.points) > 15 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_awards DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.tmidwinner) AS championship_wins, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN series_post sp ON pt.tmid = sp.tmidwinner AND pt.year = sp.year JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year WHERE pt.points > 2217 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1996 AND 1966 AND pa.points > 40 AND d.draftoverall < 290 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1856 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 3 AND AVG(pa.points) > 28 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_awards DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid) AS avg_team_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1996 AND pt.year <= 2004 AND pt.points > 2865 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 736 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid) AS avg_team_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2006 AND pt.points > 1926 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 248 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid) AS avg_team_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1986 AND pt.year <= 2019 AND pt.points > 1043 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1692 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) AS stint_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1968 AND 2003 AND pt.points > 2073 AND pt.minutes > 3860 AND p.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT d.playerid FROM draft d WHERE d.draftyear BETWEEN 1994 AND 2019 AND d.draftround <= 1 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1533 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 2888 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_minutes DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) AS stint_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1970 AND 1996 AND pt.points > 125 AND pt.minutes > 1573 AND p.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT d.playerid FROM draft d WHERE d.draftyear BETWEEN 2022 AND 1966 AND d.draftround <= 9 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1370 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 2129 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_minutes DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE p.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT pas.playerid FROM player_allstar pas WHERE pas.points > 39 AND pas.season_id >= 2016 ) AND pt.points > 27 AND t.won >= 34 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 825 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(*) AS games_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 26 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1997 AND 2012 AND t.won > 51 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1420 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(*) AS games_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 33 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2001 AND 1995 AND t.won > 58 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1497 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(*) AS games_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 37 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1990 AND 1999 AND t.won > 66 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1459 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS rank_in_team FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points >= 1207 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 1977 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4615 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 4697.49 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 1218.25 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS scoring_category, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid WHERE pt.year >= 2012 AND pt.year <= 2005 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 259.24 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 48 AND pt.year >= 2012 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 781 ORDER BY pt.year, points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(CAST(pt.points AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_team_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) FILTER (WHERE ap.award IS NOT NULL) AS distinct_awards_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2015 AND pt.minutes > 1609 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.year = pt.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) AND sp.round = 'Conference Finals' ) AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4810 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, t.name AS team_name, t.won AS team_wins, t.lost AS team_losses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year_league, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid, pt.tmid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points_same_team FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year AND t.lgid = c.lgid JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year JOIN series_post sp2 ON t.id = sp2.tmidloser AND t.year = sp2.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.points > 1763 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1976 AND 1987 AND t.won > 56 AND d.draftoverall < 168 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.lgid, t.name, t.won, t.lost HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 7201 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 38 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, points_rank_in_year_league;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, AVG(pt.rebounds * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_rebounds_per_game, AVG(pt.assists * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_assists_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.points > 25.32 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_scoring_games, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.lgid, pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_by_league_year, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS overall_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2008 AND 1960 AND pt.gp > 8.52 AND pt.points >= 344.09 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3426.25 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 2721.37 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 357.49 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, pt.lgid ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, ap.award, ac.award AS coach_award, c.coachid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, t.name AS team_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid, pt.year) AS team_avg_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.id AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (pt.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR pt.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser) AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 675 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2004 AND pt.rebounds > 143 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid = p.id AND pa.season_id = pt.year AND pa.points > 28 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, ap.award, ac.award, c.coachid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, t.name HAVING AVG(pt.assists) > 5.88 ORDER BY pt.points DESC, points_rank LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, AVG(pt.assists * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_assists_per_game, AVG(pt.rebounds * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_rebounds_per_game, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.season_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS allstar_game_appearances, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS overall_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid = aw.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 1981 AND pt.year <= 1964 AND pt.points > 1574 AND t.won > 34 AND (ap.points IS NULL OR ap.points > 42) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname), (pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name), (pt.year), () ) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 26867 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 6 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.award = 'MVP') AS mvp_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_per_year, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, (SELECT AVG(pa.points) FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid = p.id AND pa.season_id >= 1954) AS avg_allstar_points_since_year, (SELECT MAX(d.draftoverall) FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.id) AS best_draft_position, t.won AS team_wins, t.lost AS team_losses, (SELECT SUM(c.won) FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = pt.tmid AND c.year = pt.year) AS coach_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::text = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1974 AND 1984 AND pt.points > 51 AND t.won > 69 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, t.won, t.lost, p.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 27750 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 49 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_season_league, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS previous_season_points, SUM(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_career_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (pt.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR pt.tmid = sp.tmidloser) AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE pt.year >= 2007 AND pt.year <= 1954 AND pt.gp >= 12 AND t.won >= 28 AND (p.height >= '150.0' OR p.height IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2167 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.lgid) >= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, points_rank_in_season_league;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_team_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = ap.season_id WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1960 AND 1973 AND pt.gp > 11 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players awp WHERE awp.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND awp.award = 'Most Valuable Player' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0 ) AND p.height > '150.0' AND t.playoff = 'Y' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 48953 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 1400 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.lgid) >= 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, pt.tmid ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, ap.points AS allstar_points, ac.year AS coach_award_year, ac.award AS coach_award, d.draftyear, d.draftround, sp.year AS playoff_year, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, c.coachid, c.won AS coach_wins, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, SUM(t.won) AS team_total_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award) AS distinct_coach_awards FROM players p INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid INNER JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id IN (sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser) AND t.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year WHERE pt.points > 588 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1956 AND 1973 AND t.won > 37 AND (ap.points > 47 OR ap.points IS NULL) AND (d.draftround <= 2 OR d.draftround IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, ap.season_id, ap.points, ac.year, ac.award, d.draftyear, d.draftround, sp.year, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, c.coachid, c.won HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1705 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 4 AND AVG(pt.minutes) >= 47 ORDER BY total_points DESC, team_points_rank ASC LIMIT 99;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, ap.points AS allstar_points, pt.points AS regular_points, pt.postpoints AS playoff_points, c.coachid, ac.award AS coach_award, d.draftyear, d.draftround, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid, pt.year) AS team_avg_points, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS career_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM players_teams WHERE points > 1538 AND year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2007 ) AND pt.points > 2354 AND pt.minutes > 1060 AND (ap.points > 38 OR ap.points IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, ap.season_id, ap.points, pt.points, pt.postpoints, c.coachid, ac.award, d.draftyear, d.draftround HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 1743 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 1 ORDER BY career_points DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) AS stint_count, (SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.assists) + SUM(pt.rebounds)) AS total_contrib, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_team_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points, (SUM(pt.points) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pt.fgattempted), 0)) AS shooting_efficiency FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 2230 AND pt.year >= 1999 AND pt.year <= 1993 AND t.won > 82 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' AND d.draftyear >= 1959 AND pa.points > 37 AND c.won > 37 AND sp.w > 6 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1521 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 9 ORDER BY total_contrib DESC, pt.year ASC, pt.tmid ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.assists) + SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS overall_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.points > 518 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1949 AND 2019 AND t.won > 24 AND pa.points > 48 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 21750 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 29 ORDER BY overall_rank, team_points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.award IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS award_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_year, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS team_3yr_moving_avg_points, SUM(COALESCE(c.post_wins, 0)) AS total_coach_post_wins, MAX(s.w) AS max_series_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post s ON (pt.tmid = s.tmidwinner OR pt.tmid = s.tmidloser) AND pt.year = s.year WHERE pt.year >= 1966 AND pt.year <= 1996 AND pt.points > 3595 AND t.won > 15 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 17261 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.lgid) >= 4 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, sub.total_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sub.total_points DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN ( SELECT pt.playerid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT sp.year FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.w > 1 ) AND pt.points > 2249 GROUP BY pt.playerid ) sub ON p.playerid::integer = sub.playerid WHERE sub.total_points >= 38385 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, sub.total_points ORDER BY points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_season_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS total_points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_team_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1970 AND pt.year <= 2002 AND pt.points > 685 AND pa.points > 3 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = pt.tmid AND c.year = pt.year AND c.won > 42 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE (sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) AND sp.year = pt.year AND sp.w > 5 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, pt.tmid, pt.year HAVING AVG(pa.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 2 ORDER BY total_points_rank, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, pt.year, pt.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, SUM(ap.points) AS allstar_points, SUM(ap.rebounds) AS allstar_rebounds, SUM(ap.assists) AS allstar_assists, (SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.rebounds) + SUM(pt.assists)) AS total_prd, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY (SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.rebounds) + SUM(pt.assists)) DESC) AS prd_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid, pt.lgid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points, (SUM(pt.points) - LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid, pt.lgid ORDER BY pt.year)) AS points_diff_from_prev_year, SUM(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_points_career, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_points_last_3_years FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.points > 6 AND pt.year >= 1962 AND pt.year <= 1984 AND t.won > 52 AND (ap.points IS NULL OR ap.points > 42) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, pt.year, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 10639 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 1 ORDER BY total_prd DESC, pt.year ASC, prd_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.year, t.lgid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.season_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS allstar_appearances, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_season_league, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_season_points, SUM(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3_season_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1954 AND pt.year <= 1983 AND pt.points > 1582 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.year, t.lgid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2723 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 3 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 2022.65 AND p.lastseason <= 1985.49 AND t.lgid LIKE 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 25942.32 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1631 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 1988 AND (t.lgid = 'NBA' OR t.confid = 'East') AND NOT (d.draftround IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 47417 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 51;

SELECT p.playerid, pt.year, t.tmid, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_ppg, AVG(pt.assists * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_apg, AVG(pt.rebounds * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_rpg, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.season_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS allstar_game_appearances, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) AS distinct_player_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT awc.award) AS distinct_coach_awards_for_team_year, SUM(d.draftoverall) AS total_draft_value, MAX(s.w) AS max_playoff_wins_in_year, SUM(t.o_pts) AS team_total_points_for, SUM(t.d_pts) AS team_total_points_against FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::integer = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches awc ON t.tmid::integer = awc.coachid AND t.year = awc.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN series_post s ON t.tmid::integer = s.tmidwinner AND t.year = s.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2011 AND 2002 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND pt.points >= 218 AND t.o_pts >= 6721 GROUP BY CUBE (p.playerid, pt.year, t.tmid, t.lgid) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 14908 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 16 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, t.tmid;

SELECT p.playerid, t.lgid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS birth_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::text = pt.playerid::text JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::text = t.tmid::text AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::text = ap.playerid::text WHERE pt.year >= 1987 AND pt.year <= 1982 AND pt.points > 879 GROUP BY CUBE(p.playerid, t.lgid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 11625 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, t.tmid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS awards_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2010 AND 1968 AND pt.minutes >= 2814 GROUP BY p.playerid, t.tmid, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 47266 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 43 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid, t.tmid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS awards_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2013 AND 1990 AND pt.minutes >= 71 GROUP BY p.playerid, t.tmid, t.year HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 31 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) <= 28 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.year AS year1, p2.year AS year2, (p2.points - p1.points) AS point_increase, AVG(p1.points) OVER(PARTITION BY p1.playerid) AS avg_points_across_years FROM players_teams p1 JOIN players_teams p2 ON p1.playerid = p2.playerid AND p1.tmid = p2.tmid AND p1.year < p2.year WHERE p1.points > 8.36 AND p2.points > 594.78 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.year, p2.year, p1.points, p2.points HAVING (p2.points - p1.points) > 357.66 ORDER BY point_increase DESC;

SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, AVG(pt.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS avg_points_3_seasons, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds FROM players_teams pt JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id::integer WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2001 AND 2000 AND pt.points > 1288 GROUP BY pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points HAVING SUM(pt.rebounds) > 1899 ORDER BY avg_points_3_seasons DESC;

SELECT t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t.year = pt.year WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT year FROM players_teams WHERE playerid IN ( SELECT playerid FROM awards_players WHERE year BETWEEN 2004 AND 2000 ) ) GROUP BY t.name HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 14.39 ORDER BY player_count DESC;
SELECT t.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid WHERE pt.year >= 2018 AND pt.gp >= 46 GROUP BY t.tmid ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, pt.year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::text = p.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2007 AND pt.points > 213 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (t.tmid, t.lgid, pt.year), (t.tmid, t.lgid), (t.lgid, pt.year), (t.tmid), (t.lgid), (pt.year), () ) ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t.year = pt.year WHERE t.year >= 1980 AND t.year <= 1994 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award LIKE '%All-Star%' LIMIT 1) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 24983 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1992 AND 2002 AND pt.playerid IN ( SELECT ap.playerid FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = 'All-NBA First Team' ) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 28747 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.attendance, COALESCE(SUM(c.post_wins), 0) AS total_post_wins, COALESCE(SUM(c.post_losses), 0) AS total_post_losses, COUNT(DISTINCT s.tmidwinner) AS seasons_with_series_win, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t.won DESC, t.lost ASC) AS win_rank FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post s ON t.id = s.tmidwinner AND t.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1966.6 AND t.year <= 1947.02 AND t.won >= 72.95 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.attendance HAVING COALESCE(SUM(c.post_wins), 0) > 3.17 OR COUNT(DISTINCT s.tmidwinner) > 3.26 ORDER BY t.year DESC, win_rank ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.name, t.lgid, SUM(ap.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(ap.three_made) AS avg_threes_made, COUNT(DISTINCT d.playerid) AS drafted_players, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_season_points, MAX(c.won) AS max_coach_wins, SUM(sp.w) AS total_playoff_wins, SUM(sp.l) AS total_playoff_losses, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.playerid) AS award_winning_players, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND t.year = ap.season_id JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1963.03 AND 1989.94 JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser) AND t.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND awp.year = t.year WHERE t.attendance > 21012.48 AND t.year >= 1951.95 AND t.year <= 2005.07 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 20321.31 AND COUNT(DISTINCT d.playerid) >= 8.76 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC, total_team_season_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS num_players, AVG(p.points) AS avg_points FROM players_teams p JOIN teams t ON p.tmid::text = t.tmid AND p.year = t.year WHERE p.points > 1568.62 AND t.year >= 1967.8 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, num_players DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.won AS current_year_wins, t2.won AS previous_year_wins, (t1.won - t2.won) AS win_difference FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.won > 55 AND t2.won > 54 ORDER BY win_difference DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.tmid, t1.name, t1.won AS wins, t2.won AS previous_wins, (t1.won - t2.won) AS win_improvement FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.won > 61 AND t2.won > 34 ORDER BY win_improvement DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH player_stats AS ( SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.year >= 1997 AND pt.year <= 2010 GROUP BY pt.playerid, pt.year ) SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ps.year, ps.total_points, ps.total_rebounds, ps.total_assists, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.year ORDER BY ps.total_points DESC) AS points_rank FROM player_stats ps JOIN players p ON ps.playerid = p.id::integer WHERE ps.total_points > 837 ORDER BY ps.year DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname AS first_name, p.lastname AS last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, SUM(ap.year) AS total_award_years, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(pa.season_id) AS latest_allstar_season FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying WHERE p.college LIKE '%State%' AND pa.season_id >= 1952.74 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 1.17 ORDER BY distinct_awards_count DESC, total_award_years DESC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname AS first_name, p.lastname AS last_name, p.pos AS position, p.college AS college, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_post_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, SUM(CASE WHEN t.playoff = 'Y' THEN t.won ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_wins_by_teams_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pos ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_by_position, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p INNER JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 2015 AND p.lastseason <= 1963 AND pa.points > 49 AND (pt.points > 3417 OR pt.points IS NULL) AND t.year BETWEEN 1985 AND 1980 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, pt.year HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 18.13 AND SUM(pt.points) > 43245 ORDER BY total_regular_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname AS first_name, p.lastname AS last_name, p.pos AS position, p.college AS college, t.lgid AS league, t.divid AS division, ap.season_id AS allstar_season, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS birth_year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.points > 47.23 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_scoring_allstar_games, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_postseason_points, SUM(pt.postassists) AS total_postseason_assists, SUM(pt.postrebounds) AS total_postseason_rebounds, (SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.assists) + SUM(pt.rebounds)) AS total_career_stats, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS league_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS overall_assists_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_percentile, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY MAX(pt.year)) AS prev_year_points, LEAD(SUM(pt.assists), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY MAX(pt.year)) AS next_year_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2017 AND 2018 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND p.height > '1.7' AND pt.points > 7831 AND (ap.points IS NOT NULL OR aw.award IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, t.lgid, t.divid, ap.season_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, t.lgid, t.divid), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college), (t.lgid, t.divid, ap.season_id), (t.lgid, t.divid), (p.pos, p.college), () ) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 13647 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 17 AND AVG(ap.points) >= 19.28 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_assists DESC, total_rebounds DESC LIMIT 124;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, pt.year AS season_year, pt.tmid AS team_id, t.name AS team_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, AVG(pt.assists * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_assists_per_game, AVG(pt.rebounds * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_rebounds_per_game, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.season_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS allstar_game_appearances, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_per_season, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS overall_points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS previous_season_points, LEAD(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS next_season_points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid = p.id AND ap2.award LIKE '%MVP%' AND ap2.year = pt.year) AS mvp_awards_count, (SELECT AVG(d.draftoverall) FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.id AND d.draftyear <= pt.year) AS avg_draft_position, (SELECT MAX(c.won) FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = pt.tmid AND c.year = pt.year) AS team_coach_max_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::text = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1965 AND 2007 AND pt.points > 1769 AND pt.gp >= 68 AND t.won > 7 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, p.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1418 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) <= 2 ORDER BY total_points DESC, season_year ASC, player_name;

SELECT p.playerid, COUNT(ap.award) AS award_count, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_points, SUM(ps.rebounds) AS total_rebounds FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams ps ON p.id = ps.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 1975 AND ps.year BETWEEN 1975 AND 2018 AND ps.gp > 35 GROUP BY p.playerid HAVING COUNT(ap.award) > 26 ORDER BY total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE pa.points > 14 AND pa.season_id >= 1969 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) > 2 ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 1956 AND pa.season_id >= 1955 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 1639 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, SUM(ps.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.playerid::integer = ps.playerid AND ap.year = ps.season_id WHERE ap.year >= 2018 AND ps.points >= 12 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2013 AND pt.year <= 2012 AND pt.points > 2203 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 10 AND SUM(pt.points) > 24819 ORDER BY total_team_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT ap2.year) AS award_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_percentile FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players ap2 ON p.id = ap2.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 3950 AND ap.season_id >= 1959 AND ap2.year BETWEEN 1975 AND 1950 AND pt.minutes > 3211 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 9 AND SUM(pt.points) > 33317 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 1822 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT apw.year) AS award_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players apw ON p.playerid::integer = apw.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id WHERE pt.year >= 2001 AND ap.season_id >= 1990 AND pt.points > 3596 AND ap.points > 45 AND t.won > 62 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 3 AND SUM(pt.points) > 30852 AND AVG(pt.rebounds) > 12 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE ap.season_id BETWEEN 2010 AND 2009 AND ap.points > 17 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 18 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 2011 AND p.lastseason <= 1957 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 41783 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_pick, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ac.award = 'Most Valuable Player' THEN ac.year END) AS mvp_awards, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) DESC) AS allstar_seasons_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ac ON p.playerid::integer = ac.playerid AND pt.year = ac.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1992 AND 1972 AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' AND t.playoff = 'Y' AND pt.gp > 60 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 16669 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 8 AND AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) >= '5.0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, allstar_seasons DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id WHERE pt.year >= 2014 AND pt.year <= 1976 AND pt.points > 60 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 19 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS distinct_team_years, COUNT(DISTINCT dp.draftyear) AS distinct_draft_years, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_team_points, SUM(CASE WHEN ac.award = 'Most Valuable Player' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mvp_awards_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ac.award = 'Coach of the Year' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coy_awards_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) DESC) AS allstar_season_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN draft dp ON p.playerid::integer = dp.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::integer = awp.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON p.playerid::integer = ac.coachid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON p.playerid::integer = c.coachid::integer LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner WHERE ap.points > 26 AND pt.year >= 2011 AND dp.draftyear <= 2001 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 19 AND AVG(pt.points) < 19 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, distinct_allstar_seasons DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE ap.year >= 2017 AND pt.points > 1252 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) > 20 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS distinct_teams, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS distinct_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 2628 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2015 AND 1967 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 47815 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(a.award) AS award_count FROM players p JOIN awards_players a ON p.playerid = a.playerid::character varying WHERE a.year >= 2012 AND a.year <= 1952 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(a.award) > 5 ORDER BY award_count DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND ap.year = pa.season_id WHERE ap.year >= 1988 AND pa.points >= 26 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) > 10 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, MIN(pa.points) AS min_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, MAX(pt.points) AS max_regular_points, MIN(pt.points) AS min_regular_points, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_post_points, AVG(pt.postpoints) AS avg_post_points, MAX(pt.postpoints) AS max_post_points, MIN(pt.postpoints) AS min_post_points, SUM(t.won) AS total_team_wins, AVG(t.won) AS avg_team_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS total_team_losses, AVG(t.lost) AS avg_team_losses, SUM(t.attendance) AS total_attendance, AVG(t.attendance) AS avg_attendance, SUM(s.w) AS total_playoff_wins, AVG(s.w) AS avg_playoff_wins, SUM(s.l) AS total_playoff_losses, AVG(s.l) AS avg_playoff_losses, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT d.draftfrom, ', ' ORDER BY d.draftfrom) AS draft_sources, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins, AVG(c.won) AS avg_coach_wins, SUM(c.lost) AS total_coach_losses, AVG(c.lost) AS avg_coach_losses, SUM(c.post_wins) AS total_coach_post_wins, AVG(c.post_wins) AS avg_coach_post_wins, SUM(c.post_losses) AS total_coach_post_losses, AVG(c.post_losses) AS avg_coach_post_losses FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN series_post s ON t.tmid::integer = s.tmidwinner JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE pa.points > 43 AND pt.points > 1719 AND t.won > 70 AND t.attendance > 1593865 AND s.w > 3 AND c.won > 23 AND ap.year >= 1958 AND ap.year <= 1972 AND pa.season_id >= 1975 AND pa.season_id <= 1975 AND pt.year >= 2008 AND pt.year <= 2005 AND t.year >= 1996 AND t.year <= 2006 AND s.year >= 2007
