SUM(pt.fgattempted)) * 100 ELSE 0 END DESC) AS career_fg_percentage_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN SUM(pt.ftattempted) > 0 THEN (SUM(pt.ftmade)::DECIMAL / SUM(pt.ftattempted)) * 100 ELSE 0 END DESC) AS career_ft_percentage_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN SUM(pt.threeattempted) > 0 THEN (SUM(pt.threemade)::DECIMAL / SUM(pt.threeattempted)) * 100 ELSE 0 END DESC) AS career_three_percentage_rank FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid = awp.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE p.height >= 154.52 AND p.weight >= 195.97 AND p.firstseason >= 1964.39 AND p.lastseason <= 1984.61 AND ap.points >= 30.6 AND pt.points >= 1890.81 AND t.won >= 76.02 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, p.height, p.weight, p.firstseason, p.lastseason HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 8.45 AND COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) >= 17.58 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 10.55 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) >= 8.46 ORDER BY total_career_points DESC, total_career_rebounds DESC, total_career_assists DESC LIMIT 589.77;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.height, p.weight, p.firstseason, p.lastseason, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_regular_rebounds, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_regular_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_regular_assists, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_regular_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, COUNT(DISTINCT ap2.season_id) AS allstar_seasons_teammate, AVG(ap2.points) AS avg_teammate_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN players_teams pt2 ON pt.tmid = pt2.tmid AND pt.year = pt2.year AND pt.playerid != pt2.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap2 ON pt2.playerid = ap2.playerid AND pt2.year = ap2.season_id JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN teams t2 ON pt2.tmid::integer = t2.id AND pt2.year = t2.year JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year WHERE p.height > 201.05 AND p.weight > 118.67 AND p.firstseason >= 1987.94 AND p.lastseason <= 2012.86 AND t.won > 26.19 AND t2.won > 18.48 AND ap.points > 47.58 AND pt.points > 2383.62 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.height, p.weight, p.firstseason, p.lastseason HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 8.35 AND AVG(ap.points) > 16.65 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_points_last_3_years FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 2015 AND pt.points > 1443 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2528 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND year BETWEEN 2011 AND 2004 ) AND pt.points > 2982 ORDER BY pt.points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND year BETWEEN 2017 AND 1993 ) AND pt.points > 733 ORDER BY pt.points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = 'All-NBA') as award_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1684 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2004 AND 2018 ORDER BY pt.points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award LIKE '%MVP%') as award_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 717 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2020 AND 2006 ORDER BY pt.points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 2893.4 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 1377.73 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS scoring_category, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2011 AND 2002 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 885.78 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = 'MVP') AS mvp_count, (SELECT AVG(pa.points) FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid = p.id AND pa.season_id = pt.year) AS allstar_avg_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1972 AND 1994 AND pt.points > 1563 AND pt.rebounds > 397 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t.id AND sp.year = pt.year ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, p.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2297 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 905 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 4 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_rebounds DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = 'MVP') AS mvp_count, (SELECT AVG(pa.points) FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid = p.id AND pa.season_id = pt.year) AS allstar_avg_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2011 AND 1968 AND pt.points > 104 AND pt.rebounds > 266 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t.id AND sp.year = pt.year ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, p.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2874 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 1694 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 4 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_rebounds DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, t.name AS team_name, t.won AS team_wins, t.lost AS team_losses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year_league, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid, pt.tmid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points_same_team FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year AND t.lgid = c.lgid JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year JOIN series_post sp2 ON t.id = sp2.tmidloser AND t.year = sp2.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.points > 909 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1960 AND 2003 AND t.won > 13 AND d.draftoverall < 298 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.lgid, t.name, t.won, t.lost HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 42412 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, points_rank_in_year_league;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 1512 AND pt.year >= 2001 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points HAVING COUNT(pt.stint) >= 3 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award LIKE '%All-Star%') AS all_star_awards, (SELECT AVG(pa.points) FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid = p.id AND pa.season_id = pt.year) AS avg_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS career_points_running_total FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1098 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1967 AND 1958 AND p.firstseason <= 1963 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid = p.id AND ap2.year = pt.year AND ap2.award IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, p.id HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 955 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 6 ORDER BY career_points_running_total DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_season_league, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS previous_season_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1994 AND pt.year <= 2014 AND pt.points > 100 AND t.won > 26 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1769 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 10 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, points_rank_in_season_league ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_season_league, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS previous_season_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1977 AND pt.gp >= 33 AND t.playoff = 'Y' AND pt.points > (SELECT AVG(points) FROM players_teams WHERE year = pt.year AND lgid = pt.lgid) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2765 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) <= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, points_rank_in_season_league ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, ap.points AS allstar_points, ap.rebounds AS allstar_rebounds, ap.assists AS allstar_assists, pt.points AS regular_points, pt.rebounds AS regular_rebounds, pt.assists AS regular_assists, pt.steals AS regular_steals, pt.blocks AS regular_blocks, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftselection, c.coachid, ac.award AS coach_award, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, sp.w AS series_wins, sp.l AS series_losses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.tmid ORDER BY pt.points DESC, pt.rebounds DESC, pt.assists DESC) AS team_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year DESC, pt.points DESC) AS player_season_rank, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS career_points_running_total, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid, pt.year) AS team_avg_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN awards_players aap ON p.id = aap.playerid AND pt.year = aap.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (pt.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR pt.tmid = sp.tmidloser) AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 1013 AND pt.rebounds > 388 AND pt.assists > 201 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1961 AND 1963 AND ap.points > 35 AND t.won > 42 AND t.lost < 45 AND (sp.w > 4 OR sp.w IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.rebounds, ap.assists, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, pt.steals, pt.blocks, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftselection, c.coachid, ac.award, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, sp.w, sp.l HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 8 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 1 ORDER BY team_rank, player_season_rank, career_points_running_total DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, SUM(ap.points) AS total_points, SUM(ap.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(ap.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(ap.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS seasons_played, (SUM(ap.points) + SUM(ap.assists) + SUM(ap.rebounds)) AS total_contributions, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.league_id ORDER BY (SUM(ap.points) + SUM(ap.assists) + SUM(ap.rebounds)) DESC) AS league_rank, LAG(SUM(ap.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid, ap.league_id ORDER BY ap.season_id) AS prev_season_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.lgid = t.lgid JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year WHERE ap.points > 21 AND ap.season_id BETWEEN 1952 AND 2018 AND t.year BETWEEN 1954 AND 2005 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, ap.season_id, ap.league_id HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 316 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 6 ORDER BY total_contributions DESC, league_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_team, (SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.assists) + SUM(pt.rebounds)) AS total_contrib FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1953 AND pt.year <= 1952 AND pt.points > 1454 AND t.won > 28 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.year, t.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4918 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 1 ORDER BY total_contrib DESC, points_rank_in_team;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, SUM(sp.w) AS series_wins, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, SUM(t.o_pts) AS team_offensive_points, SUM(t.d_pts) AS team_defensive_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner WHERE pt.points > 987.43 AND pt.year >= 2021 AND pt.year <= 1977 AND t.won >= 56.69 AND c.won >= 56.81 AND sp.w >= 3.03 AND pa.points >= 16.78 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 29996.17 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 141.44 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 19675.88 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) >= 16 AND COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) >= 4 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_assists DESC, total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, pt.year, pt.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_points_3yr FROM players_teams pt JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::text = p.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1991 AND pt.year <= 1954 GROUP BY p.playerid, pt.year, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 27 ORDER BY p.playerid, pt.year;

SELECT p.playerid, t.tmid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS birth_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) AS distinct_awards, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_pick, SUM(CASE WHEN c.won > c.lost THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS winning_seasons_coached, SUM(sp.w) AS total_playoff_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::integer = awp.playerid LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner WHERE pt.points > 2933 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1977 AND 1965 AND ap.minutes > 10 AND awp.year >= 2010 GROUP BY CUBE(p.playerid, t.tmid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 38363 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 12 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_assists DESC;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.firstname, p1.lastname, pt1.year AS team_year, pt1.tmid AS team_id, pt1.points AS regular_points, pt1.postpoints AS playoff_points, ap.season_id AS allstar_season, ap.points AS allstar_points, d.draftyear, d.draftround, c.coachid, c.won AS coach_wins, c.lost AS coach_losses, ac.award AS coach_award, t.name AS team_name, t.won AS team_wins, t.lost AS team_losses, sp.tmidwinner AS series_winner, sp.tmidloser AS series_loser, COUNT(DISTINCT pt2.playerid) AS teammates_count, AVG(pt2.points) AS avg_teammate_points, SUM(pt1.points + pt1.postpoints) AS total_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt1.year ORDER BY (pt1.points + pt1.postpoints) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p1 JOIN players_teams pt1 ON p1.id = pt1.playerid JOIN players_teams pt2 ON pt1.tmid = pt2.tmid AND pt1.year = pt2.year AND pt1.playerid != pt2.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt1.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt1.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p1.id = ap.playerid AND pt1.year = ap.season_id JOIN draft d ON p1.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt1.points > 2140 AND pt1.postpoints > 6 AND t.won > 63 AND ap.points > 19 AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1956 AND 1992 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.firstname, p1.lastname, pt1.year, pt1.tmid, pt1.points, pt1.postpoints, ap.season_id, ap.points, d.draftyear, d.draftround, c.coachid, c.won, c.lost, ac.award, t.name, t.won, t.lost, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser HAVING AVG(pt2.points) > 16 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt2.playerid) > 9 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points AS regular_points, p2.points AS allstar_points, (p1.points - COALESCE(p2.points, 0)) AS point_diff FROM players_teams p1 LEFT JOIN player_allstar p2 ON p1.playerid = p2.playerid AND p1.year = p2.season_id WHERE p1.points > 2617 AND p1.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 1963 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points, p2.points ORDER BY point_diff DESC;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points AS regular_points, p2.points AS allstar_points, (p1.points - p2.points) AS point_diff FROM players_teams p1 JOIN player_allstar p2 ON p1.playerid = p2.playerid AND p1.year = p2.season_id WHERE p1.points > 2643 AND p2.points > 9 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points, p2.points HAVING (p1.points - p2.points) > 259 ORDER BY point_diff DESC;

SELECT s1.playerid, s1.season_id, s1.league_id, SUM(s1.points) AS total_points, AVG(s1.minutes) AS avg_minutes, MAX(s1.rebounds) AS max_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT s1.conference) AS conferences_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s1.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM player_allstar s1 JOIN players p ON s1.playerid = p.id::integer WHERE s1.minutes > 14 AND s1.season_id BETWEEN 1963 AND 1964 GROUP BY s1.playerid, s1.season_id, s1.league_id HAVING SUM(s1.points) > 56 INTERSECT SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, MAX(pt.rebounds) AS max_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.lgid) AS leagues_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players_teams pt JOIN draft d ON pt.playerid = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id::integer WHERE pt.minutes > 43 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2020 AND 1980 AND d.draftyear < 1967 GROUP BY pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 65 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 45 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, AVG(t.won) AS avg_wins, SUM(t.attendance) AS total_attendance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coaches c WHERE c.lgid = t.lgid AND c.year = t.year AND c.won > 42.17) AS coaches_above_threshold FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2002.4 AND 1958.49 AND t.attendance > 681275.19 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = (SELECT award FROM awards_players WHERE playerid = ap.playerid AND year = ap.year AND award LIKE '%MVP%' LIMIT 1) ) GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year HAVING AVG(t.won) > 65.02 ORDER BY total_attendance DESC;

SELECT t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, AVG(pts.points) AS avg_player_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY t.won DESC) AS team_rank_by_wins FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pts ON t.tmid::text = pts.tmid::text AND t.year = pts.year WHERE t.won > 35.58 AND t.year BETWEEN 2008.02 AND 1979.42 GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost ORDER BY t.year, team_rank_by_wins;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS total_players, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.coachid) AS total_award_coaches, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.points > 851 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1970 AND 2017 AND pa.points >= 28 AND c.won > 27 AND d.draftyear >= 2013 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 8249 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) >= 14 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 44 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2012 AND pt.points > 28 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 6.75 ORDER BY player_count DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(p.points) AS total_player_points, SUM(p.assists) AS total_player_assists, SUM(p.rebounds) AS total_player_rebounds, SUM(p.steals) AS total_player_steals, SUM(p.blocks) AS total_player_blocks, AVG(p.points) AS avg_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS unique_players, MAX(t.o_pts) AS team_offensive_points, MAX(t.d_pts) AS team_defensive_points, MAX(t.won) AS team_wins, MAX(t.lost) AS team_losses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.points) DESC) AS rank_by_points, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(p.assists) DESC) AS row_by_assists_in_league, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.rebounds) DESC) AS dense_rank_by_rebounds, LAG(SUM(p.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points, LEAD(SUM(p.assists), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS next_year_assists, SUM(SUM(p.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_points_in_league, AVG(SUM(p.rebounds)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_rebounds_3_year FROM teams t JOIN players_teams p ON t.tmid::integer = p.tmid AND t.year = p.year JOIN awards_players a ON p.playerid = a.playerid AND p.year = a.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid AND p.year = pa.season_id WHERE t.year >= 2020 AND t.year <= 1983 AND p.points > 3244 AND t.won > 80 AND a.award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND sp.round = 'Finals' AND pa.league_id = 'NBA' AND c.won > 0 AND d.draftyear >= 1949 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(p.points) > 6003 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) > 15 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts FROM teams t WHERE t.year = 2022 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.points > 664 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND c.year = t.year AND c.won > 70 ) ORDER BY t.won DESC, t.o_pts DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, COALESCE(SUM(p.points), 0) AS total_player_points, COALESCE(SUM(c.won), 0) AS total_coach_wins, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT s.id), 0) AS series_appearances, AVG(pa.points) OVER (PARTITION BY t.year, t.lgid) AS avg_league_points_per_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t.won DESC) AS win_rank FROM teams t LEFT JOIN players_teams p ON t.tmid::integer = p.tmid AND t.year = p.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post s ON (t.tmid::integer = s.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = s.tmidloser) AND t.year = s.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid AND p.year = pa.season_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1970 AND 1987 AND t.won > 5 AND t.games > 70 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.lgid, pa.points HAVING COALESCE(SUM(p.points), 0) > 5750 AND COALESCE(SUM(c.won), 0) > 31 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC, win_rank;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.attendance, COALESCE(SUM(c.post_wins), 0) AS total_post_wins, COALESCE(SUM(c.post_losses), 0) AS total_post_losses, COUNT(DISTINCT s.tmidwinner) AS seasons_with_series_win, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t.won DESC, t.lost ASC) AS win_rank FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post s ON t.id = s.tmidwinner AND t.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1981.51 AND t.year <= 1992.14 AND t.won >= 50.45 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.attendance HAVING COALESCE(SUM(c.post_wins), 0) > 4.17 OR COUNT(DISTINCT s.tmidwinner) > 0.28 ORDER BY t.year DESC, win_rank ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.year = pt.year AND t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid JOIN draft d ON pt.playerid = d.playerid WHERE t.year >= 1979 AND d.draftyear <= 2012 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 18128 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) >= 5 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.name, t.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_player_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_player_assists, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league, AVG(CAST(pt.points AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS avg_points_per_minute, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid AND ap.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_count_in_year_league, SUM(CASE WHEN pa.conference = 'East' THEN pa.points ELSE 0 END) AS east_allstar_points, SUM(CASE WHEN pa.conference = 'West' THEN pa.points ELSE 0 END) AS west_allstar_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = CAST(pt.tmid AS CHARACTER VARYING) AND t.year = pt.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = CAST(c.tmid AS CHARACTER VARYING) AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (t.tmid = CAST(sp.tmidwinner AS CHARACTER VARYING) OR t.tmid = CAST(sp.tmidloser AS CHARACTER VARYING)) AND t.year = sp.year WHERE t.year >= 1958 AND t.year <= 2019 AND t.won >= 49 AND t.lost <= 11 AND pt.minutes > 3494 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 56933 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) > 4116 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC, t.year ASC, t.tmid;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.name, t1.won, t1.lost, t2.year AS prev_year, t2.won AS prev_won, t2.lost AS prev_lost, (t1.won - t2.won) AS win_improvement FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.won > 38 AND t2.won > 10 AND t1.year BETWEEN 1961 AND 2010 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.name, t1.won, t1.lost, t2.year, t2.won, t2.lost ORDER BY win_improvement DESC;

WITH player_performance AS ( SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.lgid, pt.gp, pt.minutes, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, pt.steals, pt.blocks, pt.turnovers, pt.pf, ROUND(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS pts_per_36, ROUND(pt.rebounds::numeric / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS reb_per_36, ROUND(pt.assists::numeric / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS ast_per_36, ROUND((pt.steals + pt.blocks)::numeric / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS stl_blk_per_36, ROUND(pt.turnovers::numeric / NULLIF(pt.assists, 0), 2) AS ast_to_ratio, CASE WHEN pt.fgattempted > 0 THEN ROUND(pt.fgmade::numeric / pt.fgattempted * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END AS fg_pct, CASE WHEN pt.ftattempted > 0 THEN ROUND(pt.ftmade::numeric / pt.ftattempted * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END AS ft_pct, CASE WHEN pt.threeattempted > 0 THEN ROUND(pt.threemade::numeric / pt.threeattempted * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END AS three_pct FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.minutes > 348 AND pt.gp > 79 ), team_performance AS ( SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.o_reb, t.d_reb, t.o_asts, t.d_stl, t.o_blk, t.d_to, ROUND(t.o_pts::numeric / NULLIF(t.d_pts, 0), 2) AS off_def_ratio, ROUND((t.o_reb + t.d_reb)::numeric / t.games, 1) AS reb_per_game, ROUND(t.o_asts::numeric / t.games, 1) AS ast_per_game, t.won::numeric / NULLIF(t.won + t.lost, 0) AS win_pct FROM teams t WHERE t.games > 67 AND t.o_pts > 5867 ), coach_performance AS ( SELECT c.coachid, c.year, c.tmid, c.lgid, c.won, c.lost, c.post_wins, c.post_losses, c.won::numeric / NULLIF(c.won + c.lost, 0) AS reg_season_win_pct, CASE WHEN c.post_wins + c.post_losses > 0 THEN c.post_wins::numeric / (c.post_wins + c.post_losses) ELSE 0 END AS playoff_win_pct FROM coaches c WHERE c.won > 53 AND c.post_wins >= 8 ), award_winners AS ( SELECT ap.playerid, ap.year, ap.award, ap.lgid, ap.pos, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ap.playerid, ap.year) AS awards_count FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.year >= 2004 ), draft_analysis AS ( SELECT d.playerid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftselection, d.draftoverall, d.tmid, d.lgid, CASE WHEN d.draftround = 1 AND d.draftselection <= 10 THEN 'Lottery' WHEN d.draftround = 1 THEN 'First Round' WHEN d.draftround = 2 THEN 'Second Round' ELSE 'Late Round' END AS draft_tier FROM draft d WHERE d.draftyear BETWEEN 2006 AND 1991 ), all_star_performance AS ( SELECT asp.playerid, asp.season_id, asp.games_played, asp.minutes, asp.points, asp.rebounds, asp.assists, asp.steals, asp.blocks, ROUND(asp.points::numeric / NULLIF(asp.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS asg_pts_per_36, ROUND(asp.rebounds::numeric / NULLIF(asp.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS asg_reb_per_36, ROUND(asp.assists::numeric / NULLIF(asp.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS asg_ast_per_36 FROM player_allstar asp WHERE asp.minutes > 43 AND asp.points > 31 ), combined_analysis AS ( SELECT pp.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, pp.year, pp.tmid, t.name AS team_name, pp.lgid, pp.pts_per_36, pp.reb_per_36, pp.ast_per_36, pp.stl_blk_per_36, pp.ast_to_ratio, pp.fg_pct, pp.ft_pct, pp.three_pct, tp.win_pct AS team_win_pct, tp.off_def_ratio, tp.reb_per_game AS team_reb_per_game, tp.ast_per_game AS team_ast_per_game, cp.reg_season_win_pct AS coach_win_pct, cp.playoff_win_pct, aw.award, aw.awards_count, da.draft_tier, da.draftoverall, asp.asg_pts_per_36, asp.asg_reb_per_36, asp.asg_ast_per_36, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY pp.year, pp.lgid ORDER BY pp.pts_per_36 DESC ) AS pts_per_36_rank, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY pp.year, pp.lgid, p.pos ORDER BY (pp.pts_per_36 + pp.reb_per_36 + pp.ast_per_36) DESC ) AS overall_perf_rank_by_pos, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY pp.playerid ORDER BY pp.year DESC ) AS recent_season_flag, AVG(pp.pts_per_36) OVER ( PARTITION BY pp.playerid ORDER BY pp.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_pts_3_seasons, SUM(pp.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY pp.playerid ORDER BY pp.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS career_points_cumulative FROM player_performance pp JOIN players p ON pp.playerid = p.id::integer JOIN team_performance tp ON pp.tmid = tp.tmid::integer AND pp.year = tp.year AND pp.lgid = tp.lgid JOIN coach_performance cp ON pp.tmid = cp.tmid::integer AND pp.year = cp.year AND pp.lgid = cp.lgid LEFT JOIN award_winners aw ON pp.playerid = aw.playerid AND pp.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN draft_analysis da ON pp.playerid = da.playerid LEFT JOIN all_star_performance asp ON pp.playerid = asp.playerid AND pp.year = asp.season_id LEFT JOIN teams t ON pp.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pp.year = t.year WHERE pp.pts_per_36 > 30.36 AND pp.ast_to_ratio < 1.02 ) SELECT playerid, firstname, lastname, pos, year, team_name, lgid, pts_per_36, pts_per_36_rank, overall_perf_rank_by_pos, team_win_pct, coach_win_pct, award, draft_tier, asg_pts_per_36, moving_avg_pts_3_seasons, career_points_cumulative, CASE WHEN pts_per_36_rank <= 10 THEN 'Elite Scorer' WHEN pts_per_36_rank <= 25 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN pts_per_36_rank <= 50 THEN 'Good Scorer' ELSE 'Average Scorer' END AS scoring_tier FROM combined_analysis WHERE pts_per_36_rank <= 96 AND overall_perf_rank_by_pos <= 39 ORDER BY year DESC, pts_per_36_rank, overall_perf_rank_by_pos;

SELECT a.award, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS unique_players, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS unique_draft_years, SUM(ps.points) AS total_points, AVG(ps.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, MAX(ps.assists) AS max_assists, MIN(ps.steals) AS min_steals, SUM(t.won) AS total_team_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS unique_teams, COUNT(DISTINCT s.tmidwinner) AS unique_series_winners, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS unique_coaches FROM awards_players a JOIN players p ON a.playerid = p.id JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.id = ps.playerid AND a.year = ps.season_id JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND a.year = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND a.lgid = t.lgid JOIN series_post s ON t.id = s.tmidwinner AND a.year = s.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND a.year = c.year AND t.lgid = c.lgid JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND a.year = d.draftyear WHERE a.year >= 2010 AND a.year <= 1982 AND ps.points > 29 AND t.won > 19 AND c.won > 65 AND d.draftyear >= 2010 AND d.draftyear <= 1987 GROUP BY a.award HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) > 685 AND COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) > 21 AND SUM(ps.points) > 35621 AND AVG(ps.rebounds) > '0.0' AND MAX(ps.assists) > 18 AND MIN(ps.steals) < 4 AND SUM(t.won) > 376 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) > 31 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.tmidwinner) > 18 AND SUM(c.won) > 471 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) > 76 ORDER BY unique_players DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT a.playerid, a.year, a.award, a.lgid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM awards_players a JOIN players p ON a.playerid::text = p.playerid WHERE a.year >= 1965 AND a.year <= 2020 AND p.pos = 'C' GROUP BY a.playerid, a.year, a.award, a.lgid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4 INTERSECT SELECT d.playerid, d.draftyear, 'Drafted' AS award, d.lgid, d.firstname, d.lastname, p.pos, 1 AS award_count FROM draft d JOIN players p ON d.playerid::text = p.playerid WHERE d.draftyear >= 1950 AND d.draftyear <= 1969 AND d.draftround <= 3 GROUP BY d.playerid, d.draftyear, d.lgid, d.firstname, d.lastname, p.pos ORDER BY playerid, year;

SELECT a.year, a.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS award_players, AVG(p.points) AS avg_points, SUM(p.assists) AS total_assists FROM awards_players a JOIN players_teams p ON a.playerid = p.playerid AND a.year = p.year WHERE a.year >= 1966 AND p.points > 537 GROUP BY a.year, a.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) > 44 ORDER BY a.year DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT a.year, a.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(CASE WHEN a.award LIKE '%MVP%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mvp_count, SUM(CASE WHEN a.award LIKE '%All-Star%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS all_star_count, COUNT(*) AS total_awards, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_season_points FROM awards_players a JOIN players p ON a.playerid::integer = p.id JOIN players_teams ps ON a.playerid = ps.playerid AND a.year = ps.year WHERE a.year >= 1963 AND a.year <= 1969 AND ps.points > 326 GROUP BY a.year, a.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(*) > 32 ORDER BY total_awards DESC, avg_season_points DESC;

SELECT a.year, a.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(CASE WHEN a.award LIKE '%MVP%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mvp_count, SUM(CASE WHEN a.award LIKE '%All-Star%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS all_star_count, COUNT(*) AS total_awards, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_season_points FROM awards_players a JOIN players p ON a.playerid::integer = p.id JOIN players_teams ps ON a.playerid = ps.playerid AND a.year = ps.year WHERE a.year >= 1986 AND a.year <= 1950 AND ps.points > 249 GROUP BY a.year, a.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(*) > 30 ORDER BY total_awards DESC, avg_season_points DESC;

SELECT ap.playerid, ap.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, SUM(ap2.year) AS total_award_years FROM awards_players ap JOIN awards_players ap2 ON ap.playerid = ap2.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 1975 AND ap2.year <= 1978 GROUP BY ap.playerid, ap.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 10 ORDER BY award_count DESC;

SELECT ap.playerid, ap.year, ap.award, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ap.playerid ORDER BY ap.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS award_count_3yr_moving, AVG(pa.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pa.playerid ORDER BY pa.season_id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS avg_points_3game_moving FROM awards_players ap JOIN player_allstar pa ON ap.playerid = pa.playerid AND ap.year = pa.season_id JOIN players p ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 1993.79 GROUP BY ap.playerid, ap.year, ap.award, pa.playerid, pa.season_id, pa.points ORDER BY ap.year DESC, award_count_3yr_moving DESC;

SELECT p.firstname, p.lastname, p.playerid, p.firstseason, p.lastseason, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS career_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS career_assists, AVG(pt.points*1.0/NULLIF(pt.minutes,0)) AS points_per_minute, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid::character varying = p.playerid AND ap.award = 'MVP') AS mvp_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON pt.playerid::character varying = p.playerid JOIN teams t ON t.tmid::character varying = pt.tmid::character varying AND t.year = pt.year JOIN draft d ON d.playerid::character varying = p.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON pa.playerid::character varying = p.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 1959 AND p.lastseason <= 1967 AND pt.year BETWEEN p.firstseason AND p.lastseason AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid::character varying = p.playerid AND ap2.award LIKE '%All-Star%') AND pt.points > 14 AND pt.rebounds > 10 GROUP BY p.firstname, p.lastname, p.playerid, p.firstseason, p.lastseason HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 43658 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 11 ORDER BY career_points DESC, career_rebounds DESC, career_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, ap.season_id, SUM(ap.points) AS total_points, SUM(ap.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(ap.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players aw ON p.id = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year WHERE ap.points > 9 AND ap.assists > 18 AND aw.award = 'Most Valuable Player' GROUP BY p.playerid, ap.season_id HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 960 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, (SELECT MAX(d.draftoverall) FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid::character varying = p.playerid) AS best_draft_position FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND ap.year = pa.season_id WHERE pa.season_id >= 2019 AND pa.season_id <= 2012 AND pt.points > 2524 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 8.04 ORDER BY total_regular_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pa.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pa.league_id ORDER BY pa.season_id) AS running_total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pa.playerid = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE pa.points > 45 AND pa.season_id BETWEEN 1958 AND 2012 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pa.points, pa.league_id, pa.season_id ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2014 AND pt.year <= 2016 AND pt.minutes > 1470 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.points) > '5.0' AND SUM(pt.assists) > 2980 ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) AS total_points, COALESCE(AVG(pt.points), 0) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1982 AND 1958 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) > 46864 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, SUM(ap.year) AS total_award_years FROM players p LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 1975.33 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 1.73 ORDER BY award_count DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, SUM(ap.year) AS total_award_years, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid WHERE p.firstseason >= 1970 AND p.lastseason <= 1981 AND pa.points > 45 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 2 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 1957 AND pa.year >= 2006 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 19488 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year WHERE ap.points > 9 AND aw.year >= 1991 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 3 ORDER BY allstar_appearances DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN awards_players aw ON p.id = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year WHERE pt.points > 3310 AND ap.points BETWEEN 35 AND 14 AND (pt.minutes >= 2904 OR pt.gp > 18) AND NOT (ap.three_attempted < 0 AND ap.three_made > 1) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 4 AND AVG(ap.points) > 8 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.id = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year WHERE pt.year >= 2017 AND pt.points >= 1308 AND (ap.points IS NULL OR ap.points > 15) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 8 AND SUM(pt.points) > 3230 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid INNER JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id WHERE pt.year >= 2002 AND pt.points > 23 AND t.won > 63 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 5 AND AVG(pt.points) > 19.13 ORDER BY total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE ap.season_id BETWEEN 2016 AND 2017 AND ap.points > 41 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 18 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points FROM players p INNER JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.id = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE ap.points > 20.21 AND ap.season_id BETWEEN 1958.29 AND 1978.06 AND (aw.award IS NULL OR aw.award != 'All-Star') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 10.01 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE p.firstseason >= 1995 AND p.lastseason <= 1979 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4276 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS distinct_team_years, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.league_id) AS distinct_allstar_leagues, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.lgid) AS distinct_team_leagues, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_team_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::character varying = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year WHERE ap.points > 29 AND pt.points > 171 AND t.won > 44 AND c.won > 8 AND d.draftyear >= 1949 AND d.draftyear <= 2020 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 8 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, total_team_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1985 AND pt.year <= 1964 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 14092 ORDER BY career_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(ap.award) AS award_count FROM players p LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying WHERE p.firstseason >= 1985 AND p.lastseason <= 1994 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(ap.award) = 0 ORDER BY p.lastname, p.firstname;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(ap.award) AS award_count, SUM(pts.points) AS total_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pts ON p.playerid::integer = pts.playerid AND ap.year = pts.season_id WHERE p.firstseason >= 1949 AND p.lastseason <= 1982 AND pts.points > 51 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(ap.award) > 45 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND ap.year = pa.season_id WHERE ap.year >= 1968 AND pa.points > 10 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) > 10 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS distinct_award_years, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(pt.points) AS max_team_season_points, MIN(pt.points) AS min_team_season_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS distinct_teams_played_for, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.lgid = 'NBA' THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS total_nba_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pa.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) DESC) AS distinct_awards_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_team_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year WHERE ap.year >= 2001 AND ap.year <= 2000 AND pa.season_id >= 1984 AND pa.season_id <= 1997 AND pt.year >= 2019 AND pt.year <= 1966 AND t.year >= 2003 AND t.year <= 2003 AND p.firstseason >= 2017 AND p.firstseason <= 2001 AND p.lastseason >= 2016 AND p.lastseason <= 2004 AND pa.points > 3 AND pt.points > 289 AND t.won > 8 AND c.won > 17 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 28 AND SUM(pa.points) >= 336 AND AVG(pa.points) >= 86 AND SUM(pt.points) >= 4392 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, distinct_award_years DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS allstar_seasons_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points_per_game, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_postseason_points, (SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.postpoints)) AS total_career_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pos ORDER BY (SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.postpoints)) DESC) AS position_points_rank, LEAD(p.firstname) OVER (ORDER BY (SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.postpoints)) DESC) AS next_player_firstname, SUM(t.won) AS total_team_wins_during_tenure, SUM(t.lost) AS total_team_losses_during_tenure, COUNT(DISTINCT t.year) AS distinct_team_seasons, MAX(ap.year) AS latest_award_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid = ac.coachid::character varying LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner::character varying OR t.tmid = sp.tmidloser::character varying WHERE pa.points > 27 AND pt.points > 1517 AND t.won > 77 AND ap.year > 1974 AND d.draftyear > 1974 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 31215 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) > 20 ORDER BY total_career_points DESC, position_points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS allstar_seasons_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points_per_game, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_postseason_points, (SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.postpoints)) AS total_career_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pos ORDER BY (SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.postpoints)) DESC) AS position_points_rank, LEAD(p.firstname) OVER (ORDER BY (SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.postpoints)) DESC) AS next_player_firstname, SUM(t.won) AS total_team_wins_during_tenure, SUM(t.lost) AS total_team_losses_during_tenure, COUNT(DISTINCT t.year) AS distinct_team_seasons, MAX(ap.year) AS latest_award_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid = ac.coachid::character varying LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner::character varying OR t.tmid = sp.tmidloser::character varying WHERE pa.points > 6 AND pt.points > 2978 AND t.won > 46 AND ap.year > 1982 AND d.draftyear > 1981 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 42578 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) > 10 ORDER BY total_career_points DESC, position_points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE pa.season_id >= 2004 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 366 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1960 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3661;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE pa.season_id >= 2007 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 237 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1982 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2618;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pa.season_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_avg_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying JOIN awards_players ap ON pa.playerid = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE pa.points > 35.82 AND ap.year BETWEEN 1969 AND 1983 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pa.points, pa.season_id HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 330.91 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points_last_seasons, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points_last_seasons FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE pa.season_id >= 2023 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 489 ORDER BY total_points_last_seasons DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2012 AND pt.year <= 2014 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 48954 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 2144 AND t.won > 82 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 27402 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ap.league_id = 'NBA' THEN ap.three_made ELSE 0 END), 0) AS nba_allstar_threes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players awp WHERE awp.playerid::integer = p.playerid::integer AND awp.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_count, t.name AS team_name, t.won AS team_wins, t.lost AS team_losses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) DESC) AS seasons_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::character varying = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year WHERE pt.year >= 2016 AND pt.year <= 2019 AND pt.points > 427 AND t.won > 41 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.won, t.lost HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 18822 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 27 ORDER BY career_points DESC, avg_minutes_per_game DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 1987 AND pt.year <= 1978 AND ap.year >= 1993 AND ap.year <= 1955 AND d.draftyear >= 1961 AND d.draftyear <= 2020 AND pt.points > 3529 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 31533 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 27 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2012 AND pt.year <= 1997 AND pt.gp > 24 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 29274 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying WHERE p.college LIKE '%State%' AND pt.year BETWEEN 2001.23 AND 1991.49 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2122.45 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 2005 AND pt.year <= 1969 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND d.draftyear > 1959 LIMIT 1) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 36966 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1970 AND pt.year <= 1986 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 40079 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 115 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1988 AND 1963 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA First Team' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 11085 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1537.54 AND pt.year >= 2004.47 AND pt.year <= 1992.11 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year IN (SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'Most Valuable Player') AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' AND pt.year >= 1968 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 42008 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year >= 1977 AND pt.year <= 2010 AND pt.points > 3992 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 11615 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE (pt.points > 2782 OR pt.assists > 625) AND NOT (pt.lgid = 'NBA' AND t.playoff = 'Y') AND pt.year BETWEEN 1984 AND 1973 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 9417 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer WHERE pt.year IN (SELECT year FROM coaches WHERE coachid::integer = 854) AND pt.points > 1394 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1965 AND 2021 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 20920 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1973 AND pt.year <= 1987 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > (SELECT AVG(points) FROM players_teams WHERE year = 1984) ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1962 AND pt.year <= 1951 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND ap2.award = 'Most Valuable Player' ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 36973 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1973 AND pt.year <= 1987 AND pt.gp > 82 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1338 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.points > 28 AND pt.year >= 1953 AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 6114 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 26719.99 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 7041.2 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS scoring_category FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1997 AND pt.year <= 2017 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4404.57 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.points > 22 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_scoring_games, COUNT(pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2015 AND pt.year <= 2000 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1721 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(t.won) AS max_team_wins_in_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid AND pt.year = d.draftyear WHERE pt.year >= 2019 AND pt.year <= 1962 AND pt.minutes > 3226 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t.id OR sp.tmidloser = t.id) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 42039 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 31 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, SUM(ap.points) AS total_points, AVG(ap.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid) AS avg_points_per_allstar FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players aw ON p.id = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year WHERE ap.points > 16.28 AND aw.year >= 1972.99 AND aw.year <= 1982.86 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, ap.points HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 773.05 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) AS num_awards, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_blocks, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.league_id ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid, pt.lgid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points, (SELECT MAX(t.won) FROM teams t WHERE t.year = pt.year AND t.lgid = pt.lgid) AS max_team_wins_in_year_league FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid = awp.playerid::integer::character varying AND ap.season_id = awp.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::integer::character varying LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND t.year = sp.year WHERE ap.points > 18 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1965 AND 1985 AND t.won > 5 AND d.draftyear < 1981 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, pt.lgid, pt.year HAVING AVG(ap.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) >= 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, d.draftyear, d.draftround FROM players p LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE d.playerid IS NULL AND p.firstseason >= 2016 AND p.lastseason <= 2011 ORDER BY p.lastname, p.firstname;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid = aw.playerid::character varying WHERE ap.points > 10.25 AND aw.award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND aw.year IN (SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND year >= 1984.66) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 13.66 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS career_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS career_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, AVG(pt.assists * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_assists_per_game, AVG(pt.rebounds * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_rebounds_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(ap.season_id) AS last_allstar_season, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::integer = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 2250 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1995 AND 1994 AND (p.college IS NOT NULL OR 0 = 1) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 48999 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 28 ORDER BY career_points DESC, career_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award LIKE '%MVP%') as award_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1242 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2019 ORDER BY pt.points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 173 AND pt.year >= 2014 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points HAVING COUNT(pt.stint) >= 3 ORDER BY pt.year, points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1731 AND pt.year >= 1991 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points HAVING COUNT(pt.stint) >= 1 ORDER BY pt.year, points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award) AS coach_awards, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.id) FILTER (WHERE sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid) AS playoff_series_won, AVG(t.won) AS team_avg_wins, SUM(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position_sum FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.coachid::integer AND c.year = ac.year WHERE pt.points > 198 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1996 AND 2008 AND pa.points >= 33 AND t.won >= 61 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4426 AND AVG(pa.points) >= 11 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 4 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC LIMIT 57;
