SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award) AS coach_awards, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.id) FILTER (WHERE sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid) AS playoff_series_won, AVG(t.won) AS team_avg_wins, SUM(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position_sum FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.coachid::integer AND c.year = ac.year WHERE pt.points > 2840 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2014 AND 2010 AND pa.points >= 41 AND t.won >= 45 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1243 AND AVG(pa.points) >= 11 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC LIMIT 34;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid) AS avg_team_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1952 AND pt.year <= 1974 AND pt.points > 2095 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1919 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) AS stint_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1990 AND 1968 AND pt.minutes > 1079 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = pt.tmid AND c.year = pt.year AND c.won > 31 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE (sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) AND sp.year = pt.year AND sp.w > 2 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2634 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE p.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT pas.playerid FROM player_allstar pas WHERE pas.points > 17 AND pas.season_id >= 1995 ) AND pt.points > 44 AND t.won >= 46 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 633 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE p.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT pas.playerid FROM player_allstar pas WHERE pas.points > 29 AND pas.season_id >= 1997 ) AND pt.points > 7 AND t.won >= 64 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1959 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 2786 AND pt.year >= 1960 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points HAVING COUNT(pt.stint) >= 3 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, AVG(pt.points + pt.rebounds + pt.assists) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid, pt.year) AS team_avg_performance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid, pt.year ORDER BY (pt.points + pt.rebounds + pt.assists) DESC) AS performance_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1996.53 AND pt.points >= 1424.2 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists HAVING (pt.points + pt.rebounds + pt.assists) > 8116.85 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, pt.tmid, performance_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, ap.award, ac.award AS coach_award, c.coachid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, t.name AS team_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid, pt.year) AS team_avg_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.id AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (pt.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR pt.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser) AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 1920 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2019 AND 1953 AND pt.rebounds > 1205 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid = p.id AND pa.season_id = pt.year AND pa.points > 29 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, ap.award, ac.award, c.coachid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, t.name HAVING AVG(pt.assists) > 4.15 ORDER BY pt.points DESC, points_rank LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pt.points) AS median_points_per_game, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pt.assists) AS percentile_75_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_by_year, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS overall_assists_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 45 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1972 AND 1985 AND t.won > 61 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' AND d.draftyear >= 1950 AND pa.points >= 32 AND c.won > 29 AND ac.year = c.year AND sp.round = 'Conf Finals' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1789 AND AVG(pt.assists) > 1.92 ORDER BY total_points DESC, overall_assists_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year >= 1990 AND pt.year <= 2007 AND pt.points > 2474 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, t.lgid), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname), (pt.year, t.lgid), (pt.tmid, t.name, t.lgid), () ) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2248 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 9 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, pt.tmid;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) AS player_award_count, (SUM(pt.points) / NULLIF(SUM(pt.fgattempted), 0)) AS shooting_efficiency, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::integer = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year AND pt.lgid = c.lgid LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1999 AND 2020 AND pt.minutes > 544 AND (pt.points > 1512 OR pt.assists > 562 OR pt.rebounds > 108) AND NOT (pt.lgid = 'ABL1' AND t.playoff = 'N') AND p.height > '150.0' AND p.weight BETWEEN 102 AND 185 AND (p.college IS NOT NULL OR p.highschool IS NOT NULL) AND c.won > 42 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, pt.lgid, t.playoff HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2472 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) <= 3 AND AVG(pt.minutes) >= 42 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.lgid) AS leagues_played, (SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.assists) + SUM(pt.rebounds)) AS total_contrib, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY (SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.assists) + SUM(pt.rebounds)) DESC) AS yearly_contrib_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner WHERE pt.points > 1217 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1989 AND 1974 AND t.won > 32 AND pa.points > 23 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.assists) > 558 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 46 ORDER BY total_contrib DESC, pt.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, AVG(pt.assists * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_assists_per_game, AVG(pt.rebounds * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_rebounds_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid, pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank_team_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points, (SUM(pt.points) - LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year)) AS points_year_over_year_change FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (pt.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR pt.tmid = sp.tmidloser) AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE pt.year >= 2016 AND pt.year <= 2009 AND pt.points >= 2713 AND t.won >= 68 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1649 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.lgid) >= 2 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, pt.tmid ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.award IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS award_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_year, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS team_3yr_moving_avg_points, SUM(COALESCE(c.post_wins, 0)) AS total_coach_post_wins, MAX(s.w) AS max_series_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post s ON (pt.tmid = s.tmidwinner OR pt.tmid = s.tmidloser) AND pt.year = s.year WHERE pt.year >= 2007 AND pt.year <= 1958 AND pt.points > 2628 AND t.won > 68 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1780 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.lgid) >= 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_allstar_points, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) > 10000 THEN 'Elite Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.points) BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'High Scorer' ELSE 'Regular Scorer' END AS scoring_tier, CASE WHEN AVG(ps.points) > 20 THEN 'All-Star Star' WHEN AVG(ps.points) BETWEEN 15 AND 20 THEN 'All-Star Contributor' ELSE 'All-Star Role Player' END AS allstar_performance, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 5 THEN 'Highly Decorated' WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN 'Awarded' ELSE 'No Awards' END AS award_status, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.tmidwinner) AS championships_won, AVG(c.won) AS avg_coach_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.playerid::integer = ps.playerid AND pt.year = ps.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE pt.points > 2236.73 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2003.78 AND 1987.14 AND t.attendance > 195113.76 AND p.height > 200.99 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 21173.4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 42.97 AND AVG(ps.points) > 18.95 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1989 AND pt.year <= 1976 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND pt.points > 2498 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 30610 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 39 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, MAX(c.won) AS max_coach_wins, SUM(s.w) AS total_playoff_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_team FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post s ON t.tmid::integer = s.tmidwinner AND t.year = s.year WHERE pt.points > 2264 AND ap.points > 16 AND t.year BETWEEN 1941 AND 1989 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.tmid, ap.season_id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1063 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 20 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) AS player_award_count, COUNT(DISTINCT awc.award) AS coach_award_count, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, SUM(c.lost) AS coach_losses, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS team_losses, SUM(sp.w) AS playoff_wins, SUM(sp.l) AS playoff_losses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::integer = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year JOIN awards_coaches awc ON awc.coachid::integer = pt.tmid AND awc.year = pt.year JOIN coaches c ON c.coachid::integer = pt.tmid AND c.year = pt.year JOIN series_post sp ON (sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) AND sp.year = pt.year WHERE pt.points > 2484.83 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1979.92 AND 1965.23 AND (p.college LIKE '%' OR p.highschool LIKE '%') AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND ap.league_id = 'NBA' AND awp.lgid = 'NBA' AND awc.lgid = 'NBA' AND c.lgid = 'NBA' AND sp.lgidwinner = 'NBA' AND sp.lgidloser = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 9057.08 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 4991.43 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 756.28 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 10.89 AND MAX(d.draftoverall) < 51.39 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_assists DESC, total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.award IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS award_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND t.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1981 AND 1988 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND pt.gp > 15 AND pt.points > 2960 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.lgid, t.year), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.lgid, t.year), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname), (t.lgid, t.year), () ) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2750 ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 391;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1999.8 AND pt.year <= 1993.55 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND ap.league_id = 'NBA' AND d.draftyear >= 1986.64 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 19526.56 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 11.82 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(CASE WHEN c.won > c.lost THEN 1 END) AS winning_seasons_coached, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t.id THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_series_won, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year_league FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid::integer AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 1257 AND pt.rebounds > 78 AND pt.assists > 161 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 1964 AND (t.lgid = 'NBA' OR t.lgid = 'ABA') AND t.playoff = 'Y' AND p.height > '150.0' AND p.weight BETWEEN 103 AND 88 AND (p.college IS NOT NULL OR p.highschool IS NOT NULL) AND NOT (p.birthcountry = 'USA' AND p.hsstate IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, pt.year, t.lgid, t.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 15062 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 19 AND AVG(pt.minutes) >= 41 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_rebounds DESC, total_assists DESC LIMIT 121;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_season_points, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, SUM(CASE WHEN c.post_wins > c.post_losses THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS winning_postseasons, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS total_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2012 AND 1966 AND t.attendance > 596305 AND pa.minutes > 35 AND pt.points > 4334 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) < 1939 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 9.93 AND SUM(pa.points) > 57 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 33 ORDER BY total_points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, pt.year, pt.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_points_3yr FROM players_teams pt JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::text = p.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1950 AND pt.year <= 2004 GROUP BY p.playerid, pt.year, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2547 ORDER BY p.playerid, pt.year;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.firstname, p1.lastname, pt1.year AS team_year, pt1.tmid AS team_id, pt1.points AS regular_points, pt1.postpoints AS playoff_points, ap.season_id AS allstar_season, ap.points AS allstar_points, d.draftyear, d.draftround, c.coachid, c.won AS coach_wins, c.lost AS coach_losses, ac.award AS coach_award, t.name AS team_name, t.won AS team_wins, t.lost AS team_losses, sp.tmidwinner AS series_winner, sp.tmidloser AS series_loser, COUNT(DISTINCT pt2.playerid) AS teammates_count, AVG(pt2.points) AS avg_teammate_points, SUM(pt1.points + pt1.postpoints) AS total_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt1.year ORDER BY (pt1.points + pt1.postpoints) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p1 JOIN players_teams pt1 ON p1.id = pt1.playerid JOIN players_teams pt2 ON pt1.tmid = pt2.tmid AND pt1.year = pt2.year AND pt1.playerid != pt2.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt1.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt1.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p1.id = ap.playerid AND pt1.year = ap.season_id JOIN draft d ON p1.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt1.points > 1231 AND pt1.postpoints > 248 AND t.won > 80 AND ap.points > 24 AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1961 AND 1993 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.firstname, p1.lastname, pt1.year, pt1.tmid, pt1.points, pt1.postpoints, ap.season_id, ap.points, d.draftyear, d.draftround, c.coachid, c.won, c.lost, ac.award, t.name, t.won, t.lost, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser HAVING AVG(pt2.points) > 24 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt2.playerid) > 18 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.firstname, p1.lastname, pt1.year AS team_year, pt1.tmid AS team_id, pt1.points AS regular_points, pt1.postpoints AS playoff_points, ap.season_id AS allstar_season, ap.points AS allstar_points, d.draftyear, d.draftround, c.coachid, c.won AS coach_wins, c.lost AS coach_losses, ac.award AS coach_award, t.name AS team_name, t.won AS team_wins, t.lost AS team_losses, sp.tmidwinner AS series_winner, sp.tmidloser AS series_loser, COUNT(DISTINCT pt2.playerid) AS teammates_count, AVG(pt2.points) AS avg_teammate_points, SUM(pt1.points + pt1.postpoints) AS total_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt1.year ORDER BY (pt1.points + pt1.postpoints) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p1 JOIN players_teams pt1 ON p1.id = pt1.playerid JOIN players_teams pt2 ON pt1.tmid = pt2.tmid AND pt1.year = pt2.year AND pt1.playerid != pt2.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt1.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt1.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p1.id = ap.playerid AND pt1.year = ap.season_id JOIN draft d ON p1.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt1.points > 469 AND pt1.postpoints > 86 AND t.won > 44 AND ap.points > 39 AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1951 AND 1953 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.firstname, p1.lastname, pt1.year, pt1.tmid, pt1.points, pt1.postpoints, ap.season_id, ap.points, d.draftyear, d.draftround, c.coachid, c.won, c.lost, ac.award, t.name, t.won, t.lost, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser HAVING AVG(pt2.points) > 10 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt2.playerid) > 11 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, AVG(p1.points) AS avg_points, AVG(p2.points) AS avg_teammate_points, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.playerid) AS num_teammates, SUM(p1.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p1.year, p1.tmid ORDER BY p1.points DESC) AS team_points_running_total FROM players_teams p1 JOIN players_teams p2 ON p1.year = p2.year AND p1.tmid = p2.tmid AND p1.playerid != p2.playerid JOIN players pl ON p1.playerid = pl.id JOIN awards_players ap ON p1.playerid = ap.playerid AND p1.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON p1.tmid = t.id AND p1.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON p1.tmid = c.tmid AND p1.year = c.year WHERE p1.points > 2517 AND p1.year BETWEEN 1961 AND 2015 AND t.won > 19 AND c.won > 37 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points HAVING AVG(p2.points) > 1337 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p2.playerid) >= 4 ORDER BY avg_points DESC, team_points_running_total DESC;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, AVG(p1.points) AS avg_points, AVG(p2.points) AS avg_teammate_points, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.playerid) AS num_teammates, SUM(p1.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p1.year, p1.tmid ORDER BY p1.points DESC) AS team_points_running_total FROM players_teams p1 JOIN players_teams p2 ON p1.year = p2.year AND p1.tmid = p2.tmid AND p1.playerid != p2.playerid JOIN players pl ON p1.playerid = pl.id JOIN awards_players ap ON p1.playerid = ap.playerid AND p1.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON p1.tmid = t.id AND p1.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON p1.tmid = c.tmid AND p1.year = c.year WHERE p1.points > 2924 AND p1.year BETWEEN 2019 AND 1958 AND t.won > 1 AND c.won > 32 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points HAVING AVG(p2.points) > 1377 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p2.playerid) >= 6 ORDER BY avg_points DESC, team_points_running_total DESC;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points AS regular_points, p2.points AS allstar_points, (p1.points - p2.points) AS point_diff, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p1.year ORDER BY (p1.points - p2.points) DESC) AS diff_rank FROM players_teams p1 JOIN player_allstar p2 ON p1.playerid = p2.playerid AND p1.year = p2.season_id WHERE p1.points > 940.96 AND p2.points > 62.85 AND p1.year BETWEEN 1959.85 AND 1963.34 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points, p2.points HAVING COUNT(p1.stint) >= 4.95 ORDER BY point_diff DESC;

SELECT pt.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.year BETWEEN 1994 AND 2007 THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS points_in_range, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players_teams pt JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::character varying = p.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2002 AND pt.points > 1743 AND p.college IS NOT NULL AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY pt.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 41126 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT pt.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.year BETWEEN 2017 AND 2020 THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS points_in_range, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players_teams pt JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::character varying = p.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1993 AND pt.points > 1325 AND p.college IS NOT NULL AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY pt.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 28467 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, AVG(t.won) AS avg_wins, SUM(t.attendance) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid) AS total_league_attendance FROM teams t JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::text = c.tmid::text AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 1964 AND t.attendance > 137032 GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year, t.attendance ORDER BY t.year DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS distinct_players, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS distinct_teams, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::text = pt.playerid::text JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::text = t.tmid::text WHERE t.year >= 1992 AND pt.points >= 1406 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) > 12 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, p.playerid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid = p.id AND ap2.award = 'MVP' AND ap2.year >= 1999) AS mvp_count, (SELECT AVG(c.won) FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND c.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 1998) AS avg_coach_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND d.draftyear = p.firstseason JOIN awards_players ap3 ON p.id = ap3.playerid AND ap3.year = pt.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON ac.coachid::integer = (SELECT c2.coachid::integer FROM coaches c2 WHERE c2.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND c2.year = pt.year LIMIT 1) AND ac.year = pt.year JOIN series_post sp ON (sp.tmidwinner::integer = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser::integer = pt.tmid) AND sp.year = pt.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2008 AND pt.points > 273 AND pt.minutes > 3562 AND t.won > 57 AND (ap.league_id = 'NBA' OR ap.league_id IS NULL) AND p.height > '150.0' AND p.weight BETWEEN 157 AND 109 AND (d.draftround IS NULL OR d.draftround <= 1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM players_teams pt2 WHERE pt2.playerid = p.id AND pt2.year < t.year AND pt2.points > 1360) GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year, p.playerid, p.id, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1696 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, t.year, t.lgid;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.award = 'MVP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mvp_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.year, p.pos ORDER BY AVG(pt.points) DESC) AS pos_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid::integer AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.points > 1.49 AND t.year BETWEEN 1962.79 AND 1982.34 AND p.height > 2.33 GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year, p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 17243.44 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 28.55 ORDER BY t.lgid, t.year, points_rank;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1990 AND 2010 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 26680 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_playoff_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.postpoints) DESC) AS playoff_points_rank FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::integer = p.id JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND awp.year = pt.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND c.year = pt.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND ac.year = c.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1954 AND 1970 AND pt.points > 2433 AND ap.points > 23 AND t.won > 27 AND c.won > 36 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.id AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1983 AND 1984 AND d.draftoverall < ( SELECT AVG(d2.draftoverall) FROM draft d2 WHERE d2.draftyear = d.draftyear AND d2.draftoverall IS NOT NULL ) ) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, p.id, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 13 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 1 AND SUM(pt.postpoints) > 160 ORDER BY total_playoff_points DESC, avg_regular_points DESC;

SELECT t.name, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players, MAX(sp.w) AS max_series_wins, (SELECT AVG(sub_pts) FROM (SELECT SUM(pas.points) AS sub_pts FROM player_allstar pas WHERE pas.playerid IN (SELECT pt2.playerid FROM players_teams pt2 WHERE pt2.tmid = t.id AND pt2.year = t.year) GROUP BY pas.playerid HAVING SUM(pas.points) > 431.94) AS star_players) AS avg_star_points_above_threshold FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.id = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1967 AND 1966 AND t.attendance > 1218569.1 GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 17428.41 ORDER BY total_points DESC, t.year;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(pt.playerid) AS player_count, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes FROM teams t LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year WHERE t.year >= 2007 AND t.year <= 1986 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name ORDER BY player_count DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.points > 32.87) AS high_scorers_count FROM teams t JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::character varying = sp.tmidwinner::character varying WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1979 AND 2005 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.year HAVING t.won > 74.97 ORDER BY high_scorers_count DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.lgid, SUM(pt.minutes) AS total_minutes_played, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_player, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1980.92 AND 1953.87 AND (t.lgid = 'NBA' OR t.lgid = 'NBA') AND t.playoff = 'Y' AND pt.minutes > 1899.56 AND NOT (p.birthcountry = 'USA') GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 38838.23 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_minutes_played DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.name, t.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_player_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_player_assists, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league, AVG(CAST(pt.points AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS avg_points_per_minute, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid AND ap.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_count_in_year_league, SUM(CASE WHEN pa.conference = 'East' THEN pa.points ELSE 0 END) AS east_allstar_points, SUM(CASE WHEN pa.conference = 'West' THEN pa.points ELSE 0 END) AS west_allstar_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = CAST(pt.tmid AS CHARACTER VARYING) AND t.year = pt.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = CAST(c.tmid AS CHARACTER VARYING) AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (t.tmid = CAST(sp.tmidwinner AS CHARACTER VARYING) OR t.tmid = CAST(sp.tmidloser AS CHARACTER VARYING)) AND t.year = sp.year WHERE t.year >= 1991 AND t.year <= 2004 AND t.won >= 16 AND t.lost <= 59 AND pt.minutes > 1432 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 61089 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) > 3783 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC, t.year ASC, t.tmid;

WITH player_stats AS ( SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.year >= 1997 AND pt.year <= 2011 GROUP BY pt.playerid, pt.year ) SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ps.year, ps.total_points, ps.total_rebounds, ps.total_assists, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.year ORDER BY ps.total_points DESC) AS points_rank FROM player_stats ps JOIN players p ON ps.playerid = p.id::integer WHERE ps.total_points > 911 ORDER BY ps.year DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT a.coachid, c.year, c.tmid, t.name, SUM(c.won) AS total_wins, AVG(c.won::numeric / (c.won + c.lost)) AS win_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) AS distinct_awards, SUM(COALESCE(pt.points, 0)) AS total_player_points FROM awards_coaches a INNER JOIN coaches c ON a.coachid::integer = c.coachid::integer AND a.year = c.year LEFT JOIN teams t ON c.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND c.year = t.year LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON c.tmid::integer = pt.tmid::integer AND c.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::integer = p.playerid::integer WHERE a.lgid = 'NBA' AND c.year BETWEEN 1984 AND 1980 GROUP BY a.coachid, c.year, c.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(c.won) > 18 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, win_percentage DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, d.draftyear, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND d.draftyear = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND d.draftyear = pa.season_id WHERE d.draftyear BETWEEN 2004 AND 2002 AND pa.points > 90 AND ap.award = 'All-Star' GROUP BY p.playerid, d.draftyear HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 271 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.award = 'MVP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mvp_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 2409.79 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1962 AND 2016 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 20 ORDER BY avg_points_per_season DESC LIMIT 86;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id::integer WHERE p.id IN ( SELECT playerid FROM draft WHERE draftyear IN ( SELECT year FROM awards_coaches WHERE coachid IN ( SELECT coachid::integer FROM coaches WHERE won > 40 AND year >= 1987 ) ) ) AND pa.points > 46 AND t.won > 30 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 10 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) >= 6 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_points, SUM(ps.assists) AS total_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams ps ON p.playerid::integer = ps.playerid JOIN teams t ON ps.tmid = t.tmid::integer WHERE ps.year > 1993 AND t.won > 70 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(ps.points) > 7.25 ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year WHERE ap.points > 7 AND aw.year >= 2002 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 16 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.year >= 1985 AND pt.year <= 1952 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 35945 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS team_years, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position FROM players p LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid::integer AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 2005 AND p.lastseason <= 1987 AND (pa.points >= 23 OR pa.points IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) >= 5 AND AVG(pa.points) > 28.99 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(ps.points) AS total_points, AVG(ps.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams ps ON p.id = ps.playerid JOIN teams t ON ps.tmid::character varying = t.tmid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid WHERE ps.year BETWEEN 1979 AND 1981 AND p.height > '150.0' AND t.won > 26 AND ap.award = 'NBA Most Valuable Player' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(ps.points) > 29884 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.year) >= 16 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE pt.points > 1949.4 AND t.won >= 39.06 AND c.won >= 78.96 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 9190.34 AND AVG(pa.points) >= 30.89 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1977 AND pt.year <= 2015 AND p.birthdate >= '1940-01-01' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 31489 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1959 AND pt.year <= 1959 AND pt.points > 1817 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 5252 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1979 AND pt.year <= 1958 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 23376 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 1999 AND pt.gp > 44 AND pt.lgid = ( SELECT lgid FROM players_teams subpt WHERE subpt.playerid = pt.playerid AND subpt.year = ( SELECT MAX(year) FROM players_teams subsubpt WHERE subsubpt.playerid = subpt.playerid ) LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 8512 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1966 AND pt.year <= 1974 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND ap2.award = 'Most Valuable Player' ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 27926 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year > 2005 AND (pt.lgid = 'NBA' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND ap.year = pt.year)) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1599 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2002 AND pt.year <= 2010 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 15707 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 30 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2013 AND t.won > 62 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 14.07 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1971 AND pt.year <= 2017 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 9718 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, SUM(ap.points) AS total_points, AVG(ap.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.season_id ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS season_points_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid WHERE (ap.points > 49.18 OR ap.assists > 19.59) AND (ap.season_id BETWEEN 2007.62 AND 1957.65) AND NOT (t.lgid = 'NBA' AND t.playoff = 'Y') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 329.56 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 6.6 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight, p.pos, p.college, p.birthdate, a.award, a.year AS award_year, a.lgid AS award_league, d.draftyear, d.draftoverall, d.draftround, d.draftselection, d.draftfrom, ps.season_id, ps.points AS allstar_points, ps.rebounds AS allstar_rebounds, ps.assists AS allstar_assists, ps.steals AS allstar_steals, ps.blocks AS allstar_blocks, pt.year AS team_year, pt.tmid, pt.lgid AS team_league, pt.gp, pt.gs, pt.minutes AS team_minutes, pt.points AS team_points, pt.rebounds AS team_rebounds, pt.assists AS team_assists, pt.steals AS team_steals, pt.blocks AS team_blocks, pt.fgmade, pt.fgattempted, pt.ftmade, pt.ftattempted, pt.threemade, pt.threeattempted, t.name AS team_name, t.won AS team_wins, t.lost AS team_losses, t.o_pts AS team_off_pts, t.d_pts AS team_def_pts, c.coachid, c.won AS coach_wins, c.lost AS coach_losses, sp.year AS playoff_year, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, sp.w AS playoff_wins, sp.l AS playoff_losses, sp.round AS playoff_round, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) AS total_award_types, SUM(CASE WHEN a.award IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_awards, AVG(ps.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid) AS avg_allstar_points, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid, pt.year) AS avg_team_points_per_year, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_career_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS total_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pos ORDER BY AVG(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank_by_position, LAG(pt.points, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points, LEAD(pt.points, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS next_year_points, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY p.height) AS height_percentile, STDDEV(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid) AS stddev_points, MAX(ps.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid) AS max_allstar_points, MIN(ps.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid) AS min_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_career_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_career_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_career_assists, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_career_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_career_blocks, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_career_points, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_career_rebounds, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_career_assists, AVG(pt.steals) AS avg_career_steals, AVG(pt.blocks) AS avg_career_blocks, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(pt.year) - MIN(pt.year) + 1 AS career_length_years, SUM(t.won) AS total_team_wins_played_for, SUM(t.lost) AS total_team_losses_played_for, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins_played_under, SUM(c.lost) AS total_coach_losses_played_under, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.year) AS playoff_appearances, SUM(sp.w) AS total_playoff_wins_teams, SUM(sp.l) AS total_playoff_losses_teams FROM players p LEFT JOIN awards_players a ON p.playerid = a.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.playerid = ps.playerid::character varying INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year AND c.coachid IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (pt.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR pt.tmid = sp.tmidloser) AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE p.height > 218.43 AND p.weight BETWEEN 170.24 AND 312.02 AND pt.year >= 2013.91 AND pt.year <= 2007.85 AND pt.points > 4273.96 AND t.won > 78.28 AND (p.birthdate IS NULL OR p.birthdate >= '1900-01-01') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight, p.pos, p.college, p.birthdate, a.award, a.year, a.lgid, d.draftyear, d.draftoverall, d.draftround, d.draftselection, d.draftfrom, ps.season_id, ps.points, ps.rebounds, ps.assists, ps.steals, ps.blocks, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.lgid, pt.gp, pt.gs, pt.minutes, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, pt.steals, pt.blocks, pt.fgmade, pt.fgattempted, pt.ftmade, pt.ftattempted, pt.threemade, pt.threeattempted, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, c.coachid, c.won, c.lost, sp.year, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, sp.w, sp.l, sp.round HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 33667.66 AND AVG(pt.rebounds) > 38.65 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 3.72 ORDER BY total_career_points DESC, avg_career_points DESC, p.playerid, pt.year;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid, pt.year) AS team_avg_points, COUNT(ap.award) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid) AS total_awards, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS career_points_running_total FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.points > 45 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1997 AND 2008 AND pt.rebounds >= 8 AND t.won > 35 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, ap.award, pa.points HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 16 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award LIKE '%All-Star%') AS all_star_count, (SELECT AVG(sub.avg_pts) FROM (SELECT apt.year, AVG(apt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(apt.gp, 0)) AS avg_pts FROM players_teams apt WHERE apt.playerid = p.id GROUP BY apt.year HAVING AVG(apt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(apt.gp, 0)) > 6.39) sub) AS career_avg_above_threshold FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND d.draftyear = pt.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1955 AND 1984 AND pt.points > 656.65 AND t.won > 17 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = t.id AND c.year = t.year AND c.won > 71) > 0 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, p.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2076.54 AND AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) > 47.54 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, pt.tmid;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2010 AND (pt.gp > 23 OR pt.minutes > 226) AND (t.playoff = 'Y' OR t.confid = 'East') AND (aw.award IS NULL OR aw.award NOT IN ('MVP', 'ROY')) AND p.height > '150.0' AND (p.college IS NOT NULL OR p.hscountry = 'USA') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2408 AND AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) < '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 9 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, points_rank_in_year;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_pick FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1959 AND pt.year <= 1951 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND pt.gp > 18 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 30633 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, SUM(pt.points) - SUM(ap.points) AS point_diff FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id JOIN awards_players aw ON p.id = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year WHERE p.height > 227.45 AND p.weight > 94.47 AND ap.season_id >= 1952.6 AND ap.season_id <= 1971.09 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, ap.season_id HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 460.08 AND AVG(ap.points) > 8.22 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 19.45 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.award IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS award_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND t.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2010 AND 1970 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND pt.gp > 79 AND pt.points > 915 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.lgid, t.year), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.lgid, t.year), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname), (t.lgid, t.year), () ) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 280 ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 411;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.points > 42 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_scoring_games, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.assists > 9 AND pt.rebounds > 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS double_threat_games, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ap.league_id = 'NBA' THEN ap.season_id END) AS specific_league_allstars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points_with_team FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2020 AND 2009 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND pt.gp > 17 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.year, t.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2169 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 2 ORDER BY total_points DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::text = pt.tmid::text AND t.year = pt.year WHERE t.year >= 1976.94 AND t.won > 54.33 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT aps.award AS award_name, AVG(aps.year) AS avg_award_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pts.playerid) AS unique_players_count, SUM(pts.points) AS total_points, SUM(pts.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pts.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, MAX(teams.won) AS max_team_wins, MIN(teams.lost) AS min_team_losses, SUM(teams.o_pts) AS total_team_offensive_points, SUM(teams.d_pts) AS total_team_defensive_points, AVG(players.height) AS avg_player_height, SUM(CASE WHEN pts.minutes > 833.25 THEN pts.points ELSE 0 END) AS high_minute_points FROM awards_players aps JOIN players_teams pts ON aps.playerid = pts.playerid AND aps.year = pts.year JOIN teams ON pts.tmid::character varying = teams.tmid AND pts.year = teams.year JOIN players ON aps.playerid::character varying = players.playerid JOIN draft d ON aps.playerid = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pts.year = c.year AND pts.tmid = c.tmid JOIN series_post sp ON teams.tmid::character varying = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND teams.year = sp.year JOIN player_allstar pas ON aps.playerid = pas.playerid AND aps.year = pas.season_id WHERE aps.award IS NOT NULL AND pts.points > 698.21 AND teams.won > 46.43 AND teams.year BETWEEN 1959.57 AND 1999.94 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_coaches ac WHERE ac.coachid::character varying = c.coachid AND ac.year = c.year AND ac.award = 'Coach of the Year') GROUP BY aps.award, teams.tmid, teams.year, pts.tmid, pts.year HAVING SUM(pts.points) > 14628.36 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pts.playerid) >= 233.69 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_award_year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, AVG(pt.assists * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_assists_per_game, AVG(pt.rebounds * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_rebounds_per_game, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_team_year, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS overall_points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points, LEAD(SUM(pt.assists), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS next_year_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1995 AND 1978 AND pt.points > 2617 AND pt.assists > 657 AND t.won > 30 AND c.won > 54 AND pa.points > 9 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2492 AND AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) > 20.58 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, pt.tmid;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.fullgivenname AS full_name, p.pos AS position, p.college AS college, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_points_per_game, SUM(ps.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(ps.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.season_id) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(ps.points) DESC) AS points_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pos ORDER BY SUM(ps.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank_by_position, MAX(ps.personal_fouls) AS max_fouls_in_game, (SUM(ps.fg_made) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ps.fg_attempted), 0)) AS career_fg_percentage, (SUM(ps.ft_made) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ps.ft_attempted), 0)) AS career_ft_percentage, (SUM(ps.three_made) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ps.three_attempted), 0)) AS career_3p_percentage, COUNT(a.award) AS total_awards, d.draftoverall AS draft_position, t.name AS first_team_name, c.won AS coach_wins, c.lost AS coach_losses, sp.w AS playoff_wins, sp.l AS playoff_losses FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.playerid::integer = ps.playerid JOIN awards_players a ON p.playerid::integer = a.playerid AND ps.season_id = a.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ps.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND t.year = pt.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND c.year = t.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE ps.points > 74.68 AND ps.minutes >= 39.24 AND ps.season_id BETWEEN 1966.38 AND 2018.51 AND d.draftyear >= 1983.33 AND t.won > 19.55 AND c.won > 15.51 AND sp.year BETWEEN 1952.12 AND 1977.75 AND p.height > 167.83 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.fullgivenname, p.pos, p.college, d.draftoverall, t.name, c.won, c.lost, sp.w, sp.l HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ps.season_id) >= 7.51 AND SUM(ps.assists) > 277.04 AND AVG(ps.points) >= 31.97 ORDER BY avg_points_per_game DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2005 AND pt.points > 1755 AND d.draftyear <= 2007 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) > 39.24 ORDER BY avg_points_per_game DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COALESCE(SUM(pa.points), 0) AS total_allstar_points, COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) AS total_regular_points, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) AS total_postseason_points, COALESCE(AVG(pa.points / NULLIF(pa.games_played, 0)), 0) AS avg_points_per_allstar_game, COALESCE(AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)), 0) AS avg_points_per_regular_game, COALESCE(AVG(pt.postpoints / NULLIF(pt.postgp, 0)), 0) AS avg_points_per_postseason_game, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS years_drafted, MAX(CASE WHEN ac.award = 'Coach of the Year' THEN ac.year END) AS last_coach_of_year_award, MAX(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t.id OR sp.tmidloser = t.id THEN sp.year END) AS last_playoff_year, SUM(t.o_pts) AS team_offensive_points, SUM(t.d_pts) AS team_defensive_points_allowed, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) DESC) AS regular_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) DESC) AS postseason_points_rank FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::INTEGER = pa.playerid AND pa.points > 48.7 LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::INTEGER = pt.playerid AND pt.points > 2164.41 AND pt.postpoints > 230.05 LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::INTEGER = ap.playerid AND ap.year >= 2004.25 AND ap.year <= 1979.94 LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::INTEGER = d.playerid AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1979.65 AND 2019.34 LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::INTEGER = t.id AND t.year = pt.year AND t.o_pts > 210.03 LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::INTEGER = c.tmid AND c.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::INTEGER = ac.coachid AND ac.year = c.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 1984.93 AND p.lastseason <= 1988.51 AND (p.height > 1.61 OR p.weight > 126.33) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 14.92 AND COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) <= 3.83 AND MAX(CASE WHEN ac.award = 'Coach of the Year' THEN ac.year END) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY regular_points_rank, postseason_points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) AS total_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying WHERE p.firstseason >= 1988 AND p.lastseason <= 2000 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) > 30135 ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year WHERE ap.points > 27 AND aw.year >= 1984 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 3 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_team_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE ap.conference = 'East' AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 8 AND SUM(ap.points) >= 389 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.year >= 1974 AND pt.year <= 1975 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 40034 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.league_id) AS distinct_allstar_leagues, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS distinct_team_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE p.height > 182.0 AND pt.year >= 1972 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 16486.93 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS distinct_team_years, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE ap.points > 22 AND pt.points > 120 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 6 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS distinct_team_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE ap.points > 44.84 AND pt.year >= 2009.88 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 28377.99 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS team_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS coached_teams FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.id = ps.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 3023 AND ap.year >= 2023 AND ps.season_id >= 1963 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 34138 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) >= 16 AND AVG(ps.points) >= 10 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(ap.award) AS award_count FROM players p LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying WHERE p.firstseason >= 1951 AND p.lastseason <= 2004 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(ap.award) = 0 ORDER BY p.lastname, p.firstname;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(ap.award) AS award_count, SUM(pts.points) AS total_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pts ON p.playerid::integer = pts.playerid AND ap.year = pts.season_id WHERE p.firstseason >= 1959 AND p.lastseason <= 2023 AND pts.points > 100 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(ap.award) > 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC;
