SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, MAX(ap.season_id) AS last_allstar_season, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS total_seasons_played, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, SUM(ap.points) AS allstar_points_total, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_points_rank, SUM(CASE WHEN dp.draftyear IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS draft_year_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players awp WHERE awp.playerid = p.id AND awp.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_awards_count FROM players p INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid INNER JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft dp ON p.id = dp.playerid AND dp.draftyear = pt.year INNER JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND t.year = pt.year INNER JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND c.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND sp.year = pt.year WHERE pt.year >= 2019 AND pt.year <= 1992 AND pt.points > 2147 AND ap.points > 36 AND t.won > 80 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 6 AND SUM(pt.points) > 33375 ORDER BY career_points DESC, avg_points_per_game DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS player_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, MAX(pt.points) AS max_regular_points, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_post_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT t.name, ', ' ORDER BY t.name) AS team_names, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_series_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid THEN sp.l ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_series_losses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) DESC) AS awards_rank FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) AND sp.year = pt.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 2022 AND p.lastseason <= 2020 AND pa.points > 99 AND pt.points > 2316 AND t.won > 31 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 48324 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 13 ORDER BY total_regular_points DESC, awards_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(ap.points) AS total_points, AVG(ap.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds FROM players p JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON aw.playerid = ap.playerid AND aw.year = ap.season_id WHERE aw.year >= 2012 AND ap.points >= 47 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 4040 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS allstar_seasons_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points_per_game, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_postseason_points, (SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.postpoints)) AS total_career_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pos ORDER BY (SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.postpoints)) DESC) AS position_points_rank, LEAD(p.firstname) OVER (ORDER BY (SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.postpoints)) DESC) AS next_player_firstname, SUM(t.won) AS total_team_wins_during_tenure, SUM(t.lost) AS total_team_losses_during_tenure, COUNT(DISTINCT t.year) AS distinct_team_seasons, MAX(ap.year) AS latest_award_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid = ac.coachid::character varying LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner::character varying OR t.tmid = sp.tmidloser::character varying WHERE pa.points > 38 AND pt.points > 201 AND t.won > 78 AND ap.year > 2011 AND d.draftyear > 1959 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 47365 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) > 6 ORDER BY total_career_points DESC, position_points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pa.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE pa.season_id >= 1959.91 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 444.11 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1974 AND pt.year <= 1952 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 24098 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2015 AND pt.year <= 2018 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 30171 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 1622 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2005 AND 1995 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 5 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 825 AND t.year BETWEEN 1993 AND 1985 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 18 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.award = 'All-NBA') AS award_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1973 AND 1970 AND (pt.points > 1372 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid = p.id AND pa.season_id = pt.year AND pa.points > 29)) GROUP BY p.id, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 19215 AND AVG(pt.points) > 7 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 2020 AND pt.year <= 1967 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 18271 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying WHERE pa.season_id >= 1974 AND pa.season_id <= 2009 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 438 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year IN (SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'All-NBA First Team') AND pt.year >= 2000 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 15011 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year IN (SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'All-Star') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 22350 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 2003 AND pt.points > 203 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 46793 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 2007 AND pt.points > 2269 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 47609 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1955 AND pt.year <= 2004 AND (pt.lgid = 'NBA' OR pt.lgid IS NULL) AND NOT (ap.award = 'All-NBA') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 33876 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 6 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) DESC) AS awards_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1962 AND pt.year <= 1952 AND pt.points > 250 AND pa.points > 80 AND d.draftyear >= 2007 AND d.draftyear <= 2012 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 14535 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 16 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2018 AND pt.year <= 1978 AND pt.points > 2516 AND pa.points > 30 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 16508 AND AVG(pt.assists) > 757 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1950 AND pt.year <= 1967 AND pt.assists > 677 AND pa.assists > 48 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.assists) > 204 AND AVG(pt.points) > 499 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, MAX(ps.season_id) AS last_allstar_season, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) DESC) AS teams_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.playerid::integer = ps.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id::integer WHERE (pt.year > 1967 AND pt.points > 1220) OR (ps.season_id > 1989 AND ps.points > 12) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid AND sp.year = pt.year AND sp.w > 1) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_coaches ac WHERE ac.coachid::integer = c.coachid::integer AND ac.year = c.year AND ac.award = 'Coach of the Year') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 49107 AND AVG(pt.assists) < 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE (pt.points > 2074 OR pt.assists > 665) AND NOT (pt.year < 2017) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 36180 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 49.82 AND pt.year >= 2016 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 3.67 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1982 AND pt.year <= 1992 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND ap2.award = 'Most Valuable Player' ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 44393 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1995 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = pt.playerid AND d.draftyear <= 1997) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 42954 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2005 AND pt.year <= 1972 AND pt.points > 0 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 16854 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1990 AND pt.year <= 1984 AND pt.points > 10 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 41544 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 2009 AND pt.year <= 1952 AND pt.points > 37 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 44999 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.points > 2041 AND pt.year >= 1992 AND pt.year <= 1981 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 8978 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2014 AND pt.year <= 1958 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 46226 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) > 39379.95 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.points) BETWEEN 5566.82 AND 5365.92 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS scoring_category FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2019 AND pt.year <= 1994 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) >= 6990.35 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::INTEGER = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1965 AND 1965 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 49863 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, SUM(ap.points) AS total_points, AVG(ap.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid) AS avg_points_per_allstar FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players aw ON p.id = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year WHERE ap.points > 49.33 AND aw.year >= 1958.39 AND aw.year <= 1997.43 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, ap.points HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 161.23 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.assists, ap.rebounds, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points AS team_points, pt.assists AS team_assists, pt.rebounds AS team_rebounds, t.name, t.lgid, t.won, t.lost, d.draftyear, d.draftoverall, awp.award, ac.award AS coach_award, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, sp.w AS series_wins, sp.l AS series_losses, AVG(ap.points) OVER (PARTITION BY ap.playerid ORDER BY ap.season_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_points_career, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.playerid, pt.year ORDER BY pt.stint) AS cumulative_points_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank_in_league_year, LAG(pt.points, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year, pt.stint) AS previous_season_points, SUM(t.won) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_wins_league, COUNT(awp.award) OVER (PARTITION BY awp.playerid) AS total_player_awards, COUNT(ac.award) OVER (PARTITION BY ac.coachid) AS total_coach_awards, AVG(d.draftoverall) OVER (PARTITION BY d.draftyear, d.lgid) AS avg_draft_position_year_league, SUM(sp.w) OVER (PARTITION BY sp.tmidwinner ORDER BY sp.year) AS cumulative_playoff_wins_team FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid = awp.playerid::character varying AND ap.season_id = awp.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON t.tmid = ac.coachid::character varying AND t.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND t.year = sp.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year WHERE p.height > 174.03 AND p.weight > 149.23 AND pt.points > 2339.03 AND t.won > 95.25 AND d.draftyear > 1999.43 AND awp.year > 2009.58 AND ac.year > 1999.53 AND sp.year > 1959.91 AND c.year > 2006.38 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.assists, ap.rebounds, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.assists, pt.rebounds, t.name, t.lgid, t.won, t.lost, d.draftyear, d.draftoverall, awp.award, ac.award, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, sp.w, sp.l, ap.playerid, pt.playerid, pt.stint, t.year, awp.playerid, ac.coachid, d.lgid, sp.tmidwinner, sp.year, c.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 337.18 AND AVG(ap.points) > 61.2 AND COUNT(awp.award) > 18.26 ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC, AVG(ap.points) DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, MAX(pt.year) AS last_active_year FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN coaches c ON pa.league_id = c.lgid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t.id AND sp.year > 1963.34 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1986.18 AND 1999.21 ) AND pt.year BETWEEN 1958.45 AND 1980.28 AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 29.29 AND SUM(pt.points) > 19502.74 ORDER BY total_regular_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_ppg, AVG(pt.assists * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_apg, AVG(pt.rebounds * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_rpg, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_by_year_league, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON pt.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND pt.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year WHERE pt.points > 2229 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1989 AND 1982 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 22952 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) <= 4 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, points_rank_by_year_league;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_blocks, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.points > 44 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_scoring_games, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.assists > 8 AND pt.steals > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_impact_games, COUNT(ap.award) AS total_awards, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS league_points_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pos ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS position_assists_rank, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t.id OR sp.tmidloser = t.id) AS playoff_series_appearances, (SELECT AVG(c.won::numeric / (c.won + c.lost)) FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = t.id AND c.year BETWEEN 1975 AND 1977) AS avg_coach_win_pct FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2001 AND pt.year <= 1998 AND pt.minutes > 1614 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, t.name, t.lgid, t.year, t.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 20110 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS birth_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS birth_quarter, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1994 AND pt.year <= 1999 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) >= 1994 AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) IN (4) AND pt.points > 37 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4396 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) AS stint_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid::integer AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE p.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT d.playerid FROM draft d WHERE d.draftyear BETWEEN 2005 AND 1952 AND d.draftround <= 3 ) AND pt.year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1959 AND pt.points > 2169 AND pt.minutes >= 790 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2416 AND AVG(pt.minutes) >= 367 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) <= 4 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_minutes DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2014 AND pt.year <= 1954 AND pt.points > 2520 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid)) ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 822 AND pt.year >= 2015 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points HAVING COUNT(pt.stint) >= 2 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year) AS award_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 91 AND pt.rebounds > 33 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1999 AND 1956 ORDER BY pt.points DESC, pt.rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, AVG(pt.points + pt.rebounds + pt.assists) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid, pt.year) AS team_avg_performance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid, pt.year ORDER BY (pt.points + pt.rebounds + pt.assists) DESC) AS performance_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1971.3 AND pt.points >= 4553.61 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists HAVING (pt.points + pt.rebounds + pt.assists) > 5770.88 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, pt.tmid, performance_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, ap.points AS allstar_points, ap.rebounds AS allstar_rebounds, ap.assists AS allstar_assists, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftselection, c.coachid, ac.award AS coach_award, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, sp.w AS series_wins, sp.l AS series_losses, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_by_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.id AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (pt.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR pt.tmid = sp.tmidloser) AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2004 AND 1994 AND pt.points > 2753 AND pt.rebounds > 685 AND t.won > 46 AND (ap.points > 23 OR ap.points IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.rebounds, ap.assists, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftselection, c.coachid, ac.award, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, sp.w, sp.l HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3074 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 2 AND AVG(pt.assists) > 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_points_per_game DESC LIMIT 40;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year_league FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 2002 AND pt.year <= 2011 AND pt.points > 1880 AND t.won > 59 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4315 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 9 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year_league FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 2012 AND pt.year <= 1957 AND pt.points > 1080 AND t.won > 81 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2434 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 0 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) AS player_award_count, (SUM(pt.points) / NULLIF(SUM(pt.fgattempted), 0)) AS shooting_efficiency, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::integer = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year AND pt.lgid = c.lgid LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1961 AND 1979 AND pt.minutes > 131 AND (pt.points > 1635 OR pt.assists > 586 OR pt.rebounds > 729) AND NOT (pt.lgid = 'ABL1' AND t.playoff = 'N') AND p.height > '150.0' AND p.weight BETWEEN 195 AND 128 AND (p.college IS NOT NULL OR p.highschool IS NOT NULL) AND c.won > 38 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, pt.lgid, t.playoff HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4924 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) <= 1 AND AVG(pt.minutes) >= 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_allstar_points, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) > 10000 THEN 'Elite Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.points) BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'High Scorer' ELSE 'Regular Scorer' END AS scoring_tier, CASE WHEN AVG(ps.points) > 20 THEN 'All-Star Star' WHEN AVG(ps.points) BETWEEN 15 AND 20 THEN 'All-Star Contributor' ELSE 'All-Star Role Player' END AS allstar_performance, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 5 THEN 'Highly Decorated' WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN 'Awarded' ELSE 'No Awards' END AS award_status, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.tmidwinner) AS championships_won, AVG(c.won) AS avg_coach_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.playerid::integer = ps.playerid AND pt.year = ps.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE pt.points > 455.53 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2001.37 AND 1958.88 AND t.attendance > 466027.54 AND p.height > 224.01 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 14070.25 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 29.69 AND AVG(ps.points) > 47.67 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(ap.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(ap.minutes, 0)) AS allstar_points_per_minute, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS league_points_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.lgid = t.lgid WHERE ap.points > 32 AND pt.points > 2863 AND ap.season_id BETWEEN 1978 AND 1974 AND t.year BETWEEN 1974 AND 2014 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, ap.season_id, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 327 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 19 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, league_points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2010 AND pt.points > 5 AND t.won > 14 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 763 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, pt.year, pt.points, pt.assists, pt.rebounds, SUM(pt.points + pt.assists + pt.rebounds) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_stats, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid, pt.year) AS avg_team_points_per_player, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank_per_year, COUNT(a.playerid) AS award_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players a ON pt.playerid = a.playerid AND pt.year = a.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1196 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1958 AND 1983 AND t.won > 73 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, pt.year, pt.points, pt.assists, pt.rebounds, pt.tmid, pt.playerid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 694 ORDER BY cumulative_stats DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(CASE WHEN c.won > c.lost THEN 1 END) AS winning_seasons_coached, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t.id THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_series_won, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year_league FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid::integer AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 2813 AND pt.rebounds > 604 AND pt.assists > 618 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2009 AND 2020 AND (t.lgid = 'NBA' OR t.lgid = 'ABA') AND t.playoff = 'Y' AND p.height > '150.0' AND p.weight BETWEEN 93 AND 200 AND (p.college IS NOT NULL OR p.highschool IS NOT NULL) AND NOT (p.birthcountry = 'USA' AND p.hsstate IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, pt.year, t.lgid, t.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 20187 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 1 AND AVG(pt.minutes) >= 10 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_rebounds DESC, total_assists DESC LIMIT 953;

SELECT p.playerid, p.fullgivenname, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_points, COUNT(ap.award) FILTER (WHERE ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player') AS mvp_count, MAX(c.won) AS max_coach_wins, AVG(t.o_pts) AS avg_team_points, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, SUM(s.w) AS total_series_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::text = pt.playerid::text JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::text = ap.playerid::text AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::text = t.tmid::text AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::text = d.playerid::text JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::text = c.tmid::text AND t.year = c.year JOIN series_post s ON t.tmid::text = s.tmidwinner::text AND t.year = s.year WHERE pt.points > 3162.48 AND pt.year >= 1983.52 AND t.o_pts > 3035.34 AND d.draftyear >= 1987.82 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.fullgivenname, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 54575.65 AND COUNT(ap.award) > 69.23 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_season_points, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, SUM(CASE WHEN c.post_wins > c.post_losses THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS winning_postseasons, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS total_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1966 AND 1983 AND t.attendance > 945063 AND pa.minutes > 12 AND pt.points > 2507 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) < 1977 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 64.9 AND SUM(pa.points) > 15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 8 ORDER BY total_points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, t.tmid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS birth_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, SUM(ap.three_made) AS total_allstar_threes, MAX(c.won) AS max_coach_wins, SUM(s.w) AS total_series_wins, GROUPING(p.playerid, t.tmid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS grouping_flag FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN series_post s ON t.tmid::integer = s.tmidwinner AND t.year = s.year JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year WHERE pt.points > 2410.26 AND ap.minutes > 36.36 AND t.won > 28.0 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 1956.69 AND 1996.01 GROUP BY CUBE(p.playerid, t.tmid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 40611.55 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 30.13 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_assists ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, t.tmid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS birth_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(ap.three_made::DECIMAL / NULLIF(ap.three_attempted, 0)) AS career_three_pct, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.league_id = 'NBA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nba_allstar_games FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::INTEGER = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::INTEGER AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::INTEGER = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::INTEGER = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::INTEGER = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1955 AND pt.year <= 1962 AND pt.points > 1635 AND t.won > 64 GROUP BY CUBE(p.playerid, t.tmid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 42726 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, team_points_rank;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.year AS year1, p2.year AS year2, (p2.points - p1.points) AS point_increase, AVG(p1.points) OVER(PARTITION BY p1.playerid) AS avg_points_across_years FROM players_teams p1 JOIN players_teams p2 ON p1.playerid = p2.playerid AND p1.tmid = p2.tmid AND p1.year < p2.year WHERE p1.points > 238.69 AND p2.points > 837.69 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.year, p2.year, p1.points, p2.points HAVING (p2.points - p1.points) > 23.08 ORDER BY point_increase DESC;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.lgid, SUM(p1.points) AS total_points, AVG(p2.points) AS avg_points_other_teams FROM players_teams p1 JOIN players_teams p2 ON p1.playerid = p2.playerid AND p1.year = p2.year AND p1.tmid != p2.tmid WHERE p1.points > 1234.27 AND p1.year BETWEEN 1966.99 AND 2002.91 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.lgid HAVING SUM(p1.points) > 9692.84 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT pl.playerid AS p_id, pl.firstname || ' ' || pl.lastname AS player_name, pl.pos AS position, pl.firstseason AS debut_year, pl.lastseason AS last_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) FILTER (WHERE awp.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) FILTER (WHERE awp.award LIKE '%All-Star%') AS allstar_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, SUM(pt.points) AS total_career_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_career_rebounds, AVG(pt.rebounds / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_rebounds_per_game, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_career_assists, AVG(pt.assists / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_assists_per_game, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_career_steals, AVG(pt.steals / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_steals_per_game, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_career_blocks, AVG(pt.blocks / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_blocks_per_game, SUM(pt.turnovers) AS total_career_turnovers, AVG(pt.turnovers / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_turnovers_per_game, SUM(pt.fgmade) AS total_fg_made, SUM(pt.fgattempted) AS total_fg_attempted, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.fgattempted) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(pt.fgmade) * 100.0 / SUM(pt.fgattempted), 2) ELSE 0 END AS career_fg_percentage, SUM(pt.ftmade) AS total_ft_made, SUM(pt.ftattempted) AS total_ft_attempted, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.ftattempted) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(pt.ftmade) * 100.0 / SUM(pt.ftattempted), 2) ELSE 0 END AS career_ft_percentage, SUM(pt.threemade) AS total_three_made, SUM(pt.threeattempted) AS total_three_attempted, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.threeattempted) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(pt.threemade) * 100.0 / SUM(pt.threeattempted), 2) ELSE 0 END AS career_three_percentage, MIN(d.draftyear) AS draft_year, MIN(d.draftround) AS draft_round, MIN(d.draftselection) AS draft_selection, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS draft_overall, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT t.name, ', ') AS team_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT t.arena, ', ') AS arenas_played_in, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coaches_played_under, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.tmidwinner) AS playoff_series_won_with_teams, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.tmidloser) AS playoff_series_lost_with_teams, SUM(sp.w) AS total_playoff_series_wins, SUM(sp.l) AS total_playoff_series_losses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.steals) DESC) AS steals_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.blocks) DESC) AS blocks_rank FROM players pl LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON pl.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON pl.playerid::integer = awp.playerid LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON pl.playerid::integer = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON pl.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (pt.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR pt.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser) AND pt.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year WHERE pl.firstseason >= 2003 AND pl.lastseason <= 2022 AND pl.height >= '150' AND pl.weight >= 107 AND pt.points >= 2032 AND ap.points >= 15 AND t.won >= 12 AND sp.year >= 1963 AND d.draftyear >= 2002 GROUP BY pl.playerid, pl.firstname, pl.lastname, pl.pos, pl.firstseason, pl.lastseason HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 43 AND COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) >= 9 AND SUM(pt.points) >= 9303 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) >= 114 AND SUM(pt.assists) >= 13185 AND AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) >= '5' ORDER BY total_career_points DESC, total_career_rebounds DESC, total_career_assists DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, AVG(pt.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS avg_points_3_seasons, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds FROM players_teams pt JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id::integer WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2008 AND 2005 AND pt.gp >= 71 GROUP BY pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points ORDER BY pt.playerid, pt.year;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS distinct_players, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS distinct_teams, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::text = pt.playerid::text JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::text = t.tmid::text WHERE t.year >= 1954 AND pt.points >= 1616 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) > 19 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS distinct_players, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS distinct_teams, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::text = pt.playerid::text JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::text = t.tmid::text WHERE t.year >= 2005 AND pt.points >= 1467 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) > 97 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_player, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player') AS mvp_count_in_year, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_blocks, SUM(pt.turnovers) AS total_turnovers, MAX(pt.points) AS max_player_points, MIN(pt.points) AS min_player_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS league_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS overall_assists_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points, LEAD(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS next_year_points, (SELECT AVG(pas.points) FROM player_allstar pas WHERE pas.season_id = t.year AND pas.league_id = t.lgid) AS avg_allstar_points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coaches c WHERE c.year = t.year AND c.lgid = t.lgid AND c.won > c.lost) AS winning_coaches_count, SUM(t.o_pts) AS team_offensive_points, SUM(t.d_pts) AS team_defensive_points, (SUM(t.o_pts) - SUM(t.d_pts)) AS point_differential, (SELECT SUM(sp.w) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = t.id OR sp.tmidloser = t.id)) AS total_playoff_wins FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.id = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year AND t.lgid = pt.lgid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::text = p.playerid LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND d.draftyear = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap2 ON p.id = ap2.playerid AND ap2.year = t.year AND ap2.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN coaches c2 ON t.id = c2.tmid AND t.year = c2.year AND t.lgid = c2.lgid LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c2.id = ac.coachid::integer AND ac.year = t.year AND ac.lgid = t.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1974 AND t.year <= 1963 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND t.playoff = 'Y' GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year, t.name, t.tmid, t.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 50730 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) >= 37 ORDER BY total_team_points DESC, t.year ASC, t.name ASC;

SELECT t.name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.name ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2004 AND t.year <= 1993 GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 47270 ORDER BY t.name, t.year;
SELECT t.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid WHERE pt.year >= 1992 AND pt.gp >= 5 GROUP BY t.tmid ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS player_count, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points FROM teams t LEFT JOIN players_teams p ON t.tmid::integer = p.tmid AND t.year = p.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid AND p.year = pa.season_id WHERE t.year >= 2018 AND t.year <= 1965 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) > 44 ORDER BY player_count DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 2020 AND pt.year <= 1971 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 36926.67 INTERSECT SELECT t.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 2023 AND pt.year <= 1966 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) < 30604.09 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts FROM teams t WHERE t.year = 1966 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.points > 1789 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND c.year = t.year AND c.won > 14 ) ORDER BY t.won DESC, t.o_pts DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY t.won DESC) AS win_rank FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year WHERE t.year >= 2010 AND t.year <= 1960 AND (t.won > 64 OR t.lost < 43) AND NOT (t.lgid = 'NBA' AND t.confid = 'East') GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 37355 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id WHERE t.year >= 1962 AND t.year <= 1972 AND pt.points > 2528 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS num_players, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::text JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::text WHERE pt.year >= 1958 AND pt.year <= 1972 AND ap.award = 'NBA All-Defensive First Team' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.won AS current_year_wins, t2.won AS previous_year_wins, (t1.won - t2.won) AS win_difference FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.won > 66 AND t2.won > 21 ORDER BY win_difference DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.won, t1.lost, t2.won AS t2_won, t2.lost AS t2_lost, (t1.won - t2.won) AS win_difference FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year WHERE t1.won > 22.99 AND t2.won < 8.83 AND t1.year >= 1963.3 GROUP BY t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.won, t1.lost, t2.won, t2.lost HAVING (t1.won - t2.won) > 44.06 ORDER BY win_difference DESC;

SELECT a.playerid, a.year, a.award, p.firstname, p.lastname, CASE WHEN a.year >= 2012 THEN 'Recent Era' ELSE 'Earlier Era' END AS era_category, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.year) AS awards_in_year, SUM(p_a.points) AS total_points FROM awards_players a JOIN players p ON p.playerid::integer = a.playerid JOIN player_allstar p_a ON p_a.playerid = a.playerid AND p_a.season_id = a.year WHERE a.year BETWEEN 1994 AND 2007 AND p_a.points > 3 GROUP BY a.playerid, a.year, a.award, p.firstname, p.lastname, p_a.points HAVING SUM(p_a.points) > 50 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT ap.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.award, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, MAX(pt.year) AS last_team_year, MIN(pt.year) AS first_team_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = CAST(pt.tmid AS integer) THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_series_won, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidloser = CAST(pt.tmid AS integer) THEN sp.l ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_series_lost, ROUND(SUM(pa.points)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(pa.minutes), 0), 2) AS points_per_minute_allstar, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pa.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.award ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) DESC) AS award_frequency_rank FROM awards_players ap JOIN players p ON ap.playerid = CAST(p.playerid AS integer) JOIN player_allstar pa ON ap.playerid = pa.playerid AND ap.year = pa.season_id JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = CAST(t.tmid AS integer) AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser WHERE ap.year >= 2005 AND ap.year <= 2012 AND pa.points > 38 AND pt.points > 2172 AND t.won > 54 GROUP BY ap.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.award HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) > 14 AND SUM(pa.points) > 244 AND AVG(pt.points) > 330 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 5 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, award_years DESC;

SELECT d.draftyear, AVG(p.height) AS avg_height, COUNT(*) AS total_players FROM draft d JOIN players p ON d.playerid = p.id WHERE d.draftyear >= 1951.98 AND p.height > 90.42 GROUP BY d.draftyear ORDER BY d.draftyear;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, AVG(pt.assists * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_assists_per_game, AVG(pt.rebounds * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_rebounds_per_game, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_team_year, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS overall_points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points, LEAD(SUM(pt.assists), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS next_year_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1985 AND 2004 AND pt.points > 1598 AND pt.assists > 158 AND t.won > 9 AND c.won > 35 AND pa.points > 3 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1653 AND AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) > 41.25 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, pt.tmid;

SELECT p.playerid AS playerid, p.firstname AS first_name, p.lastname AS last_name, pt.year AS season_year, pt.lgid AS league_id, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_blocks, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)::float) AS points_per_minute, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for_count, MAX(ap.season_id) AS latest_allstar_season, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.season_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS allstar_games_played, SUM(d.draftoverall) AS draft_overall_sum, MIN(d.draftyear) AS earliest_draft_year, AVG(c.won::float / NULLIF((c.won + c.lost), 0)) AS coach_win_percentage, SUM(sp.w) AS playoff_series_wins, SUM(sp.l) AS playoff_series_losses FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser) AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.year >= 1996 AND pt.year <= 1996 AND pt.points > 3427 AND (t.lgid = 'ABA' OR t.lgid IS NULL) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.lgid, t.name), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.lgid), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname), (pt.year, pt.lgid, t.name), (pt.year, pt.lgid), (pt.year), () ) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 42482 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 40 ORDER BY total_points DESC, season_year ASC, league_id ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, a.year, a.award, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN awards_players a ON p.playerid::integer = a.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON a.playerid = pt.playerid AND a.year = pt.year WHERE a.award IN (SELECT award FROM awards_players WHERE year = 2002 GROUP BY award HAVING COUNT(*) >= 56) GROUP BY p.playerid, a.year, a.award ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.season_id) AS allstar_seasons FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.playerid::integer = ps.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND ps.season_id = ap.year WHERE ap.award = 'All-Star' AND ps.season_id IN (SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'All-Star' AND lgid = 'NBA' AND year > 2017) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(ps.points) > 21.54 ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1996 AND pt.year <= 2008 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 17.67 ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1999 AND pt.year <= 2019 AND pt.minutes > 4870 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.points) > '5.0' AND SUM(pt.assists) > 2533 ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE ap.year >= 2017 AND pt.points > 44 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 21.07 ORDER BY award_count DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, SUM(ap.year) AS total_award_years FROM players p LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 2003.64 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 10.98 ORDER BY award_count DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_award_types, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, SUM(CASE WHEN c.coachid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coached_seasons FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON p.playerid::integer = c.coachid::integer WHERE pt.year >= 2019 AND pt.year <= 1996 AND pa.season_id >= 2019 AND pa.season_id <= 2013 AND pt.points > 1465 AND pa.points > 78 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 8443 AND AVG(pa.points) > 15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 1 ORDER BY career_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS unique_awards_count, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 1984 AND pa.season_id >= 1984 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 2193 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.year >= 2013 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 43184 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id WHERE pt.points > 348.95 AND pt.year >= 1979 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 4.82 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year WHERE pt.points > 160 AND ap.season_id >= 2009 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 15197 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 18 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season, MAX(pt.rebounds) AS max_rebounds_season, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.league_id = 'NBA' THEN ap.points ELSE 0 END) AS nba_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (ORDER BY p.playerid) AS prev_player_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid = aw.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = aw.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1963 AND 1971 AND pt.points > 2562 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t.id AND sp.year = pt.year AND sp.round = 'Finals' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0 ) AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 25042 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 15 ORDER BY total_points DESC, p.playerid LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS distinct_team_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE p.firstseason >= 1955 AND p.lastseason <= 2007 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 31722 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE pt.points > 6 AND pt.rebounds > 9 AND ap.year BETWEEN 2005 AND 2021 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) > 1 AND AVG(pt.points) > 8 ORDER BY total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND ap.year = pa.season_id WHERE ap.year >= 1970 AND pa.points > 22 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) > 2 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, MAX(pt.points) AS max_regular_points, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_post_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS regular_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pa.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid WHERE ap.year >= 2008 AND ap.year <= 1965 AND pa.season_id >= 1976 AND pa.season_id <= 1961 AND pt.year >= 1988 AND pt.year <= 1978 AND t.year >= 1977 AND t.year <= 1961 AND c.year >= 1978 AND c.year <= 1964 AND ac.year >= 1999 AND ac.year <= 2017 AND p.firstseason >= 1982 AND p.firstseason <= 1950 AND p.lastseason >= 2008 AND p.lastseason <= 1956 AND p.height >= '150.0' AND p.height <= '150.0' AND p.weight >= 77 AND p.weight <= 184 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 9 AND SUM(pt.points) > 1881 AND SUM(pa.points) > 276 ORDER BY regular_points_rank, allstar_points_rank LIMIT 714;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(ap.points) AS total_points, AVG(ap.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds FROM players p JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON aw.playerid = ap.playerid AND aw.year = ap.season_id WHERE aw.year >= 2001 AND ap.points >= 50 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 3974 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE pa.season_id >= 2008 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 434 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1979 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 425;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pa.playerid = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE pa.season_id >= 1977 AND pa.season_id <= 1960 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA First Team' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 323 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 1611 AND t.year BETWEEN 1983 AND 1949 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 20892 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year AND pa.points > 39.47 ) AND pt.year BETWEEN 1966.61 AND 1951.75 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 12693.85 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1969 AND pt.year <= 2008 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 23608 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND ap.year >= 1979 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA First Team' ) AND pt.year BETWEEN 1966 AND 1987 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 14349 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying WHERE pt.year > 1989 AND pt.year < 1985 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3406 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1971 AND pt.year <= 2007 AND (pt.points > 242 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player')) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 49881 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE (pt.points > 2007 OR pt.assists > 795) AND NOT (pt.year < 1941) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3370 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.points > 528 AND (pt.assists > 47 OR pt.rebounds > 1200) AND NOT (pt.lgid = 'ABA') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 19853 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 1972 AND pt.gp > 68 AND pt.lgid = ( SELECT lgid FROM players_teams subpt WHERE subpt.playerid = pt.playerid AND subpt.year = ( SELECT MAX(year) FROM players_teams subsubpt WHERE subsubpt.playerid = subpt.playerid ) LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 9411 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 937.75 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2012 AND 2011 AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND t.won > 62.07 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 857.89 ORDER BY total_points DESC;
