SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1996 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = pt.playerid AND d.draftyear <= 1994) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 40620 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2014 AND pt.year <= 2002 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND d.draftyear > 2004 LIMIT 1) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 34614 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer WHERE pt.year >= 2003 AND pt.year <= 1964 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > (SELECT AVG(points) FROM players_teams WHERE year = 1961) ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.points > 22 AND pt.year >= 1976 AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 20873 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 25 AND t.won > 58 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2014 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1967 AND pt.year <= 2009 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND d.draftyear > 2004 LIMIT 1) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 47670 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.points > 33 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_scoring_games, COUNT(pt.stint) AS total_stints FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1988 AND 2019 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 16973 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) > 6708.25 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.assists) > 7656.38 THEN 'High Assister' WHEN SUM(pt.rebounds) > 28209.15 THEN 'High Rebounder' ELSE 'Balanced' END AS player_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1963 AND 1960 AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' AND p.height > '150.0' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 8796.26 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 8 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_assists DESC, total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.birthdate, d.draftyear, d.draftoverall, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.assists, ap.rebounds, pt.year AS team_year, pt.points AS team_points, pt.assists AS team_assists, pt.rebounds AS team_rebounds, c.year AS coach_year, c.won AS coach_wins, c.lost AS coach_losses, ac.award, ac.year AS award_year, t.name AS team_name, t.year AS team_stats_year, t.won AS team_wins, t.lost AS team_losses, AVG(ap.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY ap.season_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_points_career, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid, pt.year ORDER BY pt.stint) AS total_points_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.draftyear ORDER BY d.draftoverall) AS draft_rank, COUNT(ac.award) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid) AS total_awards, (ap.points + ap.assists + ap.rebounds) AS allstar_game_score, (pt.points + pt.assists + pt.rebounds) AS season_game_score, (t.o_pts - t.d_pts) AS team_point_diff, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS birth_year, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) + 40 AS projected_retirement_year, TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + INTERVAL '29 years' AS projected_peak_date FROM players p JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = CAST(d.playerid AS character varying) JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = CAST(ap.playerid AS character varying) JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = CAST(pt.playerid AS character varying) AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = CAST(c.tmid AS integer) AND pt.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid = CAST(ac.coachid AS character varying) AND c.year = ac.year JOIN awards_players aap ON p.playerid = CAST(aap.playerid AS character varying) AND ap.season_id = aap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = CAST(t.tmid AS integer) AND pt.year = t.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = CAST(sp.tmidwinner AS character varying) AND t.year = sp.year WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 1949 AND 1977 AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1972 AND 1952 AND ap.season_id BETWEEN 1976 AND 1980 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2014 AND 1999 AND c.year BETWEEN 1984 AND 1960 AND ac.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 1983 AND t.year BETWEEN 1996 AND 1999 AND sp.year BETWEEN 2008 AND 1959 AND (ap.points > 5 OR ap.assists > 7 OR ap.rebounds > 15) AND (pt.points > 1749 OR pt.assists > 481 OR pt.rebounds > 1208) AND (t.o_pts > 7902 AND t.d_pts < 11426) AND TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + INTERVAL '23 years' >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 years' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.birthdate, d.draftyear, d.draftoverall, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.assists, ap.rebounds, pt.year, pt.points, pt.assists, pt.rebounds, c.year, c.won, c.lost, ac.award, ac.year, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, d.draftyear, d.draftoverall, ap.season_id, pt.stint, ac.award, p.playerid, ap.points, ap.assists, ap.rebounds, pt.points, pt.assists, pt.rebounds HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4702 AND AVG(ap.points) > '5.0' AND COUNT(ac.award) > 3 ORDER BY total_points_season DESC, avg_points_career DESC, draft_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, SUM(pa.points) AS allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, SUM(sp.w) AS playoff_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 1693 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2013 AND 2013 AND pa.points > 32 AND t.won > 29 AND c.won > 53 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2574 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 5 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 42 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid) AS avg_team_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1950 AND pt.points > 1167 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1502 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) AS stint_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1989 AND 1966 AND pt.points > 2819 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award IS NOT NULL ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = pt.tmid AND c.year = pt.year AND c.won > 27 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4258 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE p.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT d.playerid FROM draft d WHERE d.draftyear BETWEEN 1990 AND 1973 AND d.draftround <= 8 ) AND pt.points > 1673 AND t.won > 67 AND c.won > 55 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3467 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 2 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_by_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 3000 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1982 AND 1991 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3099 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, points_rank_by_year;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(*) AS games_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 23 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2003 AND 2001 AND t.won > 55 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1761 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(CAST(pt.points AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_team_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) FILTER (WHERE ap.award IS NOT NULL) AS distinct_awards_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1974 AND pt.minutes > 776 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.year = pt.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) AND sp.round = 'Conference Finals' ) AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2596 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(CAST(pt.points AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_team_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) FILTER (WHERE ap.award IS NOT NULL) AS distinct_awards_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2001 AND pt.minutes > 954 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.year = pt.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) AND sp.round = 'Conference Finals' ) AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3623 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = 'MVP') AS mvp_count, (SELECT AVG(pa.points) FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid = p.id AND pa.season_id = pt.year) AS allstar_avg_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1963 AND 1979 AND pt.points > 127 AND pt.rebounds > 219 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t.id AND sp.year = pt.year ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, p.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2556 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 324 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_rebounds DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 2398 AND pt.year >= 2009 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points HAVING COUNT(pt.stint) >= 4 ORDER BY pt.year, points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year) AS award_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 155 AND pt.rebounds > 34 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2001 ORDER BY pt.points DESC, pt.rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, ap.award, ac.award AS coach_award, c.coachid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, t.name AS team_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid, pt.year) AS team_avg_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.id AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (pt.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR pt.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser) AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 285 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1952 AND 1966 AND pt.rebounds > 1375 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid = p.id AND pa.season_id = pt.year AND pa.points > 40 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, ap.award, ac.award, c.coachid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, t.name HAVING AVG(pt.assists) > 2.23 ORDER BY pt.points DESC, points_rank LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (pt.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR pt.tmid = sp.tmidloser) AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1968 AND 1979 AND pt.points > 1408 AND t.won > 5 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 829 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 2 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, points_rank_in_league_year;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, ap.points AS allstar_points, ap.rebounds AS allstar_rebounds, ap.assists AS allstar_assists, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftselection, c.coachid, ac.award AS coach_award, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, sp.w AS series_wins, sp.l AS series_losses, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_by_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.id AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (pt.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR pt.tmid = sp.tmidloser) AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2020 AND 2013 AND pt.points > 749 AND pt.rebounds > 493 AND t.won > 46 AND (ap.points > 17 OR ap.points IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.rebounds, ap.assists, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftselection, c.coachid, ac.award, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, sp.w, sp.l HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3102 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 4 AND AVG(pt.assists) > 7 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_points_per_game DESC LIMIT 25;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.award LIKE '%All-Star%' AND ap.year BETWEEN 1951 AND 1992) AS allstar_awards_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY AVG(pt.points) DESC) AS league_avg_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.id WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2014 AND 2009 AND pt.points > 565 AND pa.points > 14 AND t.won > 53 AND (d.draftyear IS NULL OR d.draftyear < 2008) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.year, t.lgid, p.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 25221 AND AVG(pt.points) > 16 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 2 ORDER BY total_points DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2006.24 AND pt.year <= 2018.71 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND ap.league_id = 'NBA' AND d.draftyear >= 2009.0 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 27205.98 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 7.53 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.lgid, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(CASE WHEN ac.award LIKE '%MVP%' THEN 1 END) AS mvp_awards, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t.id THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_wins_by_team FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ac ON p.playerid::integer = ac.playerid AND pt.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 2594 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1948 AND 1975 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.lgid, pt.year), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.lgid, pt.year), (t.name, t.lgid, pt.year), (t.lgid, pt.year), (pt.year), ()) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 38005 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.tmid, t.name, pt.year, pt.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_lg, SUM(pt.points) / NULLIF(SUM(pt.minutes), 0) AS points_per_minute, (SELECT MAX(d.draftoverall) FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid::character varying = p.playerid AND d.draftyear <= pt.year) AS highest_draft_pick_before_year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND c.year = pt.year AND c.won > c.lost) AS winning_coaches_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::character varying = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.lgid = t.lgid AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON pa.playerid = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE pt.points > 1941.84 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2000.8 AND 1995.2 AND t.won > 19.18 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.tmid, t.name, pt.year, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.assists) > 782.91 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 46.0 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank_lg;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1954 AND 1995 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1010 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, t.tmid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS birth_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(ap.three_made::DECIMAL / NULLIF(ap.three_attempted, 0)) AS career_three_pct, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.league_id = 'NBA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nba_allstar_games FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::INTEGER = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::INTEGER AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::INTEGER = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::INTEGER = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::INTEGER = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1977 AND pt.year <= 1998 AND pt.points > 2955 AND t.won > 27 GROUP BY CUBE(p.playerid, t.tmid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 20476 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 4 ORDER BY total_points DESC, team_points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(*) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1988 AND pt.points > 1369 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((p.playerid, t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid), (p.playerid, t.tmid), (p.playerid)) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 37634 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT pl.playerid, pl.firstname, pl.lastname, pl.college, pl.pos, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, ap.conference, AVG(ap.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pl.playerid, ap.league_id, ap.conference ORDER BY prev_season_points, LEAD(ap.points, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY pl.playerid, ap.league_id, ap.conference ORDER BY ap.season_id) AS next_season_points, pt.year AS team_year, pt.tmid, pt.lgid AS team_lgid, pt.points AS team_points, pt.rebounds AS team_rebounds, pt.assists AS team_assists, t.name AS team_name, t.arena, t.playoff, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid, pt.lgid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS team_avg_points, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, d.draftfrom, apw.year AS award_year, apw.award, apw.lgid AS award_lgid, c.year AS coach_year, c.coachid, c.won AS coach_wins, c.lost AS coach_losses, c.lgid AS coach_lgid, sp.year AS series_year, sp.round, sp.series, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, sp.w AS series_wins, sp.l AS series_losses, sp.lgidwinner, sp.lgidloser, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY pl.playerid, ap.league_id, ap.conference) AS total_allstar_appearances, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, MIN(ap.points) AS min_allstar_points, SUM(ap.rebounds) AS total_allstar_rebounds, AVG(ap.rebounds) AS avg_allstar_rebounds, SUM(ap.assists) AS total_allstar_assists, AVG(ap.assists) AS avg_allstar_assists, SUM(ap.steals) AS total_allstar_steals, AVG(ap.steals) AS avg_allstar_steals, SUM(ap.blocks) AS total_allstar_blocks, AVG(ap.blocks) AS avg_allstar_blocks, SUM(ap.turnovers) AS total_allstar_turnovers, AVG(ap.turnovers) AS avg_allstar_turnovers, SUM(ap.personal_fouls) AS total_allstar_fouls, AVG(ap.personal_fouls) AS avg_allstar_fouls, SUM(ap.fg_made) AS total_allstar_fg_made, AVG(ap.fg_made) AS avg_allstar_fg_made, SUM(ap.fg_attempted) AS total_allstar_fg_attempted, AVG(ap.fg_attempted) AS avg_allstar_fg_attempted, SUM(ap.ft_made) AS total_allstar_ft_made, AVG(ap.ft_made) AS avg_allstar_ft_made, SUM(ap.ft_attempted) AS total_allstar_ft_attempted, AVG(ap.ft_attempted) AS avg_allstar_ft_attempted, SUM(ap.three_made) AS total_allstar_three_made, AVG(ap.three_made) AS avg_allstar_three_made, SUM(ap.three_attempted) AS total_allstar_three_attempted, AVG(ap.three_attempted) AS avg_allstar_three_attempted FROM players pl JOIN player_allstar ap ON pl.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON pl.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND pt.lgid = t.lgid AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON pl.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN awards_players apw ON pl.playerid::integer = apw.playerid AND ap.season_id = apw.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::character varying = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year AND t.lgid = c.lgid JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::character varying = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND t.year = sp.year AND t.lgid = sp.lgidwinner WHERE ap.points > 11.37 AND pt.points > 1710.09 AND t.year >= 1958 AND d.draftyear >= 2010 AND apw.year >= 1953 AND c.year >= 2004 AND sp.year >= 1979 GROUP BY pl.playerid, pl.firstname, pl.lastname, pl.college, pl.pos, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, ap.conference, ap.points, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.lgid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, t.name, t.arena, t.playoff, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, d.draftfrom, apw.year, apw.award, apw.lgid, c.year, c.coachid, c.won, c.lost, c.lgid, sp.year, sp.round, sp.series, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, sp.w, sp.l, sp.lgidwinner, sp.lgidloser ORDER BY pl.playerid, ap.season_id, pt.year, d.draftyear, apw.year, c.year, sp.year;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS unique_players, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS unique_coaches, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.lgid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::character varying = p.playerid JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.lgid AND t.year = c.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND t.year = pa.season_id WHERE t.year >= 1978 AND t.won >= 59 GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 9316 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS total_players, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.coachid) AS total_award_coaches, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.points > 1336 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2017 AND 1969 AND pa.points >= 15 AND c.won > 71 AND d.draftyear >= 2022 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 20584 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) >= 14 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 33 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id WHERE t.year >= 1964 AND t.year <= 1981 AND pt.points > 3968 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 33970 ORDER BY t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS distinct_players, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS league_points_rank, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_team_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_team_assists, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.award IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS player_awards_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = t.id AND c.year = t.year AND c.won > c.lost) AS winning_coaches_count, (SELECT AVG(d.draftoverall) FROM draft d WHERE d.tmid = t.id AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 2015 AND 2005) AS avg_draft_pick FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.id = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1966 AND 2007 AND t.won > 23 AND pt.minutes > 3204 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, t.name, t.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 43228 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) >= 28 ORDER BY total_team_points DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.won, t2.attendance, t1.o_pts, t2.d_pts, (t1.o_pts - t2.d_pts) AS net_pts_diff FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year WHERE t1.won > 79.03 AND t2.attendance > 329662.32 GROUP BY t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.won, t2.attendance, t1.o_pts, t2.d_pts HAVING (t1.o_pts - t2.d_pts) > -290.74 ORDER BY net_pts_diff DESC;

SELECT a.playerid, a.year, a.award, a.lgid, b.firstname, b.lastname, b.draftyear, b.draftoverall FROM awards_players a JOIN draft b ON a.playerid = b.playerid WHERE a.year >= 1978 AND a.year <= 1961 AND b.draftyear >= 1954 AND b.draftoverall <= 74 INTERSECT SELECT c.playerid, c.year, c.award, c.lgid, d.firstname, d.lastname, d.draftyear, d.draftoverall FROM awards_players c JOIN draft d ON c.playerid = d.playerid JOIN players_teams e ON c.playerid = e.playerid AND c.year = e.year WHERE e.points >= 1142 AND e.rebounds >= 1690 ORDER BY year DESC, draftoverall ASC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname AS first_name, p.lastname AS last_name, pt.year AS season_year, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for_count, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, COUNT(apl.award) AS mvp_award_count, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_wins_with_team, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league_season FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players apl ON p.playerid::integer = apl.playerid AND pt.year = apl.year AND apl.award = 'Most Valuable Player' LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON pt.tmid = sp.tmidwinner AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE pt.year >= 1990 AND pt.year <= 2022 AND pt.points > 1954 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, t.name, t.lgid), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.lgid), (pt.year, t.lgid), (t.lgid), () ) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 29220 ORDER BY total_points DESC, season_year ASC, league ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, ap.season_id, SUM(ap.points) AS total_points, SUM(ap.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(ap.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players aw ON p.id = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year WHERE ap.points > 43 AND ap.assists > 7 AND aw.award = 'Most Valuable Player' GROUP BY p.playerid, ap.season_id HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 104 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) AS total_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 1977 AND pt.year <= 1956 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname UNION ALL SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COALESCE(SUM(pas.points), 0) AS total_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar pas ON p.playerid = pas.playerid::character varying WHERE pas.season_id >= 1982 AND pas.season_id <= 2008 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) AS total_points, COALESCE(SUM(pt.assists), 0) AS total_assists, COALESCE(SUM(pt.rebounds), 0) AS total_rebounds, COALESCE(AVG(ps.points), 0) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.rebounds), 0) DESC) AS rebounds_rank FROM players p LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.playerid::integer = ps.playerid AND pt.year = ps.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.points > 1348 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1994 AND 2001 AND t.won > 9 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) > 43653 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 28 UNION SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) AS total_points, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postassists), 0) AS total_assists, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postrebounds), 0) AS total_rebounds, COALESCE(AVG(ps.points), 0) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.postrebounds), 0) DESC) AS rebounds_rank FROM players p LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.playerid::integer = ps.playerid AND pt.year = ps.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.postpoints > 645 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1968 AND 1992 AND t.won > 0 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) > 995 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 22 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, SUM(ap.year) AS total_award_years, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid WHERE p.firstseason >= 1957 AND p.lastseason <= 1977 AND pa.points > 30 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 9 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying WHERE ap.award LIKE '%All-Star%' AND pa.season_id >= 1996.23 AND pa.season_id <= 1996.2 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 170.42 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.points > 3014 AND ap.points BETWEEN 32 AND 11 AND (pt.gp >= 10 OR pt.minutes > 1665) AND NOT (ap.three_attempted = 0 AND ap.three_made > 0) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(ap.points) > 11 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 6 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT apw.year) AS award_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players apw ON p.playerid::integer = apw.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id WHERE pt.year >= 2014 AND ap.season_id >= 2021 AND pt.points > 2926 AND ap.points > 20 AND t.won > 42 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 3 AND SUM(pt.points) > 36916 AND AVG(pt.rebounds) > 12 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 2011 AND p.lastseason <= 1996 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 48458 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS team_years, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position FROM players p LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid::integer AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 1994 AND p.lastseason <= 1951 AND (pa.points >= 7 OR pa.points IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) >= 12 AND AVG(pa.points) > 29.38 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pt.points) AS median_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1201 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2019 AND 1983 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 36.68 ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE ap.year >= 1990 AND pt.points > 1663 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) > 14 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_team_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE pa.season_id >= 1967 AND pt.year >= 1973 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 96.91 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid INNER JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1633 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 1975 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 1 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid INNER JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.points > 2914 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2012 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 22 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE p.firstseason >= 2008 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND ap.year >= 2014 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2524 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'None' AND year >= 1996 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3781 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year IN (SELECT year FROM coaches WHERE coachid = 'A') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 41645 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1962 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = pt.playerid AND d.draftyear > 1985 LIMIT 1) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 8476 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year > 2006 AND (pt.lgid = 'NBA' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND ap.year = pt.year)) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 6535 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 16.06 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 1972 AND t.won > 77.77 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > (SELECT AVG(points) FROM players_teams WHERE year = 2000) ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = pt.playerid AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1986 AND 2018 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 6449 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.college, p.pos, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, ap.season_id, ap.points AS allstar_points, ap.rebounds AS allstar_rebounds, ap.assists AS allstar_assists, pt.year AS team_year, pt.points AS team_points, pt.rebounds AS team_rebounds, pt.assists AS team_assists, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS career_points_running_total, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid) AS avg_points_per_season, COUNT(ap.season_id) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid) AS allstar_appearances, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS total_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pos ORDER BY AVG(pt.points) DESC) AS avg_points_rank_by_position, SUM(pt.points) AS total_career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_career_points, MAX(pt.points) AS max_season_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.lgid = 'NBA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nba_seasons_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id WHERE pt.year >= 2008 AND pt.year <= 1972 AND pt.points > 1405 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND p.pos IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.college, p.pos, t.name, t.lgid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.rebounds, ap.assists, pt.year, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 13256 AND AVG(pt.points) > 16 ORDER BY total_career_points DESC, avg_career_points DESC LIMIT 714;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_by_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.coachid::integer AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.points > 34 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2008 AND 1983 AND t.won > 18 AND pa.points > 11 AND c.won > 5 AND sp.year = pt.year GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 505 AND AVG(pt.points) > 10.8 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_points_per_game DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1984 AND 2001 AND (pt.gp > 47 OR pt.minutes > 3168) AND (t.playoff = 'Y' OR t.confid = 'East') AND (aw.award IS NULL OR aw.award NOT IN ('MVP', 'ROY')) AND p.height > '150.0' AND (p.college IS NOT NULL OR p.hscountry = 'USA') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 777 AND AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) < '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 7 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, points_rank_in_year;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS league_points_rank, (SUM(pt.points) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pt.minutes), 0)) AS points_per_minute FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 382.16 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2020.19 AND 1999.11 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 33305.95 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 13.46 ORDER BY total_points DESC, seasons_played DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_playoff_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(c.won) AS max_coach_wins, SUM(s.w) AS total_series_wins_by_teams, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) DESC) AS awards_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.postpoints) DESC) AS playoff_percentile FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::character varying = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year JOIN series_post s ON t.id = s.tmidwinner OR t.id = s.tmidloser WHERE pt.points > 1887.53 AND pt.year >= 1999.34 AND t.won >= 42.05 AND pa.points >= 30.12 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 9309.65 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 11.31 ORDER BY total_regular_points DESC, awards_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, pt.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute FROM players_teams pt JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id JOIN player_allstar ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id WHERE pt.year >= 1997.89 AND pt.year <= 1991.14 GROUP BY p.playerid, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4958.0 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.lgid AS league, t.year AS season, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS distinct_players, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS distinct_teams, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_player, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.year = pt.year AND t.lgid = pt.lgid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::text = p.playerid WHERE t.year >= 1986 AND t.year <= 1978 AND t.won > 50 AND pt.minutes > 1169 GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) > 249 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, AVG(t.won) AS avg_wins, SUM(t.attendance) AS total_attendance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coaches c WHERE c.lgid = t.lgid AND c.year = t.year AND c.won > 43.96) AS coaches_above_threshold FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1985.86 AND 1947.18 AND t.attendance > 610169.69 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = (SELECT award FROM awards_players WHERE playerid = ap.playerid AND year = ap.year AND award LIKE '%MVP%' LIMIT 1) ) GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year HAVING AVG(t.won) > 45.29 ORDER BY total_attendance DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, p.playerid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid = p.id AND ap2.award = 'MVP' AND ap2.year >= 2002) AS mvp_count, (SELECT AVG(c.won) FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND c.year BETWEEN 1958 AND 1958) AS avg_coach_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND d.draftyear = p.firstseason JOIN awards_players ap3 ON p.id = ap3.playerid AND ap3.year = pt.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON ac.coachid::integer = (SELECT c2.coachid::integer FROM coaches c2 WHERE c2.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND c2.year = pt.year LIMIT 1) AND ac.year = pt.year JOIN series_post sp ON (sp.tmidwinner::integer = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser::integer = pt.tmid) AND sp.year = pt.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1992 AND 2005 AND pt.points > 689 AND pt.minutes > 4088 AND t.won > 54 AND (ap.league_id = 'NBA' OR ap.league_id IS NULL) AND p.height > '150.0' AND p.weight BETWEEN 145 AND 126 AND (d.draftround IS NULL OR d.draftround <= 8) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM players_teams pt2 WHERE pt2.playerid = p.id AND pt2.year < t.year AND pt2.points > 2133) GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year, p.playerid, p.id, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 9478 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, t.year, t.lgid;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS player_count, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points FROM teams t LEFT JOIN players_teams p ON t.tmid::integer = p.tmid AND t.year = p.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid AND p.year = pa.season_id WHERE t.year >= 1957 AND t.year <= 1986 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) > 12 ORDER BY player_count DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.won, t.lost, ROUND(t.won::DECIMAL / NULLIF(t.games, 0), 3) AS win_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count FROM teams t LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::INTEGER = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::INTEGER = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year = 1995 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE (sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid::INTEGER OR sp.tmidloser = t.tmid::INTEGER) AND sp.year = 1960 ) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.games HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) > 6 ORDER BY win_percentage DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, t.name, SUM(t.won) AS total_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS total_losses, AVG(t.attendance) AS avg_attendance, SUM(pts.points) AS total_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pts.playerid) AS unique_players, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS unique_coaches, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS all_star_players, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(t.won) DESC, AVG(t.attendance) DESC) AS rank_in_league, SUM(sp.w) AS playoff_series_wins, SUM(sp.l) AS playoff_series_losses, AVG(d.draftoverall) AS avg_draft_pick, COUNT(DISTINCT d.playerid) AS drafted_players FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pts ON t.tmid::integer = pts.tmid AND t.year = pts.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON pts.playerid = ap.playerid AND pts.year = ap.year AND ap.award = 'All-Star' LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON t.tmid::integer = d.tmid AND t.year = d.draftyear WHERE t.year >= 1952 AND t.year <= 2008 AND t.attendance > 3587768 AND pts.points > 29748 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.won) > 66 AND AVG(t.attendance) > 3364432 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pts.playerid) > 41 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_attendance DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.name, t1.won, t1.lost, t2.year AS prev_year, t2.won AS prev_won, t2.lost AS prev_lost, (t1.won - t2.won) AS win_improvement FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.won > 12 AND t2.won > 52 AND t1.year BETWEEN 2020 AND 1986 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.name, t1.won, t1.lost, t2.year, t2.won, t2.lost ORDER BY win_improvement DESC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname AS first_name, p.lastname AS last_name, SUM(pt.points) AS regular_season_points, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS playoff_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS regular_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) DESC) AS awards_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1986 AND pt.points >= 1971 AND pa.points >= 6 AND t.won >= 4 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 24239 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 8 ORDER BY regular_season_points DESC, awards_rank ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, AVG(pt.assists * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_assists_per_game, AVG(pt.rebounds * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_rebounds_per_game, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_team_year, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS overall_points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points, LEAD(SUM(pt.assists), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS next_year_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2020 AND 1989 AND pt.points > 518 AND pt.assists > 714 AND t.won > 67 AND c.won > 58 AND pa.points > 35 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 576 AND AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) > 23.6 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, pt.tmid;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year), 0) AS award_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND p.firstseason = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE pt.points > 869.42 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1980.34 AND 1985.42 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 8.74 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, SUM(COALESCE(ap.year, 0)) AS total_award_years FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 1975 AND d.draftyear <= 1966 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 8 ORDER BY distinct_awards_count DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.points > 1943 AND ap.points BETWEEN 17 AND 25 AND (pt.gp >= 73 OR pt.minutes > 870) AND NOT (ap.three_attempted = 0 AND ap.three_made > 0) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(ap.points) > 8 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid = awp.playerid::character varying WHERE awp.award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND awp.year BETWEEN 2001 AND 2010 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND d.draftyear > 1977) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 402 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE (pt.points > 592 OR pt.rebounds > 930) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players aw WHERE aw.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND aw.year = ap.season_id AND aw.award = 'All-NBA') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 35576 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE pt.points > 2759.1 AND t.won >= 29.23 AND c.won >= 26.89 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 17843.61 AND AVG(pa.points) >= 3.16 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid INNER JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1861 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1996 AND 1953 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 9 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1995 AND pt.year <= 1989 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = 'All-NBA First Team' LIMIT 1) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 45874 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1962 AND pt.year <= 2009 AND pt.points > 561 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 32531 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 1986 AND pt.year <= 1972 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = pt.playerid AND d.draftyear < 1956 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 48840 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying WHERE pt.year > 1969 AND pt.year < 2005 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 6396 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2006 AND pt.year <= 2000 AND (pt.points > 1306 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player')) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 6363 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE (pt.points > 1011 OR pt.assists > 698) AND NOT (pt.year < 1989) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3841 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer WHERE pt.points > 641 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1997 AND 2010 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > (SELECT AVG(points) FROM players_teams WHERE year = 2012) ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE (pt.points > 2299 OR pt.assists > 805) AND NOT (pt.tmid = 41 AND pt.year < 2001) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 34942 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 2 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1993 AND pt.year <= 1980 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = 'All-NBA First Team' LIMIT 1) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 32782 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1975 AND pt.year <= 2012 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1730 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 10862.12 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 2479.57 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS scoring_category, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1974 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 979.44 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.assists, ap.rebounds, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points AS regular_points, pt.assists AS regular_assists, pt.rebounds AS regular_rebounds, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, AVG(ap.points) OVER (PARTITION BY ap.playerid) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.playerid, pt.year ORDER BY pt.stint ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_regular_points, COUNT(apl.award) OVER (PARTITION BY apl.playerid) AS total_player_awards, COUNT(ac.award) OVER (PARTITION BY c.coachid) AS total_coach_awards, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, sp.year AS playoff_year, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players apl ON p.playerid::integer = apl.playerid AND apl.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid = ac.coachid::character varying AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser WHERE p.firstseason >= 1977 AND p.lastseason <= 1968 AND ap.points > 48 AND pt.points > 2351 AND t.won > 59 AND t.lost < 76 AND (d.draftyear IS NULL OR d.draftyear >= 1958) AND (sp.year IS NULL OR sp.year >= 2000) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.assists, ap.rebounds, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.assists, pt.rebounds, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, apl.award, apl.playerid, c.coachid, ac.award, ac.coachid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, sp.year, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, ap.playerid, pt.playerid, pt.stint HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 885 AND AVG(ap.points) > 4 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC, running_regular_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, ap.season_id) DESC) AS allstar_seasons_rank, SUM(ap.points) / NULLIF(SUM(ap.minutes), 0) AS points_per_minute_allstar, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players awp WHERE awp.playerid = p.id AND awp.award players_teams pt2 ON coaches.tmid = pt2.tmid AND coaches.year = pt2.year WHERE pt2.playerid = p.id AND coaches.won > 74) AS coaches_with_wins_above_threshold FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.lgid = t.lgid JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR (ap.points > 11 OR pt.points > 373) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = pt.tmid::integer AND c.year = pt.year AND c.won > 26) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_coaches ac WHERE ac.coachid::integer = (SELECT c2.coachid::integer FROM coaches c2 WHERE c2.tmid = pt.tmid::integer AND c2.year = pt.year LIMIT 1) AND ac.year = pt.year AND ac.award = 'Coach of the Year')) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight, p.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 8 AND SUM(ap.points) > 388 AND AVG(pt.points) > 22 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, pt.year, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS yearly_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1955 AND pt.year <= 1976 AND pt.points > 3392 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, pt.year, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 31547 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.year, p.lgid, SUM(p.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(p.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY p.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_points FROM players_teams p JOIN awards_players a ON p.playerid = a.playerid AND p.year = a.year AND p.lgid = a.lgid WHERE p.points > 411.1 AND p.year BETWEEN 2007.52 AND 2002.95 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.year, p.lgid HAVING COUNT(a.award) >= 40.86 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.lgid AS league, t.year AS season, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS distinct_players, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS distinct_teams, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_player, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.year = pt.year AND t.lgid = pt.lgid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::text = p.playerid WHERE t.year >= 1966 AND t.year <= 1987 AND t.won > 34 AND pt.minutes > 3411 GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) > 1 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid;
