SUM(t.d_pts)) AS point_differential, (SELECT SUM(sp.w) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = t.id OR sp.tmidloser = t.id)) AS total_playoff_wins FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.id = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year AND t.lgid = pt.lgid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::text = p.playerid LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND d.draftyear = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap2 ON p.id = ap2.playerid AND ap2.year = t.year AND ap2.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN coaches c2 ON t.id = c2.tmid AND t.year = c2.year AND t.lgid = c2.lgid LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c2.id = ac.coachid::integer AND ac.year = t.year AND ac.lgid = t.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1974 AND t.year <= 1994 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND t.playoff = 'Y' GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year, t.name, t.tmid, t.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 72488 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) >= 28 ORDER BY total_team_points DESC, t.year ASC, t.name ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t.id AND sp.year = t.year) AS playoff_series_won, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.id = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1956 AND 1982 AND t.won >= 82 AND t.o_pts >= 351 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 34169 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.name, t1.year, t1.won, t1.lost, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t1.id AND sp.year = t1.year) AS playoff_wins, (SELECT AVG(c.won) FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = t1.id AND c.year = t1.year) AS avg_coach_wins, (SELECT SUM(pa.points) FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.league_id = t1.lgid AND pa.season_id = t1.year) AS allstar_points_in_league, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.tmid = t1.id AND pt.year = t1.year AND pt.points > 28220.88) AS high_scoring_players, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM draft d WHERE d.tmid = t1.id AND d.draftyear = t1.year AND d.draftoverall <= 42.05) AS top_draft_picks, (SELECT MAX(ap.year) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid IN (SELECT pt.playerid FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.tmid = t1.id AND pt.year = t1.year) AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player') AS latest_award_year, SUM(t2.o_pts) AS total_opp_points, AVG(t2.d_pts) AS avg_def_points_allowed FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year AND t1.id != t2.id LEFT JOIN players_teams pt1 ON pt1.tmid = t1.id AND pt1.year = t1.year LEFT JOIN players p ON p.id = pt1.playerid WHERE t1.year BETWEEN 1956.69 AND 1961.65 AND t1.won > 24.53 AND t1.playoff = 'Y' GROUP BY t1.tmid, t1.name, t1.year, t1.won, t1.lost, t1.id, t1.lgid HAVING AVG(pt1.points) > 19.03 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.college) >= 26.95 ORDER BY t1.year DESC, total_opp_points ASC;

SELECT COALESCE(p.playerid::text, d.playerid::text) AS playerid_combined, p.lastname, p.firstname, d.draftyear, ap.season_id, ap.points, pt.year, pt.points AS regular_season_points, SUM(ap.points) OVER(PARTITION BY COALESCE(p.playerid::text, d.playerid::text), ap.season_id) AS total_allstar_points_per_season, AVG(pt.points) OVER(PARTITION BY COALESCE(p.playerid::text, d.playerid::text), pt.year) AS avg_regular_season_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) FILTER (WHERE awp.award IS NOT NULL) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(c.won) AS max_coach_wins, SUM(t.won) AS total_team_wins_linked, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sp.round, ', ') AS playoff_rounds_participated FROM players p FULL OUTER JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::text = d.playerid::text LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::text = ap.playerid::text LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::text = pt.playerid::text AND ap.season_id = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::text = awp.playerid::text AND ap.season_id = awp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::text = sp.tmidwinner::text OR t.tmid::text = sp.tmidloser::text WHERE ap.points > 38.69 AND pt.points > 1544.04 AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1987.46 AND 1955.7 AND t.year BETWEEN 1959.49 AND 1964.51 GROUP BY COALESCE(p.playerid::text, d.playerid::text), p.lastname, p.firstname, d.draftyear, ap.season_id, ap.points, pt.year, pt.points, awp.award, c.won, t.won, sp.round HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1383.08 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 10.32 ORDER BY total_allstar_points_per_season DESC, avg_regular_season_points_per_year DESC;

SELECT a.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) AS distinct_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS distinct_teams, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pa.rebounds) AS avg_allstar_rebounds, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_regular_rebounds FROM awards_players a JOIN players p ON a.playerid = p.id JOIN player_allstar pa ON a.playerid = pa.playerid AND a.year = pa.season_id JOIN players_teams pt ON a.playerid = pt.playerid AND a.year = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::text = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year WHERE a.year >= 2009 AND a.year <= 1991 AND pt.points > 2317 GROUP BY a.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) > 4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 19 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, distinct_awards DESC;

SELECT a.year, a.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(CASE WHEN a.award LIKE '%MVP%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mvp_count, SUM(CASE WHEN a.award LIKE '%All-Star%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS all_star_count, COUNT(*) AS total_awards, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_season_points FROM awards_players a JOIN players p ON a.playerid::integer = p.id JOIN players_teams ps ON a.playerid = ps.playerid AND a.year = ps.year WHERE a.year >= 1962 AND a.year <= 2005 AND ps.points > 85 GROUP BY a.year, a.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(*) > 20 ORDER BY total_awards DESC, avg_season_points DESC;

SELECT p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year FROM players p INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2011.98 AND pt.points > 11.24 GROUP BY p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1797.2 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname AS first_name, p.lastname AS last_name, p.pos AS position, p.college AS college, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_post_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, SUM(CASE WHEN t.playoff = 'Y' THEN t.won ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_wins_by_teams_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pos ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_by_position, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p INNER JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 1972 AND p.lastseason <= 1957 AND pa.points > 18 AND (pt.points > 761 OR pt.points IS NULL) AND t.year BETWEEN 2001 AND 1949 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, pt.year HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 80.27 AND SUM(pt.points) > 19825 ORDER BY total_regular_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, 'award' AS category, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_count FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 2010 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname UNION ALL SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, 'allstar' AS category, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS allstar_count FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid WHERE pa.season_id >= 1974 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname ORDER BY player_id, category;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, pt.year AS season_year, pt.tmid AS team_id, t.name AS team_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, AVG(pt.assists * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_assists_per_game, AVG(pt.rebounds * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_rebounds_per_game, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.season_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS allstar_game_appearances, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_per_season, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS overall_points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS previous_season_points, LEAD(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS next_season_points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid = p.id AND ap2.award LIKE '%MVP%' AND ap2.year = pt.year) AS mvp_awards_count, (SELECT AVG(d.draftoverall) FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.id AND d.draftyear <= pt.year) AS avg_draft_position, (SELECT MAX(c.won) FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = pt.tmid AND c.year = pt.year) AS team_coach_max_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::text = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2005 AND 2008 AND pt.points > 391 AND pt.gp >= 65 AND t.won > 82 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, p.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 829 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) <= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, season_year ASC, player_name;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, SUM(pt.points) AS total_career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid::character varying = p.playerid AND ap.award LIKE '%All-Star%' AND ap.year >= 1950) AS all_star_appearances_since_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pos ORDER BY AVG(pt.points) DESC) AS pos_avg_points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (ORDER BY p.playerid) AS prev_player_career_points, (SELECT MIN(draft.draftoverall) FROM draft WHERE draft.playerid::character varying = p.playerid AND draft.draftyear <= 2014) AS earliest_draft_pick, (SELECT AVG(pa.points) FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid::character varying = p.playerid AND pa.season_id BETWEEN 1953 AND 1987) AS avg_allstar_points_in_range, MAX(teams.won) AS max_team_wins_in_season, MIN(teams.lost) AS min_team_losses_in_season, SUM(teams.o_pts) AS total_team_offensive_points, COUNT(DISTINCT teams.tmid) AS distinct_teams_played_for FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams ON pt.tmid = teams.tmid::integer AND pt.year = teams.year LEFT JOIN draft ON p.playerid = draft.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.points > 428 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1979 AND (p.college IS NOT NULL OR p.highschool IS NOT NULL) AND teams.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 47821 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 5 ORDER BY total_career_points DESC, avg_points_per_season DESC LIMIT 563;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, ROUND(AVG(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)), 2) AS avg_points_per_game, ROUND(AVG(pt.assists::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)), 2) AS avg_assists_per_game, ROUND(AVG(pt.rebounds::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)), 2) AS avg_rebounds_per_game, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid::integer = p.id AND ap.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_awards_count, (SELECT AVG(pa.points) FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid::integer = p.id AND pa.season_id >= 1995) AS avg_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1991 AND 2020 AND pt.points > 2910 AND t.won > 18 AND (c.won > 27 OR c.post_wins > 2) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, p.id HAVING AVG(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) > 7.16 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 9 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, avg_points_per_game DESC;

SELECT p.playerid AS playerid, p.firstname AS first_name, p.lastname AS last_name, pt.year AS season_year, pt.lgid AS league_id, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_blocks, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)::float) AS points_per_minute, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for_count, MAX(ap.season_id) AS latest_allstar_season, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.season_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS allstar_games_played, SUM(d.draftoverall) AS draft_overall_sum, MIN(d.draftyear) AS earliest_draft_year, AVG(c.won::float / NULLIF((c.won + c.lost), 0)) AS coach_win_percentage, SUM(sp.w) AS playoff_series_wins, SUM(sp.l) AS playoff_series_losses FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser) AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.year >= 1988 AND pt.year <= 1985 AND pt.points > 3912 AND (t.lgid = 'ABA' OR t.lgid IS NULL) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.lgid, t.name), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.lgid), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname), (pt.year, pt.lgid, t.name), (pt.year, pt.lgid), (pt.year), () ) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 32702 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 47 ORDER BY total_points DESC, season_year ASC, league_id ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(pt.points) AS max_team_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE (pa.points > 14.05 OR pa.rebounds > 27.0) AND NOT (pt.lgid = 'NBA' AND pt.year < 2000.34) AND pa.minutes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pa.points) >= 28.28 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 5.35 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.season_id) AS allstar_seasons FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.playerid::integer = ps.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND ps.season_id = ap.year WHERE ap.award = 'All-Star' AND ps.season_id IN (SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'All-Star' AND lgid = 'NBA' AND year > 2000) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(ps.points) > 16.7 ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1999 AND pt.year <= 2003 AND pt.minutes > 3966 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.points) > '5.0' AND SUM(pt.assists) > 1190 ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) AS total_points, COALESCE(SUM(pt.assists), 0) AS total_assists, COALESCE(SUM(pt.rebounds), 0) AS total_rebounds, COALESCE(AVG(ps.points), 0) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.rebounds), 0) DESC) AS rebounds_rank FROM players p LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.playerid::integer = ps.playerid AND t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.points > 856 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2014 AND 1996 AND t.won > 74 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) > 3901 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 5 UNION SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) AS total_points, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postassists), 0) AS total_assists, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postrebounds), 0) AS total_rebounds, COALESCE(AVG(ps.points), 0) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.postrebounds), 0) DESC) AS rebounds_rank FROM players p LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.playerid::integer = ps.playerid AND pt.year = ps.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.postpoints > 371 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1997 AND t.won > 49 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) > 7431 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE ap.year >= 2017 AND pt.points > 25 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 20.51 ORDER BY award_count DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1997 AND pt.year <= 1960 AND ap.year >= 1966 AND ap.year <= 1986 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 41106 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 8 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE pa.year >= 1996 AND pa.points > 1640 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 4874 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 1950 AND p.lastseason <= 1950 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 9169 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 100.0) AS points_per_100_min, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS total_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.lgid ORDER BY AVG(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank_in_league FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2003 AND pt.minutes > 15758 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid::integer AND sp.year = pt.year AND sp.round = 'Conf. Finals' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0 ) AND pt.lgid IN ('NBA', 'NBA') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 45169 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 6 ORDER BY total_points DESC, allstar_seasons DESC LIMIT 44;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2015 AND pt.year <= 1988 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 17543 ORDER BY career_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(a.award) AS award_count FROM players p JOIN awards_players a ON p.playerid = a.playerid::character varying WHERE a.year >= 2017 AND a.year <= 1989 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(a.award) > 4 ORDER BY award_count DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 1981 AND pa.season_id >= 1983 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) > 6 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS allstar_career_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(CAST(pa.points AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(pa.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pa.season_id = aw.year WHERE (pa.points > 1 AND pa.minutes > 28) OR (pa.assists > 0 AND pa.rebounds > 14) AND NOT (pa.personal_fouls > 6) AND aw.award = 'All-NBA' AND pa.league_id = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 327 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) >= 8 ORDER BY allstar_career_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pa.season_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_avg_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying JOIN awards_players ap ON pa.playerid = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE pa.points > 18.15 AND ap.year BETWEEN 1997 AND 2014 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pa.points, pa.season_id HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 96.97 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ap.league_id = 'NBA' THEN ap.three_made ELSE 0 END), 0) AS nba_allstar_threes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players awp WHERE awp.playerid::integer = p.playerid::integer AND awp.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_count, t.name AS team_name, t.won AS team_wins, t.lost AS team_losses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) DESC) AS seasons_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::character varying = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year WHERE pt.year >= 1966 AND pt.year <= 2005 AND pt.points > 897 AND t.won > 69 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.won, t.lost HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 18737 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 12 ORDER BY career_points DESC, avg_minutes_per_game DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 579 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2010 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 33553 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1983 AND pt.year <= 2013 AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 13103 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year IN (SELECT year FROM coaches WHERE coachid = 'a') AND pt.points > 2389 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 7574 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, MAX(t.won) AS max_team_wins, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) DESC) AS awards_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1967 AND pt.year <= 2015 AND t.won > 44 AND pt.points > 545 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 35843 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 10 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 2008 AND pt.points > 435 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 44645 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1984 AND pt.points > 11 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 31961 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 2020 AND pt.year <= 1984 AND pt.points > 16 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 18867 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.points > 2 AND pt.year >= 2001 AND pt.year <= 2008 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 9908 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 14 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2003 AND 1999 AND t.won > 64 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 15.57 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.lgid ORDER BY AVG(pt.points) DESC) AS league_avg_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid::integer JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.year >= 1954 AND pt.year <= 1953 AND pt.points > 12 AND pa.points > 32 AND t.won > 65 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 12961 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 24 ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 1451 AND t.year >= 1947 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 20954 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.year >= 2008 THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS recent_points, COUNT(CASE WHEN pt.lgid = 'NBA' THEN 1 END) AS league_games FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1958 AND 2005 AND pt.points > 774 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 10192 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, COUNT(DISTINCT apw.award) AS unique_award_count, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players apw ON ap.playerid = apw.playerid AND ap.season_id = apw.year JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE ap.season_id >= 1956 AND ap.season_id <= 1985 AND (pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) > 42.32 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT apw.award) >= 7 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, MAX(ap.season_id) AS last_allstar_year, MIN(ap.season_id) AS first_allstar_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) DESC) AS allstar_seasons_rank, SUM(ap.points) / NULLIF(SUM(ap.minutes), 0) AS points_per_minute_allstar, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players awp WHERE awp.playerid = p.id AND awp.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_awards_count, (SELECT MAX(draft.draftoverall) FROM draft WHERE draft.playerid = p.id) AS best_draft_position, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT coaches.coachid) FROM coaches JOIN players_teams pt2 ON coaches.tmid = pt2.tmid AND coaches.year = pt2.year WHERE pt2.playerid = p.id AND coaches.won > 40) AS coaches_with_wins_above_threshold FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.lgid = t.lgid JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.id = aw.playerid AND aw.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE p.height > '150.0' AND p.weight BETWEEN 157 AND 213 AND (ap.points > 47 OR pt.points > 345) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = pt.tmid::integer AND c.year = pt.year AND c.won > 47) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_coaches ac WHERE ac.coachid::integer = (SELECT c2.coachid::integer FROM coaches c2 WHERE c2.tmid = pt.tmid::integer AND c2.year = pt.year LIMIT 1) AND ac.year = pt.year AND ac.award = 'Coach of the Year')) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight, p.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 18 AND SUM(ap.points) > 40 AND AVG(pt.points) > 17 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, allstar_seasons DESC LIMIT 53;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight, p.pos, p.college, p.birthdate, p.birthcountry, p.highschool, p.hscity, p.hsstate, p.hscountry, p.race, p.deathdate, p.usefirst, p.middlename, p.namenick, p.namesuffix, p.namegiven, p.fullgivenname, p.firstseason, p.lastseason, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS player_awards, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ac.award, ', ' ORDER BY ac.award) AS coach_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, SUM(pt.gp) AS total_games_played, SUM(pt.gs) AS total_games_started, SUM(pt.minutes) AS total_minutes, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_blocks, SUM(pt.turnovers) AS total_turnovers, SUM(pt.pf) AS total_personal_fouls, SUM(pt.fgmade) AS total_fg_made, SUM(pt.fgattempted) AS total_fg_attempted, SUM(pt.ftmade) AS total_ft_made, SUM(pt.ftattempted) AS total_ft_attempted, SUM(pt.threemade) AS total_three_made, SUM(pt.threeattempted) AS total_three_attempted, SUM(pt.postgp) AS total_postseason_games, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_postseason_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS teams_played_for, SUM(t.won) AS total_team_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS total_team_losses, AVG(t.attendance) AS avg_team_attendance, SUM(s.w) AS total_playoff_series_wins, SUM(s.l) AS total_playoff_series_losses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_percentile, CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.steals) DESC) AS steals_cume_dist, SUM(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.pos ORDER BY p.lastseason ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_points_by_position FROM players p LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON p.playerid = ac.coachid::character varying INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying INNER JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN series_post s ON t.tmid = s.tmidwinner::character varying AND t.year = s.year WHERE p.height > 184.79 AND p.weight BETWEEN 114.47 AND 286.57 AND p.firstseason >= 1951 AND p.lastseason <= 1995 AND pt.points > 1691 AND t.won > 7 AND t.attendance > 1803393 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight, p.pos, p.college, p.birthdate, p.birthcountry, p.highschool, p.hscity, p.hsstate, p.hscountry, p.race, p.deathdate, p.usefirst, p.middlename, p.namenick, p.namesuffix, p.namegiven, p.fullgivenname, p.firstseason, p.lastseason HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 5893 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 21 AND AVG(pa.points) > 25.1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_rebounds DESC, total_assists DESC LIMIT 441;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight, p.pos, p.college, p.birthdate, p.birthcountry, p.highschool, p.hscity, p.hsstate, p.hscountry, p.usefirst, p.firstseason, p.lastseason, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_blocks, SUM(pt.turnovers) AS AVG(pt.assists * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.turnovers, 0)) AS ast_to_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(ps.points) AS max_allstar_points, MAX(ps.assists) AS max_allstar_assists, MAX(ps.rebounds) AS max_allstar_rebounds, MAX(ps.steals) AS max_allstar_steals, MAX(ps.blocks) AS max_allstar_blocks, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_won, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, MAX(d.draftyear) AS draft_year, MAX(t.won) AS max_team_wins, MAX(t.lost) AS max_team_losses, MAX(t.attendance) AS max_team_attendance, MAX(t.o_pts) AS max_team_off_pts, MAX(t.d_pts) AS max_team_def_pts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.steals) DESC) AS steals_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.blocks) DESC) AS blocks_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) DESC) AS ppm_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(pt.assists * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.turnovers, 0)) DESC) AS ast_to_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.playerid = ps.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = ps.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying WHERE (pt.points > 47 OR pt.assists > 0 OR pt.rebounds > 28 OR pt.steals > 5 OR pt.blocks > 8) AND pt.year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2001 AND (p.height > '150.0' OR p.weight > 108) AND (p.birthcountry = 'USA' OR p.hscountry = 'USA') AND (p.college IS NOT NULL OR p.highschool IS NOT NULL) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND ap2.award = 'Most Valuable Player')) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t.id OR sp.tmidloser = t.id)) AND (pt.tmid IN (SELECT pt2.tmid FROM players_teams pt2 WHERE pt2.playerid = pt.playerid AND pt2.year > pt.year - 3 GROUP BY pt2.tmid HAVING SUM(pt2.points) > 1495)) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight, p.pos, p.college, p.birthdate, p.birthcountry, p.highschool, p.hscity, p.hsstate, p.hscountry, p.usefirst, p.firstseason, p.lastseason HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 46058 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 6613 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 6230 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 9 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 13 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_assists DESC, total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight, p.pos, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND ap.year >= 2018) AS mvp_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE p.height > '150.0' AND p.weight BETWEEN 125 AND 216 AND pt.year = 1947 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight, p.pos, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists ORDER BY pt.points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coaches c WHERE c.coachid::integer = p.id AND c.won > 64) AS coaching_wins_above_threshold, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pos ORDER BY AVG(pa.points) DESC) AS pos_points_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND t.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser WHERE p.firstseason >= 2013 AND p.lastseason <= 1995 AND pa.points > 55 AND pt.minutes > 1914 AND (t.won > 62 OR t.won IS NULL) AND sp.year BETWEEN 2021 AND 1967 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, p.id HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 46.15 AND SUM(pt.points) > 46423 ORDER BY total_regular_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT ap2.season_id) AS allstar_seasons_with_award, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(ap.rebounds) AS total_allstar_rebounds, AVG(ap.rebounds) AS avg_allstar_rebounds, SUM(ap.assists) AS total_allstar_assists, AVG(ap.assists) AS avg_allstar_assists, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, MIN(ap.points) AS min_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_regular_rebounds, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_regular_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_regular_assists, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_regular_assists, MAX(pt.points) AS max_regular_points, MIN(pt.points) AS min_regular_points, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_pick, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS worst_draft_pick, COUNT(DISTINCT ap3.award) AS distinct_awards, COUNT(ap3.award) AS total_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award) AS coach_awards_count, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins, SUM(c.lost) AS total_coach_losses, AVG(c.won::numeric / NULLIF(c.won + c.lost, 0)) AS avg_coach_win_pct, SUM(t.won) AS total_team_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS total_team_losses, AVG(t.won::numeric / NULLIF(t.won + t.lost, 0)) AS avg_team_win_pct, SUM(t.o_pts) AS total_team_points_for, SUM(t.d_pts) AS total_team_points_against, AVG(t.o_pts - t.d_pts) AS avg_team_point_diff, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.year) AS playoff_series_appearances, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t.id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_series_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidloser = t.id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_series_losses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS regular_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap3.award) DESC) AS awards_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pos ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS pos_points_rank FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap2 ON ap.playerid = ap2.playerid AND ap.season_id = ap2.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap3 ON p.playerid = ap3.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid = ac.coachid::character varying AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser WHERE ap.points > 18.03 AND ap.rebounds > 12.28 AND ap.assists > 0.03 AND pt.points > 1780.84 AND pt.rebounds > 856.67 AND pt.assists > 350.89 AND t.won > 51.22 AND t.lost > 43.99 AND c.won > 31.75 AND c.lost > 60.52 AND ap3.year > 1992.28 AND d.draftyear > 1996.25 AND sp.year > 2022.25 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 14.91 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 5.91 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap3.award) > 5.66 AND SUM(ap.points) > 441.39 AND SUM(pt.points) > 10019.97 AND SUM(t.won) > 3425.61 AND SUM(c.won) > 1417.25 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, total_regular_points DESC, distinct_awards DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_ppg, AVG(pt.assists * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_apg, AVG(pt.rebounds * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_rpg, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_by_year_league, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON pt.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND pt.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year WHERE pt.points > 874 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1990 AND 1997 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 14761 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) <= 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, points_rank_by_year_league;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award LIKE '%MVP%') as award_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 546 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2010 AND 1997 ORDER BY pt.points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid) AS avg_team_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1966 AND pt.points > 2129 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1495 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid) AS avg_team_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2015 AND pt.points > 2037 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1565 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid) AS avg_team_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2018 AND pt.year <= 1980 AND pt.points > 2791 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1183 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2020 AND 1978 AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' AND pt.gp >= 3 AND t.playoff = 'Y' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 169 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 423 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 4 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_season_league, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS previous_season_points, SUM(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_career_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (pt.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR pt.tmid = sp.tmidloser) AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE pt.year >= 1961 AND pt.year <= 1997 AND pt.gp >= 21 AND t.won >= 76 AND (p.height >= '150.0' OR p.height IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2575 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.lgid) >= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, points_rank_in_season_league;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, ap.points AS allstar_points, ap.rebounds AS allstar_rebounds, ap.assists AS allstar_assists, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftselection, c.coachid, ac.award AS coach_award, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, sp.w AS series_wins, sp.l AS series_losses, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_by_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.id AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (pt.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR pt.tmid = sp.tmidloser) AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2013 AND 1998 AND pt.points > 2831 AND pt.rebounds > 31 AND t.won > 18 AND (ap.points > 21 OR ap.points IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.rebounds, ap.assists, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftselection, c.coachid, ac.award, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, sp.w, sp.l HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2024 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 2 AND AVG(pt.assists) > 4 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_points_per_game DESC LIMIT 18;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_per_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT year FROM coaches WHERE coachid = 'A' AND lgid = 'AA' UNION SELECT year FROM series_post WHERE tmidwinner = 376 OR tmidloser = 554 INTERSECT SELECT season_id FROM player_allstar WHERE league_id = 'AA' AND conference = 'East' ) AND pt.points > 367 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1963 AND 2012 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 16539 AND AVG(pt.assists) >= 6616 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_points_per_season DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_team_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 2002 AND pt.year <= 1998 AND pt.gp > 44 AND t.won > 74 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1126 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 64 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid, pt.lgid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, SUM(CASE WHEN c.post_wins > c.post_losses THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS winning_postseasons FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year AND pt.lgid = c.lgid LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.year >= 1967 AND pt.year <= 1952 AND pt.points >= 947 AND t.won >= 57 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 24999 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) <= 9 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, t.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_ppg, AVG(pt.assists * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_apg, AVG(pt.rebounds * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_rpg, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank_in_league_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank_in_league_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) FILTER (WHERE ap.award IS NOT NULL) AS distinct_awards_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid AND sp.year = pt.year) AS team_playoff_series_wins, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = pt.tmid AND c.year = pt.year AND c.won > c.lost) AS winning_coach_stints FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying AND d.draftyear = p.firstseason LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 1988 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND pt.gp >= 30 AND pt.points >= 1706 AND (p.college = 'University of California, Los Angeles' OR p.college IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 47380 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 1729 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 19054 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC, total_assists DESC, total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, MIN(d.draftyear) AS draft_year, MAX(c.won) AS max_coach_wins, (SUM(pt.points) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pt.fgattempted), 0)) AS points_per_attempt FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid::integer = c.tmid::integer AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year >= 2019 AND pt.year <= 1994 AND pt.points > 5613 AND t.won > 24 AND (c.won > 52 OR c.won IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, pt.tmid, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 41273 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 3089 ORDER BY total_points DESC, team_points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, pt.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_player_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award) AS distinct_coach_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS distinct_draft_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, MAX(ap.year) AS latest_award_year, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_by_year, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS team_losses, (SUM(t.won) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(t.won) + SUM(t.lost), 0)) * 100 AS team_win_percentage FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON ac.coachid::integer = pt.tmid AND ac.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND c.year = pt.year WHERE pt.points > 1163.19 AND pt.year >= 2008.29 AND pt.year <= 1971.33 AND t.won >= 21.51 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, pt.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 37.29 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award) <= 40.62 AND COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) > 41.05 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank_by_year ASC, team_win_percentage DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, pt.year, pt.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.season_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS allstar_appearances, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_pick, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_by_year_league, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points, SUM(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3yr_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.year >= 1953 AND pt.points > 377 AND t.won > 14 AND (ap.points IS NULL OR ap.points > 20) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, pt.year, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3542 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 30 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, points_rank_by_year_league ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, SUM(sp.w) AS series_wins, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, SUM(t.o_pts) AS team_offensive_points, SUM(t.d_pts) AS team_defensive_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner WHERE pt.points > 2515.38 AND pt.year >= 1966 AND pt.year <= 2021 AND t.won >= 15.36 AND c.won >= 51.86 AND sp.w >= 2.29 AND pa.points >= 44.8 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 9021.65 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 1607.36 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 19019.91 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) >= 21 AND COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) >= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_assists DESC, total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.firstname, p1.lastname, pt1.year AS team_year, pt1.tmid AS team_id, pt1.points AS regular_points, pt1.postpoints AS playoff_points, ap.season_id AS allstar_season, ap.points AS allstar_points, d.draftyear, d.draftround, c.coachid, c.won AS coach_wins, c.lost AS coach_losses, ac.award AS coach_award, t.name AS team_name, t.won AS team_wins, t.lost AS team_losses, sp.tmidwinner AS series_winner, sp.tmidloser AS series_loser, COUNT(DISTINCT pt2.playerid) AS teammates_count, AVG(pt2.points) AS avg_teammate_points, SUM(pt1.points + pt1.postpoints) AS total_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt1.year ORDER BY (pt1.points + pt1.postpoints) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p1 JOIN players_teams pt1 ON p1.id = pt1.playerid JOIN players_teams pt2 ON pt1.tmid = pt2.tmid AND pt1.year = pt2.year AND pt1.playerid != pt2.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt1.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt1.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p1.id = ap.playerid AND pt1.year = ap.season_id JOIN draft d ON p1.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt1.points > 2954 AND pt1.postpoints > 811 AND t.won > 77 AND ap.points > 25 AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1965 AND 1955 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.firstname, p1.lastname, pt1.year, pt1.tmid, pt1.points, pt1.postpoints, ap.season_id, ap.points, d.draftyear, d.draftround, c.coachid, c.won, c.lost, ac.award, t.name, t.won, t.lost, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser HAVING AVG(pt2.points) > 5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt2.playerid) > 20 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT pl.playerid AS p_id, pl.firstname || ' ' || pl.lastname AS player_name, pl.pos AS position, pl.firstseason AS debut_year, pl.lastseason AS last_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) FILTER (WHERE awp.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) FILTER (WHERE awp.award LIKE '%All-Star%') AS allstar_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, SUM(pt.points) AS total_career_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_career_rebounds, AVG(pt.rebounds / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_rebounds_per_game, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_career_assists, AVG(pt.assists / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_assists_per_game, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_career_steals, AVG(pt.steals / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_steals_per_game, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_career_blocks, AVG(pt.blocks / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_blocks_per_game, SUM(pt.turnovers) AS total_career_turnovers, AVG(pt.turnovers / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_turnovers_per_game, SUM(pt.fgmade) AS total_fg_made, SUM(pt.fgattempted) AS total_fg_attempted, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.fgattempted) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(pt.fgmade) * 100.0 / SUM(pt.fgattempted), 2) ELSE 0 END AS career_fg_percentage, SUM(pt.ftmade) AS total_ft_made, SUM(pt.ftattempted) AS total_ft_attempted, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.ftattempted) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(pt.ftmade) * 100.0 / SUM(pt.ftattempted), 2) ELSE 0 END AS career_ft_percentage, SUM(pt.threemade) AS total_three_made, SUM(pt.threeattempted) AS total_three_attempted, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.threeattempted) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(pt.threemade) * 100.0 / SUM(pt.threeattempted), 2) ELSE 0 END AS career_three_percentage, MIN(d.draftyear) AS draft_year, MIN(d.draftround) AS draft_round, MIN(d.draftselection) AS draft_selection, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS draft_overall, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT t.name, ', ') AS team_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT t.arena, ', ') AS arenas_played_in, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coaches_played_under, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.tmidwinner) AS playoff_series_won_with_teams, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.tmidloser) AS playoff_series_lost_with_teams, SUM(sp.w) AS total_playoff_series_wins, SUM(sp.l) AS total_playoff_series_losses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.steals) DESC) AS steals_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.blocks) DESC) AS blocks_rank FROM players pl LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON pl.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON pl.playerid::integer = awp.playerid LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON pl.playerid::integer = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON pl.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (pt.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR pt.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser) AND pt.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year WHERE pl.firstseason >= 1952 AND pl.lastseason <= 1959 AND pl.height >= '150' AND pl.weight >= 164 AND pt.points >= 3856 AND ap.points >= 70 AND t.won >= 18 AND sp.year >= 1975 AND d.draftyear >= 2011 GROUP BY pl.playerid, pl.firstname, pl.lastname, pl.pos, pl.firstseason, pl.lastseason HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 31 AND COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) >= 36 AND SUM(pt.points) >= 27253 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) >= 5458 AND SUM(pt.assists) >= 9370 AND AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) >= '5' ORDER BY total_career_points DESC, total_career_rebounds DESC, total_career_assists DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS unique_players, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS unique_coaches, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.lgid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::character varying = p.playerid JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.lgid AND t.year = c.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND t.year = pa.season_id WHERE t.year >= 1968 AND t.won >= 37 GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 29491 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.points > 19.57) AS high_scorers_count FROM teams t JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::character varying = sp.tmidwinner::character varying WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1982 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.year HAVING t.won > 40.66 ORDER BY high_scorers_count DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t.year = pt.year WHERE t.year >= 1980 AND t.year <= 1958 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award LIKE '%All-Star%' LIMIT 1) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2967 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, t.name, SUM(COALESCE(pt.points, 0)) AS total_player_points, AVG(COALESCE(pt.points, 0)) AS avg_player_points, SUM(COALESCE(pt.rebounds, 0)) AS total_player_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(COALESCE(ps.points, 0)) AS total_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(pt.points, 0)) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league, LAG(SUM(COALESCE(pt.points, 0)), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id LEFT JOIN player_allstar ps ON pt.playerid = ps.playerid AND pt.year = ps.season_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1959 AND 1984 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award LIKE '%MVP%' ) AND t.lgid IN (SELECT lgid FROM coaches WHERE year = t.year AND won > 51) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, t.name HAVING AVG(COALESCE(pt.points, 0)) > 7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) >= 26 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.name, t.won, t.lost, SUM(t.o_pts) AS total_offensive_points, AVG(t.o_pts) AS avg_offensive_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS total_players_used, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid IN (SELECT pt.playerid FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year) AND ap.year = t.year AND ap.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_count_in_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.won DESC, t.lost ASC) AS team_rank_in_league, SUM(CASE WHEN p.height > (SELECT AVG(height) FROM players WHERE height IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tall_players_count, (SELECT MAX(p2.points) FROM player_allstar p2 WHERE p2.playerid IN (SELECT pt2.playerid FROM players_teams pt2 WHERE pt2.tmid = t.id AND pt2.year = t.year) AND p2.season_id = t.year) AS max_allstar_points_by_player FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.id = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1989 AND 1972 JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND ap.year = t.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND sp.year = t.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2017 AND 1968 AND t.won >= 30 AND t.o_pts >= 10415 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM players_teams pt2 WHERE pt2.tmid = t.id AND pt2.year = t.year AND pt2.points > 2406) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.lgid, t.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 34828 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) >= 2 ORDER BY total_offensive_points DESC, team_rank_in_league ASC;

SELECT a.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS career_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS career_rebounds, AVG(pt.points::float / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, SUM(CASE WHEN c.won > c.lost THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS winning_seasons_coached, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t.id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_series_wins, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM awards_players a JOIN players p ON a.playerid::text = p.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON a.playerid = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner JOIN draft d ON a.playerid = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON a.playerid = ap.playerid AND a.year = ap.season_id WHERE a.year >= 2019.94 AND a.year <= 1996.09 AND pt.year >= 2004.4 AND pt.year <= 2004.74 AND t.year >= 2001.63 AND t.year <= 1962.61 AND c.year >= 1966.8 AND c.year <= 1977.61 AND sp.year >= 2001.45 AND sp.year <= 2013.51 AND d.draftyear >= 1994.38 AND d.draftyear <= 1958.45 AND ap.season_id >= 1970.48 AND ap.season_id <= 2007.56 AND pt.points > 3483.14 AND pt.assists > 661.75 AND pt.rebounds > 2168.74 GROUP BY a.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 19007.83 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 9383.17 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 7202.07 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 15.2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) > 5.1 ORDER BY career_points DESC, career_assists DESC, career_rebounds DESC;

SELECT a.year, a.award, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS player_count, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points FROM awards_players a JOIN awards_players a2 ON a.year = a2.year AND a.playerid = a2.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON a.playerid = pa.playerid AND a.year = pa.season_id WHERE a.year >= 1989.3 AND a.year <= 1964.26 GROUP BY a.year, a.award HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) > 67.15 ORDER BY player_count DESC;

leagues_played_in, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pas.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(pas.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pas ON
