SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstseason AS first_season, p.lastseason AS last_season, ap.season_id AS allstar_season, pt.year AS team_year, pt.tmid AS team_id, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league_id, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_blocks, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.points > 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_scoring_allstar_games, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league_year, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS team_losses, MAX(t.attendance) AS max_attendance FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1989 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND pt.points > 1107 AND ap.points > 39 AND t.attendance > 1359593 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (p.playerid, p.firstseason, p.lastseason, ap.season_id, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, t.lgid), (p.playerid, p.firstseason, p.lastseason), (pt.year, t.lgid), (pt.tmid, t.name), () ) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 40866 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 15 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC LIMIT 57;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) AS total_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 1998 AND pt.year <= 1966 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname UNION ALL SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COALESCE(SUM(pas.points), 0) AS total_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar pas ON p.playerid = pas.playerid::character varying WHERE pas.season_id >= 1967 AND pas.season_id <= 1990 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, SUM(ap.year) AS total_award_years, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS highest_draft_pick, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_post_points, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS distinct_teams_played_for, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS total_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(pa.points) DESC) AS avg_allstar_points_rank FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner WHERE (p.firstseason >= 1964 AND p.lastseason <= 2005) AND (ap.year BETWEEN 2006 AND 1956) AND (d.draftyear >= 1978) AND (pa.season_id >= 1998) AND (pt.year BETWEEN 1982 AND 1970) AND (t.year = pt.year) AND (c.year = t.year) AND (ac.year = c.year) AND (sp.year = t.year) AND (p.height > '150.0' OR p.weight > 89) AND NOT (p.college IS NULL AND p.highschool IS NULL) AND (ap.award LIKE '%''%' OR ac.award LIKE '%''%') AND (t.playoff = 'Y' OR sp.round IN ('Finals', 'Conference Finals')) AND (pt.gp > 0 AND pa.games_played > 0) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 5422 AND AVG(pa.points) > 17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) >= 47 ORDER BY total_points_rank, avg_allstar_points_rank LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_award_types, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, SUM(CASE WHEN c.coachid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coached_seasons FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON p.playerid::integer = c.coachid::integer WHERE pt.year >= 1987 AND pt.year <= 1988 AND pa.season_id >= 1980 AND pa.season_id <= 2016 AND pt.points > 992 AND pa.points > 72 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 29299 AND AVG(pa.points) > 49 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 4 ORDER BY career_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN awards_players aw ON p.id = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year WHERE pt.points > 3062 AND ap.points BETWEEN 22 AND 44 AND (pt.minutes >= 168 OR pt.gp > 26) AND NOT (ap.three_attempted < 2 AND ap.three_made > 2) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 8 AND AVG(ap.points) > 23 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.year >= 1979 AND pt.year <= 1966 AND pt.points > 745 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 20 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.year >= 1953 AND pt.year <= 1963 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 36667 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 2021 AND p.lastseason <= 2023 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 20736 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id WHERE pt.year >= 1961 AND pt.year <= 2001 AND pt.points > 68 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 20 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS distinct_teams_played_for, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE ap.points > 38.81 AND pt.year >= 1953.77 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 19.98 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE ap.year >= 1985 AND pt.points > 46 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) > 10 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 1991 AND pt.year <= 2008 AND ap.year >= 1982 AND ap.year <= 1994 AND d.draftyear >= 2005 AND d.draftyear <= 2000 AND pt.points > 4456 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 11692 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 24 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2014 AND pt.year <= 1998 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND ap.award = 'All-NBA First Team' LIMIT 1) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 24295 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1976 AND pt.year <= 1971 AND pt.points > 230 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 36210 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 2453.5 AND pt.year >= 2002.69 AND pt.year <= 1972.82 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND lgid = 'NBA' ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4517 ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year IN (SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'All-NBA First Team') AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 6398.24 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 1979 AND pt.year <= 2019 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = pt.playerid AND d.draftyear < 1982 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 11839 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2000 AND pt.year <= 1997 AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > (SELECT AVG(points) FROM players_teams WHERE year = 2007 AND lgid = 'NBA') ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1985 AND pt.year <= 1999 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > (SELECT AVG(points) FROM players_teams WHERE year = 1964) ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1976 AND pt.year <= 1982 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 29847 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1976 AND pt.year <= 2003 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 38629 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2009 AND pt.year <= 2017 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 28269 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 21 AND pt.year >= 2002 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 19826 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE (pt.points > 8 OR pt.rebounds > 28) AND NOT (pt.assists < 4 AND pt.turnovers > 5) AND pt.year BETWEEN 1971 AND 1959 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4280 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.year >= 2007 THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS recent_points, COUNT(CASE WHEN pt.lgid = 'NBA' THEN 1 END) AS league_seasons FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2008 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 46758 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(CAST(pt.points AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year) AS awards_count_per_year, (SELECT AVG(ps.points) FROM player_allstar ps WHERE ps.playerid = p.id AND ps.season_id = pt.year) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1969 AND 1970 AND pt.gp > 48 AND t.won > 43 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.id, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 450 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 223 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_assists DESC LIMIT 68;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pos ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS scoring_rank_by_position, SUM(t.o_pts) AS total_team_offensive_points, SUM(t.d_pts) AS total_team_defensive_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid = ac.coachid::character varying AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 718.01 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1988.52 AND 1992.0 AND t.won > 38.19 AND pa.points >= 27.82 AND ac.award IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 20794.73 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 35.03 ORDER BY total_points DESC, scoring_rank_by_position;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year) AS total_points_year, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year) AS avg_points_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 2450.62 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1982.3 AND 1954.46 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points HAVING COUNT(ap.award) >= 5.12 ORDER BY pt.year, points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(*) AS games_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 40 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2020 AND t.won > 35 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1828 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS rank_in_team FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points >= 657 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 1972 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4556 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1998 AND pt.year <= 1969 AND pt.points > 951 AND pt.gp >= 92 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4652 AND AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) > 36.24 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, SUM(pt.points) - SUM(ap.points) AS point_diff FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id JOIN awards_players aw ON p.id = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year WHERE p.height > 206.67 AND p.weight > 87.34 AND ap.season_id >= 1955.58 AND ap.season_id <= 2001.34 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, ap.season_id HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 396.16 AND AVG(ap.points) > 30.97 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 11.56 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.year AS year1, p2.year AS year2, (p2.points - p1.points) AS points_increase, p1.tmid FROM players_teams p1 JOIN players_teams p2 ON p1.playerid = p2.playerid AND p1.tmid = p2.tmid AND p1.year < p2.year WHERE p1.points > 2791 AND p2.points > 1667 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.year, p2.year, p1.tmid, p1.points, p2.points HAVING (p2.points - p1.points) > 596 ORDER BY points_increase DESC;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points AS regular_points, p2.points AS allstar_points, (p1.points - p2.points) AS point_diff, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p1.year ORDER BY (p1.points - p2.points) DESC) AS diff_rank FROM players_teams p1 JOIN player_allstar p2 ON p1.playerid = p2.playerid AND p1.year = p2.season_id WHERE p1.points > 203.94 AND p2.points > 53.63 AND p1.year BETWEEN 1957.55 AND 2002.16 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points, p2.points HAVING COUNT(p1.stint) >= 2.2 ORDER BY point_diff DESC;

SELECT t.lgid AS league, t.year AS season, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS distinct_players, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS distinct_teams, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_player, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.year = pt.year AND t.lgid = pt.lgid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::text = p.playerid WHERE t.year >= 2017 AND t.year <= 1967 AND t.won > 73 AND pt.minutes > 3434 GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) > 423 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, p.playerid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid = p.id AND ap2.award = 'MVP' AND ap2.year >= 1976) AS mvp_count, (SELECT AVG(c.won) FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND c.year BETWEEN 1984 AND 2012) AS avg_coach_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND d.draftyear = p.firstseason JOIN awards_players ap3 ON p.id = ap3.playerid AND ap3.year = pt.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON ac.coachid::integer = (SELECT c2.coachid::integer FROM coaches c2 WHERE c2.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND c2.year = pt.year LIMIT 1) AND ac.year = pt.year JOIN series_post sp ON (sp.tmidwinner::integer = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser::integer = pt.tmid) AND sp.year = pt.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1979 AND 2012 AND pt.points > 711 AND pt.minutes > 1933 AND t.won > 23 AND (ap.league_id = 'NBA' OR ap.league_id IS NULL) AND p.height > '150.0' AND p.weight BETWEEN 187 AND 106 AND (d.draftround IS NULL OR d.draftround <= 10) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM players_teams pt2 WHERE pt2.playerid = p.id AND pt2.year < t.year AND pt2.points > 2924) GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year, p.playerid, p.id, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 5679 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC, t.year, t.lgid;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, pt.year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::text = p.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2018 AND pt.points > 68 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (t.tmid, t.lgid, pt.year), (t.tmid, t.lgid), (t.lgid, pt.year), (t.tmid), (t.lgid), (pt.year), () ) ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY t.won DESC) AS win_rank FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year WHERE t.year >= 2016 AND t.year <= 1987 AND (t.won > 7 OR t.lost < 18) AND NOT (t.lgid = 'NBA' AND t.confid = 'East') GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 48399 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.id) AS coach_award_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS player_award_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, SUM(d.draftoverall) AS total_draft_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points FROM teams t JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN draft d ON pt.playerid = d.playerid AND d.draftyear = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1967 AND 1969 AND t.attendance > 914202 AND pt.points > 3958 AND pa.points > 99 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 59536 AND AVG(pt.points) > 37.92 ORDER BY total_team_points DESC, t.year;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.id) AS coach_award_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS player_award_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, SUM(d.draftoverall) AS total_draft_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points FROM teams t JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN draft d ON pt.playerid = d.playerid AND d.draftyear = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1987 AND 2002 AND t.attendance > 624426 AND pt.points > 1304 AND pa.points > 71 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 40265 AND AVG(pt.points) > 11.65 ORDER BY total_team_points DESC, t.year;

SELECT t.year, t.tmid, t.name, AVG(t.won::numeric / t.games) AS win_rate, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_points_3yr, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS league_points_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players_count, MAX(CASE WHEN ac.award = 'Coach of the Year' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_coach_of_year FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND t.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND t.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND t.year = ac.year WHERE t.year >= 1962 AND t.year <= 1999 AND t.attendance >= 784757 AND pt.points >= 4824 GROUP BY t.year, t.tmid, t.name, t.lgid HAVING AVG(t.won::numeric / t.games) > 0.43 AND SUM(pt.points) > 405286 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t1.lgid, t1.year, t1.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.coachid) AS award_coaches, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.lgid ORDER BY t1.year) AS prev_year_points FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year AND t1.tmid <> t2.tmid JOIN players_teams pt ON t1.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t1.year = pt.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN coaches c ON t1.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t1.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN draft d ON pt.playerid = d.playerid AND pt.year = d.draftyear JOIN series_post sp ON t1.tmid = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND t1.year = sp.year WHERE t1.won > 35.01 AND t1.games > 13.43 AND pt.points > 2988.32 AND pa.points > 5.21 AND ap.award = 'MVP' AND ac.award = 'Coach of the Year' AND d.draftround > 8.3 AND sp.w > 1.75 GROUP BY t1.lgid, t1.year, t1.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 33266.99 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) > 24.71 ORDER BY t1.lgid, t1.year, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.name, t1.won, t1.lost, t1.o_pts, t1.d_pts, t2.won AS t2_won, t2.lost AS t2_lost, t2.o_pts AS t2_o_pts, t2.d_pts AS t2_d_pts, (t1.o_pts - t1.d_pts) AS t1_net_rating, (t2.o_pts - t2.d_pts) AS t2_net_rating, AVG(t1.o_pts + t1.d_pts) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.year) AS avg_combined_pts_per_year FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.year = t2.year AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.tmid < t2.tmid JOIN players_teams pt ON pt.tmid = t1.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t1.year WHERE t1.year >= 2023 AND t1.o_pts >= 11999 GROUP BY t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.name, t1.won, t1.lost, t1.o_pts, t1.d_pts, t2.won, t2.lost, t2.o_pts, t2.d_pts HAVING COUNT(pt.playerid) > 1 ORDER BY t1.year DESC, t1_net_rating DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.won, t2.attendance, t1.o_pts, t2.d_pts, (t1.o_pts - t2.d_pts) AS net_pts_diff FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year WHERE t1.won > 12.62 AND t2.attendance > 460554.23 GROUP BY t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.won, t2.attendance, t1.o_pts, t2.d_pts HAVING (t1.o_pts - t2.d_pts) > 874.08 ORDER BY net_pts_diff DESC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS full_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_points, AVG(ap.assists) AS avg_allstar_assists, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS total_points_rank, LEAD(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (ORDER BY p.playerid) AS next_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pt.lgid = 'NBA' THEN pt.tmid END) AS nba_teams_played_for FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::INTEGER = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::INTEGER = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::VARCHAR = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::INTEGER = awp.playerid AND ap.season_id = awp.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner::VARCHAR AND t.year = sp.year WHERE p.height > 199.68 AND pt.gp >= 20.66 AND ap.games_played >= 40.21 AND t.won > 11.72 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2013.37 AND 1973.53 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 9.17 AND SUM(pt.points) > 29566.41 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS full_name, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_position, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.assists) AS avg_allstar_assists, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, LEAD(SUM(ap.points)) OVER (ORDER BY p.playerid) AS next_player_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.lgid = 'NBA' THEN d.tmid END) AS nba_teams_drafted_by FROM players p JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::INTEGER = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::INTEGER = ap.playerid AND d.draftyear = ap.season_id JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::INTEGER = pt.playerid AND d.draftyear = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::INTEGER = awp.playerid AND d.draftyear = awp.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON pt.tmid::VARCHAR = sp.tmidwinner::VARCHAR AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE p.height > 214.45 AND d.draftoverall < 53.97 AND ap.games_played >= 29.55 AND pt.gp >= 39.7 AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 2000.45 AND 2016.79 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) > 0.71 AND SUM(ap.points) > 737.92 ORDER BY total_team_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.lastname, p.firstname, t.name AS team_name, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons_count, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, SUM(CASE WHEN awp.award = 'Most Valuable Player' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mvp_awards_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS team_assists_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 1971 AND pt.gp >= 17 AND t.attendance > 678787 AND (p.height > '150.0' OR p.weight > 98) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, t.name, pt.year, t.id, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 16814 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.lgid) >= 2 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, team_assists_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, SUM(COALESCE(ap.year, 0)) AS total_award_years FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 1982 AND d.draftyear <= 1989 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 5 ORDER BY distinct_awards_count DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid INNER JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id WHERE pt.year >= 2017 AND pt.points > 36 AND t.won > 54 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 4 AND AVG(pt.points) > 23.5 ORDER BY total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points FROM players p INNER JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.id = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE ap.points > 18.25 AND ap.season_id BETWEEN 1955.77 AND 1956.4 AND (aw.award IS NULL OR aw.award != 'All-Star') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 1.33 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE p.college LIKE '%University%' AND pt.year >= 1992 AND pt.year <= 2003 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 41983 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.points > 1931 AND pt.year >= 2011 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS distinct_team_years, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.league_id) AS distinct_allstar_leagues, COUNT(DISTINCT dp.draftyear) AS distinct_draft_years, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.three_made::numeric / NULLIF(ap.three_attempted, 0)) AS allstar_three_pct, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.threemade::numeric / NULLIF(pt.threeattempted, 0)) AS regular_three_pct, MAX(t.won) AS max_team_wins, MIN(t.lost) AS min_team_losses, SUM(CASE WHEN ac.award = 'Coach of the Year' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coach_of_year_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) DESC) AS team_years_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft dp ON p.playerid::integer = dp.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::integer = awp.playerid AND ap.season_id = awp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 2000 AND p.lastseason <= 1985 AND ap.points > 14 AND t.won > 22 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 13 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 23 AND SUM(ap.points) > 364 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, distinct_allstar_seasons DESC LIMIT 226;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(a.award) AS award_count FROM players p JOIN awards_players a ON p.playerid = a.playerid::character varying WHERE a.year >= 1965 AND a.year <= 1969 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(a.award) > 2 ORDER BY award_count DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND ap.year = pa.season_id WHERE ap.year >= 1979 AND pa.points > 11 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) > 9 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE ap.year >= 1999 AND pt.points > 336 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) > 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pa.three_made) AS avg_threes_made FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE pa.points > 27 AND pa.season_id BETWEEN 1985 AND 2017 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 207 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pa.playerid = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE pa.season_id >= 1955 AND pa.season_id <= 2011 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA First Team' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 448 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1970 AND pt.year <= 1995 AND (pt.lgid = 'NBA' OR pt.lgid IS NULL) AND NOT (ap.award = 'All-NBA') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3689 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 9 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid AND pt.year = d.draftyear WHERE pt.year IN (SELECT year FROM coaches WHERE coachid::integer = 9575 AND lgid = 'NBA') AND pt.points > 1127 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1982 AND 2016 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1188 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 27 ORDER BY career_points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 30 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2012 AND 1995 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 5166 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2014 AND pt.year <= 1994 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 5959 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 17 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1991 AND 2012 AND t.won > 35 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 12.5 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1480.09 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1954 AND 1998 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 16.6 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, COUNT(DISTINCT apw.award) AS unique_award_count, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players apw ON ap.playerid = apw.playerid AND ap.season_id = apw.year JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE ap.season_id >= 1986 AND ap.season_id <= 1980 AND (pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) > 44.77 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT apw.award) >= 10 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

total_assists, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_blocks, SUM(pt.turnovers) AS total_turnovers, SUM(pt.pf) AS total_fouls, SUM(pt.minutes) AS total_minutes, SUM(pt.gp) AS
