SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(ap.season_id) AS latest_allstar_season, COUNT(apl.award) AS award_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points, (SUM(pt.points) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pt.fgattempted), 0)) AS career_fg_percentage, (SUM(pt.ftmade) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pt.ftattempted), 0)) AS career_ft_percentage, (SUM(pt.threemade) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pt.threeattempted), 0)) AS career_three_percentage, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, c.won AS coach_wins, c.lost AS coach_losses, sp.w AS playoff_wins, sp.l AS playoff_losses FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players apl ON p.playerid::integer = apl.playerid AND pt.year = apl.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 301 AND t.year BETWEEN 1986 AND 1962 AND p.height > '150.0' AND p.weight > 64 AND t.attendance > 921021 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, t.name, t.lgid, t.year, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, c.won, c.lost, sp.w, sp.l HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 25930 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 8 ORDER BY total_points DESC, t.year, t.lgid;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) AS stint_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid::integer AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE p.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT d.playerid FROM draft d WHERE d.draftyear BETWEEN 1953 AND 1991 AND d.draftround <= 5 ) AND pt.year BETWEEN 2005 AND 1986 AND pt.points > 4 AND pt.minutes >= 3216 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1155 AND AVG(pt.minutes) >= 36 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) <= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_minutes DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1698 AND pt.year >= 1992 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points HAVING COUNT(pt.stint) >= 4 ORDER BY pt.year, points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank_in_team, LAG(SUM(pt.rebounds), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) FILTER (WHERE ap.year = pt.year) AS awards_this_year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid AND sp.year = pt.year) AS team_playoff_series_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid AND d.draftyear <= pt.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid::integer AND c.year = pt.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1974 AND 2001 AND pt.points > 2741 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 418 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) <= 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.year, t.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1966 AND pt.year <= 2005 AND pt.points > 2807 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.year, t.lgid)) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 15054 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN player_allstar ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id WHERE pt.year IN (SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND lgid = 'NBA') AND pt.points > 626.97 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 26775.3 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, pt.year, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS yearly_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2001 AND pt.year <= 1975 AND pt.points > 1884 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, pt.year, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 5761 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, pt.year, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_overall_pick FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1954 AND pt.gp > 46 AND pt.tmid IN ( SELECT tmid FROM coaches WHERE year = pt.year AND won > 60 AND lgid = 'NBA' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.year = pt.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) AND sp.round = 'Finals' ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, pt.year, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1337 AND AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) > 29.34 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, t.tmid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS awards_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1954 AND 1967 AND pt.minutes >= 2328 GROUP BY p.playerid, t.tmid, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 10696 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 19 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid, t.tmid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS awards_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2004 AND 1971 AND pt.minutes >= 733 GROUP BY p.playerid, t.tmid, t.year HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 61 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) <= 36 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, AVG(pt.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS avg_points_3_seasons, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds FROM players_teams pt JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id::integer WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1994 AND 2011 AND pt.gp >= 32 GROUP BY pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points ORDER BY pt.playerid, pt.year;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_playoff_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.postpoints) DESC) AS playoff_points_rank FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::integer = p.id JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND awp.year = pt.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND c.year = pt.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND ac.year = c.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2003 AND 2009 AND pt.points > 739 AND ap.points > 10 AND t.won > 47 AND c.won > 65 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.id AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1968 AND 2016 AND d.draftoverall < ( SELECT AVG(d2.draftoverall) FROM draft d2 WHERE d2.draftyear = d.draftyear AND d2.draftoverall IS NOT NULL ) ) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, p.id, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 15 AND SUM(pt.postpoints) > 807 ORDER BY total_playoff_points DESC, avg_regular_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_playoff_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.postpoints) DESC) AS playoff_points_rank FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::integer = p.id JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND awp.year = pt.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND c.year = pt.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND ac.year = c.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2020 AND 1960 AND pt.points > 2529 AND ap.points > 31 AND t.won > 41 AND c.won > 69 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.id AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1973 AND 2020 AND d.draftoverall < ( SELECT AVG(d2.draftoverall) FROM draft d2 WHERE d2.draftyear = d.draftyear AND d2.draftoverall IS NOT NULL ) ) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, p.id, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 28 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 15 AND SUM(pt.postpoints) > 602 ORDER BY total_playoff_points DESC, avg_regular_points DESC;

SELECT t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t.year = pt.year WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT year FROM players_teams WHERE playerid IN ( SELECT playerid FROM awards_players WHERE year BETWEEN 1962 AND 2002 ) ) GROUP BY t.name HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 15.42 ORDER BY player_count DESC;

SELECT t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, AVG(pts.points) AS avg_player_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY t.won DESC) AS team_rank_by_wins FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pts ON t.tmid::text = pts.tmid::text AND t.year = pts.year WHERE t.won > 21.53 AND t.year BETWEEN 2005.7 AND 1974.31 GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost ORDER BY t.year, team_rank_by_wins;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.won, t.lost, ROUND(t.won::DECIMAL / NULLIF(t.games, 0), 3) AS win_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count FROM teams t LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::INTEGER = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::INTEGER = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year = 1951 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE (sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid::INTEGER OR sp.tmidloser = t.tmid::INTEGER) AND sp.year = 2005 ) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.games HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) > 6 ORDER BY win_percentage DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY pt.year) AS cumulative_player_points, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid) AS avg_player_points_per_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t.won DESC) AS team_win_rank FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id::integer WHERE t.year >= 1986 AND t.o_pts > 7144 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, pt.tmid, pt.year, pt.points ORDER BY t.won DESC, t.year;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS distinct_players, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS league_points_rank, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_team_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_team_assists, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.award IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS player_awards_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = t.id AND c.year = t.year AND c.won > c.lost) AS winning_coaches_count, (SELECT AVG(d.draftoverall) FROM draft d WHERE d.tmid = t.id AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1982 AND 1969) AS avg_draft_pick FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.id = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1999 AND t.won > 27 AND pt.minutes > 3698 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, t.name, t.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 63244 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) >= 36 ORDER BY total_team_points DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, t.name, SUM(t.won) AS total_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS total_losses, AVG(t.attendance) AS avg_attendance, SUM(pts.points) AS total_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pts.playerid) AS unique_players, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS unique_coaches, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS all_star_players, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(t.won) DESC, AVG(t.attendance) DESC) AS rank_in_league, SUM(sp.w) AS playoff_series_wins, SUM(sp.l) AS playoff_series_losses, AVG(d.draftoverall) AS avg_draft_pick, COUNT(DISTINCT d.playerid) AS drafted_players FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pts ON t.tmid::integer = pts.tmid AND t.year = pts.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON pts.playerid = ap.playerid AND pts.year = ap.year AND ap.award = 'All-Star' LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON t.tmid::integer = d.tmid AND t.year = d.draftyear WHERE t.year >= 1969 AND t.year <= 2014 AND t.attendance > 4719343 AND pts.points > 47826 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.won) > 84 AND AVG(t.attendance) > 1192577 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pts.playerid) > 37 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_attendance DESC;

SELECT d.draftyear, AVG(p.height) AS avg_height, COUNT(*) AS total_players FROM draft d JOIN players p ON d.playerid = p.id WHERE d.draftyear >= 1974.04 AND p.height > 92.34 GROUP BY d.draftyear ORDER BY d.draftyear;

SELECT p.lastname, p.firstname, pt.year, pt.points, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1474 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1981 AND 1959 GROUP BY p.lastname, p.firstname, pt.year, pt.points ORDER BY pt.year, pt.points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year WHERE pa.points > 37 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1985 AND 1991 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 6719 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_award_types, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.assists) AS avg_assists, MAX(ps.w) AS max_playoff_wins FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN series_post ps ON pa.tmid = ps.tmidwinner JOIN teams t ON pa.tmid = t.id WHERE pa.year >= 2013 AND pa.points > 233 AND t.won > 53 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 24552 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 2 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year WHERE p.college LIKE '%' AND aw.award LIKE '%' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 186.05 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, (SELECT AVG(pts.o_pts) FROM teams pts WHERE pts.year = ap.season_id AND pts.lgid = ap.league_id) AS avg_league_points_per_team_that_year FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year JOIN coaches c ON ap.season_id = c.year AND ap.league_id = c.lgid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE ap.points > 39 AND ap.season_id BETWEEN 2006 AND 2002 AND aw.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, ap.league_id HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 238 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid = p.id AND pa.season_id = pt.year AND pa.points > 30 ) AND pt.year BETWEEN 2018 AND 1992 AND t.won > 40 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 6.45 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 4 ORDER BY total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS awards_list, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years_count FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id WHERE pa.points > 46.01 AND pt.year >= 1973.8 AND t.won >= 61.74 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 176.88 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 17.14 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pa.three_made) AS avg_threes_made FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE pa.points > 7 AND pa.season_id BETWEEN 2018 AND 1976 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 704 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ap.league_id = 'NBA' THEN ap.three_made ELSE 0 END), 0) AS nba_allstar_threes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players awp WHERE awp.playerid::integer = p.playerid::integer AND awp.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_count, t.name AS team_name, t.won AS team_wins, t.lost AS team_losses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) DESC) AS seasons_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::character varying = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year WHERE pt.year >= 2008 AND pt.year <= 1969 AND pt.points > 2005 AND t.won > 69 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.won, t.lost HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 34703 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 11 ORDER BY career_points DESC, avg_minutes_per_game DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2013 AND pt.year <= 1954 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1956 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1965 AND pt.year <= 1958 AND pt.points > 754 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 7995 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1973 AND pt.year <= 1997 AND pt.points > 630 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 41679 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 1996 AND pt.gp > 65 AND pt.lgid = ( SELECT lgid FROM players_teams subpt WHERE subpt.playerid = pt.playerid AND subpt.year = ( SELECT MAX(year) FROM players_teams subsubpt WHERE subsubpt.playerid = subpt.playerid ) LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 340 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight, p.pos, p.college, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(ap.rebounds) AS total_allstar_rebounds, SUM(ap.assists) AS total_allstar_assists, SUM(ap.steals) AS total_allstar_steals, SUM(ap.blocks) AS total_allstar_blocks, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, SUM(pt.points) AS total_career_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_career_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_career_assists, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_career_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_career_blocks, SUM(pt.fgmade) AS total_fgmade, SUM(pt.fgattempted) AS total_fgattempted, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.fgattempted) > 0 THEN (SUM(pt.fgmade)::DECIMAL / SUM(pt.fgattempted)) * 100 ELSE 0 END AS career_fg_percentage, SUM(pt.ftmade) AS total_ftmade, SUM(pt.ftattempted) AS total_ftattempted, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.ftattempted) > 0 THEN (SUM(pt.ftmade)::DECIMAL / SUM(pt.ftattempted)) * 100 ELSE 0 END AS career_ft_percentage, SUM(pt.threemade) AS total_threemade, SUM(pt.threeattempted) AS total_threeattempted, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.threeattempted) > 0 THEN (SUM(pt.threemade)::DECIMAL / SUM(pt.threeattempted)) * 100 ELSE 0 END AS career_three_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) AS distinct_awards_won, COUNT(awp.award) AS total_awards_won, MAX(awp.year) AS latest_award_year, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftselection, d.draftoverall, d.draftfrom, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS team_league, t.arena, t.playoff, t.won AS team_wins, t.lost AS team_losses, t.attendance, t.o_pts AS team_offensive_pts, t.d_pts AS team_defensive_pts, c.coachid AS coach_id, c.won AS coach_wins, c.lost AS coach_losses, c.post_wins AS coach_post_wins, c.post_losses AS coach_post_losses, ac.award AS coach_award, ac.year AS coach_award_year, sp.tmidwinner AS series_winner_id, sp.tmidloser AS series_loser_id, sp.w AS series_wins, sp.l AS series_losses, sp.round AS playoff_round, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS career_rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS career_assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.steals) DESC) AS career_steals_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.blocks) DESC) AS career_blocks_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN SUM(pt.fgattempted) > 0 THEN (SUM(pt.fgmade)::DECIMAL / SUM(pt.fgattempted)) * 100 ELSE 0 END DESC) AS career_fg_percentage_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) DESC) AS allstar_seasons_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(awp.award) DESC) AS total_awards_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid = awp.playerid::character varying JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid = ac.coachid::character varying AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND t.year = sp.year WHERE p.height > 151.17 AND p.weight > 93.95 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1999 AND 1953 AND ap.season_id BETWEEN 1969 AND 2004 AND awp.year BETWEEN 2013 AND 1989 AND t.won > 9 AND t.attendance > 754788 AND c.won > 78 AND ac.year > 1989 AND sp.w > 3 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight, p.pos, p.college, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftselection, d.draftoverall, d.draftfrom, t.name, t.lgid, t.arena, t.playoff, t.won, t.lost, t.attendance, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, c.coachid, c.won, c.lost, c.post_wins, c.post_losses, ac.award, ac.year, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, sp.w, sp.l, sp.round HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 25141.97 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 19582.4 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 17751.68 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 7 AND COUNT(awp.award) > 33 ORDER BY career_points_rank, allstar_seasons_rank, total_awards_rank LIMIT 1000;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(pt.points AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS yearly_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1968 AND 1975 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.minutes) > 43789 ORDER BY pt.year, yearly_points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award) AS coach_awards, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.id) FILTER (WHERE sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid) AS playoff_series_won, AVG(t.won) AS team_avg_wins, SUM(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position_sum FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.coachid::integer AND c.year = ac.year WHERE pt.points > 1002 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1978 AND 1953 AND pa.points >= 8 AND t.won >= 36 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2446 AND AVG(pa.points) >= 13 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 10 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC LIMIT 83;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award) AS coach_awards, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON pt.tmid::integer = ac.coachid::integer AND pt.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.id = ps.playerid AND pt.year = ps.season_id JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1972 AND 1975 AND pt.points > 2420 AND pt.rebounds > 896 AND pt.assists > 284 AND t.won > 53 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1293 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 1142 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 648 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 6 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_rebounds DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying WHERE pa.season_id >= 2001.77 AND pa.season_id <= 1970.47 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 117.16 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 1993.14 AND pt.year <= 1966.03 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1614.69 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.year, p.lgid, SUM(p.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(p.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY p.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_points FROM players_teams p JOIN awards_players a ON p.playerid = a.playerid AND p.year = a.year AND p.lgid = a.lgid WHERE p.points > 468.15 AND p.year BETWEEN 2015.85 AND 1988.3 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.year, p.lgid HAVING COUNT(a.award) >= 3.58 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1270 AND t.year BETWEEN 1970 AND 1957 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((p.playerid, t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid), (p.playerid, t.lgid), (t.tmid, t.year), (t.lgid)) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2589 ORDER BY t.lgid, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1974 AND 1971 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3927 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid AS team_id, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league_id, t.year AS season_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS total_players, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS avg_points_per_minute, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid AND ap.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_count_in_season_league FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year AND t.lgid = pt.lgid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying AND d.draftyear = t.year - 1 WHERE t.year >= 1968 AND t.year <= 1982 AND t.won >= 60 AND t.attendance >= 605568 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 49183 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) >= 16 UNION ALL SELECT t.tmid AS team_id, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league_id, t.year AS season_year, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS total_coaches, SUM(c.won) AS total_wins_by_coaches, SUM(c.lost) AS total_losses_by_coaches, SUM(c.post_wins) AS total_postseason_wins, AVG(c.won * 1.0 / NULLIF(c.won + c.lost, 0)) AS win_percentage, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(c.won) DESC) AS coach_wins_rank_in_league, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_coaches ac WHERE ac.year = t.year AND ac.lgid = t.lgid AND ac.award LIKE '%Coach%') AS coach_awards_count FROM teams t JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year AND t.lgid = c.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2019 AND t.year <= 1987 AND t.won >= 77 AND t.attendance >= 126526 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(c.won) > 35 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) >= 2 ORDER BY season_year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.won, t.lost, ROUND(t.won::DECIMAL / NULLIF(t.games, 0), 3) AS win_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count FROM teams t LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::INTEGER = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::INTEGER = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year = 1997 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE (sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid::INTEGER OR sp.tmidloser = t.tmid::INTEGER) AND sp.year = 1952 ) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.games HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) > 17 ORDER BY win_percentage DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id WHERE t.name LIKE '%Lakers%' AND t.year >= 1992 AND t.year <= 2015 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, COALESCE(SUM(p.points), 0) AS total_player_points, COALESCE(SUM(c.won), 0) AS total_coach_wins, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT s.id), 0) AS series_appearances, AVG(pa.points) OVER (PARTITION BY t.year, t.lgid) AS avg_league_points_per_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t.won DESC) AS win_rank FROM teams t LEFT JOIN players_teams p ON t.tmid::integer = p.tmid AND t.year = p.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post s ON (t.tmid::integer = s.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = s.tmidloser) AND t.year = s.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid AND p.year = pa.season_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1953 AND 1969 AND t.won > 4 AND t.games > 74 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.lgid, pa.points HAVING COALESCE(SUM(p.points), 0) > 15185 AND COALESCE(SUM(c.won), 0) > 48 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC, win_rank;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, p.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 2501.2 AND t.year >= 1997.27 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, p.pos), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year, t.lgid, p.pos;

WITH player_performance AS ( SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, pt.steals, pt.blocks, pt.minutes, pt.gp, ROUND(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS pts_per_36, ROUND((pt.fgmade::numeric / NULLIF(pt.fgattempted, 0)) * 100, 2) AS fg_pct, ROUND((pt.ftmade::numeric / NULLIF(pt.ftattempted, 0)) * 100, 2) AS ft_pct, ROUND((pt.threemade::numeric / NULLIF(pt.threeattempted, 0)) * 100, 2) AS three_pct, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.tmid ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS team_points_rank, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_points_3yr, SUM(pt.points + pt.rebounds + pt.assists) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS career_pts_reb_ast FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.minutes > 1743 AND pt.gp >= 43 ), team_performance AS ( SELECT t.year, t.tmid, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.o_reb, t.d_reb, t.pace, ROUND(t.won::numeric / NULLIF(t.games, 0) * 100, 2) AS win_pct, t.o_pts - t.d_pts AS point_diff, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY t.won DESC) AS league_win_rank, LAG(t.won) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_wins FROM teams t WHERE t.games >= 69 AND t.year BETWEEN 2003 AND 2003 ), coach_performance AS ( SELECT c.year, c.tmid, c.coachid, c.won, c.lost, c.post_wins, c.post_losses, ROUND(c.won::numeric / NULLIF(c.won + c.lost, 0) * 100, 2) AS reg_season_win_pct, CASE WHEN c.post_wins + c.post_losses > 0 THEN ROUND(c.post_wins::numeric / NULLIF(c.post_wins + c.post_losses, 0) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END AS playoff_win_pct, SUM(c.won) OVER (PARTITION BY c.coachid ORDER BY c.year ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS career_wins FROM coaches c WHERE c.won >= 64 AND c.year BETWEEN 2005 AND 2015 ), award_winners AS ( SELECT ap.playerid, ap.year, ap.award, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ap.playerid) AS total_awards, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.year ORDER BY ap.award) AS award_rank_year FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.year >= 1998 ), draft_analysis AS ( SELECT d.playerid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, CASE WHEN d.draftround = 1 AND d.draftoverall <= 14 THEN 'Lottery' WHEN d.draftround = 1 THEN 'First Round' WHEN d.draftround = 2 THEN 'Second Round' ELSE 'Undrafted' END AS draft_tier, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.draftyear ORDER BY d.draftoverall) AS draft_position_rank FROM draft d WHERE d.draftyear BETWEEN 2017 AND 2008 ), all_star_performance AS ( SELECT asp.playerid, asp.season_id, asp.points, asp.rebounds, asp.assists, asp.steals, asp.blocks, ROUND(asp.points::numeric / NULLIF(asp.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS all_star_pts_per_36, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY asp.season_id ORDER BY asp.points DESC) AS all_star_points_rank FROM player_allstar asp WHERE asp.minutes > 16 AND asp.season_id >= 2017 ) SELECT pp.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pp.year, tp.tmid, tp.win_pct AS team_win_pct, pp.pts_per_36, pp.fg_pct, pp.ft_pct, pp.three_pct, pp.team_points_rank, pp.moving_avg_points_3yr, pp.career_pts_reb_ast, cp.coachid, cp.reg_season_win_pct AS coach_win_pct, cp.career_wins AS coach_career_wins, aw.total_awards, da.draft_tier, da.draft_position_rank, asp.all_star_pts_per_36, asp.all_star_points_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pp.year ORDER BY pp.pts_per_36 DESC) AS league_pts_per_36_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pp.year ORDER BY pp.points) AS points_percentile, AVG(pp.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pp.tmid, pp.year) AS team_avg_points, SUM(pp.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pp.playerid ORDER BY pp.year ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS career_total_points FROM player_performance pp JOIN players p ON pp.playerid = p.id::integer JOIN team_performance tp ON pp.tmid = tp.tmid::integer AND pp.year = tp.year JOIN coach_performance cp ON pp.tmid = cp.tmid::integer AND pp.year = cp.year LEFT JOIN award_winners aw ON pp.playerid = aw.playerid AND pp.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN draft_analysis da ON pp.playerid = da.playerid LEFT JOIN all_star_performance asp ON pp.playerid = asp.playerid AND pp.year = asp.season_id WHERE pp.pts_per_36 > 29.67 AND tp.win_pct >= 69.54 ORDER BY pp.pts_per_36 DESC, tp.win_pct DESC LIMIT 368;

SELECT a.coachid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.year) AS distinct_years, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) AS distinct_awards, SUM(c.won) AS total_wins FROM awards_coaches a JOIN coaches c ON a.coachid::text = c.coachid AND a.year = c.year WHERE a.year >= 2016 AND a.year <= 2000 AND c.won > 82 GROUP BY a.coachid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.year) > 3 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT ap.playerid, ap.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award)) OVER (PARTITION BY ap.playerid ORDER BY ap.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_awards FROM awards_players ap JOIN players p ON ap.playerid = p.id JOIN player_allstar pa ON ap.playerid = pa.playerid AND ap.year = pa.season_id JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE ap.year >= 2012 AND ap.year <= 2014 AND p.weight >= 289 GROUP BY ap.playerid, ap.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 7 ORDER BY ap.playerid, ap.year;

SELECT ap.playerid, ap.year, ap.award, COUNT(*) AS award_count, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_season_points, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.points > (SELECT AVG(points) FROM players_teams WHERE year = ap.year) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS games_above_avg_points FROM awards_players ap JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE ap.year >= 1971.44 AND pt.points >= 13.98 GROUP BY ap.playerid, ap.year, ap.award HAVING COUNT(*) > 7.46 ORDER BY award_count DESC, avg_regular_season_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS distinct_teams, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id WHERE pt.year >= 1950 AND pt.year <= 1979 AND pt.points > 864 GROUP BY p.playerid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 8 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pa.rebounds) AS total_rebounds FROM players p INNER JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 2020 AND ap.year <= 1951 AND pa.points >= 19 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 1 ORDER BY award_count DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE ap.year = pa.season_id AND ap.year >= 2001 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 41639 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.id = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year WHERE pt.year >= 2014 AND pt.points >= 1122 AND (ap.points IS NULL OR ap.points > 14) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 1 AND SUM(pt.points) > 10975 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::integer = awp.playerid WHERE p.firstname LIKE 'A%' AND p.lastname LIKE 'A%' AND ap.points >= 37.08 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 7.63 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT ap2.year) AS award_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_percentile FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players ap2 ON p.id = ap2.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 4786 AND ap.season_id >= 1970 AND ap2.year BETWEEN 1956 AND 1990 AND pt.minutes > 3205 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 1 AND SUM(pt.points) > 36283 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 1917 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 2019 AND p.lastseason <= 2021 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 21313 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.points > 1527.0 AND ap.season_id >= 1959.56 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 30575.37 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season, MAX(pt.rebounds) AS max_rebounds_season, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.league_id = 'NBA' THEN ap.points ELSE 0 END) AS nba_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (ORDER BY p.playerid) AS prev_player_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid = aw.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = aw.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1970 AND 1960 AND pt.points > 856 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t.id AND sp.year = pt.year AND sp.round = 'Finals' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0 ) AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 27279 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 9 ORDER BY total_points DESC, p.playerid LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS distinct_team_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 1953 AND ap.season_id <= 1962 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 10675 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE pt.points > 42 AND pt.rebounds > 16 AND ap.year BETWEEN 1991 AND 2013 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) > 1 AND AVG(pt.points) > 15 ORDER BY total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 2004 AND pa.points > 8 AND d.draftyear <= 1990 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) >= 4 AND SUM(pa.points) > 319 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid = p.id AND pa.season_id = pt.year AND pa.points > 38 ) AND pt.year BETWEEN 1999 AND 2017 AND t.won > 55 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 15.37 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 9 ORDER BY total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_team_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE pa.season_id >= 1970 AND pt.year >= 1998 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 246.42 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS allstar_seasons_count, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points_per_allstar_game FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE p.firstname LIKE 'A%' OR p.lastname LIKE 'A%' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 142.96 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(ps.points) AS total_points, AVG(ps.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams ps ON p.id = ps.playerid JOIN teams t ON ps.tmid::character varying = t.tmid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid WHERE ps.year BETWEEN 1983 AND 1961 AND p.height > '150.0' AND t.won > 67 AND ap.award = 'NBA Most Valuable Player' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(ps.points) > 19362 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.year) >= 17 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1973 AND pt.year <= 1985 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 7591 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1958 AND pt.year <= 1964 AND pt.points > 1379 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 7448 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE (pt.points > 2923 OR pt.assists > 983) AND NOT (pt.lgid = 'NBA' AND t.playoff = 'Y') AND pt.year BETWEEN 1958 AND 1970 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 37020 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 9 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1964 AND pt.year <= 2001 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3332 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1992 AND pt.year <= 2019 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 16824 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.points > 30 AND pt.year >= 2003 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 15895 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS overall_points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points, (SUM(pt.points) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pt.fgattempted), 0)) AS career_fg_pct FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 2649 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2004 AND 1997 AND t.won > 61 AND ap.points > 3 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.assists) > 651 AND AVG(pt.minutes) >= 43 ORDER BY total_points DESC, overall_points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.college, p.pos, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, ap.season_id, ap.points AS allstar_points, ap.rebounds AS allstar_rebounds, ap.assists AS allstar_assists, pt.year AS team_year, pt.points AS team_points, pt.rebounds AS team_rebounds, pt.assists AS team_assists, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS career_points_running_total, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid) AS avg_points_per_season, COUNT(ap.season_id) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid) AS allstar_appearances, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS total_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pos ORDER BY AVG(pt.points) DESC) AS avg_points_rank_by_position, SUM(pt.points) AS total_career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_career_points, MAX(pt.points) AS max_season_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.lgid = 'NBA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nba_seasons_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id WHERE pt.year >= 2014 AND pt.year <= 1954 AND pt.points > 1073 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND p.pos IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.college, p.pos, t.name, t.lgid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.rebounds, ap.assists, pt.year, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 14918 AND AVG(pt.points) > 19 ORDER BY total_career_points DESC, avg_career_points DESC LIMIT 831;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS career_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS career_rebounds, AVG(CAST(pt.points AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(ap.season_id) AS last_allstar_season, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, AVG(d.draftoverall) AS avg_draft_position FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid = aw.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 1376 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1993 AND 2014 AND ap.season_id >= 1969 AND d.draftyear >= 1956 AND aw.year >= 1974 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 41769 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 12 ORDER BY career_points DESC, career_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 112 AND pt.year >= 1999 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points HAVING COUNT(pt.stint) >= 1 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid) AS avg_team_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id WHERE pt.year >= 1987 AND pt.year <= 2015 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 311 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) AS stint_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid::integer AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT sp.year FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.w > 1 AND sp.l < 0 ) AND pt.minutes > 1754 AND pa.points > 20 AND c.won > 45 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1288 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 12 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_minutes DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2001 AND pt.year <= 1993 AND pt.points > 451 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid)) ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE p.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT d.playerid FROM draft d WHERE d.draftyear BETWEEN 2006 AND 1986 AND d.draftround <= 2 ) AND pt.points > 627 AND t.won > 2 AND c.won > 78 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 695 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 4 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, sub.total_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sub.total_points DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN ( SELECT pt.playerid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT sp.year FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.w > 1 ) AND pt.points > 435 GROUP BY pt.playerid ) sub ON p.playerid::integer = sub.playerid WHERE sub.total_points >= 15595 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, sub.total_points ORDER BY points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 13 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2016 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' AND d.draftyear >= 1959 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 19326 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(ap.three_made::numeric / NULLIF(ap.three_attempted, 0)) AS career_three_pct, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, SUM(CASE WHEN ac.award = 'Most Valuable Player' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mvp_count, SUM(t2.won) AS team_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY (SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.assists) + SUM(pt.rebounds)) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ac ON p.playerid::integer = ac.playerid AND pt.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN teams t2 ON pt.lgid = t2.lgid AND pt.year = t2.year WHERE pt.year >= 2018 AND pt.year <= 1954 AND pt.points > 2131 AND t.won > 74 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, ap.season_id, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 6275 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 572 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 10 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.points) AS distinct_points_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.assists) AS distinct_assists_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.rebounds) AS distinct_rebounds_count, SUM(ap.points) AS total_points, SUM(ap.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(ap.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_points, AVG(ap.assists) AS avg_assists, AVG(ap.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_team_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_team_rebounds, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_team_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_team_assists, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_team_rebounds, SUM(t.o_pts) AS total_team_offensive_points, SUM(t.d_pts) AS total_team_defensive_points, AVG(t.o_pts) AS avg_team_offensive_points, AVG(t.d_pts) AS avg_team_defensive_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::integer = awp.playerid AND ap.season_id = awp.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner WHERE ap.points > 13 AND ap.assists > 11 AND ap.rebounds > 34 AND pt.points > 586 AND pt.assists > 266 AND pt.rebounds > 137 AND t.o_pts > 6114 AND t.d_pts > 671 AND ap.season_id >= 1997 AND ap.season_id <= 1977 AND t.year >= 1954 AND t.year <= 2010 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, ap.season_id, ap.league_id HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 1025 AND SUM(ap.assists) > 54 AND SUM(ap.rebounds) > 850 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.points) > 38 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.assists) > 43 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.rebounds) > 42 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_assists DESC, total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, SUM(ap.points) AS total_points, SUM(ap.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(ap.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(ap.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.league_id ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league, ROUND(SUM(ap.points) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ap.fg_attempted), 0), 3) AS points_per_shot_attempt FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.lgid = t.lgid JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year WHERE ap.points > 16 AND ap.season_id >= 1966 AND ap.season_id <= 2014 AND t.year >= 1981 AND t.year <= 1999 AND aw.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, ap.season_id, ap.league_id), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.league_id), (ap.league_id, ap.season_id), ()) HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 120 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 11 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_minutes ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, SUM(ap.points) AS total_points, SUM(ap.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(ap.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(ap.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.league_id ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league, ROUND(SUM(ap.points) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ap.fg_attempted), 0), 3) AS points_per_shot_attempt FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.lgid = t.lgid JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year WHERE ap.points > 32 AND ap.season_id >= 1998 AND ap.season_id <= 2006 AND t.year >= 1996 AND t.year <= 1968 AND aw.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, ap.season_id, ap.league_id), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.league_id), (ap.league_id, ap.season_id), ()) HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 191 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 2 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_minutes ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 1981.26 AND p.lastseason <= 2001.34 AND t.lgid LIKE 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 22127.18 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS season_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER ( PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_points_3yr FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 1597.19 AND pt.year >= 2003 AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3566.88 ORDER BY p.playerid, pt.year;

SELECT p.playerid, pt.year, t.tmid, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_ppg, AVG(pt.assists * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_apg, AVG(pt.rebounds * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_rpg, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.season_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS allstar_game_appearances, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) AS distinct_player_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT awc.award) AS distinct_coach_awards_for_team_year, SUM(d.draftoverall) AS total_draft_value, MAX(s.w) AS max_playoff_wins_in_year, SUM(t.o_pts) AS team_total_points_for, SUM(t.d_pts) AS team_total_points_against FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::integer = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches awc ON t.tmid::integer = awc.coachid AND t.year = awc.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN series_post s ON t.tmid::integer = s.tmidwinner AND t.year = s.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 1986 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND pt.points >= 1375 AND t.o_pts >= 6254 GROUP BY CUBE (p.playerid, pt.year, t.tmid, t.lgid) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 48789 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 8 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, t.tmid;

SELECT t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t.year = pt.year WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT year FROM players_teams WHERE playerid IN ( SELECT playerid FROM awards_players WHERE year BETWEEN 1996 AND 2001 ) ) GROUP BY t.name HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 28.12 ORDER BY player_count DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(pt.playerid) AS player_count, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes FROM teams t LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year WHERE t.year >= 1960 AND t.year <= 1988 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name ORDER BY player_count DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t.year = pt.year JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1952 AND t.year <= 1991 AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 15358 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.points > 445.06) AS high_scorers_count FROM teams t WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1969.37 AND 1961.54 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY t.id, t.tmid, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts HAVING t.won > 33.67 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.won DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS player_count, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points FROM players_teams p JOIN teams t ON p.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND p.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid AND p.year = pa.season_id WHERE p.year >= 2012 AND p.year <= 2011 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, player_count DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_points_3yr FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year AND t.lgid = pt.lgid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::text = p.playerid WHERE t.year >= 1952 AND t.year <= 2020 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 81834 ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t1.year AS year1, t2.year AS year2, t1.lgid, AVG(t1.won - t2.won) AS avg_win_diff, SUM(t1.o_pts) AS total_pts_year1, SUM(t2.o_pts) AS total_pts_year2 FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.tmid = t2.tmid WHERE t1.year > t2.year AND t1.year - t2.year <= 3 AND t1.won >= 7 AND t2.won >= 76 GROUP BY t1.year, t2.year, t1.lgid HAVING AVG(t1.won - t2.won) > 0.13 ORDER BY avg_win_diff DESC;

SELECT c.coachid, t.tmid, t.name, ap.playerid, ap.award, ap.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_count, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.assists) AS avg_assists, SUM(pt.points) AS team_points, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS team_losses, SUM(t.o_pts) AS team_offensive_points, SUM(t.d_pts) AS team_defensive_points, GROUPING(c.coachid, t.tmid, ap.playerid, ap.award, ap.year) AS grouping_id FROM coaches c JOIN teams t ON c.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND c.year = t.year AND c.lgid = t.lgid JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid = ac.coachid::character varying AND c.year = ac.year JOIN awards_players ap ON ac.year = ap.year AND ac.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN player_allstar pa ON ap.playerid = pa.playerid AND ap.year = pa.season_id JOIN players_teams pt ON pa.playerid = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::character varying = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND t.year = sp.year WHERE ac.award = 'Coach of the Year' AND ap.award IN ('MVP', 'All-NBA') AND pa.points > 59.51 AND t.won > 27.6 AND t.year BETWEEN 2010.97 AND 1969.07 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((c.coachid, t.tmid, t.name, ap.playerid, ap.award, ap.year), (c.coachid, t.tmid, t.name, ap.year), (c.coachid, t.tmid, t.name), (c.coachid, t.tmid), (c.coachid), ()) HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 188.51 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) >= 2.66 ORDER BY total_points DESC, team_wins DESC, grouping_id;

ap.season_id = awp.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner::VARCHAR AND t.year = sp.year WHERE p.height > 186.99 AND pt.gp >= 81.24 AND ap.games_played >= 25.52 AND t.won > 5.66 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1979.83 AND 1960.41 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 10.01 AND SUM(pt.points) > 5748.82 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, 'NBA' THEN d.tmid END) AS nba_teams_drafted_by FROM players p JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::INTEGER = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::INTEGER = ap.playerid AND d.draftyear =
