JOIN series_post sp ON pt.tmid::VARCHAR = sp.tmidwinner::VARCHAR AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE p.height > 209.75 AND d.draftoverall < 23.85 AND ap.games_played >= 65.74 AND pt.gp >= 39.81 AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1990.87 AND 1978.21 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) > 1.64 AND SUM(ap.points) > 255.58 ORDER BY total_team_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, 'award' AS category, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_count FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 1962 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname UNION ALL SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, 'allstar' AS category, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS allstar_count FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid WHERE pa.season_id >= 1963 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname ORDER BY player_id, category;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.stint = 1 THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS total_points_stint1, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.stint = 2 THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS total_points_stint2, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(CASE WHEN ap.season_id IS NOT NULL THEN ap.points ELSE NULL END) AS max_allstar_points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid = p.id AND ap2.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_awards_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2017 AND 1954 AND pt.points > 1831 AND (t.won > 73 OR t.won IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 12930 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 11 AND AVG(pt.assists) > 4 ORDER BY total_points_stint1 DESC, avg_assists DESC LIMIT 395;

SELECT p.playerid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS distinct_team_years, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.league_id) AS distinct_allstar_leagues, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE ap.points > 15.69 AND pt.year >= 1986.94 GROUP BY p.playerid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 18.57 AND SUM(pt.points) < 4758.14 ORDER BY total_regular_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS distinct_teams, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id WHERE pt.year >= 2013 AND pt.year <= 1951 AND pt.points > 1027 GROUP BY p.playerid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 11 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id::integer WHERE p.id IN ( SELECT playerid FROM draft WHERE draftyear IN ( SELECT year FROM awards_coaches WHERE coachid IN ( SELECT coachid::integer FROM coaches WHERE won > 48 AND year >= 1980 ) ) ) AND pa.points > 13 AND t.won > 48 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 13 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) >= 3 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, SUM(aps.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_team_points, MAX(t.won) AS max_team_wins, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(aps.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar aps ON p.id = aps.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND t.year = pt.year WHERE ap.year >= 1982 AND ap.year <= 1972 AND t.won > 72 AND aps.points > 56 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 9 AND SUM(aps.points) > 64 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, distinct_awards DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.year >= 1961 AND pt.year <= 1987 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 28161 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) AS distinct_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS distinct_teams_played_for, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS distinct_draft_years, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.minutes) AS avg_allstar_minutes, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_regular_minutes, MAX(pt.points) AS max_regular_points, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins, SUM(c.lost) AS total_coach_losses, SUM(t.won) AS total_team_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS total_team_losses, SUM(sp.w) AS total_series_wins, SUM(sp.l) AS total_series_losses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS regular_points_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::integer = awp.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid WHERE ap.points > 7.73 AND pt.points > 1076.32 AND t.won > 79.62 AND c.won > 21.26 AND sp.year >= 1964.71 AND sp.year <= 1982.3 AND awp.year >= 1994.51 AND awp.year <= 2007.86 AND d.draftyear >= 1978.8 AND d.draftyear <= 1973.7 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 11.61 AND COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) > 4.22 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) > 27.72 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, total_regular_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS distinct_teams_played_for, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE ap.points > 20.15 AND pt.year >= 1962.25 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 5.71 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS distinct_team_years, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.league_id) AS distinct_allstar_leagues, COUNT(DISTINCT dp.draftyear) AS distinct_draft_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, MAX(pt.rebounds) AS max_rebounds, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) DESC) AS allstar_season_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN draft dp ON p.playerid::integer = dp.playerid JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::integer = awp.playerid AND ap.season_id = awp.year JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 653.25 AND pt.year >= 2014 AND pt.year <= 2010 AND t.won > 21.49 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 4.32 AND SUM(pt.points) > 21860.11 ORDER BY total_points DESC, distinct_allstar_seasons DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, MIN(pa.points) AS min_allstar_points, SUM(pa.rebounds) AS total_allstar_rebounds, SUM(pa.assists) AS total_allstar_assists, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_regular_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_regular_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_position, SUM(CASE WHEN c.post_wins > c.post_losses THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS winning_postseasons_coached, SUM(t.won) AS total_team_wins_played_for, SUM(t.lost) AS total_team_losses_played_for, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pa.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pa.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pa.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON p.playerid::text = c.coachid WHERE pa.points > 4.31 AND pt.points > 324.65 AND t.year > 1981.8 AND ap.year > 2015.15 AND d.draftyear > 1999.37 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 7.17 AND SUM(pa.points) > 391.92 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, total_regular_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS allstar_career_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(CAST(pa.points AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(pa.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pa.season_id = aw.year WHERE (pa.points > 47 AND pa.minutes > 42) OR (pa.assists > 8 AND pa.rebounds > 3) AND NOT (pa.personal_fouls > 2) AND aw.award = 'All-NBA' AND pa.league_id = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 134 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) >= 17 ORDER BY allstar_career_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(ps.points) AS total_points, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.season_id) AS seasons_played FROM players p INNER JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.playerid = ps.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying AND ps.season_id = ap.year WHERE ps.points > 29.02 AND ps.season_id >= 1952 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ps.season_id) >= 20 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year >= 1983 AND pt.year <= 1980 AND pt.points > 7909 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1111 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1960 AND 2003 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 32647 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 761 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2006 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA First Team' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 30552 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2011 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3164 ORDER BY career_points DESC LIMIT 37;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, MAX(ps.season_id) AS last_allstar_season, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) DESC) AS teams_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.playerid::integer = ps.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id::integer WHERE (pt.year > 1982 AND pt.points > 883) OR (ps.season_id > 1957 AND ps.points > 60) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid AND sp.year = pt.year AND sp.w > 7) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_coaches ac WHERE ac.coachid::integer = c.coachid::integer AND ac.year = c.year AND ac.award = 'Coach of the Year') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 32492 AND AVG(pt.assists) < 2 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1997 AND pt.year <= 2000 AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND d.draftyear >= 1972 AND d.draftyear <= 1959 AND pa.season_id >= 1971 AND pa.season_id <= 2019 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 9099 AND AVG(pt.assists) > 2 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pa.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON p.playerid::text = c.coachid WHERE pa.season_id >= 1974 AND pa.season_id <= 1961 AND pa.league_id = 'NBA' AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND d.draftyear >= 2020 AND d.draftyear <= 1960 AND c.year >= 1994 AND c.year <= 2008 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 2971 AND AVG(pa.assists) > 9 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1986 AND pt.year <= 1963 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 26445 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.year >= 1994 THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS recent_points, COUNT(CASE WHEN pt.lgid = 'NBA' THEN 1 END) AS league_games FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1960 AND 2008 AND pt.points > 1354 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 44767 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, ap.award, ac.award AS coach_award, c.coachid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, t.name AS team_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid, pt.year) AS team_avg_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.id AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (pt.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR pt.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser) AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 2690 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2004 AND 1996 AND pt.rebounds > 217 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid = p.id AND pa.season_id = pt.year AND pa.points > 41 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, ap.award, ac.award, c.coachid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, t.name HAVING AVG(pt.assists) > 8.91 ORDER BY pt.points DESC, points_rank LIMIT 100;

t.tmid::character varying = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year AND t.lgid = c.lgid JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::character varying = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND t.year = sp.year AND t.lgid = sp.lgidwinner WHERE ap.points > 21.23 AND pt.points > 2319.4 AND t.year >= 1956 AND d.draftyear >= 1962 AND apw.year >= 2010 AND c.year >= 1950 AND sp.year >= 1983 GROUP BY pl.playerid, pl.firstname, pl.lastname, pl.college, pl.pos, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, ap.conference, ap.points, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.lgid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, t.name, t.arena, t.playoff, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, d.draftfrom, apw.year, apw.award, apw.lgid, c.year, c.coachid, c.won, c.lost, c.lgid, sp.year, sp.round, sp.series, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, sp.w, sp.l, sp.lgidwinner, sp.lgidloser ORDER BY pl.playerid, ap.season_id, pt.year, d.draftyear, apw.year, c.year, sp.year;

SELECT s1.playerid, s1.season_id, s1.league_id, SUM(s1.points) AS total_points, AVG(s1.minutes) AS avg_minutes, MAX(s1.rebounds) AS max_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT s1.conference) AS conferences_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s1.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM player_allstar s1 JOIN players p ON s1.playerid = p.id::integer WHERE s1.minutes > 0 AND s1.season_id BETWEEN 1989 AND 1986 GROUP BY s1.playerid, s1.season_id, s1.league_id HAVING SUM(s1.points) > 40 INTERSECT SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, MAX(pt.rebounds) AS max_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.lgid) AS leagues_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players_teams pt JOIN draft d ON pt.playerid = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id::integer WHERE pt.minutes > 16 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1983 AND 1990 AND d.draftyear < 1982 GROUP BY pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 45 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 11 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_playoff_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.postpoints) DESC) AS playoff_points_rank FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::integer = p.id JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND awp.year = pt.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND c.year = pt.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND ac.year = c.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1978 AND 1960 AND pt.points > 2511 AND ap.points > 14 AND t.won > 61 AND c.won > 12 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.id AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1975 AND 1991 AND d.draftoverall < ( SELECT AVG(d2.draftoverall) FROM draft d2 WHERE d2.draftyear = d.draftyear AND d2.draftoverall IS NOT NULL ) ) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, p.id, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 30 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 1 AND SUM(pt.postpoints) > 746 ORDER BY total_playoff_points DESC, avg_regular_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2006 AND pt.points > 18 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 23.89 ORDER BY player_count DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, SUM(ap.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS unique_players FROM player_allstar ap JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.lgid = t.lgid WHERE ap.season_id >= 2015 AND ap.season_id <= 2006 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 5162 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 1956 AND pt.year <= 2016 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 51730.45 INTERSECT SELECT t.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 2021 AND pt.year <= 1986 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) < 89046.43 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.year = pt.year AND t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid JOIN draft d ON pt.playerid = d.playerid WHERE t.year >= 1970 AND d.draftyear <= 2017 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 53889 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) >= 14 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t.year = pt.year JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1993 AND t.year <= 1978 AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 47713 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, p.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS allstar_players, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players_teams pt JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id JOIN player_allstar ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id WHERE pt.year >= 1971 AND pt.year <= 2008 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, p.pos) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 21973 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t1.lgid, t1.year, t1.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.coachid) AS award_coaches, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.lgid ORDER BY t1.year) AS prev_year_points FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year AND t1.tmid <> t2.tmid JOIN players_teams pt ON t1.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t1.year = pt.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN coaches c ON t1.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t1.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN draft d ON pt.playerid = d.playerid AND pt.year = d.draftyear JOIN series_post sp ON t1.tmid = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND t1.year = sp.year WHERE t1.won > 26.25 AND t1.games > 94.37 AND pt.points > 2355.92 AND pa.points > 10.45 AND ap.award = 'MVP' AND ac.award = 'Coach of the Year' AND d.draftround > 6.47 AND sp.w > 0.85 GROUP BY t1.lgid, t1.year, t1.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 39317.26 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) > 44.38 ORDER BY t1.lgid, t1.year, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.won, t1.lost, t2.won AS t2_won, t2.lost AS t2_lost, (t1.won - t2.won) AS win_difference FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year WHERE t1.won > 14.12 AND t2.won < 9.89 AND t1.year >= 2008.42 GROUP BY t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.won, t1.lost, t2.won, t2.lost HAVING (t1.won - t2.won) > 76.48 ORDER BY win_difference DESC;

WITH player_performance AS ( SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, pt.steals, pt.blocks, pt.minutes, pt.gp, ROUND(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS pts_per_36, ROUND((pt.fgmade::numeric / NULLIF(pt.fgattempted, 0)) * 100, 2) AS fg_pct, ROUND((pt.ftmade::numeric / NULLIF(pt.ftattempted, 0)) * 100, 2) AS ft_pct, ROUND((pt.threemade::numeric / NULLIF(pt.threeattempted, 0)) * 100, 2) AS three_pct, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.tmid ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS team_points_rank, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_points_3yr, SUM(pt.points + pt.rebounds + pt.assists) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS career_pts_reb_ast FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.minutes > 2002 AND pt.gp >= 37 ), team_performance AS ( SELECT t.year, t.tmid, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.o_reb, t.d_reb, t.pace, ROUND(t.won::numeric / NULLIF(t.games, 0) * 100, 2) AS win_pct, t.o_pts - t.d_pts AS point_diff, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY t.won DESC) AS league_win_rank, LAG(t.won) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_wins FROM teams t WHERE t.games >= 78 AND t.year BETWEEN 2006 AND 2015 ), coach_performance AS ( SELECT c.year, c.tmid, c.coachid, c.won, c.lost, c.post_wins, c.post_losses, ROUND(c.won::numeric / NULLIF(c.won + c.lost, 0) * 100, 2) AS reg_season_win_pct, CASE WHEN c.post_wins + c.post_losses > 0 THEN ROUND(c.post_wins::numeric / NULLIF(c.post_wins + c.post_losses, 0) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END AS playoff_win_pct, SUM(c.won) OVER (PARTITION BY c.coachid ORDER BY c.year ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS career_wins FROM coaches c WHERE c.won >= 33 AND c.year BETWEEN 2020 AND 2000 ), award_winners AS ( SELECT ap.playerid, ap.year, ap.award, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ap.playerid) AS total_awards, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.year ORDER BY ap.award) AS award_rank_year FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.year >= 2008 ), draft_analysis AS ( SELECT d.playerid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, CASE WHEN d.draftround = 1 AND d.draftoverall <= 14 THEN 'Lottery' WHEN d.draftround = 1 THEN 'First Round' WHEN d.draftround = 2 THEN 'Second Round' ELSE 'Undrafted' END AS draft_tier, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.draftyear ORDER BY d.draftoverall) AS draft_position_rank FROM draft d WHERE d.draftyear BETWEEN 2000 AND 2012 ), all_star_performance AS ( SELECT asp.playerid, asp.season_id, asp.points, asp.rebounds, asp.assists, asp.steals, asp.blocks, ROUND(asp.points::numeric / NULLIF(asp.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS all_star_pts_per_36, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY asp.season_id ORDER BY asp.points DESC) AS all_star_points_rank FROM player_allstar asp WHERE asp.minutes > 40 AND asp.season_id >= 2006 ) SELECT pp.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pp.year, tp.tmid, tp.win_pct AS team_win_pct, pp.pts_per_36, pp.fg_pct, pp.ft_pct, pp.three_pct, pp.team_points_rank, pp.moving_avg_points_3yr, pp.career_pts_reb_ast, cp.coachid, cp.reg_season_win_pct AS coach_win_pct, cp.career_wins AS coach_career_wins, aw.total_awards, da.draft_tier, da.draft_position_rank, asp.all_star_pts_per_36, asp.all_star_points_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pp.year ORDER BY pp.pts_per_36 DESC) AS league_pts_per_36_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pp.year ORDER BY pp.points) AS points_percentile, AVG(pp.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pp.tmid, pp.year) AS team_avg_points, SUM(pp.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pp.playerid ORDER BY pp.year ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS career_total_points FROM player_performance pp JOIN players p ON pp.playerid = p.id::integer JOIN team_performance tp ON pp.tmid = tp.tmid::integer AND pp.year = tp.year JOIN coach_performance cp ON pp.tmid = cp.tmid::integer AND pp.year = cp.year LEFT JOIN award_winners aw ON pp.playerid = aw.playerid AND pp.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN draft_analysis da ON pp.playerid = da.playerid LEFT JOIN all_star_performance asp ON pp.playerid = asp.playerid AND pp.year = asp.season_id WHERE pp.pts_per_36 > 37.88 AND tp.win_pct >= 74.03 ORDER BY pp.pts_per_36 DESC, tp.win_pct DESC LIMIT 199;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname AS first_name, p.lastname AS last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, SUM(ap.year) AS total_award_years, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(pa.season_id) AS latest_allstar_season FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying WHERE p.college LIKE '%State%' AND pa.season_id >= 1974.05 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 1.23 ORDER BY distinct_awards_count DESC, total_award_years DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, COUNT(ap.award) AS award_count, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_points, SUM(ps.rebounds) AS total_rebounds FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams ps ON p.id = ps.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 1970 AND ps.year BETWEEN 1992 AND 1974 AND ps.gp > 8 GROUP BY p.playerid HAVING COUNT(ap.award) > 6 ORDER BY total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, d.draftyear, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND d.draftyear = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND d.draftyear = pa.season_id WHERE d.draftyear BETWEEN 1984 AND 1959 AND pa.points > 98 AND ap.award = 'All-Star' GROUP BY p.playerid, d.draftyear HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 451 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pa.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pa.league_id ORDER BY pa.season_id) AS running_total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pa.playerid = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE pa.points > 20 AND pa.season_id BETWEEN 1954 AND 2012 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pa.points, pa.league_id, pa.season_id ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, SUM(ap.year) AS total_award_years, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid WHERE p.firstseason >= 1952 AND p.lastseason <= 1995 AND pa.points > 20 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 7 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.year >= 2006 AND pt.year <= 1996 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 9784 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 2016 AND p.lastseason <= 1980 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 9 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE p.college LIKE '%University%' AND pt.year BETWEEN 2005 AND 2001 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 5666 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 48.0) AS avg_points_per_48, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 1268.96 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2004.13 AND 1965.76 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 10.73 ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 19.71;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(ap.award) AS award_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND d.draftyear > 1981.35 ) AND t.year BETWEEN 2010.23 AND 1981.18 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 8346.26 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pa.assists) AS avg_allstar_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE pa.season_id BETWEEN 1986.27 AND 2000.42 AND pa.points > 30.8 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 946.88 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id AND pt.points > 2640.73 ) AND pa.points >= 9.79 AND pa.season_id BETWEEN 1991.0 AND 1986.43 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 648.72 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year IN (SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'All-NBA First Team') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2917 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 1877 AND t.won > 34 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2645 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1964 AND pt.year <= 1996 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 12416 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1972 AND pt.year <= 1956 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = 'All-NBA First Team') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 14465 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 1284 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1970 AND 1950 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 33271 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 1477 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 1983 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 1 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 79 AND pt.year >= 2001 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year AND pa.points > 37) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 22770 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1954 AND pt.year <= 1977 AND pt.points > 1272 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 17493 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2003 AND pt.year <= 1979 AND pt.points > 733 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 43784 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1978 AND t.won >= 82 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 45637 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1986 AND (pt.points > 22 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = 'All-NBA')) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 16006 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE p.college LIKE '%University%' AND pt.year >= 2015 AND pt.year <= 1963 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 31591 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 2004 AND pt.points > 1289 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3844 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS overall_points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points, (SUM(pt.points) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pt.fgattempted), 0)) AS career_fg_pct FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 2849 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2001 AND 2018 AND t.won > 57 AND ap.points > 21 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.assists) > 647 AND AVG(pt.minutes) >= 11 ORDER BY total_points DESC, overall_points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT ap2.season_id) AS allstar_seasons_with_award, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(ap.rebounds) AS total_allstar_rebounds, AVG(ap.rebounds) AS avg_allstar_rebounds, SUM(ap.assists) AS total_allstar_assists, AVG(ap.assists) AS avg_allstar_assists, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, MIN(ap.points) AS min_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_regular_rebounds, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_regular_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_regular_assists, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_regular_assists, MAX(pt.points) AS max_regular_points, MIN(pt.points) AS min_regular_points, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_pick, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS worst_draft_pick, COUNT(DISTINCT ap3.award) AS distinct_awards, COUNT(ap3.award) AS total_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award) AS coach_awards_count, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins, SUM(c.lost) AS total_coach_losses, AVG(c.won::numeric / NULLIF(c.won + c.lost, 0)) AS avg_coach_win_pct, SUM(t.won) AS total_team_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS total_team_losses, AVG(t.won::numeric / NULLIF(t.won + t.lost, 0)) AS avg_team_win_pct, SUM(t.o_pts) AS total_team_points_for, SUM(t.d_pts) AS total_team_points_against, AVG(t.o_pts - t.d_pts) AS avg_team_point_diff, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.year) AS playoff_series_appearances, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t.id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_series_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidloser = t.id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_series_losses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS regular_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap3.award) DESC) AS awards_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pos ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS pos_points_rank FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap2 ON ap.playerid = ap2.playerid AND ap.season_id = ap2.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap3 ON p.playerid = ap3.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid = ac.coachid::character varying AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser WHERE ap.points > 11.67 AND ap.rebounds > 3.2 AND ap.assists > 7.58 AND pt.points > 129.94 AND pt.rebounds > 661.25 AND pt.assists > 192.47 AND t.won > 61.39 AND t.lost > 73.78 AND c.won > 52.55 AND c.lost > 68.42 AND ap3.year > 1976.96 AND d.draftyear > 1984.04 AND sp.year > 1968.35 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 13.37 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 6.82 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap3.award) > 4.18 AND SUM(ap.points) > 138.2 AND SUM(pt.points) > 4763.91 AND SUM(t.won) > 2797.76 AND SUM(c.won) > 1379.4 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, total_regular_points DESC, distinct_awards DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) AS distinct_awards, SUM(CASE WHEN awp.award = 'Most Valuable Player' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mvp_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league_year, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS team_losses, (SUM(t.won) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(t.games), 0)) AS team_win_percentage, SUM(s.w) AS playoff_series_wins, SUM(s.l) AS playoff_series_losses, SUM(c.post_wins) AS coach_post_wins, SUM(c.post_losses) AS coach_post_losses FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid = awp.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = awp.year LEFT JOIN series_post s ON t.tmid::integer = s.tmidwinner AND t.year = s.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year AND t.lgid = c.lgid WHERE pt.points > 931 AND t.year BETWEEN 1968 AND 1957 AND p.height > '150.0' AND p.weight > 58 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1474 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 20 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 7 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank_in_league_year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.height, p.weight, COALESCE(SUM(pa.points), 0) AS total_allstar_points, COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) AS total_regular_points, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) AS total_post_points, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year), 0) AS award_years_count, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT c.year), 0) AS coached_years_count, total_regular_blocks, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postblocks), 0) AS total_post_blocks, COALESCE(SUM(pa.turnovers), 0) AS total_allstar_turnovers, COALESCE(SUM(pt.turnovers), 0) AS total_regular_turnovers, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postturnovers), 0) AS total_post_turnovers, COALESCE(SUM(pa.personal_fouls), 0) AS total_allstar_fouls, COALESCE(SUM(pt.pf), 0) AS total_regular_fouls, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpf), 0) AS total_post_fouls, COALESCE(SUM(pa.ft_made), 0) AS total_allstar_ft_made, COALESCE(SUM(pt.ftmade), 0) AS total_regular_ft_made, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postftmade), 0) AS total_post_ft_made, COALESCE(SUM(pa.ft_attempted), 0) AS total_allstar_ft_attempted, COALESCE(SUM(pt.ftattempted), 0) AS total_regular_ft_attempted, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postftattempted), 0) AS total_post_ft_attempted, COALESCE(SUM(pa.fg_made), 0) AS total_allstar_fg_made, COALESCE(SUM(pt.fgmade), 0) AS total_regular_fg_made, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postfgmade), 0) AS total_post_fg_made, COALESCE(SUM(pa.fg_attempted), 0) AS total_allstar_fg_attempted, COALESCE(SUM(pt.fgattempted), 0) AS total_regular_fg_attempted, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postfgattempted), 0) AS total_post_fg_attempted, COALESCE(SUM(pa.three_made), 0) AS total_allstar_three_made, COALESCE(SUM(pt.threemade), 0) AS total_regular_three_made, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postthreemade), 0) AS total_post_three_made, COALESCE(SUM(pa.three_attempted), 0) AS total_allstar_three_attempted, COALESCE(SUM(pt.threeattempted), 0) AS total_regular_three_attempted, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postthreeattempted), 0) AS total_post_three_attempted, COALESCE(SUM(t.won), 0) AS total_team_wins, COALESCE(SUM(t.lost), 0) AS total_team_losses, COALESCE(SUM(t.attendance), 0) AS total_attendance, COALESCE(SUM(t.o_pts), 0) AS total_team_points_for, COALESCE(SUM(t.d_pts), 0) AS total_team_points_against, COALESCE(SUM(sp.w), 0) AS total_playoff_series_wins, COALESCE(SUM(sp.l), 0) AS total_playoff_series_losses, COALESCE(SUM(c.won), 0) AS total_coach_wins, COALESCE(SUM(c.lost), 0) AS total_coach_losses, COALESCE(SUM(c.post_wins), 0) AS total_coach_post_wins, COALESCE(SUM(c.post_losses), 0) AS total_coach_post_losses, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid), 0) AS distinct_teams_played_for, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year), 0) AS distinct_seasons_played, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id), 0) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award), 0) AS distinct_award_types, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award), 0) AS distinct_coach_award_types, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear), 0) AS distinct_draft_years, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid), 0) AS distinct_coaches_played_under, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pa.points), 0) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) DESC) AS regular_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) DESC) AS post_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pa.assists), 0) DESC) AS allstar_assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.assists), 0) DESC) AS regular_assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.postassists), 0) DESC) AS post_assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pa.rebounds), 0) DESC) AS allstar_rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.rebounds), 0) DESC) AS regular_rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.postrebounds), 0) DESC) AS post_rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pa.steals), 0) DESC) AS allstar_steals_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.steals), 0) DESC) AS regular_steals_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.poststeals), 0) DESC) AS post_steals_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pa.blocks), 0) DESC) AS allstar_blocks_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.blocks), 0) DESC) AS regular_blocks_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.postblocks), 0) DESC) AS post_blocks_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pa.turnovers), 0) ASC) AS allstar_turnovers_rank_asc, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.turnovers), 0) ASC) AS regular_turnovers_rank_asc, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.postturnovers), 0) ASC) AS post_turnovers_rank_asc, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pa.personal_fouls), 0) ASC) AS allstar_fouls_rank_asc, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.pf), 0) ASC) AS regular_fouls_rank_asc, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpf), 0) ASC) AS post_fouls_rank_asc, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(AVG(pa.points), 0) DESC) AS avg_allstar_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)), 0) DESC) AS avg_regular_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(MAX(d.draftoverall), 0) ASC) AS draft_pick_rank_asc, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year), 0) DESC) AS award_years_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT c.year), 0) DESC) AS coached_years_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(t.won), 0) DESC) AS team_wins_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(t.lost), 0) ASC) AS team_losses_rank_asc, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(sp.w), 0) DESC) AS playoff_series_wins_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(sp.l), 0) ASC) AS playoff_series_losses_rank_asc, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(c.won), 0) DESC) AS coach_wins_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(c.lost), 0) ASC) AS coach_losses_rank_asc, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(c.post_wins), 0) DESC) AS coach_post_wins_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(c.post_losses), 0) ASC) AS coach_post_losses_rank_asc, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid), 0) DESC) AS distinct_teams_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year), 0) DESC) AS distinct_seasons_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id), 0) DESC) AS distinct_allstar_seasons_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award), 0) DESC) AS distinct_award_types_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award), 0) DESC) AS distinct_coach_award_types_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear), 0) DESC) AS distinct_draft_years_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid), 0) DESC) AS distinct_coaches_rank FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying AND pa.points > 25.48 AND pa.season_id >= 1974.57 LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying AND pt.points > 629.79 AND pt.year >= 1986.99 LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying AND ap.year >= 1965.93 LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON p.playerid = ac.coachid::character varying AND ac.year >= 1995.03 LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying AND d.draftyear >= 1976.1 LEFT JOIN coaches c ON p.playerid = c.coachid AND c.year >= 1950.14 LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND t.year >= 1998.52 LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND sp.year >= 2003.67 WHERE p.height > 198.73 AND p.weight > 69.02 AND p.firstseason >= 1993.53 AND p.lastseason <= 1986.55 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.height, p.weight HAVING COALESCE(SUM(pa.points), 0) > 633.22 OR COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) > 20790.3 OR COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) > 3614.25 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, total_regular_points DESC, total_post_points DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award) AS coach_awards, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, ROUND(SUM(pt.fgmade)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(pt.fgattempted), 0) * 100, 2) AS fg_percentage, ROUND(SUM(pt.ftmade)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(pt.ftattempted), 0) * 100, 2) AS ft_percentage, ROUND(SUM(pt.threemade)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(pt.threeattempted), 0) * 100, 2) AS three_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid THEN sp.id END) AS playoff_series_count, MAX(c.won) AS coach_wins, MAX(c.lost) AS coach_losses, d.draftround, d.draftselection FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (pt.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR pt.tmid = sp.tmidloser) AND pt.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1612 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2011 AND 1993 AND pa.minutes > 4 AND t.won > 45 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, d.draftround, d.draftselection HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3975 AND AVG(pa.points) > 50 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 8 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS league_points_rank, (SUM(pt.points) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pt.minutes), 0)) AS points_per_minute FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 1840.47 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1994.95 AND 1947.77 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 44249.67 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 18.34 ORDER BY total_points DESC, seasons_played DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1984 AND pt.year <= 2001 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND pt.points > 701 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 19548 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 45 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_team, (SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.assists) + SUM(pt.rebounds)) AS total_contrib FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 2009 AND pt.year <= 2019 AND pt.points > 1316 AND t.won > 17 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.year, t.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2504 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 1 ORDER BY total_contrib DESC, points_rank_in_team;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner WHERE pt.points > 50 AND pa.points > 23 AND t.won > 44 AND c.won > 59 AND sp.w > 5 AND ap.year >= 1958 AND d.draftyear <= 2015 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 11798 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 8 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT
