c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.points > 22 AND pa.points > 32 AND t.lost > 81 AND c.lost > 55 AND sp.l > 6 AND ap.year >= 1951 AND d.draftyear <= 1980 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2639 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, t.tmid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS birth_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, SUM(ap.three_made) AS total_allstar_threes, MAX(c.won) AS max_coach_wins, SUM(s.w) AS total_series_wins, GROUPING(p.playerid, t.tmid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS grouping_flag FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN series_post s ON t.tmid::integer = s.tmidwinner AND t.year = s.year JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year WHERE pt.points > 1231.84 AND ap.minutes > 2.85 AND t.won > 38.22 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 1928.26 AND 1909.0 GROUP BY CUBE(p.playerid, t.tmid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 26088.05 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 47.76 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_assists ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, t.tmid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS birth_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.league_id = 'NBA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nba_allstar_games, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS overall_assists_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1993 AND pt.year <= 2008 AND pt.points > 95 AND t.won > 75 GROUP BY CUBE(p.playerid, t.tmid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 46331 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 13 ORDER BY total_points DESC, overall_assists_rank;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, AVG(t.won) AS avg_wins, SUM(t.attendance) AS total_attendance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coaches c WHERE c.lgid = t.lgid AND c.year = t.year AND c.won > 27.92) AS coaches_above_threshold FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1968.68 AND 1998.27 AND t.attendance > 878983.58 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = (SELECT award FROM awards_players WHERE playerid = ap.playerid AND year = ap.year AND award LIKE '%MVP%' LIMIT 1) ) GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year HAVING AVG(t.won) > 60.03 ORDER BY total_attendance DESC;

SELECT t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t.year = pt.year WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT year FROM players_teams WHERE playerid IN ( SELECT playerid FROM awards_players WHERE year BETWEEN 2014 AND 1961 ) ) GROUP BY t.name HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 20.78 ORDER BY player_count DESC;

SELECT t.name, t.won AS team_wins, t.lost AS team_losses, c.coachid AS coach_id, c.won AS coach_wins, c.lost AS coach_losses, AVG(c.won::numeric / (c.won + c.lost)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid) AS avg_coach_win_pct_by_team, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(c.won::numeric / (c.won + c.lost)) DESC) AS overall_coach_win_pct_rank FROM teams t JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.won > 1.03 AND c.won > 79.51 GROUP BY t.name, t.tmid, t.won, t.lost, c.coachid, c.won, c.lost ORDER BY overall_coach_win_pct_rank;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.won, t2.attendance, t1.o_pts, t2.d_pts, (t1.o_pts - t2.d_pts) AS net_pts_diff FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year WHERE t1.won > 41.48 AND t2.attendance > 989611.83 GROUP BY t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.won, t2.attendance, t1.o_pts, t2.d_pts HAVING (t1.o_pts - t2.d_pts) > 800.35 ORDER BY net_pts_diff DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS full_name, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer WHERE pt.points > 27.52 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1969 AND 1965 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 2 ORDER BY avg_points_per_game DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 2014 AND p.lastseason <= 1990 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) >= 7 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.year >= 1974 AND pt.year <= 1998 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 19760 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 1155 AND pt.year >= 1968 AND pt.year <= 2000 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 41507 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE (pt.points > 2373 OR pt.assists > 125) AND NOT (pt.year < 1985) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 11634 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 12 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid AS team_id, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league_id, t.year AS season_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS total_players, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS avg_points_per_minute, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid AND ap.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_count_in_season_league FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year AND t.lgid = pt.lgid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying AND d.draftyear = t.year - 1 WHERE t.year >= 2012 AND t.year <= 1966 AND t.won >= 6 AND t.attendance >= 624794 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 24711 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) >= 1 UNION ALL SELECT t.tmid AS team_id, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league_id, t.year AS season_year, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS total_coaches, SUM(c.won) AS total_wins_by_coaches, SUM(c.lost) AS total_losses_by_coaches, SUM(c.post_wins) AS total_postseason_wins, AVG(c.won * 1.0 / NULLIF(c.won + c.lost, 0)) AS win_percentage, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(c.won) DESC) AS coach_wins_rank_in_league, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_coaches ac WHERE ac.year = t.year AND ac.lgid = t.lgid AND ac.award LIKE '%Coach%') AS coach_awards_count FROM teams t JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year AND t.lgid = c.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1960 AND t.year <= 1985 AND t.won >= 1 AND t.attendance >= 602939 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(c.won) > 68 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) >= 2 ORDER BY season_year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstseason AS first_season, p.lastseason AS last_season, ap.season_id AS allstar_season, pt.year AS team_year, pt.tmid AS team_id, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league_id, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_blocks, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.points > 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_scoring_allstar_games, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league_year, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS team_losses, MAX(t.attendance) AS max_attendance FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 1996 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND pt.points > 2544 AND ap.points > 33 AND t.attendance > 270117 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (p.playerid, p.firstseason, p.lastseason, ap.season_id, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, t.lgid), (p.playerid, p.firstseason, p.lastseason), (pt.year, t.lgid), (pt.tmid, t.name), () ) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 7216 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 9 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC LIMIT 117;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) AS total_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying WHERE p.firstseason >= 1958 AND p.lastseason <= 1966 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) > 32399 ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, SUM(ap.year) AS total_award_years, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS highest_draft_pick, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_post_points, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS distinct_teams_played_for, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS total_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(pa.points) DESC) AS avg_allstar_points_rank FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner WHERE (p.firstseason >= 1971 AND p.lastseason <= 2002) AND (ap.year BETWEEN 2012 AND 1987) AND (d.draftyear >= 1976) AND (pa.season_id >= 2004) AND (pt.year BETWEEN 2004 AND 2004) AND (t.year = pt.year) AND (c.year = t.year) AND (ac.year = c.year) AND (sp.year = t.year) AND (p.height > '150.0' OR p.weight > 194) AND NOT (p.college IS NULL AND p.highschool IS NULL) AND (ap.award LIKE '%''%' OR ac.award LIKE '%''%') AND (t.playoff = 'Y' OR sp.round IN ('Finals', 'Conference Finals')) AND (pt.gp > 0 AND pa.games_played > 0) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 42108 AND AVG(pa.points) > 31 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) >= 2 ORDER BY total_points_rank, avg_allstar_points_rank LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_team_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE ap.conference = 'East' AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 14 AND SUM(ap.points) >= 271 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.year >= 1985 AND pt.year <= 2002 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 8645 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND ap.year = pa.season_id WHERE ap.year >= 2000 AND pa.points > 34 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 8 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND ap.year = pa.season_id WHERE ap.year >= 1950 AND pa.points > 36 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) > 7 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 1483 AND pt.year >= 1989 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3778 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2009 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 6158 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 1889 AND pt.year >= 1990 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 10884 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 1959 AND pt.year <= 1980 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 23126 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying WHERE pa.season_id >= 2017 AND pa.season_id <= 1976 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 20 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 2016 AND pt.year <= 2003 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = pt.playerid AND d.draftyear < 1971 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 35163 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, SUM(pa.points) AS allstar_points, COUNT(pa.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS player_award_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award) AS coach_award_count, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins_in_seasons, SUM(s.w) AS playoff_series_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN series_post s ON t.tmid::integer = s.tmidwinner AND t.year = s.year WHERE pt.points > 145 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2018 AND 1960 AND pa.points > 27 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 19148 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 9 UNION ALL SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_points, AVG(pt.postpoints * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.postgp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.postpoints) DESC) AS points_rank, 0 AS allstar_points, 0 AS allstar_appearances, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS player_award_count, 0 AS coach_award_count, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins_in_seasons, SUM(s.w) AS playoff_series_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN series_post s ON t.tmid::integer = s.tmidwinner AND t.year = s.year WHERE pt.postpoints > 665 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1961 AND 1953 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.postpoints) > 3932 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 12 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE p.college LIKE '%''%' AND pt.year BETWEEN 1969 AND 1989 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3005 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1997 AND pt.year <= 2005 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1938 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 18032.5 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 10245.56 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS scoring_category FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2014 AND pt.year <= 2011 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 9427.47 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_active FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.lgid = 'NBA' AND pt.year >= 1999 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND ap.year BETWEEN 2014 AND 1959 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 14065 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) AS num_awards, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_blocks, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.league_id ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid, pt.lgid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points, (SELECT MAX(t.won) FROM teams t WHERE t.year = pt.year AND t.lgid = pt.lgid) AS max_team_wins_in_year_league FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid = awp.playerid::integer::character varying AND ap.season_id = awp.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::integer::character varying LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND t.year = sp.year WHERE ap.points > 11 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1997 AND 1977 AND t.won > 74 AND d.draftyear < 1955 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, pt.lgid, pt.year HAVING AVG(ap.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) >= 11 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid = aw.playerid::character varying WHERE ap.points > 2.48 AND aw.award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND aw.year IN (SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND year >= 1963.26) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 1.64 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, p.height, p.weight, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(ap.assists) AS total_allstar_assists, AVG(ap.assists) AS avg_allstar_assists, SUM(ap.rebounds) AS total_allstar_rebounds, AVG(ap.rebounds) AS avg_allstar_rebounds, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.league_id, ', ' ORDER BY ap.league_id) AS allstar_leagues, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS team_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_team_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_team_assists, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_team_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_team_rebounds, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_team_rebounds, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pt.lgid, ', ' ORDER BY pt.lgid) AS team_leagues, COUNT(DISTINCT ap2.award) AS award_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap2.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap2.award) AS awards, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_pick, t.name AS last_team_name, t.won AS last_team_wins, t.lost AS last_team_losses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) DESC) AS allstar_seasons_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN awards_players ap2 ON p.playerid = ap2.playerid::character varying JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE p.height > 228.41 AND p.weight > 114.37 AND ap.points > 32.22 AND pt.points > 1367.53 AND t.won > 58.09 AND d.draftyear >= 1953.29 AND d.draftyear <= 1961.95 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, p.height, p.weight, t.name, t.won, t.lost HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 2.84 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 4.59 AND SUM(ap.points) > 362.88 AND SUM(pt.points) > 24633.5 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, total_team_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, p.height, p.weight, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_blocks, SUM(pt.turnovers) AS total_turnovers, SUM(pt.pf) AS total_fouls, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute, AVG(pt.fgmade * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.fgattempted, 0)) AS fg_pct, AVG(pt.ftmade * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.ftattempted, 0)) AS ft_pct, AVG(pt.threemade * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.threeattempted, 0)) AS three_pct, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(ap.season_id) AS last_allstar_season, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, MAX(a.year) AS last_award_year, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) AS distinct_awards, MAX(d.draftyear) AS draft_year, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, MAX(t.won) AS max_team_wins, MIN(t.lost) AS min_team_losses, SUM(t.o_pts) AS total_team_points_for, SUM(t.d_pts) AS total_team_points_against, SUM(s.w) AS total_playoff_wins, SUM(s.l) AS total_playoff_losses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.steals) DESC) AS steals_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.blocks) DESC) AS blocks_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.turnovers) DESC) AS turnovers_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) DESC) AS ppm_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN awards_players a ON p.playerid = a.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN series_post s ON t.tmid::character varying = s.tmidwinner::character varying OR t.tmid::character varying = s.tmidloser::character varying WHERE p.height > 233.2 AND p.weight > 180.46 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1964 AND 1998 AND t.won > 30 AND (a.award IS NULL OR a.award != '') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, p.height, p.weight HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 11480 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 1604 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 16672 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 19 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_rebounds DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.height, p.weight, p.firstseason, p.lastseason, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_regular_rebounds, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_regular_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_regular_assists, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_regular_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, COUNT(DISTINCT ap2.season_id) AS allstar_seasons_teammate, AVG(ap2.points) AS avg_teammate_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN players_teams pt2 ON pt.tmid = pt2.tmid AND pt.year = pt2.year AND pt.playerid != pt2.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap2 ON pt2.playerid = ap2.playerid AND pt2.year = ap2.season_id JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN teams t2 ON pt2.tmid::integer = t2.id AND pt2.year = t2.year JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year WHERE p.height > 168.98 AND p.weight > 132.73 AND p.firstseason >= 1964.84 AND p.lastseason <= 1975.46 AND t.won > 12.94 AND t2.won > 48.75 AND ap.points > 18.27 AND pt.points > 2756.01 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.height, p.weight, p.firstseason, p.lastseason HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 16.36 AND AVG(ap.points) > 11.02 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS birth_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS birth_quarter, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2006 AND pt.year <= 1957 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) >= 2000 AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) IN (3) AND pt.points > 1 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2699 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award) AS coach_awards, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, ROUND(SUM(pt.fgmade)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(pt.fgattempted), 0) * 100, 2) AS fg_percentage, ROUND(SUM(pt.ftmade)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(pt.ftattempted), 0) * 100, 2) AS ft_percentage, ROUND(SUM(pt.threemade)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(pt.threeattempted), 0) * 100, 2) AS three_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid THEN sp.id END) AS playoff_series_count, MAX(c.won) AS coach_wins, MAX(c.lost) AS coach_losses, d.draftround, d.draftselection FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (pt.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR pt.tmid = sp.tmidloser) AND pt.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 3981 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1989 AND 1982 AND pa.minutes > 35 AND t.won > 58 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, d.draftround, d.draftselection HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 8408 AND AVG(pa.points) > 28 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 10 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS career_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS career_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS avg_points_per_minute, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pt.points) AS median_points_per_season, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pt.assists) AS percentile_75_assists, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS overall_assists_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.rebounds), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_rebounds FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 2091 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1954 AND 1982 AND t.won > 24 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' AND d.draftyear >= 1955 AND pa.points >= 15 AND c.won > 73 AND ac.year = c.year AND sp.round = 'Conf Finals' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 19711 AND AVG(pt.assists) >= 8.44 ORDER BY career_points DESC, pt.year, team_points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year_league, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year WHERE pt.year >= 1989 AND pt.year <= 2020 AND pt.minutes > 1 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2221 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) <= 1 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_pick, SUM(CASE WHEN c.post_wins > c.post_losses THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS winning_postseasons, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_team FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE pt.year >= 2016 AND pt.year <= 1987 AND pt.points > 2531 AND t.won > 3 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.year, t.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 8991 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 4 AND AVG(pa.points) >= 21 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank_in_team;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.lgid, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(CASE WHEN ac.award LIKE '%MVP%' THEN 1 END) AS mvp_awards, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t.id THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_wins_by_team FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ac ON p.playerid::integer = ac.playerid AND pt.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 855 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1995 AND 2007 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.lgid, pt.year), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.lgid, pt.year), (t.name, t.lgid, pt.year), (t.lgid, pt.year), (pt.year), ()) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 29798 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.year, t.lgid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points_last_n_seasons, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_last_n_seasons, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank_in_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 2007 AND pt.year <= 1982 AND pt.points > 2452 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.year, t.lgid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 5496 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points_last_n_seasons DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.assists) AS avg_allstar_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, pt.year, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_regular_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_regular_rebounds, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_regular_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_regular_blocks, SUM(pt.turnovers) AS total_regular_turnovers, SUM(pt.fgmade) AS total_fgmade, SUM(pt.fgattempted) AS total_fgattempted, (CASE WHEN SUM(pt.fgattempted) > 0 THEN (SUM(pt.fgmade)::float / SUM(pt.fgattempted)::float) * 100 ELSE 0 END) AS fg_percentage, SUM(pt.ftmade) AS total_ftmade, SUM(pt.ftattempted) AS total_ftattempted, (CASE WHEN SUM(pt.ftattempted) > 0 THEN (SUM(pt.ftmade)::float / SUM(pt.ftattempted)::float) * 100 ELSE 0 END) AS ft_percentage, SUM(pt.threemade) AS total_threemade, SUM(pt.threeattempted) AS total_threeattempted, (CASE WHEN SUM(pt.threeattempted) > 0 THEN (SUM(pt.threemade)::float / SUM(pt.threeattempted)::float) * 100 ELSE 0 END) AS three_percentage, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, c.year AS coach_year, c.won AS coach_wins, c.lost AS coach_losses, (CASE WHEN (c.won + c.lost) > 0 THEN (c.won::float / (c.won + c.lost)::float) * 100 ELSE 0 END) AS coach_win_percentage, sp.year AS playoff_year, sp.round, sp.w AS playoff_wins, sp.l AS playoff_losses, ac.award, ac.note AS award_note, ap2.award AS player_award, ap2.note AS player_award_note, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league_year, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS overall_points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points, LEAD(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS next_year_points, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_percentile, CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_cume_dist, SUM(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid) AS league_year_total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid) AS avg_points_per_player_in_league_year FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid::integer AND t.year = c.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid = ac.coachid::character varying AND c.year = ac.year JOIN awards_players ap2 ON p.playerid::integer = ap2.playerid AND pt.year = ap2.year WHERE ap.points > 37.5 AND pt.points > 20.95 AND t.year BETWEEN 2017.18 AND 1983.56 AND d.draftyear >= 1997.74 AND c.won >= 67.83 AND sp.w >= 1.02 AND ac.year = c.year AND ap2.year = pt.year GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, pt.year, t.name, t.lgid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, c.year, c.won, c.lost, sp.year, sp.round, sp.w, sp.l, ac.award, ac.note, ap2.award, ap2.note HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 788.54 AND AVG(pt.assists) > 6.14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 5.92 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 1412.18 AND SUM(pt.steals) > 230.68 AND SUM(pt.blocks) > 392.82 AND (CASE WHEN SUM(pt.fgattempted) > 0 THEN (SUM(pt.fgmade)::float / SUM(pt.fgattempted)::float) * 100 ELSE 0 END) > 88.14 AND (CASE WHEN SUM(pt.ftattempted) > 0 THEN (SUM(pt.ftmade)::float / SUM(pt.ftattempted)::float) * 100 ELSE 0 END) > 82.92 AND (CASE WHEN SUM(pt.threeattempted) > 0 THEN (SUM(pt.threemade)::float / SUM(pt.threeattempted)::float) * 100 ELSE 0 END) > 99.69 ORDER BY total_regular_points DESC, avg_regular_assists DESC, total_regular_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, pt.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute FROM players_teams pt JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id JOIN player_allstar ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id WHERE pt.year >= 2000.88 AND pt.year <= 2000.35 GROUP BY p.playerid, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3166.38 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, AVG(pt.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_points, SUM(pt.assists) OVER ( PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS running_total_assists FROM players_teams pt JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id::integer WHERE pt.year >= 2002 AND pt.points > 1464 AND p.firstseason <= 2011 ORDER BY pt.playerid, pt.year;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS total_players, SUM(p.points) AS total_points, AVG(p.points) AS avg_points_per_player, SUM(p.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(p.assists) AS total_assists, MAX(ap.awards_count) AS max_awards_per_player, (SELECT MAX(sub_awards) FROM (SELECT COUNT(award) AS sub_awards FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid IN (SELECT playerid FROM players_teams pt2 WHERE pt2.tmid = t.id AND pt2.year = t.year) GROUP BY ap2.playerid) subq) AS max_awards_in_team_year, (SELECT AVG(draft_rank) FROM (SELECT draftoverall AS draft_rank FROM draft d WHERE d.tmid = t.id AND d.draftyear = t.year) draft_sub) AS avg_draft_rank FROM teams t JOIN players_teams p ON t.id = p.tmid AND t.year = p.year LEFT JOIN (SELECT playerid, COUNT(*) AS awards_count FROM awards_players GROUP BY playerid) ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid WHERE t.year >= 1974 AND t.year <= 1974 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.lgid, t.id HAVING SUM(p.points) > 4225 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) >= 10 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, COALESCE(SUM(p.points), 0) AS total_player_points, COALESCE(SUM(c.won), 0) AS total_coach_wins, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT s.id), 0) AS series_appearances, AVG(pa.points) OVER (PARTITION BY t.year, t.lgid) AS avg_league_points_per_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t.won DESC) AS win_rank FROM teams t LEFT JOIN players_teams p ON t.tmid::integer = p.tmid AND t.year = p.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post s ON (t.tmid::integer = s.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = s.tmidloser) AND t.year = s.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid AND p.year = pa.season_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2015 AND t.won > 74 AND t.games > 6 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.lgid, pa.points HAVING COALESCE(SUM(p.points), 0) > 22319 AND COALESCE(SUM(c.won), 0) > 35 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC, win_rank;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, t.name, SUM(COALESCE(pt.points, 0)) AS total_player_points, AVG(COALESCE(pt.points, 0)) AS avg_player_points, SUM(COALESCE(pt.rebounds, 0)) AS total_player_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(COALESCE(ps.points, 0)) AS total_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(pt.points, 0)) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league, LAG(SUM(COALESCE(pt.points, 0)), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id LEFT JOIN player_allstar ps ON pt.playerid = ps.playerid AND pt.year = ps.season_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1955 AND 1978 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award LIKE '%MVP%' ) AND t.lgid IN (SELECT lgid FROM coaches WHERE year = t.year AND won > 50) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, t.name HAVING AVG(COALESCE(pt.points, 0)) > 8 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) >= 13 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, COUNT(ap.award) AS award_count, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_points, SUM(ps.rebounds) AS total_rebounds FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams ps ON p.id = ps.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 1965 AND ps.year BETWEEN 1999 AND 1976 AND ps.gp > 33 GROUP BY p.playerid HAVING COUNT(ap.award) > 39 ORDER BY total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS total_points_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE pa.season_id >= 1961 AND pa.season_id <= 2019 AND pt.year IN ( SELECT pt2.year FROM players_teams pt2 WHERE pt2.tmid IN ( SELECT t.tmid::integer FROM teams t WHERE t.year = pt2.year AND t.won > 62 ) ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 33.87 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 3 ORDER BY total_points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_points, SUM(ps.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.playerid::integer = ps.playerid WHERE ps.season_id IN (SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'All-NBA') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(ps.points) > 12.27 ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COALESCE(SUM(pa.points), 0) AS total_allstar_points, COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) AS total_regular_points, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) AS total_postseason_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MIN(d.draftyear) AS draft_year, AVG(t.won::numeric / NULLIF(t.games, 0)) * 100 AS avg_team_win_percentage, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pa.points), 0) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) DESC) AS regular_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) DESC) AS postseason_points_rank FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pa.season_id >= 1987 LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND pt.year >= 1960 LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND ap.year >= 1999 LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND t.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::character varying = c.tmid::character varying AND c.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND ac.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser WHERE p.weight > 296 AND p.height > '60.0' AND (t.lgid = 'ABA' OR t.lgid IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(pa.points), 0) > 86 AND COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) > 4648 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 3 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, total_regular_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.points > 2492 AND pt.year >= 1950 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 15 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_pick, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ac.award = 'Most Valuable Player' THEN ac.year END) AS mvp_awards, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) DESC) AS allstar_seasons_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ac ON p.playerid::integer = ac.playerid AND pt.year = ac.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1964 AND 1958 AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' AND t.playoff = 'Y' AND pt.gp > 25 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 42013 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 3 AND AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) >= '5.0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, allstar_seasons DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(ap.award) AS award_count FROM players p LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying WHERE p.firstseason >= 1990 AND p.lastseason <= 1997 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(ap.award) = 0 ORDER BY p.lastname, p.firstname;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1971 AND pt.year <= 1963 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 41634 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 17.61 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1956 AND 1979 AND t.won > 69.36 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > (SELECT AVG(points) FROM players_teams WHERE year = 2019) ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 15333.98 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 9269.04 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS scoring_category FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1991 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 7152.29 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

LAST_VALUE(pt.rebounds) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.minutes RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_rebounds_by_minutes, SUM(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_points, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid, pt.tmid) AS avg_points_per_team, COUNT(*) OVER pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid = ac.coachid::character varying AND WHERE pt.points > 47117 AND pt.year >= 2022 AND t.won >= 2 AND ap.points >= 5 AND d.draftyear <= 1969 AND c.won > 52 AND ac.year BETWEEN 1965 AND 2012 AND awp.year >= 1980 AND sp.year >= 1975 GROUP BY
