SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(1.0 * pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1966 AND pt.year <= 1996 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1722 ORDER BY pt.year, pt.lgid, points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, SUM(pa.points) AS allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points)) AS points_percentile FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 1664 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2001 AND 2010 AND pa.points > 44 AND t.won > 20 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2445 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 22 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 6 AND SUM(pa.points) > 19 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid) AS avg_team_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1960 AND pt.year <= 1977 AND pt.points > 1846 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1809 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, (SELECT MAX(d.draftoverall) FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.id AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1983 AND 1981) AS max_draft_position, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = pt.tmid AND c.year = pt.year AND c.won > 11) AS coaches_with_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::text = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1975 AND (pt.points > 2431 OR pt.assists > 887) AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' AND (t.playoff = 'Y' OR t.confid = 'East') AND NOT (p.college IS NULL AND p.highschool IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, pt.lgid, p.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1075 AND AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) > 0.47 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pa.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying WHERE pa.season_id >= 1985 AND pa.season_id <= 1951 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 2896 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points AS regular_points, p2.points AS allstar_points, (p1.points - p2.points) AS point_diff FROM players_teams p1 JOIN player_allstar p2 ON p1.playerid = p2.playerid AND p1.year = p2.season_id WHERE p1.points > 2884 AND p2.points > 60 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points, p2.points HAVING (p1.points - p2.points) > 753 ORDER BY point_diff DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.year = pt.year AND t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid JOIN draft d ON pt.playerid = d.playerid WHERE t.year >= 1989 AND d.draftyear <= 1969 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 18198 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) >= 10 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 1389.59 AND pt.year >= 1972.53 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 28.09 ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE p.firstname LIKE 'A%' AND ap.award LIKE '%MVP%' AND pt.year >= 2016.63 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 7125.61 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) > 24452.55 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.points) BETWEEN 9899.18 AND 7689.4 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS scoring_category FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 2018 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) >= 6495.75 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) > 42855.13 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.assists) > 7388.09 THEN 'High Assister' ELSE 'Balanced' END AS player_category FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND p.id::text = pt.playerid::text JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::text = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2001 AND pt.year <= 1992 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 22543.16 OR SUM(pt.assists) > 370.66 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, pt.tmid;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS unique_coaches FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 2008 AND t.won > 9 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year), (t.lgid, t.year), (t.year), () ) ORDER BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.lgid, SUM(pt.minutes) AS total_minutes_played, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_player, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2006.47 AND 2018.37 AND (t.lgid = 'NBA' OR t.lgid = 'NBA') AND t.playoff = 'Y' AND pt.minutes > 3057.65 AND NOT (p.birthcountry = 'USA') GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 39494.31 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_minutes_played DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.tmid, t1.name, t1.won AS wins, t2.won AS previous_wins, (t1.won - t2.won) AS win_improvement FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.won > 50 AND t2.won > 28 ORDER BY win_improvement DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT a.coachid, c.year, c.tmid, t.name, SUM(c.won) AS total_wins, AVG(c.won::numeric / (c.won + c.lost)) AS win_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) AS distinct_awards, SUM(COALESCE(pt.points, 0)) AS total_player_points FROM awards_coaches a INNER JOIN coaches c ON a.coachid::integer = c.coachid::integer AND a.year = c.year LEFT JOIN teams t ON c.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND c.year = t.year LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON c.tmid::integer = pt.tmid::integer AND c.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::integer = p.playerid::integer WHERE a.lgid = 'NBA' AND c.year BETWEEN 1979 AND 2011 GROUP BY a.coachid, c.year, c.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(c.won) > 24 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, win_percentage DESC;

SELECT a.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) AS distinct_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS distinct_teams, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pa.rebounds) AS avg_allstar_rebounds, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_regular_rebounds FROM awards_players a JOIN players p ON a.playerid = p.id JOIN player_allstar pa ON a.playerid = pa.playerid AND a.year = pa.season_id JOIN players_teams pt ON a.playerid = pt.playerid AND a.year = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::text = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year WHERE a.year >= 2005 AND a.year <= 1956 AND pt.points > 2544 GROUP BY a.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) > 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 12 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, distinct_awards DESC;

SELECT ap.playerid, ap.year, ap.award, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ap.playerid ORDER BY ap.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS award_count_3yr_moving, AVG(pa.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pa.playerid ORDER BY pa.season_id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS avg_points_3game_moving FROM awards_players ap JOIN player_allstar pa ON ap.playerid = pa.playerid AND ap.year = pa.season_id JOIN players p ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 2011.78 GROUP BY ap.playerid, ap.year, ap.award, pa.playerid, pa.season_id, pa.points ORDER BY ap.year DESC, award_count_3yr_moving DESC;

SELECT aps.award AS award_name, AVG(aps.year) AS avg_award_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pts.playerid) AS unique_players_count, SUM(pts.points) AS total_points, SUM(pts.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pts.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, MAX(teams.won) AS max_team_wins, MIN(teams.lost) AS min_team_losses, SUM(teams.o_pts) AS total_team_offensive_points, SUM(teams.d_pts) AS total_team_defensive_points, AVG(players.height) AS avg_player_height, SUM(CASE WHEN pts.minutes > 1343.32 THEN pts.points ELSE 0 END) AS high_minute_points FROM awards_players aps JOIN players_teams pts ON aps.playerid = pts.playerid AND aps.year = pts.year JOIN teams ON pts.tmid::character varying = teams.tmid AND pts.year = teams.year JOIN players ON aps.playerid::character varying = players.playerid JOIN draft d ON aps.playerid = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pts.year = c.year AND pts.tmid = c.tmid JOIN series_post sp ON teams.tmid::character varying = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND teams.year = sp.year JOIN player_allstar pas ON aps.playerid = pas.playerid AND aps.year = pas.season_id WHERE aps.award IS NOT NULL AND pts.points > 1903.26 AND teams.won > 54.79 AND teams.year BETWEEN 1968.66 AND 1994.55 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_coaches ac WHERE ac.coachid::character varying = c.coachid AND ac.year = c.year AND ac.award = 'Coach of the Year') GROUP BY aps.award, teams.tmid, teams.year, pts.tmid, pts.year HAVING SUM(pts.points) > 12453.2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pts.playerid) >= 1666.47 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_award_year ASC;

SELECT p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year FROM players p INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1992.21 AND pt.points > 1.5 GROUP BY p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1974.5 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, ROUND(AVG(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)), 2) AS avg_points_per_game, ROUND(AVG(pt.assists::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)), 2) AS avg_assists_per_game, ROUND(AVG(pt.rebounds::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)), 2) AS avg_rebounds_per_game, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid::integer = p.id AND ap.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_awards_count, (SELECT AVG(pa.points) FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid::integer = p.id AND pa.season_id >= 1968) AS avg_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2010 AND 1998 AND pt.points > 2805 AND t.won > 57 AND (c.won > 27 OR c.post_wins > 25) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, p.id HAVING AVG(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) > 13.31 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, avg_points_per_game DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pa.points) AS median_points, SUM(pa.assists) AS total_assists FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE pa.points > 34 AND pa.season_id >= 1963 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.assists) > 4 ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_points, SUM(ps.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.playerid::integer = ps.playerid WHERE ps.season_id IN (SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'All-NBA') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(ps.points) > 20.08 ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE ap.year = pa.season_id AND ap.year >= 2005 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 14402 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 2020 AND pa.year >= 1982 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 8655 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, SUM(ap.year) AS total_award_years, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS highest_draft_pick, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_post_points, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS distinct_teams_played_for, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS total_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(pa.points) DESC) AS avg_allstar_points_rank FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner WHERE (p.firstseason >= 1971 AND p.lastseason <= 2010) AND (ap.year BETWEEN 1988 AND 1961) AND (d.draftyear >= 2000) AND (pa.season_id >= 2021) AND (pt.year BETWEEN 1978 AND 1976) AND (t.year = pt.year) AND (c.year = t.year) AND (ac.year = c.year) AND (sp.year = t.year) AND (p.height > '150.0' OR p.weight > 184) AND NOT (p.college IS NULL AND p.highschool IS NULL) AND (ap.award LIKE '%''%' OR ac.award LIKE '%''%') AND (t.playoff = 'Y' OR sp.round IN ('Finals', 'Conference Finals')) AND (pt.gp > 0 AND pa.games_played > 0) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 31411 AND AVG(pa.points) > 9 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) >= 7 ORDER BY total_points_rank, avg_allstar_points_rank LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_award_types, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, SUM(CASE WHEN c.coachid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coached_seasons FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON p.playerid::integer = c.coachid::integer WHERE pt.year >= 1961 AND pt.year <= 2016 AND pa.season_id >= 2018 AND pa.season_id <= 2012 AND pt.points > 1405 AND pa.points > 80 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 37429 AND AVG(pa.points) > 17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 7 ORDER BY career_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 2001 AND p.lastseason <= 1962 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 18 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year WHERE pt.points > 1492 AND ap.season_id >= 1968 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 49078 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 9 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = 'All-NBA First Team' ) AND pt.year BETWEEN 1973 AND 2003 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 22511 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(ap.award) AS award_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND d.draftyear > 1993.52 ) AND t.year BETWEEN 2005.28 AND 1958.69 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2250.92 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pt.points) AS median_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.points > 2835 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2011 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 28.0 ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(CAST(pt.points AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1974 AND pt.year <= 1957 AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 42819 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year >= 2014 AND pt.year <= 2009 AND pt.points > 6469 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 25579 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 2168 AND t.won > 43 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1605 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes_per_season FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= (SELECT MIN(year) FROM players_teams WHERE points > 1310) AND pt.year <= 1987 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 9653 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year IN (SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'Most Valuable Player') AND pt.gp >= 27 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 925 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) DESC) AS awards_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2018 AND pt.year <= 1974 AND pt.points > 1336 AND pa.points > 69 AND d.draftyear >= 1978 AND d.draftyear <= 2005 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 22780 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE (pt.points > 2416 OR pt.assists > 479) AND NOT (pt.tmid = 18 AND pt.year < 1955) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 32759 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 7 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid::integer JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner WHERE pt.year >= 2000 AND pt.year <= 2004 AND pt.points > 523 AND ap.year >= 2001 AND d.draftyear >= 1967 AND pa.season_id >= 1966 AND c.year >= 1979 AND t.year >= 1974 AND sp.year >= 2003 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 40847 AND AVG(pt.assists) > 7.73 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 14 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid::integer JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.year >= 1991 AND pt.year <= 1985 AND pt.points > 228 AND ap.year >= 1953 AND d.draftyear >= 2015 AND pa.season_id >= 1989 AND c.year >= 2000 AND t.year >= 2004 AND sp.year >= 1979 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 7474 AND AVG(pt.assists) > 11.86 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 4 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid AND pt.year = d.draftyear WHERE pt.year IN (SELECT year FROM coaches WHERE coachid::integer = 5222 AND lgid = 'NBA') AND pt.points > 897 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1976 AND 2010 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 26202 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 2 ORDER BY career_points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1987 AND pt.year <= 2016 AND (pt.points > 43 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player')) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 20666 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.lgid ORDER BY AVG(pt.points) DESC) AS league_avg_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid::integer JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.year >= 1963 AND pt.year <= 1966 AND pt.points > 15 AND pa.points > 0 AND t.won > 59 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 8204 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1980 AND pt.year <= 1995 AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 29167 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2020 AND pt.year <= 2006 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 19750 ORDER BY total_points DESC;
