SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND year BETWEEN 1994 AND 2008 ) AND pt.points > 195 ORDER BY pt.points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, SUM(pa.points) AS allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, SUM(sp.w) AS playoff_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 1083 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1962 AND 1975 AND pa.points > 36 AND t.won > 34 AND c.won > 31 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2161 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 4 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 26 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) AS stint_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid::integer AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE p.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT d.playerid FROM draft d WHERE d.draftyear BETWEEN 1993 AND 1959 AND d.draftround <= 1 ) AND pt.year BETWEEN 1991 AND 1967 AND pt.points > 2963 AND pt.minutes >= 418 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 263 AND AVG(pt.minutes) >= 380 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) <= 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_minutes DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(*) AS games_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 33 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1996 AND 1990 AND t.won > 41 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 984 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, ap.points AS allstar_points, ap.rebounds AS allstar_rebounds, ap.assists AS allstar_assists, pt.points AS regular_points, pt.rebounds AS regular_rebounds, pt.assists AS regular_assists, pt.steals AS regular_steals, pt.blocks AS regular_blocks, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftselection, c.coachid, ac.award AS coach_award, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, sp.w AS series_wins, sp.l AS series_losses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.tmid ORDER BY pt.points DESC, pt.rebounds DESC, pt.assists DESC) AS team_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year DESC, pt.points DESC) AS player_season_rank, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS career_points_running_total, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid, pt.year) AS team_avg_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN awards_players aap ON p.id = aap.playerid AND pt.year = aap.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (pt.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR pt.tmid = sp.tmidloser) AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 2955 AND pt.rebounds > 917 AND pt.assists > 585 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1984 AND 2004 AND ap.points > 38 AND t.won > 31 AND t.lost < 52 AND (sp.w > 2 OR sp.w IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.rebounds, ap.assists, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, pt.steals, pt.blocks, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftselection, c.coachid, ac.award, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, sp.w, sp.l HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 11 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 4 ORDER BY team_rank, player_season_rank, career_points_running_total DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, t.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_ppg, AVG(pt.assists * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_apg, AVG(pt.rebounds * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_rpg, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank_in_league_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank_in_league_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) FILTER (WHERE ap.award IS NOT NULL) AS distinct_awards_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid AND sp.year = pt.year) AS team_playoff_series_wins, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = pt.tmid AND c.year = pt.year AND c.won > c.lost) AS winning_coach_stints FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying AND d.draftyear = p.firstseason LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1976 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND pt.gp >= 66 AND pt.points >= 3756 AND (p.college = 'University of California, Los Angeles' OR p.college IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 6176 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 7238 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 19387 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC, total_assists DESC, total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_by_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM coaches c WHERE c.won > 60 AND c.lost < 76 UNION SELECT DISTINCT year FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.w > 9 AND sp.l < 0 ) AND pt.points > 493 AND t.attendance > 52327 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4745 AND AVG(pt.points) > 42 ORDER BY total_points DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, pt.year, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_overall_pick FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1960 AND pt.gp > 28 AND pt.tmid IN ( SELECT tmid FROM coaches WHERE year = pt.year AND won > 51 AND lgid = 'NBA' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.year = pt.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) AND sp.round = 'Finals' ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, pt.year, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2692 AND AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) > 29.19 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(*) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1996 AND pt.points > 140 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((p.playerid, t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid), (p.playerid, t.tmid), (p.playerid)) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 33358 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, p.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2002 AND pt.points > 1855 GROUP BY CUBE(t.lgid, t.year, p.pos) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) > 35 ORDER BY t.lgid, t.year, p.pos;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, p.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2020 AND pt.points > 1200 GROUP BY CUBE(t.lgid, t.year, p.pos) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) > 33 ORDER BY t.lgid, t.year, p.pos;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS total_players, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.coachid) AS total_award_coaches, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.points > 558 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1973 AND 1953 AND pa.points >= 21 AND c.won > 50 AND d.draftyear >= 1993 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 22103 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) >= 11 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 12 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, p.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS allstar_players, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players_teams pt JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id JOIN player_allstar ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id WHERE pt.year >= 1963 AND pt.year <= 1959 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, p.pos) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 49860 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t1.year AS year1, t2.year AS year2, t1.lgid, AVG(t1.won - t2.won) AS avg_win_diff, SUM(t1.o_pts) AS total_pts_year1, SUM(t2.o_pts) AS total_pts_year2 FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.tmid = t2.tmid WHERE t1.year > t2.year AND t1.year - t2.year <= 7 AND t1.won >= 39 AND t2.won >= 56 GROUP BY t1.year, t2.year, t1.lgid HAVING AVG(t1.won - t2.won) > -9.42 ORDER BY avg_win_diff DESC;

SELECT ap.playerid, ap.year, ap.award, COUNT(*) AS award_count, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_season_points, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.points > (SELECT AVG(points) FROM players_teams WHERE year = ap.year) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS games_above_avg_points FROM awards_players ap JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE ap.year >= 1951.87 AND pt.points >= 14.45 GROUP BY ap.playerid, ap.year, ap.award HAVING COUNT(*) > 8.76 ORDER BY award_count DESC, avg_regular_season_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS total_points_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE pa.season_id >= 1990 AND pa.season_id <= 1958 AND pt.year IN ( SELECT pt2.year FROM players_teams pt2 WHERE pt2.tmid IN ( SELECT t.tmid::integer FROM teams t WHERE t.year = pt2.year AND t.won > 50 ) ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 38.51 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 5 ORDER BY total_points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS unique_awards_count, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 2015 AND pa.season_id >= 1994 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 3902 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE pt.points > 19 AND pt.rebounds > 16 AND ap.year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2015 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) > 5 AND AVG(pt.points) > 25 ORDER BY total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 2006 AND pa.points > 26 AND d.draftyear <= 1988 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) >= 4 AND SUM(pa.points) > 188 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(ap.award) AS award_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND d.draftyear > 1971.7 ) AND t.year BETWEEN 1977.45 AND 2011.82 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 5773.1 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, MAX(ap.season_id) AS last_allstar_season, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS total_seasons_played, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, SUM(ap.points) AS allstar_points_total, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_points_rank, SUM(CASE WHEN dp.draftyear IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS draft_year_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players awp WHERE awp.playerid = p.id AND awp.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_awards_count FROM players p INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid INNER JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft dp ON p.id = dp.playerid AND dp.draftyear = pt.year INNER JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND t.year = pt.year INNER JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND c.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND sp.year = pt.year WHERE pt.year >= 1984 AND pt.year <= 2003 AND pt.points > 2268 AND ap.points > 21 AND t.won > 10 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 14 AND SUM(pt.points) > 12034 ORDER BY career_points DESC, avg_points_per_game DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND ap.year = pa.season_id WHERE ap.year >= 2007 AND pa.points > 23 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) > 1 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, MIN(pa.points) AS min_allstar_points, SUM(pa.rebounds) AS total_allstar_rebounds, SUM(pa.assists) AS total_allstar_assists, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_regular_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_regular_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_position, SUM(CASE WHEN c.post_wins > c.post_losses THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS winning_postseasons_coached, SUM(t.won) AS total_team_wins_played_for, SUM(t.lost) AS total_team_losses_played_for, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pa.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pa.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pa.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON p.playerid::text = c.coachid WHERE pa.points > 45.14 AND pt.points > 1441.6 AND t.year > 1989.42 AND ap.year > 1947.52 AND d.draftyear > 1966.0 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 13.88 AND SUM(pa.points) > 305.23 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, total_regular_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM( CASE WHEN pt.points > 32 THEN pt.points WHEN pt.points BETWEEN 10 AND 16 THEN pt.points * 0.5 ELSE 0 END ) AS adjusted_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 2008 AND pt.year <= 2019 AND pt.points > 0 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.assists) > 8 ORDER BY adjusted_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points_last_seasons, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points_last_seasons FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE pa.season_id >= 2022 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 455 ORDER BY total_points_last_seasons DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(CAST(pt.points AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 2010 AND pt.year <= 1952 AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 20087 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 319.33 AND d.draftyear >= 2016.84 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, MIN(d.draftyear) AS draft_year, MAX(a.year) AS latest_award_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players a ON p.playerid::integer = a.playerid LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 2292 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1973 AND 1986 AND ap.points >= 51 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 17324 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 24 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1971 AND pt.year <= 1983 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 30243 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year IN (SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'All-NBA First Team') AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 26412 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2000 AND pt.year <= 1996 AND (pt.points > 23 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = 'All-NBA')) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 20960 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.points > 28 AND pt.year >= 2014 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 19 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.points > 42 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1984 AND 1999 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 17602 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) > 36073.33 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.points) BETWEEN 5890.24 AND 9514.33 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS scoring_category FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 1996 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) >= 8021.2 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.year >= 1990 THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS recent_points, COUNT(CASE WHEN pt.lgid = 'NBA' THEN 1 END) AS seasons_in_league, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1961 AND 1950 AND pt.points > 2804 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 45089 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight, p.pos, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND ap.year >= 1980) AS mvp_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE p.height > '150.0' AND p.weight BETWEEN 105 AND 303 AND pt.year = 1994 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight, p.pos, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists ORDER BY pt.points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, AVG(ast.assists) AS avg_allstar_assists, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) DESC) AS awards_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ast ON p.playerid = ast.playerid::character varying JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying WHERE ast.season_id >= 2016 AND pt.year >= 2019 AND ap.year >= 2016 AND d.draftyear >= 1950 AND p.firstseason <= 1955 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college HAVING AVG(ast.assists) > 1.57 AND SUM(pt.points) > 41683.64 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 24 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_allstar_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pa.rebounds) AS total_allstar_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pa.points) AS median_allstar_points, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pa.assists) AS p75_allstar_assists, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_regular_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(t.won) AS max_team_wins, MIN(t.lost) AS min_team_losses, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mvp_awards, SUM(CASE WHEN ac.award = 'Coach of the Year' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coach_of_year_awards_near FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON t.id = ac.coachid::integer AND t.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE p.height > 201.56 AND p.weight BETWEEN 149 AND 227 AND pa.season_id >= 2003 AND t.won > 81 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 30.79 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) >= 1 ORDER BY total_regular_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) AS stint_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1979 AND 1996 AND pt.minutes > 2222 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = pt.tmid AND c.year = pt.year AND c.won > 82 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE (sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) AND sp.year = pt.year AND sp.w > 2 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1136 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 2 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_by_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 4420 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2008 AND 2006 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 6491 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, points_rank_by_year;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, AVG(pt.rebounds * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_rebounds_per_game, AVG(pt.assists * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_assists_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.points > 40.86 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_scoring_games, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.lgid, pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_by_league_year, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS overall_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1996 AND 2009 AND pt.gp > 6.81 AND pt.points >= 677.62 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1547.23 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 1470.01 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 509.82 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, pt.lgid ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (pt.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR pt.tmid = sp.tmidloser) AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2014 AND 1992 AND pt.points > 179 AND t.won > 15 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 763 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, points_rank_in_league_year;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_per_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.award = 'MVP' AND ap.year BETWEEN 1966 AND 1958) AS mvp_count, (SELECT AVG(d.draftoverall) FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.id AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 2016 AND 1993) AS avg_draft_position, (SELECT SUM(pa.points) FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid = p.id AND pa.season_id BETWEEN 1986 AND 1986) AS allstar_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1974 AND 1987 AND pt.minutes > 2821 AND p.height > '150.0' AND t.won > 6 AND (c.won IS NULL OR c.won > 60) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, p.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 41469 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 5869 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 45 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, points_rank_per_year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) AS stints_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 2013 AND pt.year <= 1968 AND pt.points > 1987 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 5620 AND AVG(pt.minutes) >= 24 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, pt.tmid;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_blocks, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS avg_points_per_minute, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for_count, MAX(ap.season_id) AS latest_allstar_season, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.season_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS allstar_appearances, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1968 AND 1966 AND pt.minutes > 4386 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 36226 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) >= 18346 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) <= 34 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, SUM(ap.points) AS total_points, SUM(ap.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(ap.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(ap.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS seasons_played, MAX(ap.points) AS max_points_in_game, MIN(ap.personal_fouls) AS min_fouls_in_game, SUM(ap.three_made) AS total_threes, SUM(ap.ft_made) AS total_free_throws, SUM(ap.steals + ap.blocks) AS total_defensive_plays, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.league_id ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS league_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.assists) DESC) AS overall_assists_rank, LAG(SUM(ap.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY ap.season_id) AS prev_season_points, (SUM(ap.points) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ap.fg_attempted + ap.ft_attempted + ap.three_attempted), 0)) AS efficiency_ratio FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.lgid = t.lgid JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year WHERE ap.points > 42 AND ap.season_id >= 1961 AND ap.season_id <= 1970 AND t.year >= 2013 AND t.year <= 1995 AND aw.award = 'All-NBA' AND d.draftyear >= 2006 AND d.draftyear <= 2007 AND c.won > 55 AND ac.award = 'Coach of the Year' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, ap.season_id, ap.league_id), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname), (ap.league_id, ap.season_id), ()) HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 745 AND AVG(ap.minutes) >= 38 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 16 ORDER BY total_points DESC, overall_assists_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_pick, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t.id THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_wins_by_team, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.year >= 1960 AND pt.year <= 1964 AND pt.points > 100 AND t.won > 72 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 28874 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 20 AND AVG(pa.points) >= 28.91 ORDER BY total_points DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.lgid, pt.year, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, SUM(pt.gp) AS total_games, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(ac.award) AS coach_awards_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t.id THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_wins_by_team FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::text = pt.playerid::text JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::text = t.tmid::text AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::text = ap.playerid::text AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::text = d.playerid::text LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::text = aw.playerid::text AND pt.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::text = c.tmid::text AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::text = ac.coachid::text AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 3212.22 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1989 AND 2018 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.lgid, pt.year HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 4.28 AND SUM(pt.gp) >= 17.43 ORDER BY avg_points DESC, total_games DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.lgid, pt.year, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, SUM(pt.gp) AS total_games, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(ac.award) AS coach_awards_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t.id THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_wins_by_team FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::text = pt.playerid::text JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::text = t.tmid::text AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::text = ap.playerid::text AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::text = d.playerid::text LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::text = aw.playerid::text AND pt.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::text = c.tmid::text AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::text = ac.coachid::text AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 4384.59 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 1997 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.lgid, pt.year HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 48.73 AND SUM(pt.gp) >= 53.09 ORDER BY avg_points DESC, total_games DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 2874 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1959 AND 2018 AND (t.lgid = 'NBA' OR t.confid = 'East') AND NOT (d.draftround IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 18646 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 4 ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.playerid, p.year, p.lgid, SUM(p.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(p.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY p.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_points FROM players_teams p JOIN awards_players a ON p.playerid = a.playerid AND p.year = a.year AND p.lgid = a.lgid WHERE p.points > 1672.13 AND p.year BETWEEN 1975.97 AND 2004.13 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.year, p.lgid HAVING COUNT(a.award) >= 10.19 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, p.pos, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS birth_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS allstar_players, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.playerid) AS award_players, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.tmidwinner) AS playoff_series_won FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 15.66 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1977 AND 1958 AND t.won > 69.48 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (t.tmid, t.lgid), (t.tmid, p.pos), (t.lgid, birth_year), (t.tmid), (t.lgid), (p.pos), (birth_year), () ) HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 11.43 ORDER BY total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, pt.year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::varchar = p.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1995 AND 1995 AND pt.points > 1493 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (t.tmid, t.lgid, pt.year), (t.tmid, t.lgid), (t.lgid, pt.year), (t.tmid), (t.lgid), (pt.year), () ) ORDER BY t.lgid, pt.year, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_points_3yr FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year AND t.lgid = pt.lgid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::text = p.playerid WHERE t.year >= 1990 AND t.year <= 1949 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 83777 ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, AVG(t1.won) AS avg_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.tmid) AS teams_with_higher_attendance FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.year = t2.year AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t2.attendance > t1.attendance WHERE t1.year >= 2007 AND t1.attendance >= 2424352 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid HAVING AVG(t1.won) > 75.57 ORDER BY t1.year DESC, t1.lgid;

WITH player_performance AS ( SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, pt.steals, pt.blocks, pt.minutes, pt.gp, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) as points_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.rebounds DESC) as rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.assists DESC) as assists_rank, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year) as avg_points_per_year, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as career_points_running_total FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.minutes > 2794 AND pt.gp >= 57 ), team_performance AS ( SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.o_reb, t.d_reb, t.attendance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY t.won DESC) as wins_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY t.o_pts DESC) as offense_rank, (t.o_pts - t.d_pts) as point_differential, AVG(t.o_pts) OVER (PARTITION BY t.year) as avg_offense_per_year FROM teams t WHERE t.attendance > 305150 AND t.won >= 17 ), coach_performance AS ( SELECT c.coachid, c.year, c.tmid, c.won, c.lost, c.post_wins, c.post_losses, (c.won::decimal / (c.won + c.lost)) as win_percentage, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.year ORDER BY c.won DESC) as wins_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.year ORDER BY (c.won::decimal / (c.won + c.lost)) DESC) as win_pct_rank FROM coaches c WHERE c.won > 28 AND c.post_wins >= 11 ), all_star_performance AS ( SELECT ap.playerid, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.rebounds, ap.assists, ap.steals, ap.blocks, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.season_id ORDER BY ap.points DESC) as all_star_points_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.season_id ORDER BY ap.points) as points_percentile FROM player_allstar ap WHERE ap.points > 16 AND ap.rebounds >= 8 ), award_winners AS ( SELECT aw.playerid, aw.year, aw.award, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY aw.playerid) as total_awards, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY aw.year ORDER BY aw.award) as award_rank FROM awards_players aw WHERE aw.year BETWEEN 1985 AND 1983 ), draft_analysis AS ( SELECT d.playerid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.draftyear ORDER BY d.draftoverall) as draft_position_rank, CASE WHEN d.draftround = 1 THEN 'First Round' WHEN d.draftround = 2 THEN 'Second Round' ELSE 'Late Round' END as draft_category FROM draft d WHERE d.draftoverall <= 35 AND d.draftyear >= 1955 ) SELECT pp.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pp.year, pp.tmid, t.name as team_name, pp.points, pp.rebounds, pp.assists, pp.points_rank, pp.rebounds_rank, pp.assists_rank, pp.avg_points_per_year, pp.career_points_running_total, tp.won as team_wins, tp.lost as team_losses, tp.wins_rank as team_wins_rank, tp.point_differential, tp.avg_offense_per_year, cp.coachid, cp.win_percentage as coach_win_pct, cp.wins_rank as coach_wins_rank, ap.points as all_star_points, ap.all_star_points_rank, ap.points_percentile, aw.total_awards, aw.award_rank, da.draftoverall, da.draft_position_rank, da.draft_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pp.year ORDER BY pp.points DESC) as yearly_points_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pp.year ORDER BY pp.points) as yearly_points_percentile, SUM(pp.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pp.playerid ORDER BY pp.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as career_total_points, AVG(pp.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pp.tmid, pp.year) as team_avg_points FROM player_performance pp JOIN players p ON pp.playerid = p.id::integer JOIN team_performance tp ON pp.tmid = tp.tmid::integer AND pp.year = tp.year JOIN coach_performance cp ON pp.tmid = cp.tmid::integer AND pp.year = cp.year LEFT JOIN all_star_performance ap ON pp.playerid = ap.playerid AND pp.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN award_winners aw ON pp.playerid = aw.playerid AND pp.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN draft_analysis da ON pp.playerid = da.playerid JOIN teams t ON pp.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pp.year = t.year WHERE pp.points > 913 AND tp.won >= 32 AND cp.win_percentage > 0.78 GROUP BY pp.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pp.year, pp.tmid, t.name, pp.points, pp.rebounds, pp.assists, pp.points_rank, pp.rebounds_rank, pp.assists_rank, pp.avg_points_per_year, pp.career_points_running_total, tp.won, tp.lost, tp.wins_rank, tp.point_differential, tp.avg_offense_per_year, cp.coachid, cp.win_percentage, cp.wins_rank, ap.points, ap.all_star_points_rank, ap.points_percentile, aw.total_awards, aw.award_rank, da.draftoverall, da.draft_position_rank, da.draft_category HAVING AVG(pp.points) > 854 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pp.year) >= 5 ORDER BY pp.points DESC, pp.year DESC, pp.playerid;

SELECT ap.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.award, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, MAX(pt.year) AS last_team_year, MIN(pt.year) AS first_team_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = CAST(pt.tmid AS integer) THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_series_won, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidloser = CAST(pt.tmid AS integer) THEN sp.l ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_series_lost, ROUND(SUM(pa.points)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(pa.minutes), 0), 2) AS points_per_minute_allstar, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pa.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.award ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) DESC) AS award_frequency_rank FROM awards_players ap JOIN players p ON ap.playerid = CAST(p.playerid AS integer) JOIN player_allstar pa ON ap.playerid = pa.playerid AND ap.year = pa.season_id JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = CAST(t.tmid AS integer) AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser WHERE ap.year >= 2012 AND ap.year <= 1972 AND pa.points > 9 AND pt.points > 103 AND t.won > 81 GROUP BY ap.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.award HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) > 8 AND SUM(pa.points) > 150 AND AVG(pt.points) > 448 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 7 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, award_years DESC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, p.pos AS position, p.height, p.weight, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS allstar_total_points, AVG(ap.points) AS allstar_avg_points, SUM(ap.assists) AS allstar_total_assists, AVG(ap.assists) AS allstar_avg_assists, SUM(ap.rebounds) AS allstar_total_rebounds, AVG(ap.rebounds) AS allstar_avg_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS team_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS regular_season_total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS regular_season_avg_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS regular_season_total_assists, AVG(pt.assists) AS regular_season_avg_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS regular_season_total_rebounds, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS regular_season_avg_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) FILTER (WHERE awp.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_awards_count, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) FILTER (WHERE awp.award LIKE '%All-Star%') AS allstar_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, d.draftfrom AS drafted_from, t.name AS most_recent_team, t.lgid AS most_recent_league, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS total_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(pt.points) DESC) AS avg_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(ap.points) DESC) AS allstar_avg_points_rank, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) AS playoff_series_appearances, (SELECT SUM(sp.w) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid) AS playoff_series_wins, (SELECT SUM(sp.l) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) AS playoff_series_losses FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid = awp.playerid::character varying AND ap.season_id = awp.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year WHERE p.height > 168.79 AND p.weight BETWEEN 175.76 AND 263.13 AND ap.points > 41.42 AND pt.points > 1317.36 AND awp.award IS NOT NULL AND d.draftyear >= 1959.86 AND t.won > 22.36 AND c.won > 74.45 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players awp2 WHERE awp2.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND awp2.award LIKE '%All-Star%') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.height, p.weight, d.draftoverall, d.draftfrom, t.name, t.lgid, pt.tmid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 7.18 AND SUM(pt.points) > 13176.08 AND AVG(ap.points) > 23.49 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) > 46.79 ORDER BY total_points_rank, avg_points_rank, allstar_points_rank, allstar_avg_points_rank LIMIT 264.92;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.award = 'MVP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mvp_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 1128.2 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1956 AND 1955 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 11 ORDER BY avg_points_per_season DESC LIMIT 29;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.award = 'MVP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mvp_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 484.27 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1960 AND 1970 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 20 ORDER BY avg_points_per_season DESC LIMIT 55;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year >= 2009) AS award_count FROM players p WHERE p.id IN ( SELECT pt.playerid FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.year = 1993 AND pt.points > 524 ) ORDER BY award_count DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id::integer WHERE p.id IN ( SELECT playerid FROM draft WHERE draftyear IN ( SELECT year FROM awards_coaches WHERE coachid IN ( SELECT coachid::integer FROM coaches WHERE won > 74 AND year >= 2000 ) ) ) AND pa.points > 27 AND t.won > 41 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 11 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) >= 3 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::integer = awp.playerid WHERE p.firstname LIKE 'A%' AND p.lastname LIKE 'A%' AND ap.points >= 13.73 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 7.9 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2001 AND pt.year <= 2018 AND pt.points > 4777 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 6 AND SUM(pt.points) > 34313 ORDER BY total_team_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid = p.id AND pa.season_id = pt.year AND pa.points > 14 ) AND pt.year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2013 AND t.won > 48 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 16.92 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 9 ORDER BY total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, MAX(pt.points) AS max_regular_points, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_post_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS regular_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pa.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid WHERE ap.year >= 2020 AND ap.year <= 1964 AND pa.season_id >= 1956 AND pa.season_id <= 1961 AND pt.year >= 2009 AND pt.year <= 1962 AND t.year >= 1960 AND t.year <= 1987 AND c.year >= 1957 AND c.year <= 2006 AND ac.year >= 2007 AND ac.year <= 1964 AND p.firstseason >= 2014 AND p.firstseason <= 1982 AND p.lastseason >= 1979 AND p.lastseason <= 1974 AND p.height >= '150.0' AND p.height <= '150.0' AND p.weight >= 162 AND p.weight <= 125 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 8 AND SUM(pt.points) > 44410 AND SUM(pa.points) > 115 ORDER BY regular_points_rank, allstar_points_rank LIMIT 63;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pa.three_made) AS avg_threes_made FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE pa.points > 43 AND pa.season_id BETWEEN 1976 AND 1998 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 953 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS allstar_seasons_count, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points_per_allstar_game FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE p.firstname LIKE 'A%' OR p.lastname LIKE 'A%' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 311.6 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2007 AND pt.year <= 1977 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 22740 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, MIN(d.draftyear) AS draft_year, MAX(a.year) AS latest_award_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players a ON p.playerid::integer = a.playerid LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1618 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2020 AND 1968 AND ap.points >= 99 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 13786 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 9 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year IN (SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'Most Valuable Player') AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' AND pt.year >= 2005 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 16204 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS total_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) DESC) AS seasons_played_rank, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.year >= 2002 THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS recent_points, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(pt.year::text, 'YYYY')) IN (4, 3) THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS q_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 493 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1979 AND 1968 AND ap.points > 19 AND t.won > 31 AND sp.w > 6 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 26096 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 10 ORDER BY total_points DESC, seasons_played DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 40 AND pt.year >= 1969 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3922 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(t.won) AS max_team_wins_in_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid AND pt.year = d.draftyear WHERE pt.year >= 1999 AND pt.year <= 2014 AND pt.minutes > 205 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t.id OR sp.tmidloser = t.id) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 33849 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_assists DESC;
