SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.lgid = 'NBA' THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS nba_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, COUNT(CASE WHEN pt.gp >= 79 THEN 1 END) AS full_seasons, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2020 AND 1997 AND p.height >= '1.5' AND pt.lgid IN ('NBA') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 17083 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 8 ORDER BY total_points DESC, seasons_played DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.tmidwinner) AS championship_wins, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN series_post sp ON pt.tmid = sp.tmidwinner AND pt.year = sp.year JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year WHERE pt.points > 1059 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2004 AND 1961 AND pa.points > 20 AND d.draftoverall < 220 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4567 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 7 AND AVG(pa.points) > 15 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_awards DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 45 AND pt.year >= 1960 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 325 ORDER BY pt.year, points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award) AS coach_awards, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, ROUND(SUM(pt.fgmade)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(pt.fgattempted), 0) * 100, 2) AS fg_percentage, ROUND(SUM(pt.ftmade)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(pt.ftattempted), 0) * 100, 2) AS ft_percentage, ROUND(SUM(pt.threemade)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(pt.threeattempted), 0) * 100, 2) AS three_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid THEN sp.id END) AS playoff_series_count, MAX(c.won) AS coach_wins, MAX(c.lost) AS coach_losses, d.draftround, d.draftselection FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (pt.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR pt.tmid = sp.tmidloser) AND pt.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 3549 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 1957 AND pa.minutes > 46 AND t.won > 37 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, d.draftround, d.draftselection HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2257 AND AVG(pa.points) > 39 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 8 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_team_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = ap.season_id WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1983 AND 1982 AND pt.gp > 52 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players awp WHERE awp.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND awp.award = 'Most Valuable Player' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0 ) AND p.height > '150.0' AND t.playoff = 'Y' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 47470 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 6083 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.lgid) >= 4 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, pt.tmid ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.playerid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS allstar_appearances, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_per_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points, (SUM(pt.points) - LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year)) AS points_change_from_prev FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 2369 AND pt.year >= 1943 AND pt.year <= 1997 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 34641 AND AVG(pt.assists) > 312 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY AVG(pt.points) DESC) AS league_avg_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY MIN(pt.year)) AS prev_career_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id WHERE pt.points > 1 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1999 AND 2006 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 29274 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 7 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points AS regular_points, p2.points AS allstar_points, (p1.points - p2.points) AS point_diff FROM players_teams p1 JOIN player_allstar p2 ON p1.playerid = p2.playerid AND p1.year = p2.season_id WHERE p1.points > 2588 AND p2.points > 77 AND p1.year BETWEEN 1970 AND 1988 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points, p2.points HAVING (p1.points - p2.points) > 2780 ORDER BY point_diff DESC;

SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, AVG(pt.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS avg_points_3_seasons, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds FROM players_teams pt JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id::integer WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1990 AND 2006 AND pt.points > 2419 GROUP BY pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points HAVING SUM(pt.rebounds) > 1383 ORDER BY avg_points_3_seasons DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::text = pt.lgid WHERE t.year > 2008 AND pt.year > 1957 AND t.won > 79 GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 44.18 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid AS team_id, t1.name AS team_name, t1.lgid AS league, AVG(pas.three_made) AS avg_allstar_three_made, MAX(pt.points) AS max_player_team_points, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t1.id THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS total_series_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS distinct_awarded_players, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (ORDER BY t1.year) AS prev_year_total_points FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year AND t1.id <> t2.id JOIN players_teams pt ON t1.id = pt.tmid AND t1.year = pt.year JOIN player_allstar pas ON pt.playerid = pas.playerid AND pt.year = pas.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN series_post sp ON t1.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t1.id = sp.tmidloser JOIN coaches c ON t1.id = c.tmid AND t1.year = c.year JOIN draft d ON pt.playerid = d.playerid AND t1.year = d.draftyear WHERE t1.year >= 1995 AND t1.year <= 1955 AND t1.won > 59 AND t1.lost < 50 AND pt.points > 273 AND pas.three_made > 17 AND (t1.lgid = 'NBA' OR t1.lgid = 'NBA') AND NOT (t1.playoff = 'Y' AND t1.attendance < 404043) AND (t1.confid = 'E' OR t1.divid = 'Atlantic') AND c.won > 33 AND d.draftround BETWEEN 7 AND 9 GROUP BY t1.id, t1.name, t1.lgid, t1.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 64256 AND AVG(pas.three_made) > 5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) > 45 ORDER BY total_series_wins DESC, avg_allstar_three_made DESC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 2148 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 1957 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 41832 UNION ALL SELECT c.coachid AS coach_id, c.coachid AS coach_name, SUM(c.won) AS total_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT c.year) AS seasons_coached, AVG(c.won * 1.0 / NULLIF(c.won + c.lost, 0)) AS win_percentage FROM coaches c JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid = ac.coachid::character varying AND c.year = ac.year JOIN teams t ON c.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND c.year = t.year WHERE c.won > 3 AND c.year BETWEEN 2023 AND 1980 GROUP BY c.coachid HAVING SUM(c.won) > 1326 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year WHERE pa.points > 38 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1978 AND 1995 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 28287 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE ap.year >= 2015 AND pt.points > 46 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 15.31 ORDER BY award_count DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, SUM(ap.year) AS total_award_years FROM players p LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 1989.37 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 5.76 ORDER BY award_count DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE ap.year >= 1993 AND pt.points >= 2510 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 13 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE pa.year >= 1993 AND pa.points > 1547 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 3466 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS distinct_team_years, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.league_id) AS distinct_allstar_leagues, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.assists) AS avg_allstar_assists, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_regular_assists, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.season_id = pt.year THEN ap.points + pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS combined_points_matching_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) DESC) AS allstar_seasons_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE ap.points > 36 AND pt.points > 262 AND t.won > 27 AND c.won > 72 AND sp.w > 4 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 11 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 6 AND SUM(ap.points) > 125 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, distinct_allstar_seasons DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS distinct_team_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE ap.points > 20.41 AND pt.year >= 2003.23 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1189.46 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pa.assists) AS avg_allstar_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE pa.season_id BETWEEN 1979.26 AND 2003.84 AND pa.points > 3.22 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 159.02 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2014 AND pt.year <= 1971 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 5588 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::text = pt.playerid::text JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::text = ap.playerid::text WHERE pt.points > 2084.52 AND ap.year >= 1971.45 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 20925.04 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer WHERE pt.year >= 2002 AND pt.year <= 1971 AND pt.points > 2132 AND pa.points > 97 AND t.won > 69 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 11846 AND AVG(pt.assists) > 6 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer WHERE pt.year >= 1984 AND pt.year <= 1975 AND pt.assists > 150 AND pa.assists > 7 AND t.lost < 32 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.assists) > 3886 AND AVG(pt.points) > 12 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer WHERE pt.year >= 1977 AND pt.year <= 1974 AND pt.points > 1250 AND pa.points > 2 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 9059 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 3 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer WHERE pt.lgid = 'NBA' AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND ap.lgid = 'NBA' AND pa.league_id = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.assists) > 9 AND MAX(pa.points) > 63 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE (pt.points > 22 OR pt.rebounds > 26) AND NOT (pt.assists < 0 AND pt.turnovers > 1) AND pt.year BETWEEN 1958 AND 1988 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 10331 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1990 AND pt.year <= 1958 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight HAVING SUM(pt.points) >= 13283 ORDER BY points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, AVG(pt.assists * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_assists_per_game, AVG(pt.rebounds * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_rebounds_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT ap2.award) FILTER (WHERE ap2.award = 'Most Valuable Player') AS mvp_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.tmidwinner = t.id THEN s.w ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_wins_for_team, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league_year, SUM(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS points_last_3_seasons FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND ap.season_id = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap2 ON p.playerid::integer = ap2.playerid AND ap2.year = t.year LEFT JOIN series_post s ON t.id = s.tmidwinner AND s.year = t.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND c.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND ac.year = c.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid AND d.draftyear <= t.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 1948 AND p.lastseason <= 1966 AND t.year BETWEEN 1959 AND 1989 AND pt.points > 494 AND pt.gp > 55 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, t.name, t.lgid, t.year, t.tmid, t.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1004 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 17 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC, points_rank_in_league_year;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award LIKE '%MVP%') as award_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1878 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2018 AND 1997 ORDER BY pt.points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) AS stint_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1966 AND pt.points > 1506 AND pt.minutes > 3492 AND p.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT d.playerid FROM draft d WHERE d.draftyear BETWEEN 2012 AND 2011 AND d.draftround <= 7 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2808 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 2246 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 4 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_minutes DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) AS stint_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND pt.year >= d.draftyear LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2011 AND 1987 AND pt.gp >= 31 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award IS NOT NULL ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE (sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) AND sp.year = pt.year AND sp.round = 'Finals' ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2002 AND AVG(pt.minutes) >= 10 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) <= 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 3595.71 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 1584.27 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS scoring_category, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1999 AND 2019 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 710.85 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2004 AND pt.year <= 2002 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 26132 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 17 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(c.won) AS max_coach_wins, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_pick, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_percentile FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1982 AND pt.year <= 1979 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND pt.points > 2837 AND pa.points >= 21 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1350 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 2 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.year, t.lgid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points_last_n_seasons, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_last_n_seasons, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank_in_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1956 AND pt.year <= 1954 AND pt.points > 270 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.year, t.lgid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 9290 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points_last_n_seasons DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, pt.year, pt.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_points_3yr FROM players_teams pt JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::text = p.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1960 AND pt.year <= 1993 GROUP BY p.playerid, pt.year, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1259 ORDER BY p.playerid, pt.year;

SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, AVG(pt.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS avg_points_3_seasons, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds FROM players_teams pt JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id::integer WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1999 AND 2004 AND pt.points > 2537 GROUP BY pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points HAVING SUM(pt.rebounds) > 565 ORDER BY avg_points_3_seasons DESC;

SELECT t.name, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players, MAX(sp.w) AS max_series_wins, (SELECT AVG(sub_pts) FROM (SELECT SUM(pas.points) AS sub_pts FROM player_allstar pas WHERE pas.playerid IN (SELECT pt2.playerid FROM players_teams pt2 WHERE pt2.tmid = t.id AND pt2.year = t.year) GROUP BY pas.playerid HAVING SUM(pas.points) > 97.79) AS star_players) AS avg_star_points_above_threshold FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.id = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2011 AND 2010 AND t.attendance > 1163652.45 GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 29784.83 ORDER BY total_points DESC, t.year;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.points > 493.43) AS high_scorers_count FROM teams t WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1967.74 AND 2018.55 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY t.id, t.tmid, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts HAVING t.won > 64.38 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.won DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, AVG(t1.won) AS avg_wins, AVG(t2.won) AS avg_wins_prev_year, AVG(t1.won) - AVG(t2.won) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.year >= 1992 AND t2.year >= 1959 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid HAVING AVG(t1.won) > 26 ORDER BY win_change DESC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, p.pos AS position, p.height, p.weight, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS allstar_total_points, AVG(ap.points) AS allstar_avg_points, SUM(ap.assists) AS allstar_total_assists, AVG(ap.assists) AS allstar_avg_assists, SUM(ap.rebounds) AS allstar_total_rebounds, awp.award) FILTER (WHERE awp.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_awards_count, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) FILTER (WHERE awp.award LIKE '%All-Star%') AS allstar_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, d.draftfrom AS drafted_from, t.name AS most_recent_team, t.lgid AS most_recent_league, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS total_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(pt.points) DESC) AS avg_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(ap.points) DESC) AS allstar_avg_points_rank, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) AS playoff_series_appearances, (SELECT SUM(sp.w) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid) AS playoff_series_wins, (SELECT SUM(sp.l) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) AS playoff_series_losses FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid = awp.playerid::character varying AND ap.season_id = awp.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year WHERE p.height > 183.87 AND p.weight BETWEEN 149.68 AND 242.49 AND ap.points > 34.62 AND pt.points > 1488.89 AND awp.award IS NOT NULL AND d.draftyear >= 2009.69 AND t.won > 65.11 AND c.won > 13.8 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players awp2 WHERE awp2.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND awp2.award LIKE '%All-Star%') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.height, p.weight, d.draftoverall, d.draftfrom, t.name, t.lgid, pt.tmid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 5.01 AND SUM(pt.points) > 26478.11 AND AVG(ap.points) > 14.64 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) > 64.86 ORDER BY total_points_rank, avg_points_rank, allstar_points_rank, allstar_avg_points_rank LIMIT 550.81;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, SUM(aps.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_team_points, MAX(t.won) AS max_team_wins, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(aps.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar aps ON p.id = aps.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND t.year = pt.year WHERE ap.year >= 2010 AND ap.year <= 1980 AND t.won > 79 AND aps.points > 98 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 12 AND SUM(aps.points) > 741 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, distinct_awards DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) AS distinct_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS distinct_teams_played_for, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS distinct_draft_years, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.minutes) AS avg_allstar_minutes, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_regular_minutes, MAX(pt.points) AS max_regular_points, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins, SUM(c.lost) AS total_coach_losses, SUM(t.won) AS total_team_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS total_team_losses, SUM(sp.w) AS total_series_wins, SUM(sp.l) AS total_series_losses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS regular_points_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::integer = awp.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid WHERE ap.points > 24.37 AND pt.points > 1097.66 AND t.won > 28.76 AND c.won > 65.34 AND sp.year >= 1950.43 AND sp.year <= 1964.85 AND awp.year >= 1973.09 AND awp.year <= 2006.08 AND d.draftyear >= 1957.37 AND d.draftyear <= 2021.73 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 2.1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) > 4.37 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) > 5.28 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, total_regular_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 2335 AND t.won > 74 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 11940 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 194 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2009 AND 1948 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 49377 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year IN (SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'All-NBA First Team') AND pt.year >= 2020 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 6396 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, MAX(t.won) AS max_team_wins, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) DESC) AS awards_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1958 AND pt.year <= 1990 AND t.won > 6 AND pt.points > 145 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 33952 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 8 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1973 AND pt.year <= 2001 AND pt.points > 60 AND pa.points > 10 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 30078 AND AVG(pt.assists) > 737 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2018 AND pt.year <= 1973 AND pt.assists > 81 AND pa.assists > 22 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.assists) > 7652 AND AVG(pt.points) > 2192 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1985 AND pt.year <= 1985 AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 31706 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) > 25072.32 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.assists) > 6663.34 THEN 'High Assister' WHEN SUM(pt.rebounds) > 22430.18 THEN 'High Rebounder' ELSE 'Balanced' END AS player_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2009 AND 1972 AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' AND p.height > '150.0' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 9888.84 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 6 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_assists DESC, total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight, p.pos, p.college, p.birthdate, p.birthcountry, p.highschool, p.hscity, p.hsstate, p.hscountry, p.race, p.deathdate, p.usefirst, SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award LIKE '%All-Star%') AS all_star_awards, (SELECT AVG(pa.points) FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid = p.id AND pa.season_id = pt.year) AS avg_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS career_points_running_total FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 179 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1954 AND 1954 AND p.firstseason <= 1983 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid = p.id AND ap2.year = pt.year AND ap2.award IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, p.id HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 1671 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 3 ORDER BY career_points_running_total DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.tmidwinner) AS championship_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE (pt.points > 607 OR pa.points > 49) AND (pt.year BETWEEN 1971 AND 1976) AND (t.won > 62 OR t.lost < 21) AND (p.firstseason <= 1986 AND p.lastseason >= 1985) AND (NOT (pt.minutes < 29 AND pt.gp < 65)) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2203 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 4 AND AVG(pt.minutes) BETWEEN 36 AND 15 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_awards DESC;

SELECT t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, AVG(pts.points) AS avg_player_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY t.won DESC) AS team_rank_by_wins FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pts ON t.tmid::text = pts.tmid::text AND t.year = pts.year WHERE t.won > 36.53 AND t.year BETWEEN 1967.11 AND 1963.28 GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost ORDER BY t.year, team_rank_by_wins;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, pt.year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::text = p.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2000 AND pt.points > 169 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (t.tmid, t.lgid, pt.year), (t.tmid, t.lgid), (t.lgid, pt.year), (t.tmid), (t.lgid), (pt.year), () ) ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT a.coachid, c.year, c.tmid, t.name, SUM(c.won) AS total_wins, AVG(c.won::numeric / (c.won + c.lost)) AS win_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) AS distinct_awards, SUM(COALESCE(pt.points, 0)) AS total_player_points FROM awards_coaches a INNER JOIN coaches c ON a.coachid::integer = c.coachid::integer AND a.year = c.year LEFT JOIN teams t ON c.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND c.year = t.year LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON c.tmid::integer = pt.tmid::integer AND c.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::integer = p.playerid::integer WHERE a.lgid = 'NBA' AND c.year BETWEEN 2006 AND 2009 GROUP BY a.coachid, c.year, c.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(c.won) > 30 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, win_percentage DESC;

SELECT a.playerid, a.year, a.award, a.lgid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM awards_players a JOIN players p ON a.playerid::text = p.playerid WHERE a.year >= 1976 AND a.year <= 2010 AND p.pos = 'C' GROUP BY a.playerid, a.year, a.award, a.lgid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos HAVING COUNT(*) >= 8 INTERSECT SELECT d.playerid, d.draftyear, 'Drafted' AS award, d.lgid, d.firstname, d.lastname, p.pos, 1 AS award_count FROM draft d JOIN players p ON d.playerid::text = p.playerid WHERE d.draftyear >= 1950 AND d.draftyear <= 1974 AND d.draftround <= 3 GROUP BY d.playerid, d.draftyear, d.lgid, d.firstname, d.lastname, p.pos ORDER BY playerid, year;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname AS first_name, p.lastname AS last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 100.0) AS points_per_100_min, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2006 AND pt.year <= 1998 AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 25275 ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 77;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE ap.season_id >= 2007 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 8 UNION ALL SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS team_seasons FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1993 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 2 ORDER BY allstar_appearances DESC, playerid;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::integer = awp.playerid WHERE p.firstname LIKE 'A%' AND p.lastname LIKE 'A%' AND ap.points >= 26.04 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 9.55 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT apw.year) AS award_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players apw ON p.playerid::integer = apw.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id WHERE pt.year >= 2001 AND ap.season_id >= 2005 AND pt.points > 4268 AND ap.points > 15 AND t.won > 75 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 9 AND SUM(pt.points) > 40056 AND AVG(pt.rebounds) > 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE p.firstseason >= 1997 AND p.lastseason <= 2017 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 10 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 1965 AND p.lastseason <= 1977 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 11555 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 1234 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1966 AND 1992 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 18309 ORDER BY career_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 28.75 AND pt.year >= 1996 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 5.22 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 312.54 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2021 AND 1992 AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND t.won > 78.58 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 149.4 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1994 AND (pt.points > 18 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = 'All-NBA')) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 18853 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2006 AND pt.year <= 1992 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 20403 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1984 AND pt.points > 729 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname UNION ALL SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE pa.season_id >= 1957 AND pa.points > 34 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.assists, ap.rebounds, ap.steals, ap.blocks, (ap.points + ap.assists + ap.rebounds + ap.steals + ap.blocks) AS total_stats, AVG(ap.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid) AS avg_points_per_season, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid) AS allstar_appearances FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = CAST(ap.playerid AS character varying) JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid = CAST(aw.playerid AS character varying) AND ap.season_id = aw.year WHERE ap.points > 7.73 AND ap.season_id BETWEEN 2009.07 AND 2009.84 AND aw.award = 'All-Star' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.assists, ap.rebounds, ap.steals, ap.blocks, aw.award HAVING (ap.points + ap.assists + ap.rebounds + ap.steals + ap.blocks) > 95.68 ORDER BY total_stats DESC, ap.season_id ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year >= 1973 AND ap.year <= 2007) AS award_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, MAX(pt.points) AS max_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE p.height > '150.0' AND p.weight > 82 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1962 AND 1955 GROUP BY p.id, p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 29186 ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award LIKE '%All-Star%') AS all_star_count, (SELECT AVG(sub.avg_pts) FROM (SELECT apt.year, AVG(apt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(apt.gp, 0)) AS avg_pts FROM players_teams apt WHERE apt.playerid = p.id GROUP BY apt.year HAVING AVG(apt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(apt.gp, 0)) > 24.12) sub) AS career_avg_above_threshold FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND d.draftyear = pt.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2014 AND 1997 AND pt.points > 2843.82 AND t.won > 76 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = t.id AND c.year = t.year AND c.won > 18) > 0 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, p.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1659.57 AND AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) > 7.57 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, pt.tmid;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(CAST(pt.points AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid, pt.lgid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1959 AND pt.year <= 2003 AND pt.minutes > 686 AND t.won > 58 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2353 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 11 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year WHERE pt.year >= 2022 AND pt.year <= 2008 AND pt.minutes > 2672 AND pt.points > 670 AND (p.birthdate IS NOT NULL AND p.birthdate <> '' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) > 1937) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 112 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.lgid) >= 5 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year_league, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year WHERE pt.year >= 1952 AND pt.year <= 1951 AND pt.minutes > 20 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2294 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) <= 5 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.lgid) AS leagues_played, (SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.assists) + SUM(pt.rebounds)) AS total_contrib, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY (SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.assists) + SUM(pt.rebounds)) DESC) AS yearly_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points, (SUM(pt.points) - LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year)) AS points_diff FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 2844 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1963 AND 1972 AND t.won > 15 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA First Team' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 32515 ORDER BY total_contrib DESC, pt.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1987 AND pt.year <= 1999 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 40270 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 10 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.lgid, pt.year, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, SUM(pt.gp) AS total_games, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(ac.award) AS coach_awards_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t.id THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_wins_by_team FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::text = pt.playerid::text JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::text = t.tmid::text AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::text = ap.playerid::text AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::text = d.playerid::text LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::text = aw.playerid::text AND pt.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::text = c.tmid::text AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::text = ac.coachid::text AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 1642.73 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1973 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.lgid, pt.year HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 48.76 AND SUM(pt.gp) >= 32.93 ORDER BY avg_points DESC, total_games DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.year, t.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1967 AND pt.year <= 2002 AND pt.points > 985 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.year, t.lgid)) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 19551 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstseason, p.lastseason, ap.season_id, AVG(ap.points) OVER(PARTITION BY p.playerid) AS avg_points, SUM(ap.o_rebounds) OVER(PARTITION BY ap.season_id ORDER BY ap.minutes DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_oreb FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players awp ON ap.playerid = awp.playerid AND ap.season_id = awp.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 1972 AND p.lastseason <= 1952 AND awp.award = 'All-NBA First Team' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstseason, p.lastseason, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.o_rebounds, ap.minutes ORDER BY avg_points DESC, running_total_oreb DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.fullgivenname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league_id, pt.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_blocks, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute, AVG(pt.rebounds * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS rebounds_per_minute, AVG(pt.assists * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS assists_per_minute, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.season_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS allstar_game_appearances, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT ap2.award) AS distinct_awards_won, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.year >= 2005 THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS recent_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league_year, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS overall_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap2 ON p.playerid::integer = ap2.playerid AND pt.year = ap2.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid::integer AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE p.pos LIKE 'G' AND t.lgid LIKE 'NBA' AND p.college LIKE 'University' AND pt.year BETWEEN 1951 AND 1976 AND pt.points > 4763 AND pt.rebounds > 427 AND pt.assists > 1691 AND (t.playoff = 'Y' OR t.playoff IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.fullgivenname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, t.name, t.lgid, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 41177 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 5751 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 12076 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 8 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_rebounds DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT pt.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.year BETWEEN 1991 AND 2014 THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS points_in_range, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players_teams pt JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::character varying = p.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2003 AND pt.points > 1873 AND p.college IS NOT NULL AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY pt.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 38023 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id WHERE t.name LIKE '%Lakers%' AND t.year >= 2000 AND t.year <= 1994 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1983 AND 1964 AND pt.playerid IN ( SELECT ap.playerid FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = 'All-NBA First Team' ) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 31650 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.lgid, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(pa.points) AS allstar_points, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_pick FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id AND p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND c.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND d.draftyear = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND ap.year = t.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND ac.year = t.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1963 AND 1977 AND pt.points > 3038 AND pa.points > 285 AND c.won > 62 AND d.draftoverall < 37 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.lgid HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 4506 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 4087 INTERSECT SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.lgid, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(pa.points) AS allstar_points, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_pick FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id AND p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND c.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND d.draftyear = t.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND sp.year = t.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1967 AND 2008 AND pt.points > 720 AND pa.points > 357 AND c.won > 21 AND sp.w > 3 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.lgid HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 2284 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 2649;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.name, t.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_player_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_player_assists, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league, AVG(CAST(pt.points AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS avg_points_per_minute, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid AND ap.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_count_in_year_league, SUM(CASE WHEN pa.conference = 'East' THEN pa.points ELSE 0 END) AS east_allstar_points, SUM(CASE WHEN pa.conference = 'West' THEN pa.points ELSE 0 END) AS west_allstar_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = CAST(pt.tmid AS CHARACTER VARYING) AND t.year = pt.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = CAST(c.tmid AS CHARACTER VARYING) AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (t.tmid = CAST(sp.tmidwinner AS CHARACTER VARYING) OR t.tmid = CAST(sp.tmidloser AS CHARACTER VARYING)) AND t.year = sp.year WHERE t.year >= 1971 AND t.year <= 1974 AND t.won >= 4 AND t.lost <= 78 AND pt.minutes > 2629 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 18493 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) > 1795 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC, t.year ASC, t.tmid;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.points > 177.99) AS high_scorers_count FROM teams t WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2014.67 AND 1991.37 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY t.id, t.tmid, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts HAVING t.won > 62.05 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.won DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, p.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 2592.71 AND t.year >= 2022.28 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, p.pos), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year, t.lgid, p.pos;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.won AS current_year_wins, t2.won AS previous_year_wins, (t1.won - t2.won) AS win_difference FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.won > 55 AND t2.won > 42 ORDER BY win_difference DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_points, SUM(ps.assists) AS total_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams ps ON p.playerid::integer = ps.playerid JOIN teams t ON ps.tmid = t.tmid::integer WHERE ps.year > 1997 AND t.won > 77 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(ps.points) > 12.03 ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 448.54 AND pt.year >= 1985.51 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 29.71 ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_award_types, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.assists) AS avg_assists, MAX(ps.w) AS max_playoff_wins FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN series_post ps ON pa.tmid = ps.tmidwinner JOIN teams t ON pa.tmid = t.id WHERE pa.year >= 2019 AND pa.points > 1700 AND t.won > 47 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 29931 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 8 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id WHERE pt.points > 853.03 AND pt.year >= 2018 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 3.72 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS distinct_team_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 1993 AND ap.season_id <= 1985 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 22587 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year) AS award_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 644 AND pt.rebounds > 899 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1978 AND 1962 ORDER BY pt.points DESC, pt.rebounds DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.attendance, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS player_count, SUM(p.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(p.points) AS avg_player_points, MAX(p.points) AS max_player_points, MIN(p.points) AS min_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins, AVG(c.won) AS avg_coach_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.won DESC) AS league_rank_by_wins, SUM(t.won) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_wins_in_league, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t.id OR sp.tmidloser = t.id) AS playoff_series_appearances, (SELECT AVG(d.draftoverall) FROM draft d WHERE d.tmid = t.id AND d.draftyear BETWEEN t.year - 5 AND t.year) AS avg_draft_pick_last_5_years FROM teams t JOIN players_teams p ON t.id = p.tmid AND t.year = p.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid AND p.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::text = ac.coachid::text AND c.year = ac.year WHERE t.year >= 2021 AND t.year <= 1950 AND t.won >= 58 AND t.attendance >= 4815112 GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.attendance, t.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 265 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) > 50 UNION ALL SELECT t.lgid, t.year, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.attendance, COUNT(DISTINCT pas.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(pas.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(pas.points) AS avg_player_points, MAX(pas.points) AS max_player_points, MIN(pas.points) AS min_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins, AVG(c.won) AS avg_coach_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.won DESC) AS league_rank_by_wins, SUM(t.won) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_wins_in_league, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t.id OR sp.tmidloser = t.id) AS playoff_series_appearances, (SELECT AVG(d.draftoverall) FROM draft d WHERE d.tmid = t.id AND d.draftyear BETWEEN t.year - 5 AND t.year) AS avg_draft_pick_last_5_years FROM teams t JOIN player_allstar pas ON t.lgid = pas.league_id AND t.year = pas.season_id JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON pas.playerid = ap.playerid AND pas.season_id = ap.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::text = ac.coachid::text AND c.year = ac.year WHERE t.year >= 1957 AND t.year <= 1972 AND t.won >= 77 AND t.attendance >= 4570492 GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.attendance, t.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pas.playerid) > 4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) > 95 ORDER BY league_rank_by_wins, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT a.year, a.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS award_players, AVG(pas.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM awards_players a JOIN player_allstar pas ON a.playerid = pas.playerid AND a.year = pas.season_id JOIN players_teams pt ON a.playerid = pt.playerid AND a.year = pt.year WHERE a.year >= 1985 AND a.year <= 1989 GROUP BY a.year, a.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) > 11 ORDER BY a.year DESC, award_players DESC;

SELECT aps.award AS award_name, AVG(aps.year) AS avg_award_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pts.playerid) AS unique_players_count, SUM(pts.points) AS total_points, SUM(pts.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pts.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, MAX(teams.won) AS max_team_wins, MIN(teams.lost) AS min_team_losses, SUM(teams.o_pts) AS total_team_offensive_points, SUM(teams.d_pts) AS total_team_defensive_points, AVG(players.height) AS avg_player_height, SUM(CASE WHEN pts.minutes > 3029.89 THEN pts.points ELSE 0 END) AS high_minute_points FROM awards_players aps JOIN players_teams pts ON aps.playerid = pts.playerid AND aps.year = pts.year JOIN teams ON pts.tmid::character varying = teams.tmid AND pts.year = teams.year JOIN players ON aps.playerid::character varying = players.playerid JOIN draft d ON aps.playerid = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pts.year = c.year AND pts.tmid = c.tmid JOIN series_post sp ON teams.tmid::character varying = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND teams.year = sp.year JOIN player_allstar pas ON aps.playerid = pas.playerid AND aps.year = pas.season_id WHERE aps.award IS NOT NULL AND pts.points > 1296.04 AND teams.won > 66.01 AND teams.year BETWEEN 2018.91 AND 1948.99 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_coaches ac WHERE ac.coachid::character varying = c.coachid AND ac.year = c.year AND ac.award = 'Coach of the Year') GROUP BY aps.award, teams.tmid, teams.year, pts.tmid, pts.year HAVING SUM(pts.points) > 48273.05 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pts.playerid) >= 337.05 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_award_year ASC;

SELECT p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.year >= 1991 AND pt.year <= 2001 GROUP BY p.id, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(ap.points) > 0.62 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 8 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pa.points) AS median_points, SUM(pa.assists) AS total_assists FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE pa.points > 34 AND pa.season_id >= 2018 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.assists) > 55 ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

END), 0) AS nba_allstar_assists, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pt.lgid = 'NBA' THEN pt.assists ELSE 0 END), 0) AS nba_regular_assists, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pt.lgid = 'NBA' THEN pt.postassists ELSE 0 END), avg_nba_regular_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS nba_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS nba_regular_seasons, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid = p.id AND
