(SELECT tmid FROM players_teams pt2 WHERE pt2.playerid = p.id) OR sp.tmidloser IN (SELECT tmid FROM players_teams pt3 WHERE pt3.playerid = p.id)) AS playoff_series_appearances, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pt.lgid = 'NBA' THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END), 0) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pt.lgid = 'NBA' THEN pt.assists ELSE 0 END), 0) DESC) AS SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE pa.year >= 1997 AND pa.points > 1764 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 2458 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN awards_players aw ON p.id = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year WHERE pt.points > 4997 AND ap.points BETWEEN 28 AND 46 AND (pt.minutes >= 1457 OR pt.gp > 78) AND NOT (ap.three_attempted < 3 AND ap.three_made > 2) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 7 AND AVG(ap.points) > 20 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_team_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE ap.conference = 'East' AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 14 AND SUM(ap.points) >= 157 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE p.college LIKE '%University%' AND pt.year BETWEEN 2009 AND 2001 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 9025 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pa.assists) AS avg_allstar_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE pa.season_id BETWEEN 2009.81 AND 1988.52 AND pa.points > 35.64 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 878.73 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id AND pt.points > 2127.33 ) AND pa.points >= 27.2 AND pa.season_id BETWEEN 1977.75 AND 1973.03 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 352.85 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points_last_seasons, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points_last_seasons FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pa.playerid = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE pa.season_id >= 2016 AND pa.points > 49 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 421 ORDER BY total_points_last_seasons DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1997 AND (pt.points > 579 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award LIKE '%All-Star%')) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 28654 ORDER BY career_points DESC LIMIT 72;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE (pt.points > 2241 OR pt.assists > 277) AND NOT (pt.lgid = 'NBA' AND t.playoff = 'Y') AND pt.year BETWEEN 1963 AND 1981 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 27751 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 20 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 2530.71 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 1980 AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND t.won > 10.29 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 142.15 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1979 AND pt.points > 3 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 29780 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 46 AND t.won > 66 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3148 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid INNER JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1362 AND d.draftyear >= 1977 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 10 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 349.44 AND pt.year >= 1986.51 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 10.73 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.points > 36 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_scoring_games, COUNT(pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2004 AND pt.year <= 1995 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 42106 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, SUM(ap.points) AS total_points, AVG(ap.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.season_id ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS season_points_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid WHERE (ap.points > 23.37 OR ap.assists > 8.45) AND (ap.season_id BETWEEN 1979.36 AND 2017.36) AND NOT (t.lgid = 'NBA' AND t.playoff = 'Y') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 495.01 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 18.88 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_assists DESC;

s.tmidwinner::character varying AND t.year = s.year WHERE p.height > 213.28 AND p.weight BETWEEN 74.84 AND 212.45 AND p.firstseason >= 1976 AND p.lastseason <= 1986 AND pt.points > 2971 AND t.won > 34 SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year > 1993 AND pt.points > 22 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 16901 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, MAX(pt.year) AS last_active_year FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN coaches c ON pa.league_id = c.lgid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t.id AND sp.year > 1992.41 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1978.78 AND 1951.75 ) AND pt.year BETWEEN 1966.74 AND 2002.01 AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 41.8 AND SUM(pt.points) > 49301.98 ORDER BY total_regular_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1869 AND pt.year >= 1991 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points HAVING COUNT(pt.stint) >= 2 ORDER BY pt.year, points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, SUM(pa.points) AS allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 1640 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2003 AND pa.points > 35 AND t.won > 49 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3881 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 23 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 3 AND SUM(pa.points) > 45 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year WHERE pt.year >= 1979 AND pt.year <= 1993 AND pt.minutes > 1966 AND pt.points > 1970 AND (p.birthdate IS NOT NULL AND p.birthdate <> '' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) > 1986) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4380 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.lgid) >= 5 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) AS player_award_count, COUNT(DISTINCT awc.award) AS coach_award_count, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, SUM(c.lost) AS coach_losses, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS team_losses, SUM(sp.w) AS playoff_wins, SUM(sp.l) AS playoff_losses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::integer = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year JOIN awards_coaches awc ON awc.coachid::integer = pt.tmid AND awc.year = pt.year JOIN coaches c ON c.coachid::integer = pt.tmid AND c.year = pt.year JOIN series_post sp ON (sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) AND sp.year = pt.year WHERE pt.points > 1333.03 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1976.07 AND 1994.82 AND (p.college LIKE '%' OR p.highschool LIKE '%') AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND ap.league_id = 'NBA' AND awp.lgid = 'NBA' AND awc.lgid = 'NBA' AND c.lgid = 'NBA' AND sp.lgidwinner = 'NBA' AND sp.lgidloser = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 16574.19 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 6014.24 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 1825.55 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 6.48 AND MAX(d.draftoverall) < 153.4 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_assists DESC, total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(CASE WHEN c.won > c.lost THEN 1 END) AS winning_seasons_coached, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t.id THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_series_won, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year_league FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid::integer AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 1062 AND pt.rebounds > 262 AND pt.assists > 199 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1990 AND 1998 AND (t.lgid = 'NBA' OR t.lgid = 'ABA') AND t.playoff = 'Y' AND p.height > '150.0' AND p.weight BETWEEN 64 AND 184 AND (p.college IS NOT NULL OR p.highschool IS NOT NULL) AND NOT (p.birthcountry = 'USA' AND p.hsstate IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, pt.year, t.lgid, t.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 22023 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 33 AND AVG(pt.minutes) >= 18 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_rebounds DESC, total_assists DESC LIMIT 656;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::text = pt.lgid WHERE t.year > 2021 AND pt.year > 1963 AND t.won > 20 GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 20.61 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE t.won > 14 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA First Team' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 42 ORDER BY avg_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.name, t.won, t.lost, SUM(t.o_pts) AS total_offensive_points, AVG(t.o_pts) AS avg_offensive_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS total_players_used, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid IN (SELECT pt.playerid FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year) AND ap.year = t.year AND ap.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_count_in_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.won DESC, t.lost ASC) AS team_rank_in_league, SUM(CASE WHEN p.height > (SELECT AVG(height) FROM players WHERE height IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tall_players_count, (SELECT MAX(p2.points) FROM player_allstar p2 WHERE p2.playerid IN (SELECT pt2.playerid FROM players_teams pt2 WHERE pt2.tmid = t.id AND pt2.year = t.year) AND p2.season_id = t.year) AS max_allstar_points_by_player FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.id = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 2016 AND 2011 JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND ap.year = t.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND sp.year = t.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2017 AND 2016 AND t.won >= 22 AND t.o_pts >= 9075 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM players_teams pt2 WHERE pt2.tmid = t.id AND pt2.year = t.year AND pt2.points > 377) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.lgid, t.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 22665 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) >= 28 ORDER BY total_offensive_points DESC, team_rank_in_league ASC;

WITH player_stats AS ( SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.year >= 2005 AND pt.year <= 2007 GROUP BY pt.playerid, pt.year ) SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ps.year, ps.total_points, ps.total_rebounds, ps.total_assists, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.year ORDER BY ps.total_points DESC) AS points_rank FROM player_stats ps JOIN players p ON ps.playerid = p.id::integer WHERE ps.total_points > 1442 ORDER BY ps.year DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year FROM players p INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2016.96 AND pt.points > 39.75 GROUP BY p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1571.51 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 1960 AND pa.season_id >= 1988 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 1843 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT ap2.year) AS award_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_percentile FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players ap2 ON p.id = ap2.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 3096 AND ap.season_id >= 1966 AND ap2.year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1976 AND pt.minutes > 3630 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 15 AND SUM(pt.points) > 40653 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 2297 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.year >= 1983 AND pt.year <= 2017 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 22590 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE p.firstseason >= 1975 AND p.lastseason <= 1986 AND pt.points > 1204 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 19 AND SUM(pt.points) > 34422 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS distinct_team_years, COUNT(DISTINCT dp.draftyear) AS distinct_draft_years, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_team_points, SUM(CASE WHEN ac.award = 'Most Valuable Player' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mvp_awards_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ac.award = 'Coach of the Year' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coy_awards_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) DESC) AS allstar_season_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN draft dp ON p.playerid::integer = dp.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::integer = awp.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON p.playerid::integer = ac.coachid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON p.playerid::integer = c.coachid::integer LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner WHERE ap.points > 5 AND pt.year >= 2009 AND dp.draftyear <= 1996 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 10 AND AVG(pt.points) < 7 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, distinct_allstar_seasons DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(ap.points) AS total_points, AVG(ap.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds FROM players p JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON aw.playerid = ap.playerid AND aw.year = ap.season_id WHERE aw.year >= 2000 AND ap.points >= 31 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 4411 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points_last_seasons, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points_last_seasons FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pa.season_id >= 1957 AND pa.season_id <= 1983 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 486 ORDER BY total_points_last_seasons DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1977 AND pt.year <= 2019 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = 'All-NBA First Team') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 41508 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1981 AND 1959 AND pt.points > 1279 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 32236 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 305 AND pt.year >= 2022 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year AND pa.points > 34) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 7691 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1977 AND 1968 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 48417 ORDER BY career_points DESC LIMIT 14;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2000 AND pt.year <= 1995 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1255 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.points > 38 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2017 AND 1979 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 15889 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight, p.pos, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND ap.year >= 1970) AS mvp_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE p.height > '150.0' AND p.weight BETWEEN 98 AND 331 AND pt.year = 1985 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight, p.pos, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists ORDER BY pt.points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, p.height, p.weight, p.firstseason, p.lastseason, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_blocks, AVG(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT t.name, ', ' ORDER BY t.name) AS team_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ac.award, ', ' ORDER BY ac.award) AS coach_awards, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_wins_with_team, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid THEN sp.l ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_losses_with_team, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank, (SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.assists) + SUM(pt.rebounds) + SUM(pt.steals) + SUM(pt.blocks)) AS total_contributions FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid = awp.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = awp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid = ac.coachid::character varying AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (pt.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR pt.tmid = sp.tmidloser) AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE p.height > '150.0' AND p.weight BETWEEN 198 AND 260 AND p.firstseason >= 2005 AND p.lastseason <= 1973 AND pt.points > 1783 AND pt.gp > 31 AND t.won > 51 AND t.attendance > 2592912 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, p.height, p.weight, p.firstseason, p.lastseason HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 46952 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 5216 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 28277 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 32 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 3 AND AVG(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) > 25.03 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_assists DESC, total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 275 AND pt.year >= 2010 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points HAVING COUNT(pt.stint) >= 4 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, SUM(pa.points) AS allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 674 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2004 AND pa.points > 22 AND t.won > 48 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3509 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 23 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 1 AND SUM(pa.points) > 64 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) AS stint_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2017 AND 1964 AND pt.points > 2620 AND pt.minutes > 2470 AND p.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT d.playerid FROM draft d WHERE d.draftyear BETWEEN 1968 AND 1996 AND d.draftround <= 9 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4754 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 2301 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 4 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_minutes DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, ap.points AS allstar_points, ap.rebounds AS allstar_rebounds, ap.assists AS allstar_assists, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftselection, c.coachid, ac.award AS coach_award, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, sp.w AS series_wins, sp.l AS series_losses, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_by_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.id AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (pt.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR pt.tmid = sp.tmidloser) AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1953 AND pt.points > 986 AND pt.rebounds > 740 AND t.won > 13 AND (ap.points > 38 OR ap.points IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.rebounds, ap.assists, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftselection, c.coachid, ac.award, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, sp.w, sp.l HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 920 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 1 AND AVG(pt.assists) > 8 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_points_per_game DESC LIMIT 75;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) AS stints_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 2000 AND pt.year <= 1959 AND pt.points > 1888 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1055 AND AVG(pt.minutes) >= 46 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, pt.tmid;

SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, AVG(pt.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS avg_points_3_seasons, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds FROM players_teams pt JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id::integer WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 1994 AND pt.gp >= 33 GROUP BY pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points ORDER BY pt.playerid, pt.year;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, pt.year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::varchar = p.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1996 AND 1983 AND pt.points > 1127 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (t.tmid, t.lgid, pt.year), (t.tmid, t.lgid), (t.lgid, pt.year), (t.tmid), (t.lgid), (pt.year), () ) ORDER BY t.lgid, pt.year, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id WHERE t.year >= 2020 AND t.year <= 1984 AND pt.points > 2338 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, pt.year, pt.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 100) AS pts_per_100min, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) FILTER (WHERE d.draftyear IS NOT NULL) AS draft_years_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.conference = 'East' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS east_allstar_appearances, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.conference = 'West' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS west_allstar_appearances, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.lgid ORDER BY AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 100) DESC) AS efficiency_rank_in_league FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid AND d.draftyear = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND aw.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND t.year = pt.year AND t.lgid = pt.lgid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1973 AND 1971 AND pt.minutes > 652 AND (p.college IS NOT NULL OR p.highschool IS NOT NULL) AND pt.lgid IN ('NBA', 'NBA') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, pt.year, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 10797 AND AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 100) >= 79.72 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 13 ORDER BY total_points DESC, efficiency_rank_in_league ASC LIMIT 143;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year) AS total_points_year, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year) AS avg_points_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 1791.51 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1956.34 AND 1999.96 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points HAVING COUNT(ap.award) >= 9.34 ORDER BY pt.year, points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) AS stint_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1954 AND 1978 AND pt.points > 1784 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award IS NOT NULL ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = pt.tmid AND c.year = pt.year AND c.won > 49 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4203 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 2 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.fullgivenname, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_points, COUNT(ap.award) FILTER (WHERE ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player') AS mvp_count, MAX(c.won) AS max_coach_wins, AVG(t.o_pts) AS avg_team_points, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, SUM(s.w) AS total_series_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::text = pt.playerid::text JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::text = ap.playerid::text AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::text = t.tmid::text AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::text = d.playerid::text JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::text = c.tmid::text AND t.year = c.year JOIN series_post s ON t.tmid::text = s.tmidwinner::text AND t.year = s.year WHERE pt.points > 2408.33 AND pt.year >= 2015.91 AND t.o_pts > 49.12 AND d.draftyear >= 2003.42 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.fullgivenname, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 59148.87 AND COUNT(ap.award) > 93.03 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, pt.year, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_overall_pick FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2016 AND pt.gp > 5 AND pt.tmid IN ( SELECT tmid FROM coaches WHERE year = pt.year AND won > 81 AND lgid = 'NBA' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.year = pt.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) AND sp.round = 'Finals' ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, pt.year, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1213 AND AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) > 26.83 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.won, t1.lost, t2.won AS t2_won, t2.lost AS t2_lost, (t1.won - t2.won) AS win_difference FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year WHERE t1.won > 19.14 AND t2.won < 68.68 AND t1.year >= 1976.85 GROUP BY t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.won, t1.lost, t2.won, t2.lost HAVING (t1.won - t2.won) > 23.71 ORDER BY win_difference DESC;

SELECT COALESCE(p.playerid::text, d.playerid::text) AS playerid_combined, p.lastname, p.firstname, d.draftyear, ap.season_id, ap.points, pt.year, pt.points AS regular_season_points, SUM(ap.points) OVER(PARTITION BY COALESCE(p.playerid::text, d.playerid::text), ap.season_id) AS total_allstar_points_per_season, AVG(pt.points) OVER(PARTITION BY COALESCE(p.playerid::text, d.playerid::text), pt.year) AS avg_regular_season_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) FILTER (WHERE awp.award IS NOT NULL) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(c.won) AS max_coach_wins, SUM(t.won) AS total_team_wins_linked, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sp.round, ', ') AS playoff_rounds_participated FROM players p FULL OUTER JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::text = d.playerid::text LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::text = ap.playerid::text LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::text = pt.playerid::text AND ap.season_id = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::text = awp.playerid::text AND ap.season_id = awp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::text = sp.tmidwinner::text OR t.tmid::text = sp.tmidloser::text WHERE ap.points > 24.32 AND pt.points > 114.91 AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1969.29 AND 1971.97 AND t.year BETWEEN 1998.67 AND 1988.9 GROUP BY COALESCE(p.playerid::text, d.playerid::text), p.lastname, p.firstname, d.draftyear, ap.season_id, ap.points, pt.year, pt.points, awp.award, c.won, t.won, sp.round HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 679.24 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 12.13 ORDER BY total_allstar_points_per_season DESC, avg_regular_season_points_per_year DESC;

ap.season_id) >= 15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 29 ORDER BY p.playerid, ap.season_id, pt.year, t.year, d.draftyear, ac.year, sp.year;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, SUM(pa.points) AS allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points)) AS points_percentile FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 1781 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2011 AND 2012 AND pa.points > 26 AND t.won > 40 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1010 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 35 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 4 AND SUM(pa.points) > 20 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, AVG(t.won) AS avg_wins, SUM(t.attendance) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid) AS total_league_attendance FROM teams t JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::text = c.tmid::text AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 2007 AND t.attendance > 746773 GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year, t.attendance ORDER BY t.year DESC;
SELECT t.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid WHERE pt.year >= 1996 AND pt.gp >= 25 GROUP BY t.tmid ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, SUM(ap.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS unique_players FROM player_allstar ap JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.lgid = t.lgid WHERE ap.season_id >= 1951 AND ap.season_id <= 2011 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 842 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(p.points) AS total_player_points, SUM(p.assists) AS total_player_assists, SUM(p.rebounds) AS total_player_rebounds, SUM(p.steals) AS total_player_steals, SUM(p.blocks) AS total_player_blocks, AVG(p.points) AS avg_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS unique_players, MAX(t.o_pts) AS team_offensive_points, MAX(t.d_pts) AS team_defensive_points, MAX(t.won) AS team_wins, MAX(t.lost) AS team_losses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.points) DESC) AS rank_by_points, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(p.assists) DESC) AS row_by_assists_in_league, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.rebounds) DESC) AS dense_rank_by_rebounds, LAG(SUM(p.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points, LEAD(SUM(p.assists), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS next_year_assists, SUM(SUM(p.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_points_in_league, AVG(SUM(p.rebounds)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_rebounds_3_year FROM teams t JOIN players_teams p ON t.tmid::integer = p.tmid AND t.year = p.year JOIN awards_players a ON p.playerid = a.playerid AND p.year = a.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid AND p.year = pa.season_id WHERE t.year >= 2001 AND t.year <= 1989 AND p.points > 4224 AND t.won > 61 AND a.award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND sp.round = 'Finals' AND pa.league_id = 'NBA' AND c.won > 38 AND d.draftyear >= 1976 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(p.points) > 68605 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) > 43 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT pt.playerid FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.points > 967.1) AS high_scorers) AS high_scoring_players, (SELECT AVG(sub.avg_assists) FROM (SELECT pt2.playerid, AVG(pt2.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players_teams pt2 WHERE pt2.tmid = t.id AND pt2.year = t.year GROUP BY pt2.playerid HAVING AVG(pt2.assists) > 203.95) AS sub) AS avg_assists_above_threshold FROM teams t WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1958 AND 2012 AND t.lgid = 'AA' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.id ORDER BY t.year DESC, high_scoring_players DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS unique_players, COUNT(DISTINCT d.playerid) AS unique_drafted_players, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS unique_allstar_players, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS unique_coaches, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_player_points, AVG(p.height) AS avg_player_height, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t.id THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS total_playoff_series_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidloser = t.id THEN sp.l ELSE 0 END) AS total_playoff_series_losses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS player_count_rank FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.id = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1986.26 AND 2006.91 LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND ap.season_id = t.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser) AND t.year = sp.year WHERE t.year >= 1996.42 AND t.year <= 1985.81 AND t.won >= 35.11 AND pt.points > 312.35 AND p.height IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, t.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 6.11 AND SUM(pt.points) > 2822.79 AND AVG(p.height) BETWEEN 232.25 AND 178.92 ORDER BY total_team_player_points DESC, avg_player_height ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.won) AS total_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS total_losses, AVG(t.o_pts) AS avg_offensive_points, AVG(t.d_pts) AS avg_defensive_points, AVG(SUM(t.won)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins_3yr FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year AND t.lgid = pt.lgid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id WHERE t.year >= 2015 AND t.year <= 2010 AND t.o_pts > 6809 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.won) > 37 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.tmid, t.name, AVG(t.won::numeric / t.games) AS win_rate, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_points_3yr, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS league_points_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players_count, MAX(CASE WHEN ac.award = 'Coach of the Year' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_coach_of_year FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND t.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND t.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND t.year = ac.year WHERE t.year >= 1998 AND t.year <= 1987 AND t.attendance >= 27173 AND pt.points >= 1304 GROUP BY t.year, t.tmid, t.name, t.lgid HAVING AVG(t.won::numeric / t.games) > 0.02 AND SUM(pt.points) > 186367 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid AS team_id, t1.name AS team_name, t1.lgid AS league, AVG(pas.three_made) AS avg_allstar_three_made, MAX(pt.points) AS max_player_team_points, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t1.id THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS total_series_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS distinct_awarded_players, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (ORDER BY t1.year) AS prev_year_total_points FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year AND t1.id <> t2.id JOIN players_teams pt ON t1.id = pt.tmid AND t1.year = pt.year JOIN player_allstar pas ON pt.playerid = pas.playerid AND pt.year = pas.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN series_post sp ON t1.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t1.id = sp.tmidloser JOIN coaches c ON t1.id = c.tmid AND t1.year = c.year JOIN draft d ON pt.playerid = d.playerid AND t1.year = d.draftyear WHERE t1.year >= 1987 AND t1.year <= 1950 AND t1.won > 26 AND t1.lost < 60 AND pt.points > 2592 AND pas.three_made > 15 AND (t1.lgid = 'NBA' OR t1.lgid = 'NBA') AND NOT (t1.playoff = 'Y' AND t1.attendance < 1964917) AND (t1.confid = 'E' OR t1.divid = 'Atlantic') AND c.won > 22 AND d.draftround BETWEEN 8 AND 7 GROUP BY t1.id, t1.name, t1.lgid, t1.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 91496 AND AVG(pas.three_made) > 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) > 4 ORDER BY total_series_wins DESC, avg_allstar_three_made DESC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.lastname, p.firstname, t.name AS team_name, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons_count, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, SUM(CASE WHEN awp.award = 'Most Valuable Player' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mvp_awards_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS team_assists_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2004 AND 1997 AND pt.gp >= 20 AND t.attendance > 3410854 AND (p.height > '150.0' OR p.weight > 141) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, t.name, pt.year, t.id, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 33424 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.lgid) >= 2 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, team_assists_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, a.year, a.award, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN awards_players a ON p.playerid::integer = a.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON a.playerid = pt.playerid AND a.year = pt.year WHERE a.award IN (SELECT award FROM awards_players WHERE year = 2008 GROUP BY award HAVING COUNT(*) >= 134) GROUP BY p.playerid, a.year, a.award ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE (pt.points > 2241 OR pt.rebounds > 1401) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players aw WHERE aw.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND aw.year = ap.season_id AND aw.award = 'All-NBA') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 42983 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS distinct_team_years, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.league_id) AS distinct_allstar_leagues, COUNT(DISTINCT dp.draftyear) AS distinct_draft_years, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.three_made::numeric / NULLIF(ap.three_attempted, 0)) AS allstar_three_pct, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.threemade::numeric / NULLIF(pt.threeattempted, 0)) AS regular_three_pct, MAX(t.won) AS max_team_wins, MIN(t.lost) AS min_team_losses, SUM(CASE WHEN ac.award = 'Coach of the Year' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coach_of_year_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) DESC) AS team_years_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft dp ON p.playerid::integer = dp.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::integer = awp.playerid AND ap.season_id = awp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 1965 AND p.lastseason <= 1983 AND ap.points > 73 AND t.won > 20 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 18 AND SUM(ap.points) > 25 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, distinct_allstar_seasons DESC LIMIT 263;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes_per_season FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= (SELECT MIN(year) FROM players_teams WHERE points > 647) AND pt.year <= 1991 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 15896 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying WHERE p.college LIKE '%State%' AND pt.year BETWEEN 2008.97 AND 2004.51 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 7027.95 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1963 AND pt.year <= 1977 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1971 AND 1957) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 39075 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 2881.6 AND t.won > 57.14 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > (SELECT AVG(points) FROM players_teams WHERE year = 1956.03) ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year WHERE pa.points > 43 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1995 AND 1951 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2293 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS unique_awards_count, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 1998 AND pa.season_id >= 2002 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 4692 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE pt.points > 11 AND pt.rebounds > 13 AND ap.year BETWEEN 2001 AND 2020 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) > 2 AND AVG(pt.points) > 16 ORDER BY total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM( CASE WHEN pt.points > 32 THEN pt.points WHEN pt.points BETWEEN 19 AND 12 THEN pt.points * 0.5 ELSE 0 END ) AS adjusted_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 2017 AND pt.year <= 2018 AND pt.points > 0 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.assists) > 5 ORDER BY adjusted_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points_last_seasons, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points_last_seasons FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pa.playerid = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE pa.season_id >= 2010 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 338 ORDER BY total_points_last_seasons DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1422.13 AND pt.year >= 1962.43 AND pt.year <= 1993.56 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year IN (SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'All-NBA First Team') AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4560.86 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1963 AND pt.year <= 2008 AND pt.points > 2314 AND pa.points > 68 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 49219 AND AVG(pa.points) > 46 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year WHERE pt.year >= 2011 AND pt.year <= 1995 AND pt.rebounds > 926 AND pa.rebounds > 20 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.rebounds) > 13384 AND AVG(pa.rebounds) > 21 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.points > 974 AND (pt.assists > 33 OR pt.rebounds > 206) AND NOT (pt.lgid = 'ABA') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 22325 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2000 AND pt.points > 23 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 45481 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2023 AND pt.year <= 1996 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = 'All-NBA First Team' LIMIT 1) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 20312 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer WHERE pt.points > 678.18 AND t.year >= 2006.54 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 33520.44 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.year >= 2011 THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS recent_points, COUNT(CASE WHEN pt.lgid = 'NBA' THEN 1 END) AS league_games FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1992 AND pt.points > 4889 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1389 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_position, SUM(CASE WHEN t.playoff = 'Y' THEN pt.postpoints ELSE 0 END) AS total_postseason_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (ORDER BY p.playerid) AS prev_player_total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE p.height > 242.37 AND p.weight BETWEEN 91 AND 263 AND pt.year >= 1989 AND pt.year <= 2022 AND t.attendance > 58708 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 22.97 AND SUM(pt.points) > 35863 ORDER BY total_regular_points DESC, points_rank LIMIT 21;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.height, p.weight, COALESCE(SUM(pa.points), 0) AS total_allstar_points, COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) AS total_regular_points, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) AS total_post_points, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year), 0) AS award_years_count, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT c.year), 0) AS coached_years_count, COALESCE(MAX(d.draftoverall), 0) AS highest_draft_pick, COALESCE(AVG(pa.points), 0) AS avg_allstar_points_per_game, COALESCE(AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)), 0) AS avg_regular_points_per_game, COALESCE(SUM(pa.assists), 0) AS total_allstar_assists, COALESCE(SUM(pt.assists), 0) AS total_regular_assists, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postassists), 0) AS total_post_assists, COALESCE(SUM(pa.rebounds), 0) AS total_allstar_rebounds, COALESCE(SUM(pt.rebounds), 0) AS total_regular_rebounds, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postrebounds), 0) AS total_post_rebounds, COALESCE(SUM(pa.steals), 0) AS total_allstar_steals, COALESCE(SUM(pt.steals), 0) AS total_regular_steals, COALESCE(SUM(pt.poststeals), 0) AS total_post_steals, COALESCE(SUM(pa.blocks), 0) AS total_allstar_blocks, COALESCE(SUM(pt.blocks), 0) AS total_regular_blocks, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postblocks), 0) AS total_post_blocks, COALESCE(SUM(pa.turnovers), 0) AS total_allstar_turnovers, COALESCE(SUM(pt.turnovers), 0) AS total_regular_turnovers, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postturnovers), 0) AS total_post_turnovers, COALESCE(SUM(pa.personal_fouls), 0) AS total_allstar_fouls, COALESCE(SUM(pt.pf), 0) AS total_regular_fouls, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpf), 0) AS total_post_fouls, COALESCE(SUM(pa.ft_made), 0) AS total_allstar_ft_made, COALESCE(SUM(pt.ftmade), 0) AS total_regular_ft_made, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postftmade), 0) AS total_post_ft_made, COALESCE(SUM(pa.ft_attempted), 0) AS total_allstar_ft_attempted, COALESCE(SUM(pt.ftattempted), 0) AS total_regular_ft_attempted, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postftattempted), 0) AS total_post_ft_attempted, COALESCE(SUM(pa.fg_made), 0) AS total_allstar_fg_made, COALESCE(SUM(pt.fgmade), 0) AS total_regular_fg_made, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postfgmade), 0) AS total_post_fg_made, COALESCE(SUM(pa.fg_attempted), 0) AS total_allstar_fg_attempted, COALESCE(SUM(pt.fgattempted), 0) AS total_regular_fg_attempted, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postfgattempted), 0) AS total_post_fg_attempted, COALESCE(SUM(pa.three_made), 0) AS total_allstar_three_made, COALESCE(SUM(pt.threemade), 0) AS total_regular_three_made, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postthreemade), 0) AS total_post_three_made, COALESCE(SUM(pa.three_attempted), 0) AS total_allstar_three_attempted, COALESCE(SUM(pt.threeattempted), 0) AS total_regular_three_attempted, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postthreeattempted), 0) AS total_post_three_attempted, COALESCE(SUM(t.won), 0) AS total_team_wins, COALESCE(SUM(t.lost), 0) AS total_team_losses, COALESCE(SUM(t.attendance), 0) AS total_attendance, COALESCE(SUM(t.o_pts), 0) AS total_team_points_for, COALESCE(SUM(t.d_pts), 0) AS total_team_points_against, COALESCE(SUM(sp.w), 0) AS total_playoff_series_wins, COALESCE(SUM(sp.l), 0) AS total_playoff_series_losses, COALESCE(SUM(c.won), 0) AS total_coach_wins, COALESCE(SUM(c.lost), 0) AS total_coach_losses, COALESCE(SUM(c.post_wins), 0) AS total_coach_post_wins, COALESCE(SUM(c.post_losses), 0) AS total_coach_post_losses, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid), 0) AS distinct_teams_played_for, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year), 0) AS distinct_seasons_played, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id), 0) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award), 0) AS distinct_award_types, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award), 0) AS distinct_coach_award_types, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear), 0) AS distinct_draft_years, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid), 0) AS distinct_coaches_played_under, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pa.points), 0) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) DESC) AS regular_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) DESC) AS post_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pa.assists), 0) DESC) AS allstar_assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.assists), 0) DESC) AS regular_assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.postassists), 0) DESC) AS post_assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pa.rebounds), 0) DESC) AS allstar_rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.rebounds), 0) DESC) AS regular_rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.postrebounds), 0) DESC) AS post_rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pa.steals), 0) DESC) AS allstar_steals_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.steals), 0) DESC) AS regular_steals_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.poststeals), 0) DESC) AS post_steals_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pa.blocks), 0) DESC) AS allstar_blocks_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.blocks), 0) DESC) AS regular_blocks_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.postblocks), 0) DESC) AS post_blocks_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pa.turnovers), 0) ASC) AS allstar_turnovers_rank_asc, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.turnovers), 0) ASC) AS regular_turnovers_rank_asc, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.postturnovers), 0) ASC) AS post_turnovers_rank_asc, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pa.personal_fouls), 0) ASC) AS allstar_fouls_rank_asc, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.pf), 0) ASC) AS regular_fouls_rank_asc, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpf), 0) ASC) AS post_fouls_rank_asc, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(AVG(pa.points), 0) DESC) AS avg_allstar_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)), 0) DESC) AS avg_regular_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(MAX(d.draftoverall), 0) ASC) AS draft_pick_rank_asc, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year), 0) DESC) AS award_years_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT c.year), 0) DESC) AS coached_years_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(t.won), 0) DESC) AS team_wins_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(t.lost), 0) ASC) AS team_losses_rank_asc, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(sp.w), 0) DESC) AS playoff_series_wins_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(sp.l), 0) ASC) AS playoff_series_losses_rank_asc, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(c.won), 0) DESC) AS coach_wins_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(c.lost), 0) ASC) AS coach_losses_rank_asc, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(c.post_wins), 0) DESC) AS coach_post_wins_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(c.post_losses), 0) ASC) AS coach_post_losses_rank_asc, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid), 0) DESC) AS distinct_teams_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year), 0) DESC) AS distinct_seasons_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id), 0) DESC) AS distinct_allstar_seasons_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award), 0) DESC) AS distinct_award_types_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award), 0) DESC) AS distinct_coach_award_types_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear), 0) DESC) AS distinct_draft_years_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid), 0) DESC) AS distinct_coaches_rank FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying AND pa.points > 28.86 AND pa.season_id >= 1969.32 LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying AND pt.points > 872.45 AND pt.year >= 1958.94 LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying AND ap.year >= 1982.02 LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON p.playerid = ac.coachid::character varying AND ac.year >= 1962.48 LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying AND d.draftyear >= 1968.25 LEFT JOIN coaches c ON p.playerid = c.coachid AND c.year >= 1947.15 LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND t.year >= 1950.3 LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND sp.year >= 1957.34 WHERE p.height > 192.48 AND p.weight > 188.55 AND p.firstseason >= 1986.5 AND p.lastseason <= 2008.0 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.height, p.weight HAVING COALESCE(SUM(pa.points), 0) > 715.41 OR COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) > 20931.62 OR COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) > 909.42 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, total_regular_points DESC, total_post_points DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, SUM(pa.points) AS allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 2800 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2008 AND 1996 AND pa.points > 23 AND t.won > 45 AND c.won > 73 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3135 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 4 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 17 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.award = 'MVP') AS mvp_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_per_year, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, (SELECT AVG(pa.points) FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid = p.id AND pa.season_id >= 1968) AS avg_allstar_points_since_year, (SELECT MAX(d.draftoverall) FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.id) AS best_draft_position, t.won AS team_wins, t.lost AS team_losses, (SELECT SUM(c.won) FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = pt.tmid AND c.year = pt.year) AS coach_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::text = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1969 AND 1970 AND pt.points > 61 AND t.won > 3 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, t.won, t.lost, p.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 34918 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 18 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_season_league, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS previous_season_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1973 AND 1978 AND pt.gp >= 44 AND t.playoff = 'Y' AND pt.points > (SELECT AVG(points) FROM players_teams WHERE year = pt.year AND lgid = pt.lgid) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2143 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) <= 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, points_rank_in_season_league ASC;
