SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank_in_league FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year >= 1977 AND pt.year <= 1981 AND pt.points > 2601 AND pt.assists > 266 AND t.won > 65 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, pt.year, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2632 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 10 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name, t.won AS team_wins, t.lost AS team_losses, c.coachid AS coach_id, c.won AS coach_wins, c.lost AS coach_losses, AVG(c.won::numeric / (c.won + c.lost)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid) AS avg_coach_win_pct_by_team, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(c.won::numeric / (c.won + c.lost)) DESC) AS overall_coach_win_pct_rank FROM teams t JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.won > 14.82 AND c.won > 2.03 GROUP BY t.name, t.tmid, t.won, t.lost, c.coachid, c.won, c.lost ORDER BY overall_coach_win_pct_rank;

SELECT t.tmid AS team_id, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league_id, t.year AS season_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS total_players, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS avg_points_per_minute, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid AND ap.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_count_in_season_league FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year AND t.lgid = pt.lgid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying AND d.draftyear = t.year - 1 WHERE t.year >= 2016 AND t.year <= 1998 AND t.won >= 34 AND t.attendance >= 1508894 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 19892 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) >= 18 UNION ALL SELECT t.tmid AS team_id, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league_id, t.year AS season_year, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS total_coaches, SUM(c.won) AS total_wins_by_coaches, SUM(c.lost) AS total_losses_by_coaches, SUM(c.post_wins) AS total_postseason_wins, AVG(c.won * 1.0 / NULLIF(c.won + c.lost, 0)) AS win_percentage, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(c.won) DESC) AS coach_wins_rank_in_league, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_coaches ac WHERE ac.year = t.year AND ac.lgid = t.lgid AND ac.award LIKE '%Coach%') AS coach_awards_count FROM teams t JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year AND t.lgid = c.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1956 AND t.year <= 1963 AND t.won >= 52 AND t.attendance >= 331126 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(c.won) > 81 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) >= 1 ORDER BY season_year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS total_players, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.coachid) AS total_award_coaches, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.points > 1290 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1990 AND 1962 AND pa.points >= 20 AND c.won > 62 AND d.draftyear >= 2004 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 7803 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) >= 6 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 34 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(pt.playerid) AS player_count, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes FROM teams t LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year WHERE t.year >= 1989 AND t.year <= 1986 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name ORDER BY player_count DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(p.points) AS total_player_points, SUM(p.assists) AS total_player_assists, SUM(p.rebounds) AS total_player_rebounds, SUM(p.steals) AS total_player_steals, SUM(p.blocks) AS total_player_blocks, AVG(p.points) AS avg_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS unique_players, MAX(t.o_pts) AS team_offensive_points, MAX(t.d_pts) AS team_defensive_points, MAX(t.won) AS team_wins, MAX(t.lost) AS team_losses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.points) DESC) AS rank_by_points, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(p.assists) DESC) AS row_by_assists_in_league, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.rebounds) DESC) AS dense_rank_by_rebounds, LAG(SUM(p.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points, LEAD(SUM(p.assists), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS next_year_assists, SUM(SUM(p.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_points_in_league, AVG(SUM(p.rebounds)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_rebounds_3_year FROM teams t JOIN players_teams p ON t.tmid::integer = p.tmid AND t.year = p.year JOIN awards_players a ON p.playerid = a.playerid AND p.year = a.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid AND p.year = pa.season_id WHERE t.year >= 1949 AND t.year <= 1947 AND p.points > 4389 AND t.won > 4 AND a.award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND sp.round = 'Finals' AND pa.league_id = 'NBA' AND c.won > 37 AND d.draftyear >= 2005 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(p.points) > 36552 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) > 29 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 2631 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1995 AND 2005 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 28 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1994 AND pt.year <= 1959 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 18537 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 11066.67 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 6832.69 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS scoring_category FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2000 AND pt.year <= 2001 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 913.8 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award LIKE '%All-Star%') AS all_star_awards, (SELECT AVG(pa.points) FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid = p.id AND pa.season_id = pt.year) AS avg_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS career_points_running_total FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 882 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2018 AND 1953 AND p.firstseason <= 1958 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid = p.id AND ap2.year = pt.year AND ap2.award IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, p.id HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 1480 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 2 ORDER BY career_points_running_total DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.tmidwinner) AS championship_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE (pt.points > 2926 OR pa.points > 38) AND (pt.year BETWEEN 2015 AND 1981) AND (t.won > 59 OR t.lost < 34) AND (p.firstseason <= 1997 AND p.lastseason >= 1957) AND (NOT (pt.minutes < 12 AND pt.gp < 69)) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1980 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 8 AND AVG(pt.minutes) BETWEEN 11 AND 15 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_awards DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.points > 24 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_scoring_games, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS seasons_played, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.steals > 3 THEN pt.steals ELSE 0 END) AS impactful_steals, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY ap.season_id) AS prev_season_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2012 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND pt.points IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.tmid, ap.season_id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 43405 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 6 ORDER BY total_assists DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2003 AND pt.points > 41 AND t.won > 21 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 436 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year;

SELECT t.name, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.award = 'MVP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mvp_count FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t.year = pt.year AND t.lgid = pt.lgid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ps ON pt.playerid = ps.playerid AND pt.year = ps.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year AND t.lgid = c.lgid JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND t.year = sp.year WHERE t.year >= 2004 AND t.year <= 1956 AND t.won >= 75 AND t.attendance > 1319533 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 34517 UNION ALL SELECT t.name, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, SUM(CASE WHEN ac.award = 'Coach of the Year' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coach_of_year_count FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t.year = pt.year AND t.lgid = pt.lgid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ps ON pt.playerid = ps.playerid AND pt.year = ps.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON t.tmid = ac.coachid::character varying AND t.year = ac.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year AND t.lgid = c.lgid JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidloser::character varying AND t.year = sp.year WHERE t.year >= 1993 AND t.year <= 1984 AND t.lost >= 47 AND t.attendance > 343643 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 22678 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS unique_players, COUNT(DISTINCT d.playerid) AS unique_drafted_players, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS unique_allstar_players, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS unique_coaches, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_player_points, AVG(p.height) AS avg_player_height, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t.id THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS total_playoff_series_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidloser = t.id THEN sp.l ELSE 0 END) AS total_playoff_series_losses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS player_count_rank FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.id = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1950.24 AND 1975.6 LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND ap.season_id = t.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON (t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser) AND t.year = sp.year WHERE t.year >= 1951.22 AND t.year <= 1961.07 AND t.won >= 37.35 AND pt.points > 1422.54 AND p.height IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, t.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 12.7 AND SUM(pt.points) > 40337.77 AND AVG(p.height) BETWEEN 195.18 AND 237.55 ORDER BY total_team_player_points DESC, avg_player_height ASC;

SELECT t1.tmid AS team_id, t1.name AS team_name, t1.lgid AS league, AVG(pas.three_made) AS avg_allstar_three_made, MAX(pt.points) AS max_player_team_points, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t1.id THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS total_series_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS distinct_awarded_players, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (ORDER BY t1.year) AS prev_year_total_points FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year AND t1.id <> t2.id JOIN players_teams pt ON t1.id = pt.tmid AND t1.year = pt.year JOIN player_allstar pas ON pt.playerid = pas.playerid AND pt.year = pas.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN series_post sp ON t1.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t1.id = sp.tmidloser JOIN coaches c ON t1.id = c.tmid AND t1.year = c.year JOIN draft d ON pt.playerid = d.playerid AND t1.year = d.draftyear WHERE t1.year >= 2014 AND t1.year <= 1994 AND t1.won > 34 AND t1.lost < 52 AND pt.points > 869 AND pas.three_made > 0 AND (t1.lgid = 'NBA' OR t1.lgid = 'NBA') AND NOT (t1.playoff = 'Y' AND t1.attendance < 989970) AND (t1.confid = 'E' OR t1.divid = 'Atlantic') AND c.won > 18 AND d.draftround BETWEEN 9 AND 1 GROUP BY t1.id, t1.name, t1.lgid, t1.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 79761 AND AVG(pas.three_made) > 4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) > 49 ORDER BY total_series_wins DESC, avg_allstar_three_made DESC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, ROUND(AVG(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)), 2) AS avg_points_per_game, ROUND(AVG(pt.assists::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)), 2) AS avg_assists_per_game, ROUND(AVG(pt.rebounds::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)), 2) AS avg_rebounds_per_game, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid::integer = p.id AND ap.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_awards_count, (SELECT AVG(pa.points) FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid::integer = p.id AND pa.season_id >= 1959) AS avg_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2021 AND 1976 AND pt.points > 1414 AND t.won > 21 AND (c.won > 73 OR c.post_wins > 17) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, p.id HAVING AVG(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) > 34.21 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 18 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, avg_points_per_game DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE p.firstseason >= 1969 AND p.lastseason <= 2011 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) < 13 ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 2539 AND pt.year >= 1964 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4731 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying WHERE pt.year > 1960 AND pt.year < 1968 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3097 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(pt.points AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS yearly_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 1992 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.minutes) > 14059 ORDER BY pt.year, yearly_points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS overall_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid::integer = c.tmid::integer AND pt.year = c.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 699 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1984 AND 2012 AND t.won > 49 AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 47073 ORDER BY overall_points_rank, team_points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, p.college, p.pos, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, SUM(pt.minutes) AS total_minutes, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_blocks, SUM(pt.turnovers) AS total_turnovers, SUM(pt.pf) AS total_fouls, SUM(pt.fgmade) AS total_fg_made, SUM(pt.fgattempted) AS total_fg_attempted, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.fgattempted) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(pt.fgmade)::DECIMAL / SUM(pt.fgattempted)) * 100, 2) ELSE 0.00 END AS fg_percentage, SUM(pt.threemade) AS total_three_made, SUM(pt.threeattempted) AS total_three_attempted, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.threeattempted) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(pt.threemade)::DECIMAL / SUM(pt.threeattempted)) * 100, 2) ELSE 0.00 END AS three_point_percentage, SUM(pt.ftmade) AS total_ft_made, SUM(pt.ftattempted) AS total_ft_attempted, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.ftattempted) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(pt.ftmade)::DECIMAL / SUM(pt.ftattempted)) * 100, 2) ELSE 0.00 END AS ft_percentage, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(ps.points) AS max_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years_count, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league_year, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS overall_points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS previous_year_points, LEAD(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS next_year_points, SUM(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid = p.id AND ap2.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_award_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t.id OR sp.tmidloser = t.id) AS team_playoff_series_count, (SELECT AVG(c.won::DECIMAL / (c.won + c.lost)) FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = t.id AND c.year = pt.year) AS coach_win_percentage FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.id = ps.playerid AND pt.year = ps.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON t.id = ac.coachid::INTEGER AND pt.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1956 AND 2007 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND p.pos IN ('G', 'F', 'C') AND pt.minutes >= 3884 AND pt.points >= 2208 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.college, p.pos, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, t.lgid, t.id, p.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 651 AND SUM(pt.minutes) > 3020 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) <= 6 ORDER BY total_points DESC, player_name, pt.year;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pa.points) AS median_points, SUM(pa.rebounds) AS total_rebounds FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pa.playerid = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE pa.points > 17 AND pa.season_id >= 1996 AND pa.season_id <= 1990 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 14.9 ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS unique_awards, SUM(ps.points) AS career_points, AVG(ast.three_made) AS avg_allstar_threes, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS teams_played_for FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams ps ON p.playerid::integer = ps.playerid JOIN player_allstar ast ON p.playerid::integer = ast.playerid AND ps.year = ast.season_id JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON ps.tmid::integer = t.id::integer WHERE p.weight > 159.83 AND p.firstseason >= 1992 AND ap.year >= 1979 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(ps.points) > 2184.51 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) >= 34 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.points > 3325 AND ap.points BETWEEN 27 AND 25 AND (pt.gp >= 26 OR pt.minutes > 1774) AND NOT (ap.three_attempted = 0 AND ap.three_made > 0) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(ap.points) > 17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 2 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.year >= 2010 AND pt.year <= 1955 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 22392 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS team_years, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position FROM players p LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid::integer AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 1954 AND p.lastseason <= 1978 AND (pa.points >= 48 OR pa.points IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) >= 7 AND AVG(pa.points) > 9.34 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE ap.year >= 1951 AND pt.points > 1980 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) > 17 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1503.75 AND d.draftyear >= 1965.58 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1989 AND pt.year <= 1950 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 25523 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2002 AND pt.year <= 2017 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 10165 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) > 37890.89 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.points) BETWEEN 5505.69 AND 7680.03 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS scoring_category FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 2011 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) >= 3596.67 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 15145.59 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 2140.06 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS scoring_category, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1970 AND 1996 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 658.25 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 843 AND t.year >= 2003 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1750 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, COUNT(DISTINCT apw.award) AS unique_award_count, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players apw ON ap.playerid = apw.playerid AND ap.season_id = apw.year JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE ap.season_id >= 1989 AND ap.season_id <= 1999 AND (pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) > 42.41 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT apw.award) >= 1 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.assists, ap.rebounds, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points AS team_points, pt.assists AS team_assists, pt.rebounds AS team_rebounds, t.name, t.lgid, t.won, t.lost, d.draftyear, d.draftoverall, awp.award, ac.award AS coach_award, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, sp.w AS series_wins, sp.l AS series_losses, AVG(ap.points) OVER (PARTITION BY ap.playerid ORDER BY ap.season_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_points_career, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.playerid, pt.year ORDER BY pt.stint) AS cumulative_points_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank_in_league_year, LAG(pt.points, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year, pt.stint) AS previous_season_points, SUM(t.won) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_wins_league, COUNT(awp.award) OVER (PARTITION BY awp.playerid) AS total_player_awards, COUNT(ac.award) OVER (PARTITION BY ac.coachid) AS total_coach_awards, AVG(d.draftoverall) OVER (PARTITION BY d.draftyear, d.lgid) AS avg_draft_position_year_league, SUM(sp.w) OVER (PARTITION BY sp.tmidwinner ORDER BY sp.year) AS cumulative_playoff_wins_team FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid = awp.playerid::character varying AND ap.season_id = awp.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON t.tmid = ac.coachid::character varying AND t.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND t.year = sp.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year WHERE p.height > 167.6 AND p.weight > 75.85 AND pt.points > 2990.05 AND t.won > 40.04 AND d.draftyear > 1991.61 AND awp.year > 1994.72 AND ac.year > 1953.34 AND sp.year > 1975.65 AND c.year > 1997.27 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.assists, ap.rebounds, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.assists, pt.rebounds, t.name, t.lgid, t.won, t.lost, d.draftyear, d.draftoverall, awp.award, ac.award, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, sp.w, sp.l, ap.playerid, pt.playerid, pt.stint, t.year, awp.playerid, ac.coachid, d.lgid, sp.tmidwinner, sp.year, c.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4944.03 AND AVG(ap.points) > 58.84 AND COUNT(awp.award) > 43.33 ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC, AVG(ap.points) DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(ap.season_id) AS latest_allstar_season, COUNT(apl.award) AS award_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points, (SUM(pt.points) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pt.fgattempted), 0)) AS career_fg_percentage, (SUM(pt.ftmade) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pt.ftattempted), 0)) AS career_ft_percentage, (SUM(pt.threemade) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pt.threeattempted), 0)) AS career_three_percentage, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, c.won AS coach_wins, c.lost AS coach_losses, sp.w AS playoff_wins, sp.l AS playoff_losses FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players apl ON p.playerid::integer = apl.playerid AND pt.year = apl.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 2873 AND t.year BETWEEN 1954 AND 1981 AND p.height > '150.0' AND p.weight > 73 AND t.attendance > 3953282 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, t.name, t.lgid, t.year, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, c.won, c.lost, sp.w, sp.l HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 15599 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 24 ORDER BY total_points DESC, t.year, t.lgid;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1006 AND pt.year >= 2020 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points HAVING COUNT(pt.stint) >= 3 ORDER BY pt.year, points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) AS stint_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2003 AND 1994 AND pt.minutes > 1584 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = pt.tmid AND c.year = pt.year AND c.won > 53 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE (sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) AND sp.year = pt.year AND sp.w > 4 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2604 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, SUM(ap.points) AS total_points, SUM(ap.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(ap.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(ap.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS seasons_played, (SUM(ap.points) + SUM(ap.assists) + SUM(ap.rebounds)) AS total_contributions, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.league_id ORDER BY (SUM(ap.points) + SUM(ap.assists) + SUM(ap.rebounds)) DESC) AS league_rank, LAG(SUM(ap.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid, ap.league_id ORDER BY ap.season_id) AS prev_season_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.lgid = t.lgid JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND ap.season_id = aw.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year WHERE ap.points > 14 AND ap.season_id BETWEEN 1982 AND 2012 AND t.year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1991 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, ap.season_id, ap.league_id HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 144 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 10 ORDER BY total_contributions DESC, league_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS season_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER ( PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_points_3yr FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 1469.09 AND pt.year >= 1988 AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4544.33 ORDER BY p.playerid, pt.year;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS season_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER ( PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_points_3yr FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 2336.45 AND pt.year >= 2013 AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3051.65 ORDER BY p.playerid, pt.year;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points AS regular_points, p2.points AS allstar_points, (p1.points - COALESCE(p2.points, 0)) AS point_diff FROM players_teams p1 LEFT JOIN player_allstar p2 ON p1.playerid = p2.playerid AND p1.year = p2.season_id WHERE p1.points > 397 AND p1.year BETWEEN 2009 AND 2006 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points, p2.points ORDER BY point_diff DESC;

SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, AVG(pt.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS avg_points_3_seasons, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds FROM players_teams pt JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id::integer WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2014 AND 1995 AND pt.gp >= 68 GROUP BY pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points ORDER BY pt.playerid, pt.year;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.name, t.won, t.lost, SUM(t.o_pts) AS total_offensive_points, AVG(t.o_pts) AS avg_offensive_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS total_players_used, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid IN (SELECT pt.playerid FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year) AND ap.year = t.year AND ap.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_count_in_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.won DESC, t.lost ASC) AS team_rank_in_league, SUM(CASE WHEN p.height > (SELECT AVG(height) FROM players WHERE height IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tall_players_count, (SELECT MAX(p2.points) FROM player_allstar p2 WHERE p2.playerid IN (SELECT pt2.playerid FROM players_teams pt2 WHERE pt2.tmid = t.id AND pt2.year = t.year) AND p2.season_id = t.year) AS max_allstar_points_by_player FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.id = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1978 AND 2008 JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND ap.year = t.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND sp.year = t.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 1964 AND t.won >= 82 AND t.o_pts >= 7166 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM players_teams pt2 WHERE pt2.tmid = t.id AND pt2.year = t.year AND pt2.points > 1708) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.lgid, t.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 33872 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) >= 24 ORDER BY total_offensive_points DESC, team_rank_in_league ASC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, AVG(t1.won) AS avg_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.tmid) AS teams_with_higher_attendance FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.year = t2.year AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t2.attendance > t1.attendance WHERE t1.year >= 1990 AND t1.attendance >= 3304228 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid HAVING AVG(t1.won) > 11.6 ORDER BY t1.year DESC, t1.lgid;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(pt.points) AS max_team_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE (pa.points > 26.1 OR pa.rebounds > 4.18) AND NOT (pt.lgid = 'NBA' AND pt.year < 1998.19) AND pa.minutes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pa.points) >= 15.94 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 8.25 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE ap.year = pa.season_id AND ap.year >= 1964 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 8464 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE ap.points > 12 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 4 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND ap.year = pa.season_id WHERE ap.year >= 2012 AND pa.points > 13 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) > 6 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year IN (SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'Most Valuable Player') AND pt.gp >= 51 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1498 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1971 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = pt.playerid AND d.draftyear <= 2003) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 32233 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 993 AND t.won > 47 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 40525 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid INNER JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.points > 42.82 AND pt.year >= 1996.93 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 16468.23 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1970 AND pt.year <= 1994 AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 11282 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 26246.07 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 14181.77 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS scoring_category FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1991 AND pt.year <= 1994 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 6773.84 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award) AS coach_awards, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON pt.tmid::integer = ac.coachid::integer AND pt.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.id = ps.playerid AND pt.year = ps.season_id JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1982 AND 1982 AND pt.points > 1075 AND pt.rebounds > 284 AND pt.assists > 575 AND t.won > 71 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1499 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 1337 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 882 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 8 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_rebounds DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_points_by_team FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2015 AND pt.year <= 2017 AND pt.points > 2860 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1949 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_pick FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2001 AND pt.year <= 1950 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND pt.gp > 2 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 15505 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(ap.three_made::numeric / NULLIF(ap.three_attempted, 0)) AS career_three_pct, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, SUM(CASE WHEN ac.award = 'Most Valuable Player' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mvp_count, SUM(t2.won) AS team_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY (SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.assists) + SUM(pt.rebounds)) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ac ON p.playerid::integer = ac.playerid AND pt.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN teams t2 ON pt.lgid = t2.lgid AND pt.year = t2.year WHERE pt.year >= 1958 AND pt.year <= 1971 AND pt.points > 866 AND t.won > 41 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, ap.season_id, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 10248 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 886 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, p.pos, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS birth_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS allstar_players, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.playerid) AS award_players, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.tmidwinner) AS playoff_series_won FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 24.93 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2013 AND 1974 AND t.won > 67.94 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (t.tmid, t.lgid), (t.tmid, p.pos), (t.lgid, birth_year), (t.tmid), (t.lgid), (p.pos), (birth_year), () ) HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 5.39 ORDER BY total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, pt.year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::varchar = p.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1982 AND 2012 AND pt.points > 465 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (t.tmid, t.lgid, pt.year), (t.tmid, t.lgid), (t.lgid, pt.year), (t.tmid), (t.lgid), (pt.year), () ) ORDER BY t.lgid, pt.year, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY pt.year) AS cumulative_player_points, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid) AS avg_player_points_per_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t.won DESC) AS team_win_rank FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id::integer WHERE t.year >= 1983 AND t.o_pts > 6419 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, pt.tmid, pt.year, pt.points ORDER BY t.won DESC, t.year;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, t.name, SUM(COALESCE(pt.points, 0)) AS total_player_points, AVG(COALESCE(pt.points, 0)) AS avg_player_points, SUM(COALESCE(pt.rebounds, 0)) AS total_player_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(COALESCE(ps.points, 0)) AS total_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(pt.points, 0)) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league, LAG(SUM(COALESCE(pt.points, 0)), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id LEFT JOIN player_allstar ps ON pt.playerid = ps.playerid AND pt.year = ps.season_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1988 AND 1984 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award LIKE '%MVP%' ) AND t.lgid IN (SELECT lgid FROM coaches WHERE year = t.year AND won > 44) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, t.name HAVING AVG(COALESCE(pt.points, 0)) > 48 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) >= 17 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS num_players, AVG(p.points) AS avg_points FROM players_teams p JOIN teams t ON p.tmid::text = t.tmid AND p.year = t.year WHERE p.points > 1990.02 AND t.year >= 1973.81 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, num_players DESC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname AS first_name, p.lastname AS last_name, p.pos AS position, p.college AS college, t.lgid AS league, t.divid AS division, ap.season_id AS allstar_season, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS birth_year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.points > 26.85 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_scoring_allstar_games, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_postseason_points, SUM(pt.postassists) AS total_postseason_assists, SUM(pt.postrebounds) AS total_postseason_rebounds, (SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.assists) + SUM(pt.rebounds)) AS total_career_stats, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS league_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS overall_assists_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_percentile, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY MAX(pt.year)) AS prev_year_points, LEAD(SUM(pt.assists), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY MAX(pt.year)) AS next_year_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1962 AND 1982 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND p.height > '1.7' AND pt.points > 8169 AND (ap.points IS NOT NULL OR aw.award IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, t.lgid, t.divid, ap.season_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, t.lgid, t.divid), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college), (t.lgid, t.divid, ap.season_id), (t.lgid, t.divid), (p.pos, p.college), () ) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 37741 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 19 AND AVG(ap.points) >= 10.13 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_assists DESC, total_rebounds DESC LIMIT 250;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS full_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_points, AVG(ap.assists) AS avg_allstar_assists, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS total_points_rank, LEAD(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (ORDER BY p.playerid) AS next_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pt.lgid = 'NBA' THEN pt.tmid END) AS nba_teams_played_for FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::INTEGER = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::INTEGER = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::VARCHAR = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::INTEGER = awp.playerid AND ap.season_id = awp.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner::VARCHAR AND t.year = sp.year WHERE p.height > 155.51 AND pt.gp >= 8.52 AND ap.games_played >= 22.19 AND t.won > 59.49 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1978.33 AND 1953.19 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 5.82 AND SUM(pt.points) > 2368.77 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS full_name, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_position, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.assists) AS avg_allstar_assists, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, LEAD(SUM(ap.points)) OVER (ORDER BY p.playerid) AS next_player_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.lgid = 'NBA' THEN d.tmid END) AS nba_teams_drafted_by FROM players p JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::INTEGER = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::INTEGER = ap.playerid AND d.draftyear = ap.season_id JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::INTEGER = pt.playerid AND d.draftyear = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::INTEGER = awp.playerid AND d.draftyear = awp.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON pt.tmid::VARCHAR = sp.tmidwinner::VARCHAR AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE p.height > 183.09 AND d.draftoverall < 47.79 AND ap.games_played >= 59.94 AND pt.gp >= 13.09 AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 2002.12 AND 2016.82 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) > 1.89 AND SUM(ap.points) > 157.66 ORDER BY total_team_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1994 AND pt.year <= 2004 AND pt.points > 450 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 6 AND SUM(pt.points) > 2637 ORDER BY total_team_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS distinct_team_years, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.league_id) AS distinct_allstar_leagues, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.lgid) AS distinct_team_leagues, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_team_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::character varying = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year WHERE ap.points > 45 AND pt.points > 2921 AND t.won > 31 AND c.won > 36 AND d.draftyear >= 1985 AND d.draftyear <= 1958 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 11 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, total_team_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points_last_seasons, AVG(pa.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pa.season_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_points_3_season_window FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pa.playerid = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE pa.points > 34 AND pa.season_id >= 1956 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pa.season_id, pa.points HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 170 ORDER BY total_points_last_seasons DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2014 AND pt.year <= 1993 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 43711 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'None' AND year >= 2017 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 32917 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid) AS avg_team_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1957 AND pt.points > 2189 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 988 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 1096 AND pt.year >= 2005 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points HAVING COUNT(pt.stint) >= 2 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY AVG(pt.points) DESC) AS league_avg_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY MIN(pt.year)) AS prev_career_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id WHERE pt.points > 33 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1963 AND 1954 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 28192 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 10 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.fullgivenname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league_id, pt.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_blocks, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute, AVG(pt.rebounds * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS rebounds_per_minute, AVG(pt.assists * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS assists_per_minute, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.season_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS allstar_game_appearances, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT ap2.award) AS distinct_awards_won, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.year >= 2020 THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS recent_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league_year, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS overall_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap2 ON p.playerid::integer = ap2.playerid AND pt.year = ap2.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid::integer AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE p.pos LIKE 'G' AND t.lgid LIKE 'NBA' AND p.college LIKE 'University' AND pt.year BETWEEN 1956 AND 1973 AND pt.points > 4743 AND pt.rebounds > 1579 AND pt.assists > 1437 AND (t.playoff = 'Y' OR t.playoff IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.fullgivenname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, t.name, t.lgid, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 8890 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 8604 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 13894 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_rebounds DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.year AS year1, p2.year AS year2, (p2.points - p1.points) AS point_increase, AVG(p1.points) OVER(PARTITION BY p1.playerid) AS avg_points_across_years FROM players_teams p1 JOIN players_teams p2 ON p1.playerid = p2.playerid AND p1.tmid = p2.tmid AND p1.year < p2.year WHERE p1.points > 904.18 AND p2.points > 2682.16 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.year, p2.year, p1.points, p2.points HAVING (p2.points - p1.points) > 645.86 ORDER BY point_increase DESC;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.lgid, SUM(p1.points) AS total_points, AVG(p2.points) AS avg_points_other_teams FROM players_teams p1 JOIN players_teams p2 ON p1.playerid = p2.playerid AND p1.year = p2.year AND p1.tmid != p2.tmid WHERE p1.points > 2923.93 AND p1.year BETWEEN 1968.45 AND 1980.29 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.lgid HAVING SUM(p1.points) > 6069.68 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

s.gp, s.gs, s.orebounds, s.drebounds, s.lgid, s.note, s.postgp, s.postgs, s.postminutes, s.postpoints, s.postorebounds, s.postdrebounds, s.postrebounds, s.postassists, s.poststeals, s.postblocks, s.postturnovers, s.postpf, s.postfgmade, s.postfgattempted, s.postftmade, s.postftattempted, s.postthreemade, s.postthreeattempted, s.stint, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, p.birthdate, players_teams s JOIN players p ON s.playerid = p.id JOIN awards_players a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year JOIN draft d ON s.playerid = d.playerid WHERE s.points > 2281.63 AND s.year >= s.poststeals, s.postblocks, s.postturnovers, s.postpf, s.postfgmade, s.postfgattempted, s.postftmade, s.postftattempted, s.postthreemade, s.postthreeattempted, s.stint, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.tmid, s.points, s.minutes, s.assists, s.rebounds, s.steals, s.blocks, s.turnovers, s.pf, s.fgmade, s.fgattempted, s.ftmade, s.ftattempted, s.threemade, s.threeattempted, 1999.91 AND s.year <= 1972.54 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.tmid, s.points, s.minutes, s.assists, s.rebounds, s.steals, s.blocks, s.turnovers, s.pf, s.fgmade, s.fgattempted, s.ftmade, s.ftattempted,
