SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id WHERE t.year >= 1959 AND t.year <= 1972 AND pt.points > 1984 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3544 ORDER BY t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t.year = pt.year JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1986 AND t.year <= 2013 AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 34257 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

WITH player_performance AS ( SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, pt.steals, pt.blocks, pt.minutes, pt.gp, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) as points_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.rebounds DESC) as rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.assists DESC) as assists_rank, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year) as avg_points_per_year, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as career_points_running_total FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.minutes > 1256 AND pt.gp >= 50 ), team_performance AS ( SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.o_reb, t.d_reb, t.attendance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY t.won DESC) as wins_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY t.o_pts DESC) as offense_rank, (t.o_pts - t.d_pts) as point_differential, AVG(t.o_pts) OVER (PARTITION BY t.year) as avg_offense_per_year FROM teams t WHERE t.attendance > 400896 AND t.won >= 29 ), coach_performance AS ( SELECT c.coachid, c.year, c.tmid, c.won, c.lost, c.post_wins, c.post_losses, (c.won::decimal / (c.won + c.lost)) as win_percentage, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.year ORDER BY c.won DESC) as wins_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.year ORDER BY (c.won::decimal / (c.won + c.lost)) DESC) as win_pct_rank FROM coaches c WHERE c.won > 67 AND c.post_wins >= 8 ), all_star_performance AS ( SELECT ap.playerid, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.rebounds, ap.assists, ap.steals, ap.blocks, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.season_id ORDER BY ap.points DESC) as all_star_points_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.season_id ORDER BY ap.points) as points_percentile FROM player_allstar ap WHERE ap.points > 39 AND ap.rebounds >= 15 ), award_winners AS ( SELECT aw.playerid, aw.year, aw.award, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY aw.playerid) as total_awards, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY aw.year ORDER BY aw.award) as award_rank FROM awards_players aw WHERE aw.year BETWEEN 1985 AND 1984 ), draft_analysis AS ( SELECT d.playerid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.draftyear ORDER BY d.draftoverall) as draft_position_rank, CASE WHEN d.draftround = 1 THEN 'First Round' WHEN d.draftround = 2 THEN 'Second Round' ELSE 'Late Round' END as draft_category FROM draft d WHERE d.draftoverall <= 38 AND d.draftyear >= 2013 ) SELECT pp.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pp.year, pp.tmid, t.name as team_name, pp.points, pp.rebounds, pp.assists, pp.points_rank, pp.rebounds_rank, pp.assists_rank, pp.avg_points_per_year, pp.career_points_running_total, tp.won as team_wins, tp.lost as team_losses, tp.wins_rank as team_wins_rank, tp.point_differential, tp.avg_offense_per_year, cp.coachid, cp.win_percentage as coach_win_pct, cp.wins_rank as coach_wins_rank, ap.points as all_star_points, ap.all_star_points_rank, ap.points_percentile, aw.total_awards, aw.award_rank, da.draftoverall, da.draft_position_rank, da.draft_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pp.year ORDER BY pp.points DESC) as yearly_points_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pp.year ORDER BY pp.points) as yearly_points_percentile, SUM(pp.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pp.playerid ORDER BY pp.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as career_total_points, AVG(pp.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pp.tmid, pp.year) as team_avg_points FROM player_performance pp JOIN players p ON pp.playerid = p.id::integer JOIN team_performance tp ON pp.tmid = tp.tmid::integer AND pp.year = tp.year JOIN coach_performance cp ON pp.tmid = cp.tmid::integer AND pp.year = cp.year LEFT JOIN all_star_performance ap ON pp.playerid = ap.playerid AND pp.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN award_winners aw ON pp.playerid = aw.playerid AND pp.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN draft_analysis da ON pp.playerid = da.playerid JOIN teams t ON pp.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pp.year = t.year WHERE pp.points > 2309 AND tp.won >= 41 AND cp.win_percentage > 0.33 GROUP BY pp.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pp.year, pp.tmid, t.name, pp.points, pp.rebounds, pp.assists, pp.points_rank, pp.rebounds_rank, pp.assists_rank, pp.avg_points_per_year, pp.career_points_running_total, tp.won, tp.lost, tp.wins_rank, tp.point_differential, tp.avg_offense_per_year, cp.coachid, cp.win_percentage, cp.wins_rank, ap.points, ap.all_star_points_rank, ap.points_percentile, aw.total_awards, aw.award_rank, da.draftoverall, da.draft_position_rank, da.draft_category HAVING AVG(pp.points) > 790 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pp.year) >= 8 ORDER BY pp.points DESC, pp.year DESC, pp.playerid;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) AS num_awards, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_blocks, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.league_id ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid, pt.lgid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points, (SELECT MAX(t.won) FROM teams t WHERE t.year = pt.year AND t.lgid = pt.lgid) AS max_team_wins_in_year_league FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid = awp.playerid::integer::character varying AND ap.season_id = awp.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::integer::character varying LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND t.year = sp.year WHERE ap.points > 17 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1968 AND 1972 AND t.won > 76 AND d.draftyear < 1970 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, pt.lgid, pt.year HAVING AVG(ap.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT awp.award) >= 15 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, AVG(pt.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_points, SUM(pt.assists) OVER ( PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS running_total_assists FROM players_teams pt JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id::integer WHERE pt.year >= 2019 AND pt.points > 1371 AND p.firstseason <= 1990 ORDER BY pt.playerid, pt.year;

SELECT p.playerid, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS distinct_teams, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id WHERE pt.year >= 1964 AND pt.year <= 2013 AND pt.points > 594 GROUP BY p.playerid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 18 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.points > 839 AND ap.season_id >= 2006 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, SUM(ap.points) AS total_points, AVG(ap.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.season_id ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS season_points_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid WHERE (ap.points > 13.21 OR ap.assists > 0.11) AND (ap.season_id BETWEEN 1982.45 AND 1963.14) AND NOT (t.lgid = 'NBA' AND t.playoff = 'Y') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 928.2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 7.25 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank_in_league FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year >= 1985 AND pt.year <= 2020 AND pt.points > 1576 AND pt.assists > 268 AND t.won > 71 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, pt.year, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2861 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 22 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.assists) AS avg_allstar_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, pt.year, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_regular_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_regular_rebounds, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_regular_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_regular_blocks, SUM(pt.turnovers) AS total_regular_turnovers, SUM(pt.fgmade) AS total_fgmade, SUM(pt.fgattempted) AS total_fgattempted, (CASE WHEN SUM(pt.fgattempted) > 0 THEN (SUM(pt.fgmade)::float / SUM(pt.fgattempted)::float) * 100 ELSE 0 END) AS fg_percentage, SUM(pt.ftmade) AS total_ftmade, SUM(pt.ftattempted) AS total_ftattempted, (CASE WHEN SUM(pt.ftattempted) > 0 THEN (SUM(pt.ftmade)::float / SUM(pt.ftattempted)::float) * 100 ELSE 0 END) AS ft_percentage, SUM(pt.threemade) AS total_threemade, SUM(pt.threeattempted) AS total_threeattempted, (CASE WHEN SUM(pt.threeattempted) > 0 THEN (SUM(pt.threemade)::float / SUM(pt.threeattempted)::float) * 100 ELSE 0 END) AS three_percentage, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, c.year AS coach_year, c.won AS coach_wins, c.lost AS coach_losses, (CASE WHEN (c.won + c.lost) > 0 THEN (c.won::float / (c.won + c.lost)::float) * 100 ELSE 0 END) AS coach_win_percentage, sp.year AS playoff_year, sp.round, sp.w AS playoff_wins, sp.l AS playoff_losses, ac.award, ac.note AS award_note, ap2.award AS player_award, ap2.note AS player_award_note, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league_year, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS overall_points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points, LEAD(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS next_year_points, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_percentile, CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_cume_dist, SUM(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid) AS league_year_total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid) AS avg_points_per_player_in_league_year FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid::integer AND t.year = c.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid = ac.coachid::character varying AND c.year = ac.year JOIN awards_players ap2 ON p.playerid::integer = ap2.playerid AND pt.year = ap2.year WHERE ap.points > 48.9 AND pt.points > 39.02 AND t.year BETWEEN 1967.0 AND 1970.14 AND d.draftyear >= 2010.85 AND c.won >= 33.61 AND sp.w >= 5.64 AND ac.year = c.year AND ap2.year = pt.year GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, ap.season_id, ap.league_id, pt.year, t.name, t.lgid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, c.year, c.won, c.lost, sp.year, sp.round, sp.w, sp.l, ac.award, ac.note, ap2.award, ap2.note HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1695.78 AND AVG(pt.assists) > 7.32 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 5.89 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 1166.23 AND SUM(pt.steals) > 391.05 AND SUM(pt.blocks) > 256.89 AND (CASE WHEN SUM(pt.fgattempted) > 0 THEN (SUM(pt.fgmade)::float / SUM(pt.fgattempted)::float) * 100 ELSE 0 END) > 50.29 AND (CASE WHEN SUM(pt.ftattempted) > 0 THEN (SUM(pt.ftmade)::float / SUM(pt.ftattempted)::float) * 100 ELSE 0 END) > 86.45 AND (CASE WHEN SUM(pt.threeattempted) > 0 THEN (SUM(pt.threemade)::float / SUM(pt.threeattempted)::float) * 100 ELSE 0 END) > 31.26 ORDER BY total_regular_points DESC, avg_regular_assists DESC, total_regular_rebounds DESC;

WITH player_stats AS ( SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.year >= 2006 AND pt.year <= 1994 GROUP BY pt.playerid, pt.year ) SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ps.year, ps.total_points, ps.total_rebounds, ps.total_assists, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.year ORDER BY ps.total_points DESC) AS points_rank FROM player_stats ps JOIN players p ON ps.playerid = p.id::integer WHERE ps.total_points > 673 ORDER BY ps.year DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 1992 AND p.lastseason <= 1981 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 29412 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = 'All-NBA First Team' ) AND pt.year BETWEEN 1989 AND 1952 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 25924 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points_last_seasons, AVG(pa.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pa.season_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_points_3_season_window FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pa.playerid = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE pa.points > 6 AND pa.season_id >= 1965 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pa.season_id, pa.points HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 31 ORDER BY total_points_last_seasons DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(ps.points) AS total_points, AVG(ps.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams ps ON p.id = ps.playerid JOIN teams t ON ps.tmid::character varying = t.tmid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid WHERE ps.year BETWEEN 1999 AND 2004 AND p.height > '150.0' AND t.won > 26 AND ap.award = 'NBA Most Valuable Player' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(ps.points) > 30383 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.year) >= 10 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year IN (SELECT year FROM coaches WHERE coachid = 'a') AND pt.points > 281 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4574 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1978 AND pt.year <= 1975 AND pt.points > 2109 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 41002 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1963 AND pt.year <= 1999 AND pt.points > 586 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 18996 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::INTEGER = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2004 AND 1996 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1688 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1965 AND pt.year <= 1988 AND ap.year >= 2012 AND ap.year <= 1990 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4869 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 19 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 1998 AND p.lastseason <= 1997 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) >= 12 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.year >= 2002 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 12850 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND lgid = 'NBA' ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3846 ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, MAX(t.won) AS max_team_wins, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) DESC) AS award_years_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid AND d.draftyear = pt.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1966 AND 1991 AND pt.minutes > 3397 AND t.won > 70 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 8598 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) >= 17 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.year = ap.year AND pt.points > 2 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 3 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pa.season_id = d.draftyear AND pa.points > 6 AND d.draftround = 6 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos HAVING AVG(pa.minutes) >= 34 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, SUM(pa.points) AS allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 604 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1959 AND 1994 AND pa.points > 38 AND t.won > 24 AND c.won > 15 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1063 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 5 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 18 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, ap.points AS allstar_points, ac.year AS coach_award_year, ac.award AS coach_award, d.draftyear, d.draftround, sp.year AS playoff_year, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, c.coachid, c.won AS coach_wins, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, SUM(t.won) AS team_total_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award) AS distinct_coach_awards FROM players p INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid INNER JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id IN (sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser) AND t.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year WHERE pt.points > 264 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2021 AND t.won > 38 AND (ap.points > 32 OR ap.points IS NULL) AND (d.draftround <= 1 OR d.draftround IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, ap.season_id, ap.points, ac.year, ac.award, d.draftyear, d.draftround, sp.year, sp.tmidwinner, sp.tmidloser, c.coachid, c.won HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3471 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 8 AND AVG(pt.minutes) >= 36 ORDER BY total_points DESC, team_points_rank ASC LIMIT 78;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.award = 'MVP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mvp_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.year, p.pos ORDER BY AVG(pt.points) DESC) AS pos_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid::integer AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.points > 5.12 AND t.year BETWEEN 1982.69 AND 2023.69 AND p.height > 1.76 GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year, p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 23931.64 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 24.31 ORDER BY t.lgid, t.year, points_rank;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS player_count, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points FROM teams t LEFT JOIN players_teams p ON t.tmid::integer = p.tmid AND t.year = p.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid AND p.year = pa.season_id WHERE t.year >= 1957 AND t.year <= 1959 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) > 12 ORDER BY player_count DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.tmid, t1.name, t1.won AS wins, t2.won AS previous_wins, (t1.won - t2.won) AS win_improvement FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.won > 60 AND t2.won > 46 ORDER BY win_improvement DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, SUM(pt.points) AS total_career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid::character varying = p.playerid AND ap.award LIKE '%All-Star%' AND ap.year >= 1971) AS all_star_appearances_since_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pos ORDER BY AVG(pt.points) DESC) AS pos_avg_points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (ORDER BY p.playerid) AS prev_player_career_points, (SELECT MIN(draft.draftoverall) FROM draft WHERE draft.playerid::character varying = p.playerid AND draft.draftyear <= 1997) AS earliest_draft_pick, (SELECT AVG(pa.points) FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid::character varying = p.playerid AND pa.season_id BETWEEN 1961 AND 2000) AS avg_allstar_points_in_range, MAX(teams.won) AS max_team_wins_in_season, MIN(teams.lost) AS min_team_losses_in_season, SUM(teams.o_pts) AS total_team_offensive_points, COUNT(DISTINCT teams.tmid) AS distinct_teams_played_for FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams ON pt.tmid = teams.tmid::integer AND pt.year = teams.year LEFT JOIN draft ON p.playerid = draft.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.points > 2867 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1986 AND 1957 AND (p.college IS NOT NULL OR p.highschool IS NOT NULL) AND teams.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 34734 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 8 ORDER BY total_career_points DESC, avg_points_per_season DESC LIMIT 290;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2006 AND pt.points > 170 AND d.draftyear <= 2012 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) > 17.11 ORDER BY avg_points_per_game DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2006 AND pt.year <= 1962 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1438 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pa.rebounds) AS total_allstar_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pa.points) AS median_allstar_points, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pa.assists) AS p75_allstar_assists, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_regular_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(t.won) AS max_team_wins, MIN(t.lost) AS min_team_losses, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mvp_awards, SUM(CASE WHEN ac.award = 'Coach of the Year' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coach_of_year_awards_near FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON t.id = ac.coachid::integer AND t.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE p.height > 172.79 AND p.weight BETWEEN 81 AND 210 AND pa.season_id >= 1973 AND t.won > 31 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 20.73 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) >= 12 ORDER BY total_regular_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = 'All-NBA') as award_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1191 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2017 AND 1995 ORDER BY pt.points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points, AVG(pt.points) OVER(PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 1986 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points ORDER BY p.playerid, pt.year;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.points > 34 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_scoring_games, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS seasons_played, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.steals > 6 THEN pt.steals ELSE 0 END) AS impactful_steals, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY ap.season_id) AS prev_season_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2017 AND 2019 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND pt.points IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.tmid, ap.season_id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 18278 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 1 ORDER BY total_assists DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT ap.playerid, ap.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award)) OVER (PARTITION BY ap.playerid ORDER BY ap.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_awards FROM awards_players ap JOIN players p ON ap.playerid = p.id JOIN player_allstar pa ON ap.playerid = pa.playerid AND ap.year = pa.season_id JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE ap.year >= 1952 AND ap.year <= 1988 AND p.weight >= 198 GROUP BY ap.playerid, ap.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 1 ORDER BY ap.playerid, ap.year;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year IN (SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'Most Valuable Player') AND pt.gp >= 34 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 848 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1977 AND pt.year <= 1996 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2985 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.award = 'MVP' AND ap.year BETWEEN 1997 AND 1957) AS mvp_count, (SELECT AVG(pa.points) FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid = p.id AND pa.season_id >= 2000) AS avg_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS overall_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::text = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::text AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner::text AND t.year = sp.year WHERE p.weight > 326 AND p.height > '60.0' AND t.won > 60 AND pt.gp > 70 AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1966 AND 2007 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.year, t.tmid, p.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2354 AND AVG(pt.assists) > 10 ORDER BY overall_points_rank, team_points_rank, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.name ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1970 AND t.year <= 2018 GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 7658 ORDER BY t.name, t.year;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS unique_awards, SUM(COALESCE(pa.points, 0)) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND ap.year = pa.season_id JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE ap.year BETWEEN 1951 AND 1992 AND pa.points > 32 AND pt.gp > 84 AND ap.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 18 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1996 AND (pt.points > 1053 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award LIKE '%All-Star%')) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1982 ORDER BY career_points DESC LIMIT 71;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) > 16157.78 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.assists) > 7786.58 THEN 'High Assister' WHEN SUM(pt.rebounds) > 1738.02 THEN 'High Rebounder' ELSE 'Balanced' END AS player_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1953 AND 1950 AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' AND p.height > '150.0' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1089.89 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 18 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_assists DESC, total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT ap2.season_id) AS allstar_seasons_with_award, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(ap.rebounds) AS total_allstar_rebounds, AVG(ap.rebounds) AS avg_allstar_rebounds, SUM(ap.assists) AS total_allstar_assists, AVG(ap.assists) AS avg_allstar_assists, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, MIN(ap.points) AS min_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_regular_rebounds, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_regular_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_regular_assists, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_regular_assists, MAX(pt.points) AS max_regular_points, MIN(pt.points) AS min_regular_points, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_pick, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS worst_draft_pick, COUNT(DISTINCT ap3.award) AS distinct_awards, COUNT(ap3.award) AS total_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award) AS coach_awards_count, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins, SUM(c.lost) AS total_coach_losses, AVG(c.won::numeric / NULLIF(c.won + c.lost, 0)) AS avg_coach_win_pct, SUM(t.won) AS total_team_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS total_team_losses, AVG(t.won::numeric / NULLIF(t.won + t.lost, 0)) AS avg_team_win_pct, SUM(t.o_pts) AS total_team_points_for, SUM(t.d_pts) AS total_team_points_against, AVG(t.o_pts - t.d_pts) AS avg_team_point_diff, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.year) AS playoff_series_appearances, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t.id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_series_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidloser = t.id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_series_losses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.points) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS regular_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap3.award) DESC) AS awards_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pos ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS pos_points_rank FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap2 ON ap.playerid = ap2.playerid AND ap.season_id = ap2.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap3 ON p.playerid = ap3.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid = ac.coachid::character varying AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser WHERE ap.points > 24.14 AND ap.rebounds > 12.04 AND ap.assists > 9.74 AND pt.points > 190.55 AND pt.rebounds > 146.26 AND pt.assists > 354.11 AND t.won > 72.71 AND t.lost > 4.98 AND c.won > 5.47 AND c.lost > 8.51 AND ap3.year > 1978.02 AND d.draftyear > 2012.73 AND sp.year > 1995.49 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 17.7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 15.59 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap3.award) > 1.48 AND SUM(ap.points) > 393.28 AND SUM(pt.points) > 28144.94 AND SUM(t.won) > 3986.19 AND SUM(c.won) > 1740.56 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, total_regular_points DESC, distinct_awards DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid, pt.lgid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, SUM(CASE WHEN c.post_wins > c.post_losses THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS winning_postseasons FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year AND pt.lgid = c.lgid LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.year >= 2009 AND pt.year <= 2020 AND pt.points >= 555 AND t.won >= 78 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 29359 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) <= 10 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 773 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1956 AND 2015 AND (t.lgid = 'NBA' OR t.confid = 'East') AND NOT (d.draftround IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 48926 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 9 ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 88;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_points, SUM(ps.assists) AS total_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams ps ON p.playerid::integer = ps.playerid JOIN teams t ON ps.tmid = t.tmid::integer WHERE ps.year > 2002 AND t.won > 77 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(ps.points) > 25.31 ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE ap.year >= 1974 AND pt.points > 2602 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) > 8 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year IN (SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'Most Valuable Player') AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 37351.92 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.assists, ap.rebounds, ap.steals, ap.blocks, (ap.points + ap.assists + ap.rebounds + ap.steals + ap.blocks) AS total_stats, AVG(ap.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid) AS avg_points_per_season, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid) AS allstar_appearances FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = CAST(ap.playerid AS character varying) JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid = CAST(aw.playerid AS character varying) AND ap.season_id = aw.year WHERE ap.points > 19.76 AND ap.season_id BETWEEN 1972.22 AND 2010.04 AND aw.award = 'All-Star' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.assists, ap.rebounds, ap.steals, ap.blocks, aw.award HAVING (ap.points + ap.assists + ap.rebounds + ap.steals + ap.blocks) > 26.93 ORDER BY total_stats DESC, ap.season_id ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank_in_team, LAG(SUM(pt.rebounds), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) FILTER (WHERE ap.year = pt.year) AS awards_this_year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid AND sp.year = pt.year) AS team_playoff_series_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid AND d.draftyear <= pt.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid::integer AND c.year = pt.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2007 AND pt.points > 1461 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2575 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) <= 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, points_rank;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, SUM(ap.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS unique_players FROM player_allstar ap JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.lgid = t.lgid WHERE ap.season_id >= 1997 AND ap.season_id <= 1985 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(ap.points) > 6912 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(a.award) AS award_count FROM players p JOIN awards_players a ON p.playerid = a.playerid::character varying WHERE a.year >= 2006 AND a.year <= 1995 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(a.award) > 5 ORDER BY award_count DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, SUM(pa.points) AS allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, SUM(sp.w) AS playoff_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 2732 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2006 AND 2020 AND pa.points > 45 AND t.won > 44 AND c.won > 41 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4227 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 8 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 19 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year, p.playerid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 48.0) AS points_per_48, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS rank_points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid::text = p.playerid AND ap.year = t.year AND ap.award LIKE '%All-Star%') AS all_star_count, (SELECT MAX(d.draftoverall) FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid::integer = p.playerid::integer AND d.draftyear <= t.year) AS highest_draft_pick, (SELECT SUM(c.won) FROM coaches c WHERE c.coachid::text = t.tmid AND c.year = t.year) AS coach_wins FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::text = p.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::text = ap.playerid::text AND t.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::text = d.playerid::text AND t.year >= d.draftyear JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::text = c.coachid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 2013 AND t.year <= 1950 AND pt.points > 1126 AND t.playoff = 'Y' GROUP BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year, p.playerid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 484 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 1 ORDER BY t.year DESC, rank_points;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 1994 AND pa.points > 40 AND d.draftyear <= 2002 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) >= 2 AND SUM(pa.points) > 726 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::INTEGER = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1997 AND 1981 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 14647 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT a.playerid, a.year, 'awards_players' AS source, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM awards_players a JOIN players p ON a.playerid::character varying = p.playerid WHERE a.year > 1950 GROUP BY a.playerid, a.year UNION ALL SELECT d.playerid, d.draftyear AS year, 'draft' AS source, 1 AS award_count FROM draft d JOIN players p2 ON d.playerid::character varying = p2.playerid WHERE d.draftyear BETWEEN 2011 AND 1999 ORDER BY year DESC, award_count DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1963 AND 1983 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 37467 ORDER BY career_points DESC LIMIT 11;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1045 AND pt.year >= 2016 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points HAVING COUNT(pt.stint) >= 4 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, ap.points AS allstar_points, pt.points AS regular_points, pt.postpoints AS playoff_points, c.coachid, ac.award AS coach_award, d.draftyear, d.draftround, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid, pt.year) AS team_avg_points, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS career_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM players_teams WHERE points > 2129 AND year BETWEEN 2008 AND 2022 ) AND pt.points > 2380 AND pt.minutes > 2627 AND (ap.points > 37 OR ap.points IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, ap.season_id, ap.points, pt.points, pt.postpoints, c.coachid, ac.award, d.draftyear, d.draftround HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 1369 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 1 ORDER BY career_points DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_regular_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_regular_assists, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_regular_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_regular_rebounds, AVG(pt.rebounds) AS avg_regular_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS regular_seasons, MAX(ap.year) AS latest_award_year, COUNT(ap.award) AS total_awards, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, t.name AS team_name, t.won AS team_wins, t.lost AS team_losses, t.attendance AS team_attendance, SUM(sp.w) AS total_playoff_wins, SUM(sp.l) AS total_playoff_losses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner WHERE pa.points > 7.45 AND pt.points > 887.35 AND ap.year >= 1969.51 AND d.draftyear >= 1984.81 AND t.year >= 1966.91 AND sp.year >= 1975.75 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.won, t.lost, t.attendance HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 20180.74 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) >= 4.21 AND COUNT(ap.award) >= 3.39 ORDER BY total_regular_points DESC, total_allstar_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year), 0) AS award_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND p.firstseason = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE pt.points > 1677.64 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2016.08 AND 2004.31 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 4.45 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid WHERE ap.season_id BETWEEN 1981 AND 1971 AND pt.minutes > 1251 AND aw.year >= 1960 AND aw.award = 'All-NBA' AND (ap.points > 29 OR ap.assists > 0) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 13 AND SUM(pt.points) > 32953 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap2 ON ap.playerid = ap2.playerid AND ap.season_id < ap2.season_id WHERE ap.points > 41 AND ap2.points > 37 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 16 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 2000 AND p.lastseason <= 2002 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 35123 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND ap.year = pa.season_id WHERE ap.year >= 1964 AND pa.points > 12 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) > 6 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM( CASE WHEN pt.points > 39 THEN pt.points WHEN pt.points BETWEEN 10 AND 16 THEN pt.points * 0.5 ELSE 0 END ) AS adjusted_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1992 AND pt.year <= 2006 AND pt.points > 0 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.assists) > 2 ORDER BY adjusted_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 1258.94 AND t.won > 45.8 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > (SELECT AVG(points) FROM players_teams WHERE year = 1972.54) ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 2096 AND pt.year >= 1982 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 26522 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2018 AND t.won >= 82 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 7510 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE (pt.points > 2143.9 AND pt.year >= 1948.11) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1983.99 AND 1974.3) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 27371.67 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_points_by_team FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1995 AND pt.points > 809 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1269 ORDER BY pt.year, pt.tmid, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(*) AS games_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 36 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2005 AND 2002 AND t.won > 52 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1129 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, SUM(ap.points) AS allstar_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(apl.award) AS player_award_count, COUNT(acl.award) AS coach_award_count, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS team_losses, SUM(t.o_pts) AS team_offensive_points, SUM(t.d_pts) AS team_defensive_points_allowed, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_per_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_total_points, (SUM(pt.points) - LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year)) AS points_change_from_previous_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players apl ON p.playerid::integer = apl.playerid AND pt.year = apl.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches acl ON p.playerid::integer = acl.coachid AND pt.year = acl.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN series_post sp1 ON t.tmid::integer = sp1.tmidwinner JOIN series_post sp2 ON t.tmid::integer = sp2.tmidloser WHERE pt.points > 17 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1999 AND 1966 AND t.won > 15 AND t.lost < 38 AND ap.points > 6 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2665 AND AVG(pt.points) > 21.62 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 10 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, points_rank_per_year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.points > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_scoring_games, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.assists > 6 AND pt.rebounds > 11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS double_threat_games, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, MAX(pt.points) AS max_points_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_per_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2013 AND 2003 AND pt.points >= 68 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3424 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_allstar_points, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) > 10000 THEN 'Elite Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.points) BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'High Scorer' ELSE 'Regular Scorer' END AS scoring_tier, CASE WHEN AVG(ps.points) > 20 THEN 'All-Star Star' WHEN AVG(ps.points) BETWEEN 15 AND 20 THEN 'All-Star Contributor' ELSE 'All-Star Role Player' END AS allstar_performance, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 5 THEN 'Highly Decorated' WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN 'Awarded' ELSE 'No Awards' END AS award_status, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.tmidwinner) AS championships_won, AVG(c.won) AS avg_coach_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.playerid::integer = ps.playerid AND pt.year = ps.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE pt.points > 1950.62 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2018.04 AND 2009.28 AND t.attendance > 246196.22 AND p.height > 166.72 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 38671.85 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 3.87 AND AVG(ps.points) > 42.8 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, ap.season_id, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, MAX(c.won) AS max_coach_wins, SUM(s.w) AS total_playoff_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_team FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post s ON t.tmid::integer = s.tmidwinner AND t.year = s.year WHERE pt.points > 2163 AND ap.points > 75 AND t.year BETWEEN 1942 AND 1992 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.tmid, ap.season_id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3925 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 9 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_assists DESC;

team_avg_defensive_points_per_game, SUM(t.won) AS total_team_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS total_team_losses, SUM(t.attendance) AS total_attendance, AVG(c.won * 1.0 / NULLIF(c.won + c.lost, 0)) AS coach_win_percentage, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins, SUM(c.lost) AS total_coach_losses, SUM(c.post_wins) AS total_coach_post_wins, SUM(c.post_losses) AS total_coach_post_losses FROM players p JOIN ay.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = ay.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND t.year = sp.year AND t.lgid = sp.lgidwinner WHERE p.weight > 237.7 AND
