SELECT t.name, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players, MAX(sp.w) AS max_series_wins, (SELECT AVG(sub_pts) FROM (SELECT SUM(pas.points) AS sub_pts FROM player_allstar pas WHERE pas.playerid IN (SELECT pt2.playerid FROM players_teams pt2 WHERE pt2.tmid = t.id AND pt2.year = t.year) GROUP BY pas.playerid HAVING SUM(pas.points) > 317.89) AS star_players) AS avg_star_points_above_threshold FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.id = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1969 AND 1955 AND t.attendance > 92174.92 GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 49268.81 ORDER BY total_points DESC, t.year;

SELECT p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, p.college, p.birthdate, pt.year, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_by_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1979 AND pt.year <= 2019 AND p.birthdate IS NOT NULL AND (p.birthdate::date) >= (DATE '1900-01-01' + INTERVAL '44 years') AND (p.birthdate::date) <= (DATE '2005-12-31' - INTERVAL '35 years') AND pt.points > 3872 GROUP BY p.firstname, p.lastname, p.college, p.birthdate, pt.year, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3942 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pa.rebounds) AS median_rebounds, SUM(pa.assists) AS total_assists FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pa.playerid = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE pa.season_id >= 1998 AND pa.season_id <= 1974 AND pa.points > 47 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 23.57 ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COALESCE(SUM(pa.points), 0) AS total_allstar_points, COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) AS total_regular_points, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) AS total_postseason_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MIN(d.draftyear) AS draft_year, AVG(t.won::numeric / NULLIF(t.games, 0)) * 100 AS avg_team_win_percentage, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pa.points), 0) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) DESC) AS regular_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) DESC) AS postseason_points_rank FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pa.season_id >= 1998 LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND pt.year >= 1952 LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND ap.year >= 2010 LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND t.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::character varying = c.tmid::character varying AND c.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND ac.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser WHERE p.weight > 286 AND p.height > '60.0' AND (t.lgid = 'ABA' OR t.lgid IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(pa.points), 0) > 169 AND COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) > 6377 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 4 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, total_regular_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS team_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS coached_teams FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.id = ps.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 279 AND ap.year >= 1964 AND ps.season_id >= 1996 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2183 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) >= 8 AND AVG(ps.points) >= 6 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(CAST(pt.points AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::INTEGER = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::INTEGER = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::INTEGER = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year IN (SELECT year FROM coaches WHERE won > 20.41 AND lost < 81.09) AND pt.points > 2445.68 AND t.attendance > 1276971.81 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 18881.24 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 6.73 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 1316 AND t.won > 7 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 7395 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 1620 AND t.won > 34 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 42784 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, AVG(ast.assists) AS avg_allstar_assists, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) DESC) AS awards_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ast ON p.playerid = ast.playerid::character varying JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying WHERE ast.season_id >= 1972 AND pt.year >= 2006 AND ap.year >= 1956 AND d.draftyear >= 1983 AND p.firstseason <= 1994 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college HAVING AVG(ast.assists) > 8.99 AND SUM(pt.points) > 36705.83 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 29 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_allstar_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid) AS avg_team_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id WHERE pt.year >= 2010 AND pt.year <= 1960 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4363 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award LIKE '%All-Star%') AS all_star_awards, (SELECT AVG(pa.points) FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid = p.id AND pa.season_id = pt.year) AS avg_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS career_points_running_total FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 2785 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2008 AND 2010 AND p.firstseason <= 1986 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid = p.id AND ap2.year = pt.year AND ap2.award IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, p.id HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 1972 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 6 ORDER BY career_points_running_total DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_playoff_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(c.won) AS max_coach_wins, SUM(s.w) AS total_series_wins_by_teams, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) DESC) AS awards_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.postpoints) DESC) AS playoff_percentile FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::character varying = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year JOIN series_post s ON t.id = s.tmidwinner OR t.id = s.tmidloser WHERE pt.points > 1870.06 AND pt.year >= 2007.96 AND t.won >= 81.36 AND pa.points >= 5.38 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 7520.1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 3.82 ORDER BY total_regular_points DESC, awards_rank;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT pt.playerid FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.points > 216.14) AS high_scorers) AS high_scoring_players, (SELECT AVG(sub.avg_assists) FROM (SELECT pt2.playerid, AVG(pt2.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players_teams pt2 WHERE pt2.tmid = t.id AND pt2.year = t.year GROUP BY pt2.playerid HAVING AVG(pt2.assists) > 130.66) AS sub) AS avg_assists_above_threshold FROM teams t WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1977 AND 1990 AND t.lgid = 'AA' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.id ORDER BY t.year DESC, high_scoring_players DESC;

WITH player_performance AS ( SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.lgid, pt.gp, pt.minutes, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, pt.steals, pt.blocks, pt.turnovers, pt.pf, ROUND(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS pts_per_36, ROUND(pt.rebounds::numeric / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS reb_per_36, ROUND(pt.assists::numeric / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS ast_per_36, ROUND((pt.steals + pt.blocks)::numeric / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS stl_blk_per_36, ROUND(pt.turnovers::numeric / NULLIF(pt.assists, 0), 2) AS ast_to_ratio, CASE WHEN pt.fgattempted > 0 THEN ROUND(pt.fgmade::numeric / pt.fgattempted * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END AS fg_pct, CASE WHEN pt.ftattempted > 0 THEN ROUND(pt.ftmade::numeric / pt.ftattempted * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END AS ft_pct, CASE WHEN pt.threeattempted > 0 THEN ROUND(pt.threemade::numeric / pt.threeattempted * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END AS three_pct FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.minutes > 1281 AND pt.gp > 53 ), team_performance AS ( SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.o_reb, t.d_reb, t.o_asts, t.d_stl, t.o_blk, t.d_to, ROUND(t.o_pts::numeric / NULLIF(t.d_pts, 0), 2) AS off_def_ratio, ROUND((t.o_reb + t.d_reb)::numeric / t.games, 1) AS reb_per_game, ROUND(t.o_asts::numeric / t.games, 1) AS ast_per_game, t.won::numeric / NULLIF(t.won + t.lost, 0) AS win_pct FROM teams t WHERE t.games > 78 AND t.o_pts > 5153 ), coach_performance AS ( SELECT c.coachid, c.year, c.tmid, c.lgid, c.won, c.lost, c.post_wins, c.post_losses, c.won::numeric / NULLIF(c.won + c.lost, 0) AS reg_season_win_pct, CASE WHEN c.post_wins + c.post_losses > 0 THEN c.post_wins::numeric / (c.post_wins + c.post_losses) ELSE 0 END AS playoff_win_pct FROM coaches c WHERE c.won > 43 AND c.post_wins >= 14 ), award_winners AS ( SELECT ap.playerid, ap.year, ap.award, ap.lgid, ap.pos, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ap.playerid, ap.year) AS awards_count FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.year >= 2020 ), draft_analysis AS ( SELECT d.playerid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftselection, d.draftoverall, d.tmid, d.lgid, CASE WHEN d.draftround = 1 AND d.draftselection <= 10 THEN 'Lottery' WHEN d.draftround = 1 THEN 'First Round' WHEN d.draftround = 2 THEN 'Second Round' ELSE 'Late Round' END AS draft_tier FROM draft d WHERE d.draftyear BETWEEN 1985 AND 1983 ), all_star_performance AS ( SELECT asp.playerid, asp.season_id, asp.games_played, asp.minutes, asp.points, asp.rebounds, asp.assists, asp.steals, asp.blocks, ROUND(asp.points::numeric / NULLIF(asp.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS asg_pts_per_36, ROUND(asp.rebounds::numeric / NULLIF(asp.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS asg_reb_per_36, ROUND(asp.assists::numeric / NULLIF(asp.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS asg_ast_per_36 FROM player_allstar asp WHERE asp.minutes > 42 AND asp.points > 40 ), combined_analysis AS ( SELECT pp.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, pp.year, pp.tmid, t.name AS team_name, pp.lgid, pp.pts_per_36, pp.reb_per_36, pp.ast_per_36, pp.stl_blk_per_36, pp.ast_to_ratio, pp.fg_pct, pp.ft_pct, pp.three_pct, tp.win_pct AS team_win_pct, tp.off_def_ratio, tp.reb_per_game AS team_reb_per_game, tp.ast_per_game AS team_ast_per_game, cp.reg_season_win_pct AS coach_win_pct, cp.playoff_win_pct, aw.award, aw.awards_count, da.draft_tier, da.draftoverall, asp.asg_pts_per_36, asp.asg_reb_per_36, asp.asg_ast_per_36, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY pp.year, pp.lgid ORDER BY pp.pts_per_36 DESC ) AS pts_per_36_rank, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY pp.year, pp.lgid, p.pos ORDER BY (pp.pts_per_36 + pp.reb_per_36 + pp.ast_per_36) DESC ) AS overall_perf_rank_by_pos, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY pp.playerid ORDER BY pp.year DESC ) AS recent_season_flag, AVG(pp.pts_per_36) OVER ( PARTITION BY pp.playerid ORDER BY pp.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_pts_3_seasons, SUM(pp.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY pp.playerid ORDER BY pp.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS career_points_cumulative FROM player_performance pp JOIN players p ON pp.playerid = p.id::integer JOIN team_performance tp ON pp.tmid = tp.tmid::integer AND pp.year = tp.year AND pp.lgid = tp.lgid JOIN coach_performance cp ON pp.tmid = cp.tmid::integer AND pp.year = cp.year AND pp.lgid = cp.lgid LEFT JOIN award_winners aw ON pp.playerid = aw.playerid AND pp.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN draft_analysis da ON pp.playerid = da.playerid LEFT JOIN all_star_performance asp ON pp.playerid = asp.playerid AND pp.year = asp.season_id LEFT JOIN teams t ON pp.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pp.year = t.year WHERE pp.pts_per_36 > 21.74 AND pp.ast_to_ratio < 2.62 ) SELECT playerid, firstname, lastname, pos, year, team_name, lgid, pts_per_36, pts_per_36_rank, overall_perf_rank_by_pos, team_win_pct, coach_win_pct, award, draft_tier, asg_pts_per_36, moving_avg_pts_3_seasons, career_points_cumulative, CASE WHEN pts_per_36_rank <= 10 THEN 'Elite Scorer' WHEN pts_per_36_rank <= 25 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN pts_per_36_rank <= 50 THEN 'Good Scorer' ELSE 'Average Scorer' END AS scoring_tier FROM combined_analysis WHERE pts_per_36_rank <= 59 AND overall_perf_rank_by_pos <= 22 ORDER BY year DESC, pts_per_36_rank, overall_perf_rank_by_pos;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, SUM(ps.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.playerid::integer = ps.playerid AND ap.year = ps.season_id WHERE ap.year >= 1972 AND ps.points >= 40 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 9 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY pt.year) AS cumulative_player_points, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid) AS avg_player_points_per_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t.won DESC) AS team_win_rank FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id::integer WHERE t.year >= 2016 AND t.o_pts > 11913 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, pt.tmid, pt.year, pt.points ORDER BY t.won DESC, t.year;

SELECT a.playerid, a.year, a.award, p.firstname, p.lastname, CASE WHEN a.year >= 2015 THEN 'Recent Era' ELSE 'Earlier Era' END AS era_category, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.year) AS awards_in_year, SUM(p_a.points) AS total_points FROM awards_players a JOIN players p ON p.playerid::integer = a.playerid JOIN player_allstar p_a ON p_a.playerid = a.playerid AND p_a.season_id = a.year WHERE a.year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1996 AND p_a.points > 38 GROUP BY a.playerid, a.year, a.award, p.firstname, p.lastname, p_a.points HAVING SUM(p_a.points) > 88 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, d.draftyear, COUNT(DISTINCT apt.year) AS award_years, SUM(aps.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_team_points, MAX(t.won) AS max_team_wins, (SUM(pt.points) / NULLIF(SUM(pt.minutes),0)) * 100.0 AS points_per_100_min, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY d.draftyear DESC) AS draft_rank FROM players p JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN awards_players apt ON p.playerid::integer = apt.playerid AND d.draftyear = apt.year JOIN player_allstar aps ON p.playerid::integer = aps.playerid AND apt.year = aps.season_id JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND apt.year = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND apt.year = t.year WHERE apt.year > 1993 AND apt.year < 2007 AND d.draftoverall > 218 AND aps.points > 61 AND t.won > 18 GROUP BY p.playerid, d.draftyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT apt.year) > 18 AND SUM(aps.points) > 750 AND AVG(pt.points) > 3988 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, avg_team_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.award = 'All-NBA') AS award_count FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid WHERE pa.season_id BETWEEN 1967 AND 1994 AND pa.league_id = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.id, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 14.78 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id WHERE pt.year >= 2021 AND pt.year <= 1973 AND pt.points > 46 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 13 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1987 AND pt.points > 47 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 15057 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award) AS coach_awards, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON pt.tmid::integer = ac.coachid::integer AND pt.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.id = ps.playerid AND pt.year = ps.season_id JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2009 AND 1961 AND pt.points > 518 AND pt.rebounds > 1278 AND pt.assists > 615 AND t.won > 81 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4478 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 1983 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 104 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_rebounds DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t.year = pt.year WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT year FROM players_teams WHERE playerid IN ( SELECT playerid FROM awards_players WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 1991 ) ) GROUP BY t.name HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 14.3 ORDER BY player_count DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, p.pos, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS birth_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS allstar_players, COUNT(DISTINCT awp.playerid) AS award_players, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.tmidwinner) AS playoff_series_won FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 44.98 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2011 AND 1991 AND t.won > 69.61 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (t.tmid, t.lgid), (t.tmid, p.pos), (t.lgid, birth_year), (t.tmid), (t.lgid), (p.pos), (birth_year), () ) HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 23.18 ORDER BY total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id WHERE t.year >= 1964 AND t.year <= 1978 AND pt.points > 1144 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT a.playerid, a.year, 'awards_players' AS source, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM awards_players a JOIN players p ON a.playerid::character varying = p.playerid WHERE a.year > 1959 GROUP BY a.playerid, a.year UNION ALL SELECT d.playerid, d.draftyear AS year, 'draft' AS source, 1 AS award_count FROM draft d JOIN players p2 ON d.playerid::character varying = p2.playerid WHERE d.draftyear BETWEEN 2008 AND 1958 ORDER BY year DESC, award_count DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_award_types, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.assists) AS avg_assists, MAX(ps.w) AS max_playoff_wins FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN series_post ps ON pa.tmid = ps.tmidwinner JOIN teams t ON pa.tmid = t.id WHERE pa.year >= 2018 AND pa.points > 3873 AND t.won > 70 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 17789 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 10 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE p.firstseason >= 1970 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND ap.year >= 2008 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 35910 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.points > 40 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_scoring_games, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.assists > 14 AND pt.rebounds > 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS double_threat_games, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, MAX(pt.points) AS max_points_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_per_year, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2014 AND 2010 AND pt.points >= 15 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 5677 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, t.lgid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS birth_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::text = pt.playerid::text JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::text = t.tmid::text AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::text = ap.playerid::text WHERE pt.year >= 2002 AND pt.year <= 1987 AND pt.points > 269 GROUP BY CUBE(p.playerid, t.lgid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 32315 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.lastname, p.firstname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 1966 AND pt.year <= 1965 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4776 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 5 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year >= 2017) AS award_count FROM players p WHERE p.id IN ( SELECT pt.playerid FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.year = 2015 AND pt.points > 394 ) ORDER BY award_count DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 2000 AND p.lastseason <= 2011 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 10 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1957 AND pt.year <= 1999 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 26848 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1060.57 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1963 AND 2008 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 14.72 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award) AS coach_awards, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.id) FILTER (WHERE sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid) AS playoff_series_won, AVG(t.won) AS team_avg_wins, SUM(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position_sum FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.coachid::integer AND c.year = ac.year WHERE pt.points > 945 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1955 AND 1985 AND pa.points >= 49 AND t.won >= 37 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2726 AND AVG(pa.points) >= 30 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 9 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC LIMIT 28;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year WHERE pt.year >= 1971 AND pt.year <= 1983 AND pt.points > 1184 AND pt.minutes > 642 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 19352 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.lgid) >= 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, points_rank ASC;

WITH player_performance AS ( SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, pt.steals, pt.blocks, pt.minutes, pt.gp, ROUND(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS pts_per_36, ROUND((pt.fgmade::numeric / NULLIF(pt.fgattempted, 0)) * 100, 2) AS fg_pct, ROUND((pt.ftmade::numeric / NULLIF(pt.ftattempted, 0)) * 100, 2) AS ft_pct, ROUND((pt.threemade::numeric / NULLIF(pt.threeattempted, 0)) * 100, 2) AS three_pct, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.tmid ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS team_points_rank, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_points_3yr, SUM(pt.points + pt.rebounds + pt.assists) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS career_pts_reb_ast FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.minutes > 864 AND pt.gp >= 61 ), team_performance AS ( SELECT t.year, t.tmid, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.o_reb, t.d_reb, t.pace, ROUND(t.won::numeric / NULLIF(t.games, 0) * 100, 2) AS win_pct, t.o_pts - t.d_pts AS point_diff, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY t.won DESC) AS league_win_rank, LAG(t.won) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_wins FROM teams t WHERE t.games >= 61 AND t.year BETWEEN 2009 AND 2019 ), coach_performance AS ( SELECT c.year, c.tmid, c.coachid, c.won, c.lost, c.post_wins, c.post_losses, ROUND(c.won::numeric / NULLIF(c.won + c.lost, 0) * 100, 2) AS reg_season_win_pct, CASE WHEN c.post_wins + c.post_losses > 0 THEN ROUND(c.post_wins::numeric / NULLIF(c.post_wins + c.post_losses, 0) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END AS playoff_win_pct, SUM(c.won) OVER (PARTITION BY c.coachid ORDER BY c.year ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS career_wins FROM coaches c WHERE c.won >= 45 AND c.year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2020 ), award_winners AS ( SELECT ap.playerid, ap.year, ap.award, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ap.playerid) AS total_awards, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.year ORDER BY ap.award) AS award_rank_year FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.year >= 2017 ), draft_analysis AS ( SELECT d.playerid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, CASE WHEN d.draftround = 1 AND d.draftoverall <= 14 THEN 'Lottery' WHEN d.draftround = 1 THEN 'First Round' WHEN d.draftround = 2 THEN 'Second Round' ELSE 'Undrafted' END AS draft_tier, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.draftyear ORDER BY d.draftoverall) AS draft_position_rank FROM draft d WHERE d.draftyear BETWEEN 2013 AND 2017 ), all_star_performance AS ( SELECT asp.playerid, asp.season_id, asp.points, asp.rebounds, asp.assists, asp.steals, asp.blocks, ROUND(asp.points::numeric / NULLIF(asp.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS all_star_pts_per_36, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY asp.season_id ORDER BY asp.points DESC) AS all_star_points_rank FROM player_allstar asp WHERE asp.minutes > 27 AND asp.season_id >= 2016 ) SELECT pp.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pp.year, tp.tmid, tp.win_pct AS team_win_pct, pp.pts_per_36, pp.fg_pct, pp.ft_pct, pp.three_pct, pp.team_points_rank, pp.moving_avg_points_3yr, pp.career_pts_reb_ast, cp.coachid, cp.reg_season_win_pct AS coach_win_pct, cp.career_wins AS coach_career_wins, aw.total_awards, da.draft_tier, da.draft_position_rank, asp.all_star_pts_per_36, asp.all_star_points_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pp.year ORDER BY pp.pts_per_36 DESC) AS league_pts_per_36_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pp.year ORDER BY pp.points) AS points_percentile, AVG(pp.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pp.tmid, pp.year) AS team_avg_points, SUM(pp.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pp.playerid ORDER BY pp.year ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS career_total_points FROM player_performance pp JOIN players p ON pp.playerid = p.id::integer JOIN team_performance tp ON pp.tmid = tp.tmid::integer AND pp.year = tp.year JOIN coach_performance cp ON pp.tmid = cp.tmid::integer AND pp.year = cp.year LEFT JOIN award_winners aw ON pp.playerid = aw.playerid AND pp.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN draft_analysis da ON pp.playerid = da.playerid LEFT JOIN all_star_performance asp ON pp.playerid = asp.playerid AND pp.year = asp.season_id WHERE pp.pts_per_36 > 39.34 AND tp.win_pct >= 42.29 ORDER BY pp.pts_per_36 DESC, tp.win_pct DESC LIMIT 66;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstseason AS first_season, p.lastseason AS last_season, ap.season_id AS allstar_season, pt.year AS team_year, pt.tmid AS team_id, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league_id, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, SUM(pt.blocks) AS total_blocks, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.points > 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_scoring_allstar_games, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league_year, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS team_losses, MAX(t.attendance) AS max_attendance FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1971 AND 1984 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND pt.points > 2336 AND ap.points > 18 AND t.attendance > 948061 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (p.playerid, p.firstseason, p.lastseason, ap.season_id, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, t.lgid), (p.playerid, p.firstseason, p.lastseason), (pt.year, t.lgid), (pt.tmid, t.name), () ) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 34679 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 17 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC LIMIT 714;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2020 AND pt.year <= 2000 AND pt.points > 873 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 22690 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2017 AND pt.year <= 1992 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 29082 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS lg_3yr_avg_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1961 AND t.year <= 1975 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA First Team' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4569 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.name, t1.year, t1.won, t1.lost, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t1.id AND sp.year = t1.year) AS playoff_wins, (SELECT AVG(c.won) FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = t1.id AND c.year = t1.year) AS avg_coach_wins, (SELECT SUM(pa.points) FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.league_id = t1.lgid AND pa.season_id = t1.year) AS allstar_points_in_league, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.tmid = t1.id AND pt.year = t1.year AND pt.points > 12204.25) AS high_scoring_players, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM draft d WHERE d.tmid = t1.id AND d.draftyear = t1.year AND d.draftoverall <= 24.55) AS top_draft_picks, (SELECT MAX(ap.year) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid IN (SELECT pt.playerid FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.tmid = t1.id AND pt.year = t1.year) AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player') AS latest_award_year, SUM(t2.o_pts) AS total_opp_points, AVG(t2.d_pts) AS avg_def_points_allowed FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year AND t1.id != t2.id LEFT JOIN players_teams pt1 ON pt1.tmid = t1.id AND pt1.year = t1.year LEFT JOIN players p ON p.id = pt1.playerid WHERE t1.year BETWEEN 1991.71 AND 2015.51 AND t1.won > 46.46 AND t1.playoff = 'Y' GROUP BY t1.tmid, t1.name, t1.year, t1.won, t1.lost, t1.id, t1.lgid HAVING AVG(pt1.points) > 39.59 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.college) >= 40.01 ORDER BY t1.year DESC, total_opp_points ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE pt.points > 2208.3 AND t.won >= 6.47 AND c.won >= 33.31 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 23193.94 AND AVG(pa.points) >= 12.85 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 81 AND pt.year >= 1973 AND pt.year <= 1963 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 14757 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(CAST(pt.points AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid, pt.lgid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1955 AND pt.year <= 2001 AND pt.minutes > 2392 AND t.won > 38 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1074 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 8 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.year >= 2017 THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS points_since_year, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pt.year BETWEEN 1996 AND 1993 THEN pt.year END) AS seasons_in_range FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1295 AND pt.assists > 916 AND pt.rebounds > 1919 AND t.year >= 1964 AND t.year <= 1950 AND (t.lgid = 'NBA' OR t.lgid = 'NBA') AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1961 AND 1998 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 29443 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 18 AND AVG(pa.points) > 7 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_assists DESC, total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS allstar_career_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(CAST(pa.points AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(pa.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pa.season_id = aw.year WHERE (pa.points > 32 AND pa.minutes > 20) OR (pa.assists > 15 AND pa.rebounds > 8) AND NOT (pa.personal_fouls > 1) AND aw.award = 'All-NBA' AND pa.league_id = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 160 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) >= 14 ORDER BY allstar_career_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points_last_seasons, AVG(pa.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pa.season_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_points_rolling_3_seasons FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pa.playerid = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE pa.points > 46 AND pa.season_id >= 1997 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pa.season_id, pa.points HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 121 ORDER BY total_points_last_seasons DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1968 AND pt.year <= 1987 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = pt.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = 'All-NBA First Team' LIMIT 1) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 46257 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2017 AND pt.year <= 1990 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 48852 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year IN (SELECT year FROM coaches WHERE coachid = 'A') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 9653 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pt.points > 23 AND pt.year >= 1989 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 16151 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, pt.year, pt.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 100) AS pts_per_100min, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.steals) AS total_steals, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) FILTER (WHERE d.draftyear IS NOT NULL) AS draft_years_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.conference = 'East' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS east_allstar_appearances, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.conference = 'West' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS west_allstar_appearances, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.lgid ORDER BY AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 100) DESC) AS efficiency_rank_in_league FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid AND d.draftyear = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND aw.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND t.year = pt.year AND t.lgid = pt.lgid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1959 AND 1988 AND pt.minutes > 501 AND (p.college IS NOT NULL OR p.highschool IS NOT NULL) AND pt.lgid IN ('NBA', 'NBA') GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, pt.year, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2948 AND AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 100) >= 24.16 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 12 ORDER BY total_points DESC, efficiency_rank_in_league ASC LIMIT 778;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, SUM(pa.points) AS allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points)) AS points_percentile FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 1011 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2019 AND pa.points > 23 AND t.won > 59 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 992 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 26 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 10 AND SUM(pa.points) > 60 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) AS stint_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND pt.year >= d.draftyear LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2017 AND 2021 AND pt.gp >= 27 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award IS NOT NULL ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE (sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) AND sp.year = pt.year AND sp.round = 'Finals' ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2474 AND AVG(pt.minutes) >= 35 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) <= 4 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 3977.97 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 652.75 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS scoring_category, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid WHERE pt.year >= 2018 AND pt.year <= 1991 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 802.66 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, AVG(pt.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS avg_points_3_seasons, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds FROM players_teams pt JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id::integer WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2005 AND pt.points > 2181 GROUP BY pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points HAVING SUM(pt.rebounds) > 1921 ORDER BY avg_points_3_seasons DESC;

RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank, (SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.assists) + SUM(pt.rebounds)) AS total_regular_stats, (SUM(pa.points) + SUM(pa.assists) + SUM(pa.rebounds)) AS total_allstar_stats, (SUM(pt.postpoints) + SUM(pt.postassists) + SUM(pt.postrebounds)) AS total_post_stats FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying AND pa.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.lgid = t.lgid AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND t.year = sp.year WHERE p.birthdate >= '1900-01-01' AND p.firstseason >= 1980.4 AND pt.year >= 1997.81 AND pa.season_id >= 1970.91 AND t.year >= 1981.83 AND pt.points > 3087.88 AND pa.points > 3.19 AND t.won > 4.47 AND t.o_pts > 4455.41 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.birthcountry, p.college, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, t.name, t.lgid, t.confid, t.divid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) > 8.83 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 12.42 AND SUM(pt.points) > 23607.52 AND SUM(pa.points) > 1596.78 AND SUM(t.won) > 911.41 ORDER BY total_regular_points DESC, total_allstar_points DESC, total_post_points DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid INNER JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id WHERE pt.year >= 1993 AND pt.points > 15 AND t.won > 79 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 8 AND AVG(pt.points) > 18.99 ORDER BY total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2010 AND pt.year <= 1994 AND pt.points > 2567 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 3 AND SUM(pt.points) > 42240 ORDER BY total_team_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(1.0 * pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1963 AND pt.year <= 1969 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3827 ORDER BY pt.year, pt.lgid, points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 7890.38 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 793.82 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS scoring_category, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2011 AND pt.year <= 1990 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 982.83 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year >= 1971 AND pt.year <= 2018 AND pt.points > 2158 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, t.lgid), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname), (pt.year, t.lgid), (pt.tmid, t.name, t.lgid), () ) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 14117 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 19 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, pt.tmid;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1994.0 AND pt.year <= 2004.87 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND ap.league_id = 'NBA' AND d.draftyear >= 1999.81 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 43446.38 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 17.18 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname AS first_name, p.lastname AS last_name, 'Regular Season' AS season_type, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.minutes) AS total_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 2775 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1960 AND 1961 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname UNION ALL SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname AS first_name, p.lastname AS last_name, 'All-Star' AS season_type, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, SUM(pa.minutes) AS total_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE pa.points > 26 AND pa.season_id BETWEEN 1975 AND 2020 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(ap.award) AS award_count FROM players p LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying WHERE p.firstseason >= 1988 AND p.lastseason <= 1973 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(ap.award) = 0 ORDER BY p.lastname, p.firstname;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN player_allstar ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id WHERE pt.year IN (SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND lgid = 'NBA') AND pt.points > 2363.49 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2475.78 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, t.lgid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS birth_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.league_id = 'NBA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nba_allstar_games, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1972 AND pt.year <= 2021 AND pt.points > 478 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY CUBE(p.playerid, t.lgid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 29035 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 9 ORDER BY total_points DESC, t.lgid, p.playerid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_points_3yr FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year AND t.lgid = pt.lgid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid::text = p.playerid WHERE t.year >= 1997 AND t.year <= 2010 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 55519 ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, AVG(t1.won) AS avg_wins, AVG(t2.won) AS avg_wins_prev_year, AVG(t1.won) - AVG(t2.won) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.year >= 1977 AND t2.year >= 1956 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid HAVING AVG(t1.won) > 52 ORDER BY win_change DESC;

WITH player_performance AS ( SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.lgid, pt.gp, pt.minutes, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, pt.steals, pt.blocks, pt.turnovers, pt.pf, ROUND(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS pts_per_36, ROUND(pt.rebounds::numeric / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS reb_per_36, ROUND(pt.assists::numeric / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS ast_per_36, ROUND((pt.steals + pt.blocks)::numeric / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS stl_blk_per_36, ROUND(pt.turnovers::numeric / NULLIF(pt.assists, 0), 2) AS ast_to_ratio, CASE WHEN pt.fgattempted > 0 THEN ROUND(pt.fgmade::numeric / pt.fgattempted * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END AS fg_pct, CASE WHEN pt.ftattempted > 0 THEN ROUND(pt.ftmade::numeric / pt.ftattempted * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END AS ft_pct, CASE WHEN pt.threeattempted > 0 THEN ROUND(pt.threemade::numeric / pt.threeattempted * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END AS three_pct FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.minutes > 2673 AND pt.gp > 31 ), team_performance AS ( SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.o_reb, t.d_reb, t.o_asts, t.d_stl, t.o_blk, t.d_to, ROUND(t.o_pts::numeric / NULLIF(t.d_pts, 0), 2) AS off_def_ratio, ROUND((t.o_reb + t.d_reb)::numeric / t.games, 1) AS reb_per_game, ROUND(t.o_asts::numeric / t.games, 1) AS ast_per_game, t.won::numeric / NULLIF(t.won + t.lost, 0) AS win_pct FROM teams t WHERE t.games > 61 AND t.o_pts > 7170 ), coach_performance AS ( SELECT c.coachid, c.year, c.tmid, c.lgid, c.won, c.lost, c.post_wins, c.post_losses, c.won::numeric / NULLIF(c.won + c.lost, 0) AS reg_season_win_pct, CASE WHEN c.post_wins + c.post_losses > 0 THEN c.post_wins::numeric / (c.post_wins + c.post_losses) ELSE 0 END AS playoff_win_pct FROM coaches c WHERE c.won > 59 AND c.post_wins >= 15 ), award_winners AS ( SELECT ap.playerid, ap.year, ap.award, ap.lgid, ap.pos, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ap.playerid, ap.year) AS awards_count FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.year >= 1994 ), draft_analysis AS ( SELECT d.playerid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftselection, d.draftoverall, d.tmid, d.lgid, CASE WHEN d.draftround = 1 AND d.draftselection <= 10 THEN 'Lottery' WHEN d.draftround = 1 THEN 'First Round' WHEN d.draftround = 2 THEN 'Second Round' ELSE 'Late Round' END AS draft_tier FROM draft d WHERE d.draftyear BETWEEN 2003 AND 1982 ), all_star_performance AS ( SELECT asp.playerid, asp.season_id, asp.games_played, asp.minutes, asp.points, asp.rebounds, asp.assists, asp.steals, asp.blocks, ROUND(asp.points::numeric / NULLIF(asp.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS asg_pts_per_36, ROUND(asp.rebounds::numeric / NULLIF(asp.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS asg_reb_per_36, ROUND(asp.assists::numeric / NULLIF(asp.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS asg_ast_per_36 FROM player_allstar asp WHERE asp.minutes > 39 AND asp.points > 14 ), combined_analysis AS ( SELECT pp.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, pp.year, pp.tmid, t.name AS team_name, pp.lgid, pp.pts_per_36, pp.reb_per_36, pp.ast_per_36, pp.stl_blk_per_36, pp.ast_to_ratio, pp.fg_pct, pp.ft_pct, pp.three_pct, tp.win_pct AS team_win_pct, tp.off_def_ratio, tp.reb_per_game AS team_reb_per_game, tp.ast_per_game AS team_ast_per_game, cp.reg_season_win_pct AS coach_win_pct, cp.playoff_win_pct, aw.award, aw.awards_count, da.draft_tier, da.draftoverall, asp.asg_pts_per_36, asp.asg_reb_per_36, asp.asg_ast_per_36, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY pp.year, pp.lgid ORDER BY pp.pts_per_36 DESC ) AS pts_per_36_rank, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY pp.year, pp.lgid, p.pos ORDER BY (pp.pts_per_36 + pp.reb_per_36 + pp.ast_per_36) DESC ) AS overall_perf_rank_by_pos, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY pp.playerid ORDER BY pp.year DESC ) AS recent_season_flag, AVG(pp.pts_per_36) OVER ( PARTITION BY pp.playerid ORDER BY pp.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_pts_3_seasons, SUM(pp.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY pp.playerid ORDER BY pp.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS career_points_cumulative FROM player_performance pp JOIN players p ON pp.playerid = p.id::integer JOIN team_performance tp ON pp.tmid = tp.tmid::integer AND pp.year = tp.year AND pp.lgid = tp.lgid JOIN coach_performance cp ON pp.tmid = cp.tmid::integer AND pp.year = cp.year AND pp.lgid = cp.lgid LEFT JOIN award_winners aw ON pp.playerid = aw.playerid AND pp.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN draft_analysis da ON pp.playerid = da.playerid LEFT JOIN all_star_performance asp ON pp.playerid = asp.playerid AND pp.year = asp.season_id LEFT JOIN teams t ON pp.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pp.year = t.year WHERE pp.pts_per_36 > 35.7 AND pp.ast_to_ratio < 4.51 ) SELECT playerid, firstname, lastname, pos, year, team_name, lgid, pts_per_36, pts_per_36_rank, overall_perf_rank_by_pos, team_win_pct, coach_win_pct, award, draft_tier, asg_pts_per_36, moving_avg_pts_3_seasons, career_points_cumulative, CASE WHEN pts_per_36_rank <= 10 THEN 'Elite Scorer' WHEN pts_per_36_rank <= 25 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN pts_per_36_rank <= 50 THEN 'Good Scorer' ELSE 'Average Scorer' END AS scoring_tier FROM combined_analysis WHERE pts_per_36_rank <= 48 AND overall_perf_rank_by_pos <= 16 ORDER BY year DESC, pts_per_36_rank, overall_perf_rank_by_pos;

SELECT p.lastname, p.firstname, pt.year, pt.points, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.points > 2016 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1954 AND 1979 GROUP BY p.lastname, p.firstname, pt.year, pt.points ORDER BY pt.year, pt.points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pa.points) AS median_points, SUM(pa.rebounds) AS total_rebounds FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pa.playerid = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE pa.points > 29 AND pa.season_id >= 1953 AND pa.season_id <= 1986 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 19.49 ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COALESCE(SUM(pa.points), 0) AS total_allstar_points, COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) AS total_regular_points, COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) AS total_postseason_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MIN(d.draftyear) AS draft_year, AVG(t.won::numeric / NULLIF(t.games, 0)) * 100 AS avg_team_win_percentage, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pa.points), 0) DESC) AS allstar_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) DESC) AS regular_points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pt.postpoints), 0) DESC) AS postseason_points_rank FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pa.season_id >= 2015 LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND pt.year >= 1957 LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND ap.year >= 2020 LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND t.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::character varying = c.tmid::character varying AND c.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND ac.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser WHERE p.weight > 274 AND p.height > '60.0' AND (t.lgid = 'ABA' OR t.lgid IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(pa.points), 0) > 215 AND COALESCE(SUM(pt.points), 0) > 9476 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 5 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC, total_regular_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS distinct_team_years, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.league_id) AS distinct_allstar_leagues, COUNT(DISTINCT dp.draftyear) AS distinct_draft_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) DESC) AS allstar_season_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year JOIN draft dp ON p.playerid::integer = dp.playerid JOIN awards_players awp ON p.playerid::integer = awp.playerid AND ap.season_id = awp.year JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner WHERE p.height > 217.48 AND p.weight BETWEEN 165 AND 260 AND pt.year >= 1968 AND ap.points > 87 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 11 AND SUM(pt.points) > 4509 ORDER BY total_points DESC, distinct_allstar_seasons DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS distinct_team_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 1971 AND ap.season_id <= 1964 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 43686 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1950 AND pt.year <= 1959 AND p.birthdate >= '1940-01-01' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 8863 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 1869 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2014 AND 1998 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 9865 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, AVG(ast.assists) AS avg_allstar_assists, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) DESC) AS awards_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ast ON p.playerid = ast.playerid::character varying JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying WHERE ast.season_id >= 2016 AND pt.year >= 1981 AND ap.year >= 1976 AND d.draftyear >= 1973 AND p.firstseason <= 1961 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college HAVING AVG(ast.assists) > 0.43 AND SUM(pt.points) > 42897.85 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_allstar_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.assists) + SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS overall_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.points > 1670 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1983 AND 1952 AND t.won > 82 AND pa.points > 34 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 24902 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 26 ORDER BY overall_rank, team_points_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points_regular, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists_regular, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds_regular, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute_regular, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points_allstar, SUM(pa.assists) AS total_assists_allstar, SUM(pa.rebounds) AS total_rebounds_allstar, AVG(pa.points / NULLIF(pa.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute_allstar, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS rank_total_points_regular, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS rank_assists_in_league, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rank_rebounds_in_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::character varying = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::character varying = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 2574.48 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1979.99 AND 1984.51 AND pa.minutes > 45.72 AND t.attendance > 3317270.13 AND c.won > 4.03 AND sp.w > 5.85 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.lgid, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 19267.79 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 23.31 ORDER BY total_points_regular DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, pt.year, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS yearly_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1973 AND pt.year <= 1974 AND pt.points > 1840 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, pt.year, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 15527 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS player_count, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid = pt.tmid::character varying AND t.year = pt.year WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT year FROM players_teams WHERE playerid IN ( SELECT playerid FROM awards_players WHERE year BETWEEN 1956 AND 1952 ) ) GROUP BY t.name HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 16.28 ORDER BY player_count DESC;

SELECT a.playerid, a.year, a.award, a.lgid, b.firstname, b.lastname, b.draftyear, b.draftoverall FROM awards_players a JOIN draft b ON a.playerid = b.playerid WHERE a.year >= 1967 AND a.year <= 1968 AND b.draftyear >= 1986 AND b.draftoverall <= 299 INTERSECT SELECT c.playerid, c.year, c.award, c.lgid, d.firstname, d.lastname, d.draftyear, d.draftoverall FROM awards_players c JOIN draft d ON c.playerid = d.playerid JOIN players_teams e ON c.playerid = e.playerid AND c.year = e.year WHERE e.points >= 1789 AND e.rebounds >= 674 ORDER BY year DESC, draftoverall ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2000 AND pt.year <= 1975 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 15045 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 2004 AND pt.year <= 1981 AND pt.gp > 72 AND pt.points > 1229 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1956 ORDER BY pt.year, points_rank_in_year;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 1994.77 AND p.lastseason <= 1963.63 AND t.lgid LIKE 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 8499.5 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year WHERE pt.points > 3165 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1957 AND 1999 AND t.won > 23 AND sp.w > 10 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 15659 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) > 17 UNION ALL SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, SUM(pas.points) AS total_points, AVG(pas.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pas.league_id) AS leagues_played_in, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pas.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(pas.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pas ON p.playerid::integer = pas.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pas.season_id = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pas.league_id = t.lgid AND pas.season_id = t.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year WHERE pas.points > 52 AND pas.season_id BETWEEN 1959 AND 1958 AND t.won > 3 AND sp.w > 10 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pas.points) > 3563 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pas.league_id) > 2 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_assists DESC;
