SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2000 AND pt.year <= 1992 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 7.14 ORDER BY avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE p.firstseason >= 1964 AND p.lastseason <= 2014 AND pt.points > 455 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 11 AND SUM(pt.points) > 10199 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, MAX(t.won) AS max_team_wins, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) DESC) AS award_years_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid AND d.draftyear = pt.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1981 AND 2005 AND pt.minutes > 4890 AND t.won > 21 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 8079 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) >= 9 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE (pt.points > 1200 OR pt.assists > 326) AND NOT (pt.year < 2020) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 25786 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 14 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE (pt.points > 1696.25 AND pt.year >= 1990.48) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1959.3 AND 2008.95) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 30434.91 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE p.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT d.playerid FROM draft d WHERE d.draftyear BETWEEN 1974 AND 2011 AND d.draftround <= 9 ) AND pt.points > 1359 AND t.won > 76 AND c.won > 55 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3584 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, sub.total_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sub.total_points DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN ( SELECT pt.playerid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT sp.year FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.w > 3 ) AND pt.points > 1758 GROUP BY pt.playerid ) sub ON p.playerid::integer = sub.playerid WHERE sub.total_points >= 48437 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, sub.total_points ORDER BY points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2012 AND pt.year <= 1952 AND pt.points > 1468 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 33039 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1980 AND pt.year <= 1963 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 27473 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2011 AND pt.year <= 1953 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 30728 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 73 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND d.draftyear >= 1953) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 39857 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pa.rebounds) AS total_allstar_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS allstar_seasons_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pt.points) AS median_regular_season_points, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pt.assists) AS p75_regular_season_assists, SUM(pt.postpoints) AS total_postseason_points, AVG(t.won) AS avg_team_wins, MAX(t.attendance) AS max_team_attendance, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE p.height > 200.12 AND p.weight BETWEEN 146 AND 209 AND pt.year >= 1988 AND t.attendance > 72031 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 11.29 AND SUM(pt.postpoints) > 587 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) >= 10 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC, total_postseason_points DESC LIMIT 995;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1993 AND pt.year <= 1974 AND pt.gp > 65 AND pt.points > 588 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 117 ORDER BY pt.year, points_rank_in_year;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.award = 'MVP' AND ap.year BETWEEN 2004 AND 2015) AS mvp_count, (SELECT AVG(pa.points) FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid = p.id AND pa.season_id >= 1974) AS avg_allstar_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS overall_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::text = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::text AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner::text AND t.year = sp.year WHERE p.weight > 217 AND p.height > '60.0' AND t.won > 29 AND pt.gp > 54 AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 2005 AND 1977 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.year, t.tmid, p.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2481 AND AVG(pt.assists) > 9 ORDER BY overall_points_rank, team_points_rank, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, t.tmid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS birth_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.league_id = 'NBA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nba_allstar_games, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS team_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS overall_assists_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1963 AND pt.year <= 1962 AND pt.points > 2803 AND t.won > 71 GROUP BY CUBE(p.playerid, t.tmid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.birthdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 40400 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 12 ORDER BY total_points DESC, overall_assists_rank;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.year AS year1, p2.year AS year2, (p2.points - p1.points) AS points_increase, p1.tmid FROM players_teams p1 JOIN players_teams p2 ON p1.playerid = p2.playerid AND p1.tmid = p2.tmid AND p1.year < p2.year WHERE p1.points > 355 AND p2.points > 683 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.year, p2.year, p1.tmid, p1.points, p2.points HAVING (p2.points - p1.points) > 16 ORDER BY points_increase DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.lgid, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(pa.points) AS allstar_points, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_pick FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id AND p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND c.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND d.draftyear = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND ap.year = t.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND ac.year = t.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2020 AND pt.points > 1100 AND pa.points > 129 AND c.won > 15 AND d.draftoverall < 160 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.lgid HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 1310 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 3326 INTERSECT SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.lgid, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(pa.points) AS allstar_points, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_pick FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id AND p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND c.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND d.draftyear = t.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND sp.year = t.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1990 AND 2022 AND pt.points > 3048 AND pa.points > 475 AND c.won > 3 AND sp.w > 8 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.lgid HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 1887 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 96;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.lastname, p.firstname, t.name AS team_name, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons_count, MAX(ap.points) AS max_allstar_points, SUM(CASE WHEN awp.award = 'Most Valuable Player' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mvp_awards_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS team_assists_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2019 AND 1989 AND pt.gp >= 32 AND t.attendance > 3881756 AND (p.height > '150.0' OR p.weight > 165) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, t.name, pt.year, t.id, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 5013 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.lgid) >= 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year, team_assists_rank;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE p.firstseason >= 2007 AND p.lastseason <= 1971 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 17 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, SUM(sp.w) AS series_wins, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, SUM(t.o_pts) AS team_offensive_points, SUM(t.d_pts) AS team_defensive_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rebounds_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner WHERE pt.points > 2308.48 AND pt.year >= 2008 AND pt.year <= 1992 AND t.won >= 74.2 AND c.won >= 68.27 AND sp.w >= 4.1 AND pa.points >= 41.78 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 24170.28 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 3485.64 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 13196.25 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) >= 6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) >= 4 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_assists DESC, total_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.fullgivenname AS full_name, p.pos AS position, p.college AS college, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_points_per_game, SUM(ps.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(ps.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.season_id) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(ps.points) DESC) AS points_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pos ORDER BY SUM(ps.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank_by_position, MAX(ps.personal_fouls) AS max_fouls_in_game, (SUM(ps.fg_made) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ps.fg_attempted), 0)) AS career_fg_percentage, (SUM(ps.ft_made) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ps.ft_attempted), 0)) AS career_ft_percentage, (SUM(ps.three_made) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ps.three_attempted), 0)) AS career_3p_percentage, COUNT(a.award) AS total_awards, d.draftoverall AS draft_position, t.name AS first_team_name, c.won AS coach_wins, c.lost AS coach_losses, sp.w AS playoff_wins, sp.l AS playoff_losses FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.playerid::integer = ps.playerid JOIN awards_players a ON p.playerid::integer = a.playerid AND ps.season_id = a.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND ps.season_id = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND t.year = pt.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND c.year = t.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser WHERE ps.points > 50.86 AND ps.minutes >= 39.42 AND ps.season_id BETWEEN 2017.49 AND 2014.39 AND d.draftyear >= 1955.43 AND t.won > 16.74 AND c.won > 53.64 AND sp.year BETWEEN 1991.46 AND 2009.43 AND p.height > 199.57 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.fullgivenname, p.pos, p.college, d.draftoverall, t.name, c.won, c.lost, sp.w, sp.l HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ps.season_id) >= 9.57 AND SUM(ps.assists) > 680.76 AND AVG(ps.points) >= 23.69 ORDER BY avg_points_per_game DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.league_id) AS distinct_allstar_leagues, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS distinct_team_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE p.height > 151.5 AND pt.year >= 1954 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 30392.38 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE ap.season_id >= 1990 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 7 UNION ALL SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS team_seasons FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1968 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 11 ORDER BY allstar_appearances DESC, playerid;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2011 AND pt.year <= 2012 AND (pt.points > 10 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player')) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 28445 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.lgid, t.name AS team_name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_season_league, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_season_total_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1963 AND 2018 AND pt.points > 1462 AND t.won > 10 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.lgid, t.name), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname), (pt.year, pt.lgid, t.name), () ) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 20314 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, p.playerid ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.tmidwinner) AS championship_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE (pt.points > 1721 OR pa.points > 16) AND (pt.year BETWEEN 1997 AND 1978) AND (t.won > 69 OR t.lost < 29) AND (p.firstseason <= 1981 AND p.lastseason >= 1959) AND (NOT (pt.minutes < 24 AND pt.gp < 33)) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 731 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 8 AND AVG(pt.minutes) BETWEEN 14 AND 43 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_awards DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pa.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE pa.season_id >= 1995.82 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 202.32 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname AS first_name, p.lastname AS last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 100.0) AS points_per_100_min, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1988 AND pt.year <= 2005 AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 42870 ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 98;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year WHERE pa.points > 37 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1995 AND 1976 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 28763 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT ap2.year) AS award_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_percentile FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN awards_players ap2 ON p.id = ap2.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 1670 AND ap.season_id >= 1986 AND ap2.year BETWEEN 1978 AND 2017 AND pt.minutes > 2935 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 18 AND SUM(pt.points) > 38792 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 2998 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.college, p.pos, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, ap.season_id, ap.points AS allstar_points, ap.rebounds AS allstar_rebounds, ap.assists AS allstar_assists, pt.year AS team_year, pt.points AS team_points, pt.rebounds AS team_rebounds, pt.assists AS team_assists, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS career_points_running_total, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid) AS avg_points_per_season, COUNT(ap.season_id) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid) AS allstar_appearances, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS total_points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pos ORDER BY AVG(pt.points) DESC) AS avg_points_rank_by_position, SUM(pt.points) AS total_career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_career_points, MAX(pt.points) AS max_season_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) AS teams_played_for, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.lgid = 'NBA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nba_seasons_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id WHERE pt.year >= 1981 AND pt.year <= 1967 AND pt.points > 690 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' AND p.pos IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.college, p.pos, t.name, t.lgid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.rebounds, ap.assists, pt.year, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 8408 AND AVG(pt.points) > 7 ORDER BY total_career_points DESC, avg_career_points DESC LIMIT 452;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) AS stint_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid::integer AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT sp.year FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.w > 4 AND sp.l < 1 ) AND pt.minutes > 2958 AND pa.points > 5 AND c.won > 57 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 479 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 12 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_minutes DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS points_rank, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid, pt.year) AS team_avg_points, COUNT(ap.award) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid) AS total_awards, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS career_points_running_total FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.points > 22 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2009 AND pt.rebounds >= 8 AND t.won > 56 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, ap.award, pa.points HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 15 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pa.playerid = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE pa.season_id >= 1984 AND pa.season_id <= 1970 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA First Team' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 300 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1969 AND pt.points > 2095 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname UNION ALL SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE pa.season_id >= 1995 AND pa.points > 81 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS player_count, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points FROM players_teams p JOIN teams t ON p.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND p.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid AND p.year = pa.season_id WHERE p.year >= 1994 AND p.year <= 1992 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, player_count DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.points > 38.61 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_scoring_games, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.steals > 3.81 THEN pt.steals ELSE 0 END) AS impactful_steals, COUNT(CASE WHEN pt.turnovers < 1.11 THEN 1 END) AS low_turnover_games, (SUM(pt.points) + SUM(pt.assists) + SUM(pt.rebounds)) AS total_contributions, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner WHERE pt.points >= 8.99 AND t.year BETWEEN 2003 AND 2018 AND pt.minutes > 47.45 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1083.73 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 9 ORDER BY total_contributions DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 1964 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 25358 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2015 AND pt.year <= 1978 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 19616 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, (SELECT MAX(d.draftoverall) FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.id AND d.draftyear BETWEEN 1983 AND 1972) AS max_draft_position, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = pt.tmid AND c.year = pt.year AND c.won > 59) AS coaches_with_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::text = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1954 AND 1965 AND (pt.points > 1594 OR pt.assists > 416) AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' AND (t.playoff = 'Y' OR t.confid = 'East') AND NOT (p.college IS NULL AND p.highschool IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, pt.lgid, p.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 807 AND AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) > 0.7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) >= 4 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.tmidwinner = t.id AND sp.year = t.year) AS playoff_series_won, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.id = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1949 AND 1947 AND t.won >= 61 AND t.o_pts >= 6130 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2786 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1964 AND pt.year <= 2007 AND pt.points > 768 AND pa.points > 21 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 48234 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 9 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON pt.playerid = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 2000 AND pt.year <= 1995 AND pt.assists > 992 AND pa.assists > 5 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.assists) > 2235 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 20 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points_regular, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists_regular, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds_regular, AVG(pt.points / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute_regular, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points_allstar, SUM(pa.assists) AS total_assists_allstar, SUM(pa.rebounds) AS total_rebounds_allstar, AVG(pa.points / NULLIF(pa.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute_allstar, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS rank_total_points_regular, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS rank_assists_in_league, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.rebounds) DESC) AS rank_rebounds_in_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::character varying = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid::integer = ac.coachid AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::character varying = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND t.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 104.96 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1966.74 AND 2022.26 AND pa.minutes > 15.51 AND t.attendance > 990228.81 AND c.won > 0.13 AND sp.w > 6.37 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.lgid, pt.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3068.37 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 43.36 ORDER BY total_points_regular DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ap.award, ', ' ORDER BY ap.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND ap.year = pa.season_id WHERE ap.year >= 1957 AND pa.points >= 0 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) > 5 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_season_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS total_points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_team_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1952 AND pt.year <= 1981 AND pt.points > 44 AND pa.points > 12 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM coaches c WHERE c.tmid = pt.tmid AND c.year = pt.year AND c.won > 47 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE (sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) AND sp.year = pt.year AND sp.w > 4 ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, pt.tmid, pt.year HAVING AVG(pa.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 1 ORDER BY total_points_rank, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pa.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying WHERE pa.season_id >= 2021 AND pa.season_id <= 2020 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 4731 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE t.won > 71 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA First Team' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year HAVING AVG(pt.points) > 27 ORDER BY avg_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, t.name, SUM(t.won) AS total_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS total_losses, AVG(t.attendance) AS avg_attendance, SUM(pts.points) AS total_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pts.playerid) AS unique_players, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS unique_coaches, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS all_star_players, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(t.won) DESC, AVG(t.attendance) DESC) AS rank_in_league, SUM(sp.w) AS playoff_series_wins, SUM(sp.l) AS playoff_series_losses, AVG(d.draftoverall) AS avg_draft_pick, COUNT(DISTINCT d.playerid) AS drafted_players FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pts ON t.tmid::integer = pts.tmid AND t.year = pts.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON pts.playerid = ap.playerid AND pts.year = ap.year AND ap.award = 'All-Star' LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON t.tmid::integer = d.tmid AND t.year = d.draftyear WHERE t.year >= 1997 AND t.year <= 1966 AND t.attendance > 3317474 AND pts.points > 48807 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.won) > 91 AND AVG(t.attendance) > 1010133 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pts.playerid) > 6 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_attendance DESC;

SELECT p.firstname, p.lastname, p.playerid, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY SUBSTRING(p.playerid FROM 1 FOR 1) ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS rank_by_id_prefix, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (ORDER BY p.playerid) AS prev_player_points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid = p.id AND ap2.award LIKE 'Most Valuable Player') AS mvp_count FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON p.playerid = c.coachid WHERE p.firstseason >= 1964 AND p.lastseason <= 2002 AND pt.points > 2494 AND pa.points > 37 GROUP BY p.id, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.playerid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 19831 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 6 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS team_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(ps.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS coached_teams FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.id = ps.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 798 AND ap.year >= 1962 AND ps.season_id >= 1975 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 11804 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) >= 19 AND AVG(ps.points) >= 10 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points * 1.0 / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS career_points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1998 AND pt.year <= 2006 AND pt.gp > 71 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 43523 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

WITH player_performance AS ( SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, pt.steals, pt.blocks, pt.minutes, pt.gp, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.points DESC) as points_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.rebounds DESC) as rebounds_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY pt.assists DESC) as assists_rank, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year) as avg_points_per_year, SUM(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as career_points_running_total FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.minutes > 426 AND pt.gp >= 57 ), team_performance AS ( SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.o_reb, t.d_reb, t.attendance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY t.won DESC) as wins_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY t.o_pts DESC) as offense_rank, (t.o_pts - t.d_pts) as point_differential, AVG(t.o_pts) OVER (PARTITION BY t.year) as avg_offense_per_year FROM teams t WHERE t.attendance > 29328 AND t.won >= 70 ), coach_performance AS ( SELECT c.coachid, c.year, c.tmid, c.won, c.lost, c.post_wins, c.post_losses, (c.won::decimal / (c.won + c.lost)) as win_percentage, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.year ORDER BY c.won DESC) as wins_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.year ORDER BY (c.won::decimal / (c.won + c.lost)) DESC) as win_pct_rank FROM coaches c WHERE c.won > 41 AND c.post_wins >= 2 ), all_star_performance AS ( SELECT ap.playerid, ap.season_id, ap.points, ap.rebounds, ap.assists, ap.steals, ap.blocks, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.season_id ORDER BY ap.points DESC) as all_star_points_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.season_id ORDER BY ap.points) as points_percentile FROM player_allstar ap WHERE ap.points > 18 AND ap.rebounds >= 3 ), award_winners AS ( SELECT aw.playerid, aw.year, aw.award, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY aw.playerid) as total_awards, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY aw.year ORDER BY aw.award) as award_rank FROM awards_players aw WHERE aw.year BETWEEN 1961 AND 1993 ), draft_analysis AS ( SELECT d.playerid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.draftyear ORDER BY d.draftoverall) as draft_position_rank, CASE WHEN d.draftround = 1 THEN 'First Round' WHEN d.draftround = 2 THEN 'Second Round' ELSE 'Late Round' END as draft_category FROM draft d WHERE d.draftoverall <= 12 AND d.draftyear >= 1962 ) SELECT pp.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pp.year, pp.tmid, t.name as team_name, pp.points, pp.rebounds, pp.assists, pp.points_rank, pp.rebounds_rank, pp.assists_rank, pp.avg_points_per_year, pp.career_points_running_total, tp.won as team_wins, tp.lost as team_losses, tp.wins_rank as team_wins_rank, tp.point_differential, tp.avg_offense_per_year, cp.coachid, cp.win_percentage as coach_win_pct, cp.wins_rank as coach_wins_rank, ap.points as all_star_points, ap.all_star_points_rank, ap.points_percentile, aw.total_awards, aw.award_rank, da.draftoverall, da.draft_position_rank, da.draft_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pp.year ORDER BY pp.points DESC) as yearly_points_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pp.year ORDER BY pp.points) as yearly_points_percentile, SUM(pp.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pp.playerid ORDER BY pp.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as career_total_points, AVG(pp.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pp.tmid, pp.year) as team_avg_points FROM player_performance pp JOIN players p ON pp.playerid = p.id::integer JOIN team_performance tp ON pp.tmid = tp.tmid::integer AND pp.year = tp.year JOIN coach_performance cp ON pp.tmid = cp.tmid::integer AND pp.year = cp.year LEFT JOIN all_star_performance ap ON pp.playerid = ap.playerid AND pp.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN award_winners aw ON pp.playerid = aw.playerid AND pp.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN draft_analysis da ON pp.playerid = da.playerid JOIN teams t ON pp.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pp.year = t.year WHERE pp.points > 918 AND tp.won >= 69 AND cp.win_percentage > 0.52 GROUP BY pp.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pp.year, pp.tmid, t.name, pp.points, pp.rebounds, pp.assists, pp.points_rank, pp.rebounds_rank, pp.assists_rank, pp.avg_points_per_year, pp.career_points_running_total, tp.won, tp.lost, tp.wins_rank, tp.point_differential, tp.avg_offense_per_year, cp.coachid, cp.win_percentage, cp.wins_rank, ap.points, ap.all_star_points_rank, ap.points_percentile, aw.total_awards, aw.award_rank, da.draftoverall, da.draft_position_rank, da.draft_category HAVING AVG(pp.points) > 606 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pp.year) >= 9 ORDER BY pp.points DESC, pp.year DESC, pp.playerid;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1953 AND pt.year <= 2018 AND pt.points > 1421 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 40228 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, pt.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(CAST(pt.points AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, COUNT(a.award) AS award_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players a ON p.playerid::integer = a.playerid AND pt.year = a.year WHERE pt.year >= 2017 AND pt.year <= 2008 AND pt.points > 2083 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, pt.year), (p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname), (t.name, pt.year), ()) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 16777 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 10 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS total_players, SUM(p.points) AS total_points, AVG(p.points) AS avg_points_per_player, SUM(p.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, SUM(p.assists) AS total_assists, MAX(ap.awards_count) AS max_awards_per_player, (SELECT MAX(sub_awards) FROM (SELECT COUNT(award) AS sub_awards FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid IN (SELECT playerid FROM players_teams pt2 WHERE pt2.tmid = t.id AND pt2.year = t.year) GROUP BY ap2.playerid) subq) AS max_awards_in_team_year, (SELECT AVG(draft_rank) FROM (SELECT draftoverall AS draft_rank FROM draft d WHERE d.tmid = t.id AND d.draftyear = t.year) draft_sub) AS avg_draft_rank FROM teams t JOIN players_teams p ON t.id = p.tmid AND t.year = p.year LEFT JOIN (SELECT playerid, COUNT(*) AS awards_count FROM awards_players GROUP BY playerid) ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid WHERE t.year >= 1999 AND t.year <= 1957 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.lgid, t.id HAVING SUM(p.points) > 18900 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) >= 6 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_season, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1952 AND 1988 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 19247 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 2510 AND pt.year >= 2002 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 18 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE p.college LIKE '%University%' AND pt.year >= 1990 AND pt.year <= 2005 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 19080 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1958 AND pt.year <= 1986 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 23650 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_season_league FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year AND pt.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 2004 AND pt.year <= 1969 AND pt.points > 419 AND t.won > 26 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, pt.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4227 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 7 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.points > 318 AND t.year BETWEEN 1970 AND 2022 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 22796 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_league FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.points > 736 AND t.year BETWEEN 1972 AND 1988 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((p.playerid, t.tmid, t.year, t.lgid), (p.playerid, t.lgid), (t.tmid, t.year), (t.lgid)) HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 38813 ORDER BY t.lgid, total_points DESC;
SELECT t.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid WHERE pt.year >= 2005 AND pt.gp >= 29 GROUP BY t.tmid ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2007 AND pt.year <= 2002 AND pt.lgid = 'NBA' AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND d.draftyear >= 2012 AND d.draftyear <= 2002 AND pa.season_id >= 1962 AND pa.season_id <= 1981 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 9944 AND AVG(pt.assists) > 3 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pa.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN coaches c ON p.playerid::text = c.coachid WHERE pa.season_id >= 1970 AND pa.season_id <= 1991 AND pa.league_id = 'NBA' AND ap.award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND d.draftyear >= 2011 AND d.draftyear <= 2016 AND c.year >= 1999 AND c.year <= 1985 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 343 AND AVG(pa.assists) > 6 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year >= 1969 AND pt.points > 2 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 11221 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, a.year, a.award, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN awards_players a ON p.playerid::integer = a.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON a.playerid = pt.playerid AND a.year = pt.year WHERE a.award IN (SELECT award FROM awards_players WHERE year = 2006 GROUP BY award HAVING COUNT(*) >= 445) GROUP BY p.playerid, a.year, a.award ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT a.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS career_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS career_rebounds, AVG(pt.points::float / NULLIF(pt.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, SUM(CASE WHEN c.won > c.lost THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS winning_seasons_coached, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t.id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_series_wins, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM awards_players a JOIN players p ON a.playerid::text = p.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON a.playerid = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner JOIN draft d ON a.playerid = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar ap ON a.playerid = ap.playerid AND a.year = ap.season_id WHERE a.year >= 1995.17 AND a.year <= 1965.78 AND pt.year >= 1986.4 AND pt.year <= 2004.95 AND t.year >= 1975.0 AND t.year <= 1969.46 AND c.year >= 1988.97 AND c.year <= 1998.53 AND sp.year >= 1962.78 AND sp.year <= 1975.19 AND d.draftyear >= 1994.07 AND d.draftyear <= 2002.93 AND ap.season_id >= 1987.27 AND ap.season_id <= 1974.96 AND pt.points > 2022.69 AND pt.assists > 1992.2 AND pt.rebounds > 220.57 GROUP BY a.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 31547.57 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 9462.45 AND SUM(pt.rebounds) > 10668.58 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 6.35 AND COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) > 8.94 ORDER BY career_points DESC, career_assists DESC, career_rebounds DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying WHERE ap.award LIKE '%All-Star%' AND pa.season_id >= 2013.6 AND pa.season_id <= 1996.73 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 381.14 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1994 AND pt.year <= 1999 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM draft d WHERE d.playerid = p.playerid::integer AND d.draftyear > 1976 LIMIT 1) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 5405 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS career_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS career_rebounds, AVG(CAST(pt.points AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0)) AS points_per_minute, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(ap.season_id) AS last_allstar_season, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, AVG(d.draftoverall) AS avg_draft_position FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN draft d ON p.playerid = d.playerid::character varying JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid = aw.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 13 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1997 AND 1971 AND ap.season_id >= 1964 AND d.draftyear >= 1993 AND aw.year >= 1964 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 31890 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 7 ORDER BY career_points DESC, career_assists DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1971 AND pt.year <= 1966 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.height, p.weight HAVING SUM(pt.points) >= 24269 ORDER BY points_rank;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_points FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid JOIN players p ON pt.playerid = p.id WHERE t.year >= 2016 AND t.year <= 1973 AND pt.points > 4228 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 71247 ORDER BY t.tmid, t.year;

WITH player_performance AS ( SELECT pt.playerid, pt.year, pt.tmid, pt.points, pt.rebounds, pt.assists, pt.steals, pt.blocks, pt.minutes, pt.gp, ROUND(pt.points::numeric / NULLIF(pt.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS pts_per_36, ROUND((pt.fgmade::numeric / NULLIF(pt.fgattempted, 0)) * 100, 2) AS fg_pct, ROUND((pt.ftmade::numeric / NULLIF(pt.ftattempted, 0)) * 100, 2) AS ft_pct, ROUND((pt.threemade::numeric / NULLIF(pt.threeattempted, 0)) * 100, 2) AS three_pct, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.tmid ORDER BY pt.points DESC) AS team_points_rank, AVG(pt.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_points_3yr, SUM(pt.points + pt.rebounds + pt.assists) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS career_pts_reb_ast FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.minutes > 2408 AND pt.gp >= 59 ), team_performance AS ( SELECT t.year, t.tmid, t.won, t.lost, t.o_pts, t.d_pts, t.o_reb, t.d_reb, t.pace, ROUND(t.won::numeric / NULLIF(t.games, 0) * 100, 2) AS win_pct, t.o_pts - t.d_pts AS point_diff, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY t.won DESC) AS league_win_rank, LAG(t.won) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_wins FROM teams t WHERE t.games >= 64 AND t.year BETWEEN 1995 AND 2006 ), coach_performance AS ( SELECT c.year, c.tmid, c.coachid, c.won, c.lost, c.post_wins, c.post_losses, ROUND(c.won::numeric / NULLIF(c.won + c.lost, 0) * 100, 2) AS reg_season_win_pct, CASE WHEN c.post_wins + c.post_losses > 0 THEN ROUND(c.post_wins::numeric / NULLIF(c.post_wins + c.post_losses, 0) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END AS playoff_win_pct, SUM(c.won) OVER (PARTITION BY c.coachid ORDER BY c.year ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS career_wins FROM coaches c WHERE c.won >= 53 AND c.year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2005 ), award_winners AS ( SELECT ap.playerid, ap.year, ap.award, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ap.playerid) AS total_awards, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.year ORDER BY ap.award) AS award_rank_year FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.year >= 1992 ), draft_analysis AS ( SELECT d.playerid, d.draftyear, d.draftround, d.draftoverall, CASE WHEN d.draftround = 1 AND d.draftoverall <= 14 THEN 'Lottery' WHEN d.draftround = 1 THEN 'First Round' WHEN d.draftround = 2 THEN 'Second Round' ELSE 'Undrafted' END AS draft_tier, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.draftyear ORDER BY d.draftoverall) AS draft_position_rank FROM draft d WHERE d.draftyear BETWEEN 2011 AND 2023 ), all_star_performance AS ( SELECT asp.playerid, asp.season_id, asp.points, asp.rebounds, asp.assists, asp.steals, asp.blocks, ROUND(asp.points::numeric / NULLIF(asp.minutes, 0) * 36, 2) AS all_star_pts_per_36, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY asp.season_id ORDER BY asp.points DESC) AS all_star_points_rank FROM player_allstar asp WHERE asp.minutes > 22 AND asp.season_id >= 1998 ) SELECT pp.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pp.year, tp.tmid, tp.win_pct AS team_win_pct, pp.pts_per_36, pp.fg_pct, pp.ft_pct, pp.three_pct, pp.team_points_rank, pp.moving_avg_points_3yr, pp.career_pts_reb_ast, cp.coachid, cp.reg_season_win_pct AS coach_win_pct, cp.career_wins AS coach_career_wins, aw.total_awards, da.draft_tier, da.draft_position_rank, asp.all_star_pts_per_36, asp.all_star_points_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pp.year ORDER BY pp.pts_per_36 DESC) AS league_pts_per_36_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pp.year ORDER BY pp.points) AS points_percentile, AVG(pp.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pp.tmid, pp.year) AS team_avg_points, SUM(pp.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pp.playerid ORDER BY pp.year ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS career_total_points FROM player_performance pp JOIN players p ON pp.playerid = p.id::integer JOIN team_performance tp ON pp.tmid = tp.tmid::integer AND pp.year = tp.year JOIN coach_performance cp ON pp.tmid = cp.tmid::integer AND pp.year = cp.year LEFT JOIN award_winners aw ON pp.playerid = aw.playerid AND pp.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN draft_analysis da ON pp.playerid = da.playerid LEFT JOIN all_star_performance asp ON pp.playerid = asp.playerid AND pp.year = asp.season_id WHERE pp.pts_per_36 > 14.89 AND tp.win_pct >= 51.76 ORDER BY pp.pts_per_36 DESC, tp.win_pct DESC LIMIT 438;

SELECT a.award, COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) AS unique_players, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS unique_draft_years, SUM(ps.points) AS total_points, AVG(ps.rebounds) AS avg_rebounds, MAX(ps.assists) AS max_assists, MIN(ps.steals) AS min_steals, SUM(t.won) AS total_team_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS unique_teams, COUNT(DISTINCT s.tmidwinner) AS unique_series_winners, SUM(c.won) AS total_coach_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS unique_coaches FROM awards_players a JOIN players p ON a.playerid = p.id JOIN player_allstar ps ON p.id = ps.playerid AND a.year = ps.season_id JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND a.year = pt.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND a.lgid = t.lgid JOIN series_post s ON t.id = s.tmidwinner AND a.year = s.year JOIN coaches c ON t.id = c.tmid AND a.year = c.year AND t.lgid = c.lgid JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND a.year = d.draftyear WHERE a.year >= 2007 AND a.year <= 2018 AND ps.points > 77 AND t.won > 13 AND c.won > 12 AND d.draftyear >= 1954 AND d.draftyear <= 1965 GROUP BY a.award HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.playerid) > 825 AND COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) > 19 AND SUM(ps.points) > 94181 AND AVG(ps.rebounds) > '0.0' AND MAX(ps.assists) > 7 AND MIN(ps.steals) < 1 AND SUM(t.won) > 352 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) > 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.tmidwinner) > 3 AND SUM(c.won) > 160 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) > 33 ORDER BY unique_players DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, MAX(pt.points) AS max_team_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE (pa.points > 12.87 OR pa.rebounds > 5.31) AND NOT (pt.lgid = 'NBA' AND pt.year < 2009.02) AND pa.minutes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(pa.points) >= 9.95 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 9.75 ORDER BY avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE p.college LIKE '%University%' AND pt.year >= 1976 AND pt.year <= 1960 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 11962 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE (pt.points > 2395 OR pt.assists > 893) AND NOT (pt.turnovers > 317 AND pt.pf > 204) AND t.won >= 39 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2554 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) BETWEEN 23 AND 13 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT year FROM awards_players WHERE award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND year BETWEEN 2013 AND 2009 ) AND pt.points > 2656 ORDER BY pt.points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, 'award' AS category, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_count FROM players p JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 2020 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname UNION ALL SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS player_name, 'allstar' AS category, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS allstar_count FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid WHERE pa.season_id >= 1983 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname ORDER BY player_id, category;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_by_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.id = ac.coachid::integer AND c.year = ac.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser WHERE pt.points > 33 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2011 AND 2004 AND t.won > 72 AND pa.points > 0 AND c.won > 67 AND sp.year = pt.year GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 536 AND AVG(pt.points) > 8.0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 15 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_points_per_game DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year, pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_in_team_year FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE pt.year >= 1962 AND pt.year <= 2007 AND pt.gp > 41 AND t.won > 2 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 191 AND SUM(pt.assists) > 380 ORDER BY pt.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points AS regular_points, p2.points AS allstar_points, (p1.points - p2.points) AS point_diff, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p1.year ORDER BY (p1.points - p2.points) DESC) AS diff_rank FROM players_teams p1 JOIN player_allstar p2 ON p1.playerid = p2.playerid AND p1.year = p2.season_id WHERE p1.points > 1333.57 AND p2.points > 51.86 AND p1.year BETWEEN 1966.63 AND 2011.97 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points, p2.points HAVING COUNT(p1.stint) >= 3.36 ORDER BY point_diff DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1986 AND pt.year <= 1950 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 44390 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, SUM(ap.points) AS total_allstar_points, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE ap.season_id BETWEEN 2012 AND 2003 AND ap.points > 49 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 1 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS career_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points_per_allstar, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) AS allstar_seasons FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pa.season_id = ap.year WHERE pa.points > 1.4 AND ap.award = 'All-NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pa.season_id) >= 6.48 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer WHERE pt.points > 1616.5 AND t.year >= 1955.6 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 23996.97 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1970 AND pt.year <= 1981 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 4381 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_regular_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coaches c WHERE c.coachid::integer = p.id AND c.won > 15) AS coaching_wins_above_threshold, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pos ORDER BY AVG(pa.points) DESC) AS pos_points_rank FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.id AND t.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner OR t.id = sp.tmidloser WHERE p.firstseason >= 1960 AND p.lastseason <= 1964 AND pa.points > 96 AND pt.minutes > 3260 AND (t.won > 21 OR t.won IS NULL) AND sp.year BETWEEN 1999 AND 1990 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.pos, p.college, p.id HAVING AVG(pa.points) > 17.91 AND SUM(pt.points) > 39645 ORDER BY total_regular_points DESC, avg_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name AS team_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, MAX(pa.points) AS max_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.tmidwinner) AS championship_wins FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE (pt.points > 2766 OR pa.points > 16) AND (pt.year BETWEEN 1997 AND 2020) AND (t.won > 22 OR t.lost < 39) AND (p.firstseason <= 1979 AND p.lastseason >= 2007) AND (NOT (pt.minutes < 48 AND pt.gp < 64)) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 633 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 6 AND AVG(pt.minutes) BETWEEN 31 AND 43 ORDER BY total_points DESC, total_awards DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname || ' ' || p.lastname AS full_name, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer WHERE pt.points > 42.86 AND pt.year BETWEEN 1979 AND 2020 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 6 ORDER BY avg_points_per_game DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_allstar_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid = pa.playerid::character varying WHERE pa.season_id >= 2011.11 AND pa.season_id <= 1996.72 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 498.85 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_team_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid = pt.playerid::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 1994.72 AND pt.year <= 2019.83 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.lastname, p.firstname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 686.73 ORDER BY total_allstar_points DESC;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points AS regular_points, p2.points AS allstar_points, (p1.points - p2.points) AS point_diff FROM players_teams p1 JOIN player_allstar p2 ON p1.playerid = p2.playerid AND p1.year = p2.season_id WHERE p1.points > 1279 AND p2.points > 83 AND p1.year BETWEEN 2015 AND 1969 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.points, p2.points HAVING (p1.points - p2.points) > 1494 ORDER BY point_diff DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS total_awards, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, SUM(pa.points) AS allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS draft_years, SUM(c.won) AS coach_wins, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tmid ORDER BY SUM(pt.points)) AS points_percentile FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN series_post sp ON t.id = sp.tmidwinner AND pt.year = sp.year WHERE pt.points > 2875 AND pt.year BETWEEN 2020 AND 2008 AND pa.points > 22 AND t.won > 63 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2265 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 40 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 5 AND SUM(pa.points) > 19 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank ASC;
