SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.year, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, SUM(pt.assists) AS total_assists, SUM(pt.rebounds) AS total_rebounds, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.year >= 2006 THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS points_since_year, COUNT(CASE WHEN pt.lgid = 'NBA' THEN 1 END) AS games_in_league, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.minutes > 42 THEN pt.assists ELSE 0 END) AS high_minute_assists, (SUM(pt.points) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pt.fgattempted), 0)) AS career_fg_percentage, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank_in_league FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.playerid::integer = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1997 AND 1968 AND pt.minutes > 28 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 17463 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 17 ORDER BY total_points DESC, t.year;

SELECT c.coachid, t.tmid, t.name, ap.playerid, ap.award, ap.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_count, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.assists) AS avg_assists, SUM(pt.points) AS team_points, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS team_losses, SUM(t.o_pts) AS team_offensive_points, SUM(t.d_pts) AS team_defensive_points, GROUPING(c.coachid, t.tmid, ap.playerid, ap.award, ap.year) AS grouping_id FROM coaches c JOIN teams t ON c.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND c.year = t.year AND c.lgid = t.lgid JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid = ac.coachid::character varying AND c.year = ac.year JOIN awards_players ap ON ac.year = ap.year AND ac.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN player_allstar pa ON ap.playerid = pa.playerid AND ap.year = pa.season_id JOIN players_teams pt ON pa.playerid = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::character varying = sp.tmidwinner::character varying AND t.year = sp.year WHERE ac.award = 'Coach of the Year' AND ap.award IN ('MVP', 'All-NBA') AND pa.points > 40.96 AND t.won > 75.08 AND t.year BETWEEN 1973.5 AND 1995.59 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((c.coachid, t.tmid, t.name, ap.playerid, ap.award, ap.year), (c.coachid, t.tmid, t.name, ap.year), (c.coachid, t.tmid, t.name), (c.coachid, t.tmid), (c.coachid), ()) HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 198.8 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) >= 8.22 ORDER BY total_points DESC, team_wins DESC, grouping_id;

SELECT p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_seasons, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid AND ap.season_id = pt.year WHERE pt.year >= 1986 AND pt.year <= 2005 GROUP BY p.id, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING AVG(ap.points) > 13.44 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) >= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.points > 2766 AND t.year >= 1997 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 18230 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.lgid, SUM(p1.points) AS total_points, AVG(p2.points) AS avg_points_other_teams FROM players_teams p1 JOIN players_teams p2 ON p1.playerid = p2.playerid AND p1.year = p2.year AND p1.tmid != p2.tmid WHERE p1.points > 1170.09 AND p1.year BETWEEN 1954.63 AND 1992.31 GROUP BY p1.playerid, p1.year, p1.tmid, p1.lgid HAVING SUM(p1.points) > 8013.9 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE ap.season_id >= 2019 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) > 10 UNION ALL SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS team_seasons FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 2005 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) > 14 ORDER BY allstar_appearances DESC, playerid;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS distinct_allstar_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS distinct_team_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points FROM players p JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE ap.points > 6.91 AND pt.year >= 2013.47 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1060.2 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) AS stint_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, LAG(SUM(pt.points)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.playerid ORDER BY pt.year) AS prev_year_points FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id AND pt.year = t.year JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid AND pt.year >= d.draftyear LEFT JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1983 AND 1996 AND pt.gp >= 23 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards_players ap WHERE ap.playerid = p.id AND ap.year = pt.year AND ap.award IS NOT NULL ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_post sp WHERE (sp.tmidwinner = pt.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = pt.tmid) AND sp.year = pt.year AND sp.round = 'Finals' ) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 2508 AND AVG(pt.minutes) >= 24 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) <= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC, points_rank ASC;

SELECT ap.playerid, ap.year, ap.award, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ap.playerid ORDER BY ap.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS award_count_3yr_moving, AVG(pa.points) OVER (PARTITION BY pa.playerid ORDER BY pa.season_id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS avg_points_3game_moving FROM awards_players ap JOIN player_allstar pa ON ap.playerid = pa.playerid AND ap.year = pa.season_id JOIN players p ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid WHERE ap.year >= 1990.44 GROUP BY ap.playerid, ap.year, ap.award, pa.playerid, pa.season_id, pa.points ORDER BY ap.year DESC, award_count_3yr_moving DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pa.points) AS total_points_last_seasons, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_points_last_seasons FROM players p JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid WHERE pa.season_id >= 1968 AND pa.season_id <= 1960 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pa.points) > 337 ORDER BY total_points_last_seasons DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_points_per_game FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid WHERE pt.year >= 1977 AND pt.year <= 1993 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 11426 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid = ac.coachid::character varying JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner::character varying WHERE pt.year >= 1980 AND pa.season_id >= 1968 AND ap.year >= 1989 AND d.draftyear >= 1979 AND t.year >= 1963 AND c.year >= 1984 AND ac.year >= 1999 AND sp.year >= 1952 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 12979 AND AVG(pa.points) > 43 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) > 2 AND MAX(d.draftoverall) < 238 AND SUM(t.won) > 28 INTERSECT SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pa.points) AS avg_allstar_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS award_count, MAX(d.draftoverall) AS draft_position, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.id::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid::character varying AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_coaches ac ON c.coachid = ac.coachid::character varying JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidloser::character varying WHERE pt.year <= 2000 AND pa.season_id <= 1977 AND ap.year <= 1959 AND d.draftyear <= 1996 AND t.year <= 2003 AND c.year <= 2016 AND ac.year <= 2020 AND sp.year <= 1957 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) < 22690 AND AVG(pa.points) < 39 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) < 20 AND MAX(d.draftoverall) > 159 AND SUM(t.won) < 62 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(pt.points) AS career_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN awards_players ap ON pt.playerid = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM player_allstar pa WHERE pa.playerid = pt.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year AND pa.points > 17.52 ) AND pt.year BETWEEN 1985.62 AND 1985.68 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 29455.85 ORDER BY career_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost, SUM(pt.points) AS total_player_points, AVG(pt.points) AS avg_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playerid) AS unique_players, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY t.won DESC) AS win_rank FROM teams t JOIN players_teams pt ON t.tmid::integer = pt.tmid AND t.year = pt.year WHERE t.year >= 1957 AND t.year <= 1963 AND (t.won > 23 OR t.lost < 57) AND NOT (t.lgid = 'NBA' AND t.confid = 'East') GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.won, t.lost HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 1715 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.season_id) AS allstar_appearances, AVG(ap.points) AS avg_allstar_points, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid INNER JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN awards_players aw ON p.id = aw.playerid AND pt.year = aw.year WHERE pt.year >= 1991 AND pt.points >= 660 AND (ap.points IS NULL OR ap.points > 47) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) >= 5 AND SUM(pt.points) > 17175 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.playerid AS player_id, p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.stint = 1 THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS total_points_stint1, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.stint = 2 THEN pt.points ELSE 0 END) AS total_points_stint2, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played, MAX(CASE WHEN ap.season_id IS NOT NULL THEN ap.points ELSE NULL END) AS max_allstar_points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards_players ap2 WHERE ap2.playerid = p.id AND ap2.award LIKE '%MVP%') AS mvp_awards_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(pt.assists) DESC) AS assists_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid LEFT JOIN player_allstar ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.season_id LEFT JOIN awards_players awp ON p.id = awp.playerid AND pt.year = awp.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.id = d.playerid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON pt.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND pt.year = c.year LEFT JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::character varying = t.tmid AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 2014 AND 1962 AND pt.points > 4802 AND (t.won > 44 OR t.won IS NULL) GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, p.id HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 31092 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pt.tmid) >= 5 AND AVG(pt.assists) > 12 ORDER BY total_points_stint1 DESC, avg_assists DESC LIMIT 172;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.stint) AS stint_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.id = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid::integer AND t.year = c.year JOIN awards_players ap ON p.id = ap.playerid AND pt.year = ap.year JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.id = pa.playerid AND pt.year = pa.season_id WHERE pt.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT sp.year FROM series_post sp WHERE sp.w > 1 AND sp.l < 0 ) AND pt.minutes > 2920 AND pa.points > 35 AND c.won > 25 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 584 AND AVG(pt.minutes) > 20 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_minutes DESC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, CASE WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 7252.64 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(pt.points) >= 1047.74 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS scoring_category, AVG(pt.assists) AS avg_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.year) AS seasons_played FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year WHERE pt.year BETWEEN 1997 AND 1992 AND t.lgid = 'NBA' GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, pt.year, pt.tmid HAVING SUM(pt.points) > 3256.56 ORDER BY total_points DESC, pt.year ASC;

SELECT p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name AS team_name, pt.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_player_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award) AS distinct_coach_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) AS distinct_draft_years, SUM(pt.points) AS total_points, AVG(pt.minutes) AS avg_minutes, MAX(ap.year) AS latest_award_year, MIN(d.draftoverall) AS best_draft_position, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.year ORDER BY SUM(pt.points) DESC) AS points_rank_by_year, SUM(t.won) AS team_wins, SUM(t.lost) AS team_losses, (SUM(t.won) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(t.won) + SUM(t.lost), 0)) * 100 AS team_win_percentage FROM players p JOIN players_teams pt ON p.playerid::integer = pt.playerid JOIN teams t ON pt.tmid::integer = t.tmid::integer AND pt.year = t.year LEFT JOIN awards_players ap ON p.playerid::integer = ap.playerid AND ap.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN awards_coaches ac ON ac.coachid::integer = pt.tmid AND ac.year = pt.year LEFT JOIN draft d ON p.playerid::integer = d.playerid JOIN player_allstar pa ON p.playerid::integer = pa.playerid AND pa.season_id = pt.year JOIN series_post sp ON t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid::integer = sp.tmidloser JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid::integer = c.tmid AND c.year = pt.year WHERE pt.points > 470.67 AND pt.year >= 2001.41 AND pt.year <= 1983.54 AND t.won >= 8.89 GROUP BY p.playerid, p.firstname, p.lastname, t.name, pt.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 15.93 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award) <= 3.41 AND COUNT(DISTINCT d.draftyear) > 13.77 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank_by_year ASC, team_win_percentage DESC;
